monthly_reports.title: August 2026 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: August 2026 is the densest month in the archive so far, with 39 first appearances, and it reads less like a single trend than like a field splitting into clearly differentiated subproblems. Scientific benchmarking remains the largest surface, but the real story is the coordination among three others: trajectory evaluation is becoming a serious diagnostic discipline, long-horizon benchmarking is broadening from task completion to agent improvement loops, and evaluator reliability is starting to be benchmarked in its own right.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2026 年 8 月是目前档案里最密的一个月，一共 39 项新工作。它看起来已经不像某一条单一趋势在变强，而更像整个领域开始拆成几块彼此区分很清楚的子问题。Scientific benchmarking 还是最大头，但真正值得注意的是另外三条线也同时站起来了：trajectory evaluation 开始像一门独立的诊断方法学；long-horizon benchmark 不再只看任务做没做完，而开始把 agent improvement loop 也纳进来；evaluator reliability 这件事本身，也终于开始被系统性地测。

monthly_reports.title: July 2026 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: July 2026 is smaller than June by raw count, but more coherent. The month is dominated by one question: how do you evaluate agents in settings where the output has to answer to an external institution, physical process, or expert workflow rather than to a benchmark's internal scoring convention? The clearest examples are bridge inspection prioritization, physics literature review and proposal writing, structural reliability analysis, and world-model improvement under a fixed compute budget.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2026 年 7 月从数量上看没 6 月那么猛，但结构更集中。这个月主要围着一个问题转：如果 agent 的输出最后要对外部机构、物理过程、或者专家 workflow 负责，而不是只对 benchmark 自己那套打分规矩负责，那 evaluation 该怎么做？最清楚的例子就是桥梁检测排序、物理/天体物理文献综述与项目计划书、结构可靠度分析，以及在固定算力预算下改世界模型。

monthly_reports.title: June 2026 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: June 2026 is the month where this repository's expanded scope starts to look structurally justified rather than aspirational. The raw count is large — 36 first appearances — but the more important change is that the new work no longer reads like a flat list of domain benchmarks. Three lines become visible at once: scientific benchmarks are moving closer to real workflows and executable artifacts; skill work is becoming a measurement layer in its own right rather than a loose intuition about "agent capability"; and process-level evaluation is being attached to concrete control points such as validators, rubrics, and planning steps.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2026 年 6 月是一个很关键的月：这时候仓库前面刚扩出来的 scope，开始不像“先把 topic 开着，后面再慢慢填”，而是真有结构支撑了。表面上看是 36 项工作很多，但更重要的是，这批新文献已经不再像一排平铺的 benchmark 名单。你能同时看到三条主线长出来：scientific benchmark 更贴近真实 workflow 和可执行产物；skill 开始变成一层可以单独评、单独诊断的对象；process-level evaluation 也不再是泛泛而谈，而是开始落到 validator、rubric、planning step 这些真能卡住系统的控制点上。

monthly_reports.title: May 2026 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: May 2026 is a scale-up month just before the June breakout. AgentAtlas, AutoMat, BioXArena, AstroAlertBench, and the rest of the month's additions broaden the archive across arenas, agent ecosystems, and scientific subfields, while keeping the focus on evaluation setups that can support repeated diagnosis and comparison rather than one-off demos.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2026 年 5 月是 6 月那次明显爆发前的一个 scale-up month。AgentAtlas、AutoMat、BioXArena、AstroAlertBench 以及这个月其他新增，把仓库往 arena、agent ecosystem 和更多 scientific subfield 上同时铺开，但焦点还是没变：要的是能支持反复诊断和比较的 evaluation setup，而不是一次性 demo。

monthly_reports.title: April 2026 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: April 2026 is a plan-and-failure month. AutoResearchBench, FinTrace, Plan-RewardBench, plan-compliance evaluation, Frontier-Eng, and the astrophysical 'plausible but wrong' study all separate questions that used to blur together: Was the plan good, was the trace faithful, and did the system fail because of reasoning, execution, or the evaluator itself?
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2026 年 4 月可以直接叫 plan-and-failure month。AutoResearchBench、FinTrace、Plan-RewardBench、plan-compliance evaluation、Frontier-Eng，再加上那篇天体物理里的“plausible but wrong”研究，都在把过去糊在一起的几个问题拆开：计划本身好不好、trace 靠不靠谱、以及系统失败到底是 reasoning、execution 还是 evaluator 自己出了问题。

monthly_reports.title: March 2026 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: March 2026 is a process-instrumentation month. AgentProcessBench, CaP-X, CeProBench, AEC-Bench, and the controlled astrophysics workflow study all make the same underlying move: they try to expose intermediate process quality so that failure analysis does not have to start from a single final score.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2026 年 3 月是一个很典型的 process-instrumentation month。AgentProcessBench、CaP-X、CeProBench、AEC-Bench 和那篇受控天体物理 workflow 研究，本质上都在做同一个动作：把中间过程质量露出来，这样 failure analysis 就不用再从一个孤零零的最终分数开始猜。

monthly_reports.title: February 2026 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: February 2026 pushes evaluation deeper into institutional, biomedical, and safety-constrained settings. AIRS-Bench, AutoBM/BMEval, FIRE-Bench, ChemCensor/CREED, and the other additions all care about what happens when an agent has to work inside stronger domain rules, policy boundaries, or reviewer controls.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2026 年 2 月把 evaluation 更深地推进到了 institutional、biomedical 和 safety-constrained settings 里。AIRS-Bench、AutoBM/BMEval、FIRE-Bench、ChemCensor/CREED 以及这个月其他工作，关心的都是同一个问题：当 agent 必须在更强的领域规则、policy boundary 或 reviewer control 之内工作时，系统会怎么变。

monthly_reports.title: January 2026 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: January 2026 is the month where exploratory science, long-document workflows, and step-level judging clearly meet. LongDA, Terminal-Bench Science, HeurekaBench, MolecularIQ, ToolPRMBench, and MetaAct-RL together show the archive treating open-ended discovery, long-horizon evidence gathering, and intermediate decision quality as one connected evaluation problem.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2026 年 1 月是 exploratory science、long-document workflow 和 step-level judging 明显接到一起的月份。LongDA、Terminal-Bench Science、HeurekaBench、MolecularIQ、ToolPRMBench 和 MetaAct-RL 放一块看，很清楚地说明：这份档案已经开始把 open-ended discovery、long-horizon evidence gathering 和中间决策质量当成同一个连着的评测问题来处理。

monthly_reports.title: December 2025 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: December 2025 feels like a maturity month for engineering-heavy scientific evaluation. AInsteinBench, FEM-Bench, Hydro-SE Bench, HiSciBench, CASCADE, and the other additions keep the focus on executable workflows, structured physical reasoning, and end-to-end systems that are expensive to fake with surface fluency alone.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2025 年 12 月很像 engineering-heavy scientific evaluation 的一个 maturity month。AInsteinBench、FEM-Bench、Hydro-SE Bench、HiSciBench、CASCADE 这些工作继续把焦点压在可执行 workflow、结构化物理推理和端到端系统上，这些东西都不是靠表面流畅度就能轻易糊过去的。

monthly_reports.title: November 2025 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: November 2025 is where cost and operational risk become hard constraints rather than side metrics. BATS, CostBench, BridgeEQA, the HAZOP evaluation, and EnvTrace all ask whether an agent can stay useful when budgets, safety procedures, instrument traces, and real inspection evidence limit what counts as a good action.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2025 年 11 月开始，cost 和 operational risk 不再只是 side metrics，而是硬约束。BATS、CostBench、BridgeEQA、那篇 HAZOP evaluation 和 EnvTrace 都在问同一件事：当预算、安全流程、instrument trace 和真实检查证据都在限制什么动作才算好动作时，agent 还能不能保持有用。

monthly_reports.title: October 2025 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: October 2025 is a second breakout month, but this time the added breadth comes with more explicit diagnostic pressure. Scientific benchmarks still dominate, yet CUARewardBench, Hard2Verify, TempoBench, Enconda-bench, and PTA-GRPO make step-level judgment, verifier quality, and high-level planning hard to separate from the benchmark story.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2025 年 10 月算是第二次 breakout month，但这次扩出来的 breadth 带着更明显的诊断压力。Scientific benchmark 还是主体，可 CUARewardBench、Hard2Verify、TempoBench、Enconda-bench 和 PTA-GRPO 已经把 step-level judgment、verifier quality 和 high-level planning 硬塞进 benchmark 主叙事里了，想分都分不开。

monthly_reports.title: September 2025 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: September 2025 reads like an engineering-and-tooling month. AECBench, CFDLLMBench, AstroMMBench, gammapyGPT, and CritPt all put pressure on whether agents can operate domain software, scientific pipelines, or multi-step engineering workflows instead of merely discussing them.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2025 年 9 月很像一个 engineering-and-tooling month。AECBench、CFDLLMBench、AstroMMBench、gammapyGPT 和 CritPt 共同加压的，都是同一个问题：agent 到底能不能真正操作领域软件、科学 pipeline 或多步工程 workflow，而不是只会围着它们说。

monthly_reports.title: August 2025 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: August 2025 is a small month, but it is one of the sharpest months for benchmark design. CODE2BENCH, CEQuest, CMPhysBench, FGBench, and QCBench all focus on making the score harder to game, either by dynamic task construction or by forcing domain-specific quantitative and structural reasoning.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2025 年 8 月虽然量小，但在 benchmark design 上特别锋利。CODE2BENCH、CEQuest、CMPhysBench、FGBench 和 QCBench 都在做同一件事：让分数更难被糊弄出来，要么靠动态构题，要么逼模型真的做领域里的 quantitative 和 structural reasoning。

monthly_reports.title: July 2025 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: July 2025 is unusually reflective about who gets to define good performance. The survey, CosmoPaperQA, EngDesign, DrafterBench, and the astronomy criteria paper all push evaluation closer to expert review criteria, proposal quality, and real literature work instead of benchmark-native shortcuts.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2025 年 7 月有个很明显的特点，就是它特别在意“到底谁来定义什么叫做好”。那篇 survey、CosmoPaperQA、EngDesign、DrafterBench 和那篇 astronomy criteria paper，都在把 evaluation 往 expert review criteria、proposal quality 和真实文献工作上拉，而不是继续跟着 benchmark 自己的捷径走。

monthly_reports.title: June 2025 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: June 2025 centers on professional-discipline evaluation under stronger execution and cost constraints. MedAgentGym, CVDP, DeepResearch Bench, SDBench, ChemEBench, and the structural and foundation-design papers all ask what it takes to score agents in medicine, hardware, civil engineering, and research when running the workflow matters more than giving a plausible answer.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2025 年 6 月的中心，是在更强 execution 和 cost 约束下做 professional-discipline evaluation。MedAgentGym、CVDP、DeepResearch Bench、SDBench、ChemEBench，再加上那几篇结构分析和地基设计工作，都在追同一个问题：到了医疗、硬件、土木和研究这些场景里，如果真正重要的是 workflow 跑没跑通，而不是答案像不像，那 agent 到底该怎么打分。

monthly_reports.title: May 2025 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: May 2025 is a breadth explosion with an early hint of the repository's later development-loop themes. AstroVisBench, BAISBench, MLE-Dojo, MLR-Bench, RoboFAC, Traxgen, and Beyond 'Aha!' span astronomy, biomedicine, machine-learning research, failure analysis, and post-training, but they keep returning to the same idea that evaluation should guide improvement rather than only rank outputs.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2025 年 5 月是一次很明显的 breadth explosion，而且已经能提前看见仓库后面那条 development-loop 主线。AstroVisBench、BAISBench、MLE-Dojo、MLR-Bench、RoboFAC、Traxgen 和 Beyond 'Aha!' 横跨天文、生物医学、机器学习研究、failure analysis 和 post-training，但它们最后都在往同一句话收：evaluation 不该只负责排结果，还得负责指导怎么改。

monthly_reports.title: April 2025 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: April 2025 is a verification-hardening month. FEABench, HLS-Eval, LLM-SRBench, PHYBench, and AgentRewardBench split one problem into three parts: can the agent do the task, can the benchmark verify the result, and can the evaluator be trusted when verification is not deterministic?
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2025 年 4 月可以直接叫 verification-hardening month。FEABench、HLS-Eval、LLM-SRBench、PHYBench 和 AgentRewardBench 其实都在拆同一个问题：agent 会不会做、benchmark 能不能验、以及当验证不是确定性的时，evaluator 本身还能不能信。

monthly_reports.title: March 2025 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: March 2025 is a framing month rather than a scale month. The agent-evaluation survey, ASIMOV, CoLA, AstroChart, and LLM-EPANET all sharpen the questions of scope, abstraction level, and environment design that later topic expansions in the repository depend on.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2025 年 3 月不是靠规模取胜的，而是一个 framing month。那篇 agent-evaluation survey、ASIMOV、CoLA、AstroChart 和 LLM-EPANET 都在把 scope、abstraction level 和 environment design 这些问题磨得更清楚，后面仓库加 topic，其实就靠这些问题先站稳了。

monthly_reports.title: February 2025 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: February 2025 is where scientific-agent environments and long-horizon evaluation start to meet. MLGym, BixBench, EmbodiedBench, Robotouille, PDE-Controller, and TPBench push the repository beyond static problem sets into interactive research, embodied planning, and tool-grounded scientific tasks.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2025 年 2 月是 scientific-agent environments 和 long-horizon evaluation 开始接头的月份。MLGym、BixBench、EmbodiedBench、Robotouille、PDE-Controller 和 TPBench 一起把仓库从静态题库往外推，推到 interactive research、具身 planning 和 tool-grounded scientific tasks 这些地方。

monthly_reports.title: January 2025 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: January 2025 is a breadth month that mixes frontier general exams with domain-heavy scientific tasks. Humanity's Last Exam, Gravity-Bench, thermodynamics problem solving, and materials hypothesis generation show the archive stretching from broad capability ceilings to discipline-specific scientific reasoning.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2025 年 1 月是一个很典型的 breadth month，一头连着 frontier 级的 general exams，一头连着领域味很重的 scientific tasks。Humanity's Last Exam、Gravity-Bench、热力学问题求解和 materials hypothesis generation 放一块看，能看到这份档案开始同时往“能力上限”与“学科内推理”两个方向扩。

monthly_reports.title: December 2024 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: December 2024 reads like a transition from static benchmarks to live and process-aware evaluation. ProcessBench, Aviary, LiveIdeaBench, SafeAgentBench, and AnalogXpert all care about how a system operates over time, not just whether it can return a polished answer once.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2024 年 12 月看起来很像一次从静态 benchmark 往 live、往 process-aware evaluation 的过渡。ProcessBench、Aviary、LiveIdeaBench、SafeAgentBench 和 AnalogXpert 共同关心的，都是系统在时间里怎么运行，而不只是它能不能一次性吐出一个像样答案。

monthly_reports.title: November 2024 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: November 2024 is small but methodologically mixed in a useful way. RE-Bench, OpenCATP, RoboSpatial, MaCBench, and EEE-Bench show evaluation reaching into budgets, embodied geometry, and coordinated manipulation, making resource limits and physical context harder to treat as afterthoughts.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2024 年 11 月量不大，但方法上混得很有用。RE-Bench、OpenCATP、RoboSpatial、MaCBench 和 EEE-Bench 把 evaluation 往预算、具身几何和协同操作这些地方都伸进去了，于是 resource limits 和 physical context 这两件事越来越没法再当成事后备注。

monthly_reports.title: October 2024 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: October 2024 is the first broad breakout month for agent evaluation across engineering, science, and embodied systems. MLE-bench, DevAI, ControlEval, FVEval, Embodied Agent Interface, and PARTNR make it clear that realistic evaluation now has to account for workflows, simulators, judges, and long-horizon state together.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2024 年 10 月是 agent evaluation 第一次真正大面积铺开的 breakout month，工程、科学和具身系统这几边同时扩开。MLE-bench、DevAI、ControlEval、FVEval、Embodied Agent Interface 和 PARTNR 放在一起看，很清楚地说明一件事：realistic evaluation 现在得把 workflow、simulator、judge 和 long-horizon state 一起算进去。

monthly_reports.title: September 2024 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: September 2024 is a decomposition month. CORE-Bench, SUPER, DSBench, and ChemEval all push against single-number evaluation by separating tool use, subskills, or domain-specific reasoning layers that later become central to the repository's taxonomy.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2024 年 9 月是一个很典型的 decomposition 月。CORE-Bench、SUPER、DSBench 和 ChemEval 都在顶同一个方向：别再用一个总分把东西糊住，而是把 tool use、subskill 和领域推理层拆开来看，这些拆法后来也慢慢长成了仓库 taxonomy 的骨架。

monthly_reports.title: August 2024 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: August 2024 brings planning and execution closer to real operational settings. TransportBench, SimBench, BLADE, and PEOA all care about structured action under practical constraints, whether the agent is planning transport, running simulations, or reasoning over embodied tasks.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2024 年 8 月把 planning 和 execution 又往真实操作场景里推近了一步。TransportBench、SimBench、BLADE 和 PEOA 共同关心的，都是 practical constraints 下的结构化行动，不管 agent 面对的是运输规划、仿真运行，还是具身任务里的推理。

monthly_reports.title: July 2024 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: July 2024 is the first month where domain-authentic scientific benchmarking clearly dominates. AstroMLab 1, LAB-Bench, ElecBench, MolPuzzle, and SciCode all let the field define the task surface, which makes the month feel like a move from science-flavored QA to science-shaped evaluation.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2024 年 7 月是第一次让 domain-authentic scientific benchmarking 明显占上风的月份。AstroMLab 1、LAB-Bench、ElecBench、MolPuzzle 和 SciCode 都是在让领域本身来定义任务表面，所以这个月看起来很像一次真正的转向：从“带科学术语皮的 QA”，转到“按科学工作本身来长出来的评测”。

monthly_reports.title: June 2024 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: June 2024 pushes evaluation toward external verification rather than plausible answers. AssertionBench, GenoTEX, MatText, BioKGBench, and NATURAL PLAN each add an oracle, simulator, or constraint structure that makes it harder for a system to score well by sounding convincing.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2024 年 6 月最明显的推进，是把 evaluation 往外部验证上推，而不是停在“答案听起来像对”。AssertionBench、GenoTEX、MatText、BioKGBench 和 NATURAL PLAN 都给系统加上了 oracle、simulator 或约束结构，于是模型想靠说得顺就拿高分，这条路越来越走不通。

monthly_reports.title: May 2024 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: May 2024 is where real professional workflows begin to matter. AgentClinic, AnalogCoder, RTL-Repo, and CPsyExam expose a common gap between text that looks right and artifacts or decisions that actually survive clinical, circuit, or hardware evaluation.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2024 年 5 月开始，真实专业 workflow 明显变重要了。AgentClinic、AnalogCoder、RTL-Repo 和 CPsyExam 共同暴露出一个很实在的断层：文本看着像对，不等于临床判断、电路设计或者硬件产物真能过检。

monthly_reports.title: April 2024 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: April 2024 is a two-work contrast that shows how much a headline score depends on the interaction surface. ChemBench asks for chemistry knowledge in a static benchmark, while OSWorld evaluates real computer use over long action sequences, making 'model capability' and 'agent capability' visibly non-interchangeable.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2024 年 4 月只有两项工作，但对比特别有力，因为它把一件事讲透了：headline score 到底说明什么，很大程度上取决于交互表面。ChemBench 评的是静态 chemistry knowledge，OSWorld 评的是长动作链上的真实 computer use，所以“模型能力”和“agent 能力”从这个月开始就不该再混着说。

monthly_reports.title: March 2024 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: March 2024 is small but important because BrainBench brings a full discipline into scope without pretending that general QA is enough. The benchmark anchors neuroscience evaluation in expert-authored questions across molecular, systems, cognitive, and clinical levels, making field breadth part of the measurement problem.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2024 年 3 月规模不大，但很重要，因为 BrainBench 把一个完整学科拉进来了，而且没有假装通用 QA 就够用。它把神经科学评测扎在专家编写的问题上，覆盖分子、系统、认知和临床几个层次，于是“学科内部到底有多宽”本身也成了评测问题的一部分。

monthly_reports.title: February 2024 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: February 2024 is the archive's first clean planning month. TravelPlanner and LoTa-Bench separate two questions that later stay distinct: can an agent satisfy real-world constraints while making a plan, and can that plan survive long embodied execution?
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2024 年 2 月是这份档案里第一次把 planning 单独拎清的月份。TravelPlanner 和 LoTa-Bench 一起把后来一直要分开的两件事摆出来了：agent 制定计划时能不能满足现实约束，以及这个计划放进长时程具身执行以后还能不能站得住。

monthly_reports.title: January 2024 Monthly Report
monthly_reports.summary: January 2024 is a one-paper launch month, but it already sets a durable standard for the archive. AgentBoard treats partial progress, subgoal completion, and error propagation as evaluation targets, so the very first month argues that agent evaluation should explain where a run broke instead of collapsing everything into final accuracy.
monthly_reports.zh_summary: 2024 年 1 月虽然只有一项工作，但它一上来就把这份档案后来反复坚持的标准立住了。AgentBoard 不只看最后答没答对，还把部分进展、subgoal 完成度和错误传播都纳进评测，所以这个月一开头就在说：agent evaluation 不能只剩一个最终正确率，还得说清这趟 run 是在哪儿坏掉的。

works.title: R³-Bench
works.overview: R³-Bench evaluates resource-rational reasoning: a model faces a suite of six problems that must share one budget, so success depends on allocating effort across problems rather than solving each in isolation. Its distinguishing move is to calibrate suite performance against the same model's demonstrated single-problem competence, using matched response curves to build an offline empirical oracle over observed successes.
works.summary: Resource rationality, borrowed from cognitive science, asks how an agent should allocate limited computation to maximise expected value. The authors observe that most reasoning and agent benchmarks hand out independent per-task budgets, and that the shared-budget studies which do exist never calibrate suite performance against what the same model demonstrably can do on those same problems alone. R³-Bench supplies that missing reference. Every problem is first run in isolation across a grid of budget levels, five runs per level, producing an empirical response curve — the observed success rate as a function of budget. A knapsack solver then picks one budget level per problem, including the option of allocating zero, subject to the shared constraint, maximising expected correct answers. The result is not a policy an agent could execute; it is an offline diagnostic that says what the model's own demonstrated competence would have been worth under perfect allocation. The gap between that oracle and the model's actual contest score is the paper's central quantity, and it is large and near-universal.
works.domains_text: **Mathematics** and **Computer Science.** Both slices are identifiable and sized: 300 mathematics problems from Omni-MATH and MathNet, and 300 competitive-programming problems from LiveCodeBench Pro. The third domain, abstract reasoning from Reasoning Gym, is a synthetic reasoning substrate rather than a scientific field and earns no domain assignment.

zh.overview: R³-Bench 评估的是资源理性推理：模型面对的是一组六道题，它们必须共用一份预算，因此成败取决于如何在题目之间分配算力，而不是逐题孤立求解。它的独到之处在于把套题表现校准到同一模型在这些题上已展示出的单题水平——用匹配的响应曲线，在实际观察到的成功之上构造一个离线经验 oracle。
zh.summary: 资源理性这一概念借自认知科学，问的是 agent 应当如何分配有限算力以最大化期望价值。作者观察到，多数推理与 agent benchmark 都为每道题单发预算；而现有的共享预算研究，从来没有把套题表现校准到同一模型在同一批题上确实做得到的水平。R³-Bench 补上了这个缺失的参照。每道题先在隔离状态下按一组预算档位各跑五次，得到一条经验响应曲线——成功率随预算的变化。随后由一个背包求解器为每道题挑一个预算档（含「分配为零」这一选项），在共享约束下最大化期望答对数。得到的并不是 agent 能执行的策略，而是一个离线诊断量：它说明这个模型自己已展示的能力，在完美分配下本可以值多少分。这个 oracle 与模型实际比赛得分之间的差距，就是全文的核心量——而它既大又近乎无例外。

works.title: PACE-Bench
works.overview: PACE-Bench (Physics Adaptation via Code Evolution) evaluates self-evolving agents on recovery after the world changes underneath them. Each of its 144 tasks pairs a source physics environment with a mutated target environment sharing the same goal and interface, where a code-driven design that succeeds in the source fails in the target and the agent must iteratively repair it using diagnostic sandbox feedback within a bounded attempt budget.
works.summary: Existing evaluations of self-evolving agents optimise under fixed execution conditions and never test what happens when those conditions change. PACE-Bench closes that gap by construction. A task begins from a working solution — a Python program defining `build_agent()` for structure assembly and `agent_action()` for control logic — that succeeds in a source Box2D environment. The target environment shares the goal and the interface but mutates physical parameters such as friction, material strength, gravity or force limits, and the source design fails there. The agent must adapt the program into a working target design, guided by structured diagnostic feedback that reports what went wrong without prescribing a fix. The authors compare ten self-evolving methods from four paradigms and find the benchmark far from saturated. Two results shape the paper's argument: simulator-grounded reflection proves more reliable than unverified self-revision, and — in the study's most pointed experiment — telling the agent exactly which physical variables changed does not raise the ceiling, which locates the bottleneck in mechanism redesign rather than parameter inference.
works.domains_text: **Physics.** The six task families are physics domains in the literal sense — statics, kinematics, dynamics, granular and fluid interaction, control, and a non-standard-physics family — and success requires reasoning about mechanism under changed physical parameters, verified by rigid-body simulation. No engineering co-domain is assigned: the designs are simulated 2D mechanisms rather than artifacts evaluated against any engineering standard or fabrication constraint.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: PACE-Bench（Physics Adaptation via Code Evolution）考察自演化 agent 在世界从脚下变掉之后能否恢复。它的 144 个任务各自把一个源物理环境与一个变异后的目标环境配成一对，两者目标与接口相同；在源环境中成功的代码化设计到了目标环境中会失败，agent 必须在有限的尝试预算内，借助沙箱的诊断反馈把它逐步修好。
zh.summary: 现有的自演化 agent 评估都在固定执行条件下做优化，从不检验条件变了之后会怎样。PACE-Bench 从构造上堵住这个缺口。一个任务的起点是一份能用的解——一段定义 `build_agent()`（结构装配）与 `agent_action()`（控制逻辑）的 Python 程序——它在源 Box2D 环境中是成功的。目标环境的目标与接口都不变，只变异摩擦系数、材料强度、重力、力上限这类物理参数，而源设计在那里会失败。agent 要把程序改造成在目标环境中可用的设计，依据是一份结构化诊断反馈：它报告哪里出了问题，但不给出该怎么改。作者比较了来自四种范式的十种自演化方法，结果显示这个 benchmark 远未饱和。两个结果撑起了全文的论点：有仿真器兜底的反思比未经验证的自我修改更可靠；而在全文最扎眼的一次实验里，把究竟哪些物理量变了原原本本告诉 agent，也抬不高天花板——这把瓶颈定位在机制的重新设计上，而不是参数的推断上。

works.title: AutoResearchEval
works.overview: AutoResearchEval is a diagnostic evaluation of end-to-end autonomous research agents over 100 tasks grounded in published frontier science, spanning the full research lifecycle from ideation to review. Rather than ranking systems by a final score, it annotates 800 complete trajectories at the process level and organises the results into ARFT, a taxonomy of 45 empirically grounded failure patterns.
works.summary: The authors observe that existing AutoResearch evaluations report performance without revealing process: tasks are narrowly scoped, scores say nothing about where an agent broke down, and failure diagnoses lack systematic coverage or visibility into intermediate artifacts. AutoResearchEval is built to answer the diagnostic question instead. Tasks are grounded in published frontier science and cover six lifecycle stages, and each of eight harness–model combinations is run over all 100 tasks to produce 800 trajectories with process-level annotation. Those annotations are consolidated into ARFT, which cross-classifies failures by lifecycle stage and by root cause. To make fine-grained attribution affordable at this scale, the authors build a human-calibrated agent-as-a-judge pipeline that inspects complete trajectories and intermediate artifacts rather than final answers. The headline finding is convergent: failure patterns across every configuration point to a missing metacognitive loop — the ability to check produced output against gathered evidence, revise when it does not hold, and question whether the chosen path was sound.
works.domains_text: The benchmark spans **seven scientific domains**, but the paper reports their distribution only graphically and gives no per-domain task counts. Because a multi-field benchmark earns a domain on this repository's domain axis only when the slice is both identifiable and sized, **no canonical domain is assigned** pending a numeric breakdown from the authors.

zh.overview: AutoResearchEval 是对端到端自主研究 agent 的一次诊断式评估：100 个任务取材于已发表的前沿科学，覆盖从构思到复查的完整研究生命周期。它不按最终分数给系统排名，而是对 800 条完整轨迹做过程级标注，并把结果整理成 ARFT——一套由实证归纳出的 45 种失效模式。
zh.summary: 作者观察到，现有的 AutoResearch 评估只报告表现，不透露过程：任务范围窄，分数说不出 agent 在哪一步垮掉，失效诊断既缺乏系统覆盖，也看不到中间产物。AutoResearchEval 转而正面回答诊断问题。任务取材于已发表的前沿科学，覆盖六个生命周期阶段；八种 harness–模型组合各自跑完全部 100 个任务，产出 800 条带过程级标注的轨迹。这些标注被归并成 ARFT，按生命周期阶段与根因两个维度交叉归类失效。为了让这种细粒度归因在这一规模上还负担得起，作者构建了一条经人类校准的 agent-as-a-judge 流水线，它检查的是完整轨迹与中间产物，而不是最终答案。核心发现是收敛的：所有配置下的失效模式都指向同一处缺口——缺少元认知回路，也就是把产出与所掌握的证据相互核对、发现对不上就修正、并回头质疑所走路径是否站得住的能力。

works.title: AI Research Preference Models
works.overview: AI Research Preference Models (RPMs) predict which of an AI research agent's candidate solutions are worth the GPU time to execute, so a fixed execution budget can be spent on the candidates most likely to pay off. Two variants are built from frozen pretrained language models with no task-specific training — one that reasons over plans and code alone, and one that first runs small pilot experiments — and both are integrated into the AIRA-dojo search agent and measured on AIRS-Bench.
works.summary: The framing problem is an asymmetry in cost: an AI research agent can write a candidate solution in minutes, but finding out whether it works takes hours to days of GPU time. An agent can therefore always propose more candidates than it can afford to run, which makes its *research preference* — how it allocates a fixed execution budget across candidates — a determinant of progress independent of its ability to generate good ideas. RPMs supply that preference. The inference-only variant reasons over candidate plans, candidate code, and the prior executed solutions with their validation scores, and picks without running anything. The agentic variant additionally gets a sandboxed clone of the execution environment and runs small-scale pilot experiments — a multi-turn agent with python, bash and submit tools under a five-minute cap — before deciding. Both are dropped into AIRA-dojo's child-creation step, where the search generates 15 candidates per step under Draft, Improve and Debug operators. The result is reported as both a score gain and a budget saving, and the paper measures how far below an oracle its selections fall.
works.domains_text: **AI & Machine Learning Research.** The work being selected among is machine-learning research work — model and training changes scored by held-out task performance — and the contribution is measured entirely as AIRS-Bench normalized score. No science co-domain is assigned: although AIRS-Bench itself spans bioinformatics and mathematics, this paper reports no per-domain breakdown of its 20 tasks, and its two named per-task results (WinoGrande, SVAMP) are single tasks rather than a sized domain slice.

zh.overview: AI Research Preference Models（RPM）预测 AI 研究 agent 提出的哪些候选方案值得花 GPU 时间跑一遍，好把固定的执行预算花在最可能有回报的候选上。两个变体都建立在冻结的预训练语言模型之上、不做任何任务特定训练——一个只对方案与代码作推理，另一个会先跑小规模试点实验——并双双接入 AIRA-dojo 搜索 agent，在 AIRS-Bench 上测量。
zh.summary: 问题的出发点是一处成本上的不对称：AI 研究 agent 几分钟就能写出一个候选方案，但要弄清它管不管用，得花上数小时乃至数天的 GPU 时间。于是 agent 提出的候选永远多过它跑得起的数量，这就使它的**研究偏好**——如何在候选之间分配固定的执行预算——成为一个独立于「能否想出好点子」的进展决定因素。RPM 提供的正是这种偏好。只读式变体对候选方案、候选代码，以及此前已执行方案及其验证分数作推理，一次实验都不跑就作出取舍。agentic 变体则额外拿到执行环境的沙箱副本，先跑小规模试点实验——一个可用 python、bash 与提交工具的多轮 agent，上限五分钟——再作决定。两者都被接入 AIRA-dojo 的子节点生成环节；该搜索在 Draft、Improve 与 Debug 三类算子下每步生成 15 个候选。结果既报告为分数提升，也报告为预算节省，论文还测量了自己的选择离 oracle 还差多远。

works.title: SkillShapley
works.overview: SkillShapley is a step-level attribution framework for agent skills: it models the contribution of each step inside a skill as a Shapley value and estimates those values under a boundary-adaptive sampling scheme designed for discretized benchmark rewards.
works.summary: Agent skills are procedural instructions that let a language agent carry out long tasks such as document processing or coding, and they are written either by hand or distilled from execution traces — in both cases with little evidence about which of their steps actually matter. SkillShapley formulates skill-step attribution as Shapley-value contribution estimation over coalitions of steps, then estimates those values in two phases motivated by two empirical observations: benchmark rewards are discretized and therefore produce sharp performance cliffs, and interactions between steps are largely additive rather than synergistic. A warmup phase builds a cache with broad stratum coverage and identifies which strata remain uncertain; an adaptive phase then repeatedly evaluates the single most informative unevaluated configuration, scored by how many high-priority one-flip edges it forms with configurations already cached.
works.domains_text: No canonical science or engineering domain. The evaluated skills cover document generation, flexible job-shop scheduling optimization, and dialogue graph parsing — general-purpose agent procedures rather than tasks in a science or engineering field, and the object of evaluation is the attribution estimator rather than the skills' subject matter.

zh.overview: SkillShapley 是面向 agent skill 的步骤级归因框架：把 skill 内部每一步的贡献建模为 Shapley 值，并用一套针对离散化 benchmark 奖励设计的边界自适应采样方案来估计这些值。
zh.summary: agent skill 是一套程序性说明，让语言 agent 得以完成文档处理、编码这类长任务；它们或由人工编写，或从执行轨迹中蒸馏而来——两种来源都几乎没有留下证据说明其中哪些步骤真正要紧。SkillShapley 把 skill 步骤归因表述为在步骤联盟上估计 Shapley 值贡献，再分两个阶段完成估计，依据是两条经验观察：benchmark 奖励是离散化的，因而会形成陡峭的性能悬崖；步骤之间的交互大体可加，而非协同。预热阶段先建起一个分层覆盖面广的缓存，并找出哪些层仍不确定；自适应阶段随后反复挑出信息量最大的那个尚未评估的配置去评估——信息量按它与缓存中已有配置之间能形成多少条高优先级的一位翻转边来打分。

works.title: SkillMisevo-Bench
works.overview: SkillMisevo-Bench is a frozen benchmark, paired with the lifecycle-aware harness SkillMisevo-Gym, for measuring *skill misevolution*: the failure in which a self-improving LLM agent distils an unsafe success into its persistent skill library, so that the unsafe procedure is retrieved and re-executed long after the triggering input is gone.
works.summary: Skill evolution converts interaction trajectories into executable, transferable procedures, but the update objective is task outcome rather than procedure safety, so compromised experience can be generalized into reusable policy. Existing benchmarks measure current behavior or static artifacts and therefore cannot say whether risk was created at authoring, at retrieval, or only at later execution. SkillMisevo-Gym supplies the missing instrumentation — it versions the skill library across agent frameworks, isolates it from conversation, workspace, cache and native memory, records evolution inputs, diffs and retrievals, and replays a clean session in which only the agent-authored `SKILL.md` survives the reset. SkillMisevo-Bench fixes the task design and the metrics on top of that harness, and the paper adds SafeEvolve, a method-agnostic governance wrapper applied at skill write and reuse boundaries.
works.domains_text: General-purpose agentic operations — coding, web use, tool invocation and automation harms inherited from the AgentHazard task specification. No canonical science or engineering domain is targeted; the evaluated object is the safety of persistent skill adaptation.

zh.overview: SkillMisevo-Bench 是一个冻结的 benchmark，配套生命周期感知的 harness SkillMisevo-Gym，用来度量「skill 误演化」：自我改进的 LLM agent 把一次不安全的成功蒸馏进自己的持久 skill 库，于是在触发它的那个输入早已消失之后，这套不安全的流程仍会被检索出来重新执行。
zh.summary: skill 演化把交互 trajectory 转成可执行、可迁移的流程，但更新目标是任务结果而非流程安全，于是被污染的经验会被泛化成可复用的策略。现有 benchmark 要么测当下行为，要么测静态工件，因此说不清风险究竟产生于撰写时、检索时，还是直到后续执行才出现。SkillMisevo-Gym 补上了缺失的观测手段：它跨 agent 框架为 skill 库做版本管理，把它与对话、工作区、缓存和原生记忆隔离开，记录演化的输入、diff 与检索，并重放一次干净会话——在这次重置中，只有 agent 自己撰写的 `SKILL.md` 得以留存。SkillMisevo-Bench 在这套 harness 之上固定了任务设计与指标；论文还提出 SafeEvolve，一层与具体方法无关的治理封装，作用在 skill 的写入与复用边界上。

works.title: Replica
works.overview: Replica is a task space for paper replication in which an agent is given a research paper with one results figure irreversibly redacted and must reproduce that figure from the rest of the paper. Alongside it the authors release an auto-generated rubric-based judge calibrated against human raters, and use both to post-train Faraday, a 27B "AI Scientist" agent that calls coding agents as tools.
works.summary: The authors argue that replicating a paper is not a lookup task: the act of replication surfaces details the original left underspecified, so it demands the same hypothesis-driven exploration as open-ended research while still admitting a checkable target. Replica operationalises this by taking a published paper, selecting a main-text results plot, and removing it from the PDF, leaving the agent to reconstruct the experiment behind it. Task construction is itself a three-stage vision-language pipeline: a scan locates every main-text results plot and its caption, a localisation stage draws a bounding box inside an LLM-verifier repair loop, and the figure is then irreversibly redacted. Because the redaction is irreversible, the agent cannot recover the target by reading the source PDF. Scoring uses task-specific rubrics generated by an LLM with the gold plot hidden, so the rubric describes what a correct replication must establish rather than what the target figure looks like. The authors then post-train Faraday on this task space with a modified GRPO and compare it against frontier baselines on a held-out split.
works.domains_text: **AI & Machine Learning Research.** The source papers are ML and AI-for-science publications, and the replication target is a machine-learning results figure — training curves, ablations and benchmark comparisons — reproduced by re-running the underlying experiment. The AI-for-science subset draws on scientific applications of ML, but the paper does not report a per-field breakdown of that subset, so no science co-domain is assigned.

zh.overview: Replica 是一个面向论文复现的任务空间：把一篇论文中的某张结果图不可逆地抹除，让 agent 依据论文其余部分把这张图重新做出来。随论文一同发布的还有一个自动生成、并与人类评分对标过的 rubric 评判器；作者用两者后训练出 Faraday——一个把编码 agent 当作工具来调用的 27B「AI 科学家」。
zh.summary: 作者认为复现一篇论文并不是查资料：复现这个动作本身会把原文含糊带过的细节逼出来，因此它既需要开放式研究那样由假设驱动的探索，又保留了一个可以核对的目标。Replica 把这个想法落到实处——取一篇已发表论文，选中正文里的一张结果图，从 PDF 中移除，剩下的工作就是把那张图背后的实验重新搭起来。任务的构造本身也是一条视觉—语言流水线：先扫描定位正文中每一张结果图及其图注，再在一个由 LLM 验证器把关的修复循环里框出边界框，最后把该图不可逆地涂除。因为抹除不可逆，agent 无法靠读原始 PDF 把答案捞回来。评分所用的 rubric 由 LLM 在看不到原图的前提下逐任务生成，因此 rubric 描述的是「一次正确的复现必须证明什么」，而不是「目标图长什么样」。作者随后用改造过的 GRPO 在这个任务空间上后训练 Faraday，并在留出集上与前沿基线对比。

works.title: Beyond Final Scores
works.overview: A systematic evaluation of seven frontier models on 36 long-horizon AI research and development tasks, built around the argument that final scores reveal neither where progress is gained or lost nor whether accumulated experience improves later decisions. It contributes a framework of deterministic rule-based process metrics over within-run behaviour, plus controlled counterfactual comparisons that isolate experience reuse within and across tasks.
works.summary: The tasks come from AutoLab: each provides an objective, a correct but deliberately suboptimal starting artifact, an expert-written reference solution, a wall-clock budget and an automated verifier, and the agent's job is to improve the artifact iteratively. On top of that substrate the authors build two instruments. The first is a set of three rule-based metric families computed deterministically from verifier outcomes and recorded trajectory signals rather than from LLM judgments, characterising how an agent frames solutions, whether it reliably executes them, and how it responds to feedback. The second is a pair of counterfactual experiments on experience: within a run, the agent's accumulated context is erased at a mid-run branch point while the solution is preserved, and the next commit is compared against the unerased branch; across runs, lessons extracted from solved source tasks are supplied or withheld on held-out targets. The conclusion is that current agents behave like engineering optimizers rather than autonomous researchers — competent at formulating and implementing practical solutions, but highly variable across runs, mostly adapting established techniques, and rarely producing genuine methodological novelty.
works.domains_text: **AI & Machine Learning Research.** The task families are model development, system optimization, CUDA kernel work and algorithmic challenges — the artifact being improved is a machine-learning model or the system code around it, and the verifier measures its performance. No science co-domain is assigned; the work evaluates research-and-development capability on AI artifacts rather than on any natural-science problem.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: 在 36 个长时程 AI 研发任务上对七个前沿模型做的一次系统评估，出发点是：最终分数既看不出进展在哪里得到、又在哪里丢掉，也说不清积累下来的经验有没有改善后续决策。工作贡献了一套刻画运行内行为的确定性规则化过程指标，以及一组把任务内与跨任务的经验复用单独隔离出来的受控反事实实验。
zh.summary: 任务取自 AutoLab：每个任务提供一个目标、一份正确但刻意做得不够好的起始工件、一份专家撰写的参考解、一个墙钟预算和一个自动验证器，agent 要做的是把工件反复改好。作者在这个底座上搭了两件工具。其一是三组规则化指标，全部由验证器结果与记录下来的轨迹信号确定性地算出，不经 LLM 判定，用来刻画 agent 如何构思方案、能否可靠地把方案落地、以及如何应对反馈。其二是一对关于经验的反事实实验：在运行内部，于中途某个分叉点抹掉 agent 累积的上下文而保留其解，再把分叉后的第一次提交与未抹除的分支对比；在运行之间，把从已解决源任务中提炼的经验，在留出目标任务上给或不给。结论是当前 agent 更像工程优化器而非自主研究者——擅长构思并实现可行方案，但跨轮次波动很大，最强的解多半是在改造或组合既有技术，真正的方法学新意极为罕见。

works.title: MobileJudgeBench
works.overview: MobileJudgeBench evaluates automatic judges for mobile-agent trajectories against 931 human-labeled trajectories spanning six benchmarks, four agent models, 289 tasks, and 68 apps.
works.summary: The benchmark compares six judge methods across five LLM backends, using human success labels as ground truth. It reports trajectory-level classification metrics and tests whether those metrics predict two downstream uses: reproducing human agent rankings and serving as reward signals for on-policy training. A simple sampled-screenshot baseline is competitive with purpose-built pipelines; the best configuration reaches 90.9% accuracy, and balanced accuracy correlates with agent-ranking fidelity at Spearman ρ = 0.87.
works.domains_text: Mobile GUI agents and app interaction; no canonical scientific or engineering domain.

zh.overview: MobileJudgeBench 用 931 条人工标注的 mobile-agent trajectory 检验自动 evaluator。这些数据来自六个 benchmark、四种 agent model、289 个任务和 68 个 app。
zh.summary: Benchmark 将六种 judge 方法与五种 LLM backbone 组合，以人工成功标签为 ground truth。它既报告 trajectory 分类指标，也检查这些指标能否预测两种下游用途：复现人类给出的 agent 排名，以及为 on-policy training 提供 reward。简单的截图采样 baseline 不输专门设计的复杂 pipeline；最佳配置准确率为 90.9%，balanced accuracy 与 agent 排名 fidelity 的 Spearman ρ 为 0.87。

works.title: DSAgentBench
works.overview: DSAgentBench is a benchmark that evaluates whether agents can automate complete end-to-end data-science workflows inside real computer environments, requiring coordinated use of tools such as notebooks, IDEs, terminals, browsers, and databases.
works.summary: DSAgentBench targets long-horizon, real-world data-science practice that spans data wrangling, exploration, modeling, visualization, and validation. The authors state it is the first benchmark to evaluate whether agents can automate full data-science workflows inside real computer environments, in contrast to prior benchmarks that lack real-computer interaction and do not test complete end-to-end workflows. Each task requires grounding decisions in intermediate outputs and coordinating multiple tools, and is paired with a deterministic evaluator. Experiments across 15 closed- and open-source models reveal a large capability gap between current agentic systems and real data-science workflows.
works.domains_text: General data-science workflows conducted within real computer/operating environments (notebooks, IDEs, terminals, browsers, databases). The abstract does not enumerate specific scientific or application domains for the individual tasks; per-domain composition: TODO(reference).

zh.overview: DSAgentBench 是一个 benchmark，评估 agent 能否在真实计算机环境中自动化完整的端到端数据科学工作流，需要协同使用 notebook、IDE、终端、浏览器与数据库等工具。
zh.summary: DSAgentBench 面向长 horizon、贴近真实的数据科学实践，覆盖数据整理、探索、建模、可视化与验证。作者称它是首个评估 agent 能否在真实计算机环境中自动化完整数据科学工作流的 benchmark，与既有 benchmark 形成对比——后者缺少真实计算机交互，也不检验完整的端到端工作流。每个任务都要求让决策基于中间输出、并协同使用多种工具，且配一个确定性评估器。在 15 个闭源与开源模型上的实验揭示：当前 agentic 系统与真实数据科学工作流之间存在很大能力差距。

works.title: Apodex Discovery
works.overview: Apodex Discovery is a set of executable "reality-based" environments and an accompanying process-scoring rubric for evaluating AI systems on real-world discovery problems. Twenty problems were selected from a two-month survey of 561 industries, each realised as a stateful environment with tools, data and a hidden verifier, and solver trajectories are scored on six process dimensions blind to the outcome.
works.summary: The paper's framing analogy is the Apollo program: frontier models can solve difficult problems once the problem, the tools and the success criteria are specified, so the bottleneck is the specification rather than the model. Apodex accordingly contributes three things. A problem-scouting process surveyed 561 industries to identify problems that are simultaneously technically tractable, valuable, and commercially accessible, narrowing 423 candidates to an initial release of 20. An environment abstraction then turns each problem into a stateful interactive substrate — tools, data, computational resources and experimental interfaces — that returns fresh observations in response to solver actions, with hidden ground truth structurally prevented from reaching the solver. Finally, a process rubric scores how a solver worked rather than only what it produced, evaluated blind to the outcome and with the solver's identity withheld. The authors report results on adeno-associated virus capsid design and on drug repurposing, in both cases comparing against an external reference rather than against another agent.
works.domains_text:
**Biology** and **Medicine & Health** are assigned on the strength of the two problems reported quantitatively: adeno-associated virus capsid design (viability, tropism, structure prediction and generative design) and drug repurposing and reformulation.

`TODO(reference)` — the release names ten areas that would also touch Materials Science, Civil & Structural Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems and Computer Science, but the paper does not report how many of the 20 problems fall in each area, and results are reported for only two. Because a multi-field release earns a domain on this repository's domain axis only when the slice is identifiable and sized, the remaining areas are not assigned.

zh.overview: Apodex Discovery 由一组可执行的「基于现实」的环境与一套配套的过程评分 rubric 组成，用于评估 AI 系统在真实世界发现问题上的表现。20 个问题选自一次覆盖 561 个行业的调研，每个问题都落成一个带工具、数据与隐藏验证器的有状态环境；求解者的轨迹则在不知道结果的前提下，按六个过程维度打分。
zh.summary: 论文的立论类比是阿波罗计划：只要问题、工具与成功判据都被明确下来，前沿模型就能解决很难的题目，因此瓶颈在于「把问题说清楚」，而不在模型本身。Apodex 据此给出三样东西。其一是一套问题勘察流程：调研 561 个行业，寻找同时具备技术可行性、价值与商业可及性的问题，从 423 个候选收敛到首批发布的 20 个。其二是一层环境抽象，把每个问题变成有状态的交互底座——工具、数据、算力资源与实验接口——它会针对求解者的动作返回新的观测，同时从结构上杜绝隐藏真值流向求解者。其三是一套过程 rubric，评的是求解者**怎么做**而不只是**做出了什么**，且评判时既不知道结果，也不知道求解者是谁。作者报告了腺相关病毒衣壳设计与药物重定位两项结果，两次比较的参照物都在系统之外。

works.title: TCS-Bench
works.overview: TCS-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating large language models on research-level Theoretical Computer Science (TCS) proof generation, where each task asks a model to produce a self-contained proof of a target result drawn from papers published at top TCS venues.
works.summary: TCS-Bench assembles theorem-proving tasks from papers published at the top theoretical computer science venues — FOCS, STOC, and SODA — between 2020 and 2026. Each task supplies the context needed to derive a self-contained proof of a target statement, and models are scored on whether they can produce a correct proof. Because grading research-level proofs is itself difficult, the authors build an automated verification agent and calibrate it against human-expert judgements, reporting over 90% agreement with expert labels.
works.domains_text: Research-level theoretical computer science (theorem proving over results from FOCS, STOC, and SODA). Proof-generation tasks are mathematical in nature.

zh.overview: TCS-Bench 是一个评估大语言模型在研究级理论计算机科学（TCS）证明生成上的 benchmark，每个任务要求模型为取自顶级 TCS 会议论文的一条目标结论产出自包含的证明。
zh.summary: TCS-Bench 从顶级理论计算机科学会议——FOCS、STOC 与 SODA——2020 至 2026 年发表的论文中汇集定理证明任务。每个任务提供推导一条目标陈述自包含证明所需的上下文，模型按能否产出正确证明计分。由于评判研究级证明本身就很困难，作者构建了一个自动化验证 agent，并将其对齐人类专家判断，报告与专家标签的一致性超过 90%。

works.title: SWE-RPG
works.overview: SWE-RPG is a repository-level issue-resolution benchmark that pairs executable patch evaluation with validated ground-truth references for Requirement Clarification and Implementation Planning, enabling stage-aligned diagnosis of complete coding-agent trajectories rather than pass/fail-only scoring.
works.summary: Existing repository-level coding benchmarks typically score only whether the final patch passes tests, which cannot characterize how an unsuccessful trajectory diverges from the requirements and implementation process needed for a correct patch. SWE-RPG augments executable patch evaluation with intermediate ground-truth references (GTs) for two upstream stages — recovering explicit and implicit requirements (Requirement Clarification) and formulating a repository-grounded implementation plan (Implementation Planning). These intermediate GTs support retrospective, GT-aligned diagnosis of full trajectories across clarification, planning, code generation, and artifact submission. The benchmark comprises 163 tasks from 31 Python and Java repositories and is used to evaluate three coding agents across six LLM backends.
works.domains_text: Software & Systems Engineering — repository-level bug fixing and feature addition in real Python and Java software projects (31 repositories).

zh.overview: SWE-RPG 是一个仓库级 issue 解决 benchmark，把可执行的补丁评估与「需求澄清」（Requirement Clarification）和「实现规划」（Implementation Planning）的经验证真值参考配对，从而支持对完整 coding-agent 轨迹做阶段对齐的诊断，而不只是通过/失败式打分。
zh.summary: 既有仓库级编码 benchmark 通常只评估最终补丁是否通过测试，无法刻画一条失败轨迹如何偏离得到正确补丁所需的需求与实现过程。SWE-RPG 在可执行补丁评估之外，为两个上游阶段补充了中间真值参考（GT）——恢复显式与隐式需求（需求澄清）以及制定扎根于仓库的实现计划（实现规划）。这些中间 GT 支持对完整轨迹（澄清、规划、代码生成、产物提交）做回溯式、GT 对齐的诊断。该 benchmark 由取自 31 个 Python 与 Java 仓库的 163 个任务构成，并用于评估三个 coding agent 在六个 LLM 后端上的表现。

works.title: SWE-Bench ProMax
works.overview: SWE-Bench ProMax is an expert-curated, multilingual code-refactoring benchmark of 170 real-commit instances across seven programming languages, designed to test coding agents on coordinated, behavior-preserving changes that span many files.
works.summary: SWE-Bench ProMax targets code refactoring — coordinated, behavior-preserving changes across many files — which the authors argue is a substantially harder and more realistic test of agent capability than existing issue-resolution benchmarks that are rapidly saturating. It comprises 170 instances drawn from real commits across seven programming languages (Python, Java, TypeScript, Go, C, C++, and Rust). Each instance undergoes a multi-stage curation process intended to address quality problems identified in prior benchmarks: issue descriptions are rewritten from scratch to provide precise, unambiguous specifications, and test suites are manually reviewed to remove overly narrow tests (which reject correct solutions) and overly broad tests (which check unstated requirements). Tasks with insufficient complexity or limited cross-file scope are filtered out, yielding large-scale refactoring tasks that average 11.4 modified files and 261.6 lines of code per instance.
works.domains_text: Software engineering — real-world multilingual open-source repositories spanning seven programming languages (Python, Java, TypeScript, Go, C, C++, Rust).

zh.overview: SWE-Bench ProMax 是一个专家整理的多语言代码重构 benchmark，含 170 个来自真实提交的实例，横跨七种编程语言，用于考察 coding agent 在跨多文件、协同且保持行为不变的改动上的能力。
zh.summary: SWE-Bench ProMax 瞄准代码重构——跨多文件、协同且保持行为不变的改动——作者认为相较正在迅速饱和的既有 issue 解决 benchmark，它是对 agent 能力更难、更贴近现实的检验。它由取自真实提交、横跨七种编程语言（Python、Java、TypeScript、Go、C、C++、Rust）的 170 个实例构成。每个实例都经过多阶段整理流程，以解决先前 benchmark 中发现的质量问题：issue 描述从零重写，以提供精确无歧义的规格；测试套件经人工评审，剔除过窄测试（会否掉正确解）与过宽测试（会检查未言明的需求）。复杂度不足或跨文件范围有限的任务被过滤掉，从而得到大规模重构任务，平均每个实例改动 11.4 个文件、261.6 行代码。

works.title: MMArch
works.overview: MMArch is a 1,212-item multimodal benchmark built from figures in peer-reviewed architecture and civil-engineering papers, testing whether a model can gather visual evidence spread across a technical figure, identify the governing engineering principle, and apply it to reach a conclusion.
works.summary: MMArch targets a failure mode that figure-captioning and chart-QA benchmarks do not expose: an answer that requires combining several separated pieces of evidence inside one engineering figure and then reasoning about them with domain knowledge, rather than reading a value off the drawing. Items are generated by a deliberately decoupled pipeline in which a planner fixes a short reference answer before a writer composes a free-form question, so questions cannot be reverse-engineered from a pre-written response. Candidate items then pass automated screening, a blind adversarial audit, dual answer verification, and unanimous expert review. Eighteen open-weight and proprietary multimodal models are evaluated, and the best reaches roughly half of human expert accuracy.
works.domains_text: The benchmark spans architecture and **Civil & Structural Engineering**. Civil/structural membership is direct: structural engineering, seismic engineering, building inspection, and BIM and digital construction are four of the ten named subdomains, and the items require applying engineering principles to structural and building-system evidence. The remaining subdomains (heritage conservation, spatial analysis, urban planning, computational design, building physics, building-envelope engineering) are architectural or building-science topics without a separate canonical domain in this repository; no other science or engineering co-domain is assigned.

zh.overview: MMArch 是一个含 1,212 道题的多模态 benchmark，题目取自建筑与土木工程同行评议论文中的插图。它考察的是：模型能否把散落在一幅技术插图各处的视觉证据收拢起来，认出起支配作用的工程原理，再据以推出结论。
zh.summary: MMArch 针对的是图注生成与图表问答类 benchmark 暴露不出来的一种失败模式：答案要求把一张工程图内部若干处分散的证据合起来，再结合领域知识作推理，而不是从图上读一个数。题目由一条刻意解耦的管线生成——planner 先把一个简短的参考答案定死，writer 才去写自由形式的问题，因此问题无法从事先写好的回答里反推出来。候选题目随后依次经过自动筛查、盲态对抗审查、双路答案核验，以及需要全体一致同意的专家评审。论文共评测 18 个开放权重与闭源多模态模型，最好的一个也只达到人类专家准确率的约一半。

works.title: Evo-Bench
works.overview: Evo-Bench is a benchmark that evaluates a language model's intrinsic ability to autonomously improve its own agent harness — the editable scaffolding that governs how the model reasons and interacts with tools — across Search, Office, and General agent domains.
works.summary: Evo-Bench targets "harness evolution": rather than solving a fixed task, the model iteratively edits an operating harness that controls how a policy interacts with tasks, and is scored on how much the evolved harness improves downstream performance. The benchmark is constructed through a harness-guided pipeline that first identifies tasks genuinely sensitive to harness quality, then applies sensitivity-aware stratified splitting into a validation suite and an evaluation suite to isolate harness-improving skill from base-model strength and task-specific overfitting. The seed harness the model starts from is a minimal CodeAct loop with only shell execution and answer completion. Tasks are drawn from five source benchmarks spanning three domains: Search, Office, and General.
works.domains_text: The benchmark spans three agent domains — Search (web browsing / information seeking), Office (document and workflow tasks), and General. These are general-purpose agent settings; no specific natural-science or engineering field is evaluated. Repository note: because the evaluated domains are Search / Office / General agent tasks rather than a science or engineering field, no canonical scientific or engineering domain is assigned.

zh.overview: Evo-Bench 是一个 benchmark，评估语言模型自主改进自身 agent harness 的内在能力——harness 即那套可编辑的脚手架，管控着模型如何推理、如何与工具交互——覆盖 Search、Office 与 General 三类 agent 领域。
zh.summary: Evo-Bench 针对的是"harness 演化"：模型并不去求解某个固定任务，而是反复编辑一套操作性 harness——它控制着策略如何与任务交互——并按演化后的 harness 使下游性能提升多少来计分。该 benchmark 由一条 harness 引导的流水线构建：先筛出真正对 harness 质量敏感的任务，再用敏感度感知的分层划分把它们分成验证集与评估集，从而将"改进 harness 的技能"与基座模型强弱、任务特定过拟合区分开来。模型出发的种子 harness 是一个极简的 CodeAct 循环，仅有 shell 执行与作答完成两项能力。任务取自横跨三个领域的五个源 benchmark：Search、Office 与 General。

works.title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design
works.overview: A survey of co-evolution in agentic systems — the multi-component form of self-evolution in which several agents and their environment exert adaptive pressure on one another. It organises the literature under a progressive three-stage taxonomy tracing how a system sheds human-engineered constraints, and devotes a section to why evaluating such systems is harder than evaluating a fixed agent.
works.summary: The survey's starting observation is that single-entity self-evolution is bounded by a static learning context: an agent that improves against fixed tasks and fixed feedback eventually exhausts what that context can teach it. Co-evolution removes that ceiling by letting the other components move too. The three-stage taxonomy is ordered by how much human design remains. **Agent–Agent Co-Evolution** covers agents adapting to dynamic peers, split into adversarial pressure (pairwise and multi-source), collaborative adaptation (parallel and role-differentiated), and evolving agent organizations. **Agent–Environment Co-Evolution** extends the loop to the environment itself across three spaces: the task space (exposure and selection; adaptive task generation), the feedback space (preference-driven, outcome-driven, and consistency-augmented feedback), and the interaction space (executable world construction and model-based world construction). **Meta Co-Evolution** asks whether the evolution mechanism can itself be made evolvable, discussed under open-endedness and under precursors to meta co-evolution. The survey closes on open challenges in evaluation, scaling across components, and keeping increasingly autonomous evolutionary processes safe and controllable.
works.domains_text: No canonical domain is assigned. The subject is general agentic-system methodology; the benchmarks it discusses are tool use, web browsing, software engineering, computer use and multi-agent interaction, none of which is a science or engineering field on this repository's domain axis.

zh.overview: 一篇关于 agentic 系统中共同演化的综述——所谓共同演化，是自我演化的多组件形态，多个 agent 与它们所处的环境彼此施加适应压力。文章用一个递进的三阶段分类体系梳理文献，追踪系统如何一步步卸掉人为设计的约束，并专辟一节论述为什么评估这类系统比评估固定 agent 更难。
zh.summary: 综述的起点是：单实体的自我演化受限于静态的学习语境——一个只面对固定任务与固定反馈去改进的 agent，迟早会把这个语境能教给它的东西学完。共同演化则让其他组件也动起来，从而移走这道天花板。三阶段分类体系按「还剩多少人为设计」排序。**Agent–Agent 共同演化**涵盖 agent 对动态同伴的适应，分为对抗压力（两两对抗与多源对抗）、协作适应（并行协作与角色分化协作），以及不断演化的 agent 组织。**Agent–Environment 共同演化**把这一回路延伸到环境本身，覆盖三个空间：任务空间（暴露与选择；自适应任务生成）、反馈空间（偏好驱动、结果驱动、一致性增强的反馈）与交互空间（可执行世界构建与基于模型的世界构建）。**Meta 共同演化**则追问演化机制本身能否被做成可演化的，分别从开放性与 meta 共同演化的前身两方面讨论。综述最后落在三类开放挑战上：评估、跨组件的规模化，以及如何让自主性不断提高的演化过程保持安全可控。

works.title: EnergyBridge
works.overview: EnergyBridge is a benchmark and agent framework for residential virtual power plants (VPPs) that couples capacity reporting, household authorization, and physical execution, pairing region-specific EnergyPlus building-energy environments with an LLM-based User Participation Simulator.
works.summary: Residential VPPs can provide grid flexibility by shifting household demand, but physical flexibility becomes dependable capacity only when residents authorize a plan and the promised response is actually delivered. Existing benchmarks evaluate control but omit event-specific authorization. EnergyBridge connects capacity reporting, household authorization, and physical execution in a single workflow (VPP request → capacity report → household-specific plan → simulated consent → controller or fallback execution → EnergyPlus measurement → audit). It combines region-specific EnergyPlus environments for Tianjin and Berlin with an LLM-based User Participation Simulator, and releases human data and code for reproducible human-centered grid-flexibility research.
works.domains_text: Energy systems / residential demand response and grid flexibility (household energy management for virtual power plants). Building-energy modeling of HVAC, EV charging, an electric water heater, washer, dryer, and dishwasher, together with non-controllable base load.

zh.overview: EnergyBridge 是一个面向住宅虚拟电厂（VPP）的 benchmark 与 agent 框架，把容量申报、住户授权与物理执行耦合在一起，并将分地区的 EnergyPlus 建筑能耗环境与一个基于 LLM 的用户参与模拟器（User Participation Simulator）配对。
zh.summary: 住宅 VPP 通过调度住户用电为电网提供灵活性，但物理灵活性只有在住户授权某项方案、且承诺的响应被真正兑现之后，才会转化为可依赖的容量。既有 benchmark 只评估控制，却略过了逐事件的授权环节。EnergyBridge 把容量申报、住户授权与物理执行串进单一工作流（VPP 请求 → 容量申报 → 住户专属方案 → 模拟同意 → 控制器或回退执行 → EnergyPlus 计量 → 审计）。它把针对天津与柏林的分地区 EnergyPlus 环境与一个基于 LLM 的用户参与模拟器结合起来，并公开人类数据与代码，以支持可复现、以人为本的电网灵活性研究。

works.title: The Replay Gap
works.overview: An evaluation-methodology study showing that the standard way of scoring per-step model routing/switching in multi-step LLM agents — replaying a logged trajectory and substituting another model's recorded outputs — measures a counterfactual world that does not occur, and proposing branching (counterfactual) rollouts with matched same-model control forks as the sound alternative.
works.summary: LLM routers aim to serve each request with the cheapest adequate model and are increasingly applied per step inside multi-step agents, yet agentic routers are commonly evaluated like single-turn routers: by replaying logged trajectories and swapping in another model's recorded outputs while assuming the rest of the trajectory is unchanged. This work tests that assumption directly with branching rollouts — forking live SWE-bench agent trajectories at controlled points, rebuilding the environment, and continuing each fork with a different model — and compares swaps against matched same-model control forks that isolate sampling and replay noise. Across six paired runs (~900 rollouts), model swaps diverge from their matched control floors by large margins and rewrite the majority of subsequent actions, and a log-stitching replay evaluator mispredicts every success-relevant outcome. The authors conclude that replay-based benchmarks "score the wrong world" for agentic routing and release their harness and trajectory data.
works.domains_text: Software & Systems — the testbed is SWE-bench Verified software-repair tasks executed in per-instance Docker environments. Repository note: the paper's contribution is an evaluation-methodology critique of agentic model routing; software engineering is the experimental substrate rather than the object of study.

zh.overview: 一项评估方法学研究，表明为多步 LLM agent 中的逐步模型路由/切换打分的标准做法——回放一条已记录的轨迹并替换进另一个模型的历史输出——所测量的是一个不会发生的反事实世界，并提出以带匹配同模型对照分叉的分支（反事实）rollout 作为可靠的替代方案。
zh.summary: LLM 路由器旨在用最便宜且够用的模型服务每个请求，并越来越多地被逐步应用于多步 agent 内部；然而 agentic 路由器常被当作单轮路由器来评估：回放已记录的轨迹、替换进另一个模型的历史输出，同时假定轨迹的其余部分保持不变。本工作用分支 rollout 直接检验这一假设——在受控点处分叉活跃的 SWE-bench agent 轨迹、重建环境，并用不同模型继续每个分叉——并把「替换」与匹配的同模型对照分叉相比较，后者用于隔离采样与回放噪声。在六组配对运行（约 900 次 rollout）中，模型替换以很大幅度偏离其匹配的对照基线，并改写了随后的多数动作，而一个日志拼接式回放评估器对每一个与成败相关的结果都预测错误。作者得出结论：基于回放的 benchmark 对 agentic 路由「给错世界打了分」，并公开了他们的 harness 与轨迹数据。

works.title: TelemetrySuffBench
works.overview: A controlled benchmark that tests whether agent execution telemetry is *sufficient* to diagnose where a failure originated, separating three capabilities — failure detection, fault-origin localization, and safe abstention under insufficient evidence — over synthetic multi-component agent traces.
works.summary: TelemetrySuffBench argues that telemetry which reveals *that* an agent failed may still be inadequate for identifying *where* the failure originated. It constructs canonical multi-component agent traces with delayed-binding faults (the injected fault activates later than where it is introduced) and renders each trace under controlled observability conditions: paired coarse views, seven-factor telemetry masks, and exact-equal ambiguous origin pairs. Five frontier language models are evaluated under unified protocols with explicit candidate sets, invalid-output accounting, subgroup analyses, and a frozen blind holdout. The central finding is a detection–localization gap: masked telemetry views preserve near-perfect failure detection while collapsing origin-step localization.
works.domains_text: Domain-agnostic. The traces are synthetic renderings of generic multi-component agent execution (identity/event semantics, tool inputs, state transitions, provenance mappings, verifier evidence, terminal status); the benchmark is not grounded in any scientific or engineering field. Repository note: this is an agent-observability / trajectory-diagnosis methodology contribution and carries no science or engineering domain assignment.

zh.overview: 一个受控 benchmark，测试 agent 执行遥测是否*足以*诊断失败的起源；它在合成的多组件 agent 轨迹上，把三种能力区分开来——失败检测、故障源定位，以及在证据不足时安全弃权。
zh.summary: TelemetrySuffBench 认为：能揭示 agent *是否*失败的遥测，未必足以识别失败*从何处*起源。它构造带延迟绑定故障的规范化多组件 agent 轨迹（注入的故障在其引入位置之后才激活），并在受控可观测性条件下渲染每条轨迹：成对的粗粒度视图、七因子遥测掩码，以及完全相同的歧义起点对。作者在统一协议下评估了五个前沿语言模型，配备显式候选集、无效输出计入、子群分析与一份冻结的盲留出集。核心发现是一个检测–定位落差：被掩蔽的遥测视图仍保持近乎完美的失败检测，却使起源步骤定位崩塌。

works.title: RoboGraphBench
works.overview: A benchmark and task compiler (RoboGraph) that evaluates agentic foundation models as high-level planners for long-horizon embodied tasks, characterizing difficulty by the *task-state horizon* (TSH) — the span of task-relevant state transitions an agent must track, maintain, explore, and update over a trajectory.
works.summary: The work argues that existing long-horizon robotic benchmarks characterize difficulty mainly through action-sequence length and subtask complexity, and overlooks a distinct challenge: agents must track evolving task-relevant world states induced by both their own exploration and environmental dynamics. It formalizes this as the *task-state horizon* (TSH) and introduces RoboGraph, a robotic task compiler that translates spatial and temporal causal state-transition dependencies — including those induced by unexpected failures and interventions during execution — into executable symbolic graphs. Building on RoboGraph, the authors release a benchmark of 588 episodes across 84 scenes spanning a range of TSHs, and evaluate 15 agentic models in both semantic (symbolic) and visual closed-loop environments.
works.domains_text: Robotics — embodied high-level planning for robotic manipulation and indoor navigation, evaluated in tabletop and kitchen simulators.

zh.overview: 一个 benchmark 与任务编译器（RoboGraph），评估 agentic 基础模型作为长 horizon 具身任务的高层规划器，并以 *task-state horizon*（TSH，任务状态视界）刻画难度——即 agent 在一条轨迹上必须跟踪、维护、探索并更新的、与任务相关的状态转移的跨度。
zh.summary: 该工作指出，现有长 horizon 机器人 benchmark 主要用动作序列长度与子任务复杂度刻画难度，却忽视了一个不同的挑战：agent 必须跟踪由其自身探索和环境动态共同诱导、且不断演变的、与任务相关的世界状态。作者把这一点形式化为 *task-state horizon*（TSH），并提出 RoboGraph——一个机器人任务编译器，它把空间与时间上的因果状态转移依赖（包括执行中因意外失败与干预而诱导的依赖）翻译成可执行的符号图。基于 RoboGraph，作者发布了一个含 588 个 episode、跨 84 个场景、覆盖不同 TSH 的 benchmark，并在语义（符号）与视觉两种闭环环境中评估 15 个 agentic 模型。

works.title: Science Edge Evaluation (SEE)
works.overview: Science Edge Evaluation (SEE) is a multimodal benchmark of expert-curated questions grounded in peer-reviewed literature and experimental practice in chemistry, biology, and materials science, designed to test whether multimodal large language models can make justified, evidence-bounded inferences from real laboratory-science data.
works.summary: SEE evaluates multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on expert-level scientific problems that require reasoning over experimental data rather than recalling established concepts. Questions are built from figures and data drawn from peer-reviewed papers, recent research literature, and first-hand experimental data contributed by domain experts. The authors report that even the best-performing model reaches only 48.7% accuracy in the standard setting, that general-purpose models outperform science-specialized models on average, and that adding tool use in a visual-agent setting raises the best accuracy only modestly to 52.7% — arguing that the bottleneck is evidence-bounded reasoning discipline, not access to more information.
works.domains_text: Chemistry, biology, and materials science. Visual inputs include bioactivity measurements, Cryo-EM structures, Western blot and gel electrophoresis images, spectra (infrared, NMR, mass spectrometry), microscopy images (SEM, TEM, AFM), X-ray diffraction patterns, and thermal analysis curves.

zh.overview: Science Edge Evaluation（SEE）是一个多模态 benchmark，题目由专家整理，锚定化学、生物与材料科学的同行评审文献与实验实践；旨在检验多模态大语言模型能否从真实实验室科学数据中做出有依据、受证据边界约束的推断。
zh.summary: SEE 在专家级科学问题上评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM），这些问题要求对实验数据进行推理，而非回忆既有概念。题目由同行评审论文、近期研究文献中的图表与数据，以及领域专家贡献的第一手实验数据构建。作者报告：即便表现最好的模型在标准设定下也仅达到 48.7% 准确率；通用模型平均优于科学专用模型；在视觉智能体设定中加入工具使用，只把最佳准确率小幅提升到 52.7%——他们据此认为瓶颈在于受证据边界约束的推理纪律，而非获取更多信息。

works.title: Long-Horizon Agent Trajectory Attribution
works.overview: A benchmark and fine-grained annotation framework for *trajectory attribution* — identifying which component of a long-horizon LLM-agent trajectory (user instructions, tool calls, observations, memory, etc.) is primarily responsible for an observed outcome such as a task-aligned action, an unsafe action, or a safety refusal.
works.summary: Existing agent benchmarks mainly evaluate behavioral outcomes and offer limited support for fine-grained attribution analysis. This work introduces the task of trajectory attribution and builds a benchmark plus annotation framework for it. Heterogeneous agent trajectories are organized under a unified component schema, and each trajectory is annotated with its primary attribution component together with attack and execution chains where applicable. The benchmark is instantiated with trajectories drawn from AgentDojo and from the Stage and Canary settings of Agent3Sigma, and defines two evaluation tasks with reference baselines. The authors also release a reusable annotation skill so that trajectories from new agent models can be standardized and annotated under the same attribution framework.
works.domains_text: N/A — the benchmark evaluates general LLM-agent trajectories (tool-using agents from AgentDojo and the Agent3Sigma safety settings) rather than a scientific or engineering field.

zh.overview: 一个用于 *trajectory attribution*（轨迹归因）的 benchmark 与细粒度标注框架——即识别长 horizon LLM-agent 轨迹中的哪个组件（用户指令、工具调用、观测、记忆等）对某一观察到的结果（如任务对齐动作、不安全动作或安全拒答）负主要责任。
zh.summary: 现有 agent benchmark 主要评估行为结果，对细粒度归因分析的支持很有限。该工作提出轨迹归因这一任务，并为其构建一个 benchmark 加标注框架。异质的 agent 轨迹被组织于一套统一的组件 schema 之下，每条轨迹都标注其主要归因组件，并在适用处标注攻击链与执行链。该 benchmark 以取自 AgentDojo，以及 Agent3Sigma 的 Stage 与 Canary 设定的轨迹实例化，并定义两项带参考基线的评估任务。作者还发布了一套可复用的标注 skill，使来自新 agent 模型的轨迹能在同一归因框架下被标准化并标注。

works.title: Fisher-R1 / P-Bench
works.overview: A benchmark (P-Bench) of 425 realistic hypothesis-testing tasks and an open-weight LLM agent (Fisher-R1) trained to perform statistically valid hypothesis testing, evaluating whether an agent selects an appropriate statistical method, computes a correct p-value, and draws a valid reject/fail-to-reject conclusion.
works.summary: The work targets a failure mode in which LLM agents execute statistical analyses correctly yet reach incorrect inferential conclusions, for example reporting a p-value that is not statistically valid given the assumptions underlying the data. To measure this, the authors build P-Bench, a benchmark of 425 open-ended hypothesis-testing tasks spanning economics, biology, and medicine, where each task provides only a scientific hypothesis and a dataset and requires the agent to select a statistical method, compute a p-value, and draw a conclusion. The authors also introduce Fisher-R1, an open-weight agent trained via supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning on synthetic hypothesis-testing tasks with a verified statistical reward. On P-Bench, Fisher-R1-14B is reported to improve over its backbone and to outperform proprietary and open-source baselines including GPT-5.4 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro.
works.domains_text: Economics, biology, and medicine.

zh.overview: 一个由 425 道贴近真实的假设检验任务组成的 benchmark（P-Bench），以及一个训练来做统计上有效之假设检验的开放权重 LLM agent（Fisher-R1）；评估 agent 是否选对了合适的统计方法、算出正确的 p 值，并得出有效的拒绝/不拒绝结论。
zh.summary: 该工作针对这样一种失败模式：LLM agent 正确执行了统计分析，却得出了错误的推断结论——例如报告一个在数据所依赖的假设下并不成立的 p 值。为衡量这一点，作者构建了 P-Bench，一个由 425 道开放式假设检验任务组成的 benchmark，覆盖经济学、生物学与医学；每个任务只给出一个科学假设与一份数据集，要求 agent 选择统计方法、计算 p 值并得出结论。作者还提出 Fisher-R1，一个开放权重 agent，先经监督微调、再在带已验证统计奖励的合成假设检验任务上做强化学习。据报告，在 P-Bench 上 Fisher-R1-14B 相对其骨干模型有所提升，并优于包括 GPT-5.4 与 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在内的专有与开源基线。

works.title: TRAJDEBUG
works.overview: TRAJDEBUG is an error-lifecycle tracing framework for identifying critical failures in long-horizon agent trajectories, released together with TrajErrBench, a benchmark of 486 manually annotated failed trajectories drawn from Tau2Bench and SWE-Bench Pro.
works.summary: TRAJDEBUG addresses error discovery in long trajectories through multi-granularity history compression and evidence-based error identification, and supports critical attribution by tracing each error's resolution status and terminal impact — distinguishing errors an agent later recovers from errors that actually determine the failure. TrajErrBench supplies 486 manually annotated failed trajectories over tool-use and coding scenarios.
works.domains_text: Tool-use and coding agent trajectories.

zh.overview: TRAJDEBUG 是在长 horizon agent 轨迹中识别关键失败的错误生命周期追踪框架，随之发布 TrajErrBench——486 条人工标注的失败轨迹，取自 Tau2Bench 与 SWE-Bench Pro。
zh.summary: TRAJDEBUG 通过多粒度历史压缩与基于证据的错误识别来解决长轨迹中的错误发现问题，并追踪每个错误的解决状态与最终影响以支持关键归因——把 agent 事后已恢复的错误与真正决定失败的错误区分开。TrajErrBench 提供 486 条人工标注的失败轨迹，覆盖 tool-use 与编码场景。

works.title: SkillTV-Bench
works.overview: SkillTV-Bench is a benchmark for skill-aware trajectory verification: it evaluates how well LLM-as-a-Judge and Agent-as-a-Judge methods verify agent executions that use skills. It comprises 681 real agent trajectories from 50 tasks across eleven domains, and is accompanied by SkillTV-Evolve, which externalizes verification knowledge as a reusable JudgeSkill.
works.summary: SkillTV-Bench measures trajectory verification when agent executions are skill-augmented — a setting where the judge needs task-aware skill knowledge to verify correctly. SkillTV-Evolve runs an automated evolution loop over misjudged cases and distills the resulting verification knowledge into a reusable JudgeSkill, which raises the same agent judge's accuracy by 14.8 percentage points and lifts offline rollout-pool selection from 22.9% selected-trajectory success with one rollout to 45.5% with ten.
works.domains_text: Eleven domains; the abstract does not enumerate them.

zh.overview: SkillTV-Bench 是面向 skill-aware 轨迹验证的 benchmark：评估 LLM-as-a-Judge 与 Agent-as-a-Judge 方法对使用 skill 的 agent 执行的验证能力。它包含来自 50 个任务、11 个领域的 681 条真实 agent 轨迹，并配套 SkillTV-Evolve——把验证知识外化为可复用的 JudgeSkill。
zh.summary: SkillTV-Bench 度量 skill 增强执行下的轨迹验证——这一设定要求评判者具备任务相关的 skill 知识才能验证正确。SkillTV-Evolve 在误判案例上运行自动进化循环，把所得验证知识蒸馏为可复用的 JudgeSkill，使同一 agent 评判者的准确率提升 14.8 个百分点，并把离线 rollout 池选择的成功率从单 rollout 的 22.9% 提升到十个 rollout 的 45.5%。

works.title: HarnessOpt-Bench
works.overview: HarnessOpt-Bench is a benchmark measuring how well frontier LLMs perform automated harness optimization — iteratively improving the prompts, tools, control flow, and orchestration code surrounding LLMs — under a fixed target-evaluation budget inside a trusted execution environment.
works.summary: Each optimizer model receives a seed harness, evaluation feedback, and a fixed budget of target evaluations, and is scored by its normalized gain over the seed on a held-out test partition. A trusted execution environment enforces evaluation boundaries, meters resource use, and preserves candidate versions for audit. Across 4 downstream tasks, 5 frontier optimizer models, and 111 scored runs, the paper reports that optimizer models separate more than the coding harnesses they act through, and that gains vary substantially across tasks and seed regimes.
works.domains_text: Agentic-system harness optimization; no single science domain.

zh.overview: HarnessOpt-Bench 是度量前沿 LLM 自动化 harness 优化能力的 benchmark——在可信执行环境内、固定的目标评估预算下，迭代改进围绕 LLM 的提示词、工具、控制流与编排代码。
zh.summary: 每个优化器模型获得种子 harness、评估反馈与固定的目标评估预算，按其在留出测试划分上相对种子的归一化增益计分。可信执行环境强制评估边界、计量资源使用，并保存候选版本以供审计。在 4 个下游任务、5 个前沿优化器模型、共 111 次计分运行中，论文报告：优化器模型之间的差异大于它们所借助的编码 harness 之间的差异，且增益随任务与种子设定的不同而差异显著。

works.title: EcoAgent-Bench
works.overview: EcoAgent-Bench is a benchmark for economic decision-making in budget-constrained LLM agents: every task specifies priced actions and an explicit budget, and agents are scored on whether their decisions are economically sound rather than merely task-completing.
works.summary: EcoAgent-Bench comprises 304 real-derived tasks in five families adapted from GAIA, HotpotQA, and MuSiQue, testing four decision types: avoiding unnecessary escalation, escalating when needed, selecting model tiers, and stopping on unsupported premises. An economic-consistency score compares performance on upgrade-oriented versus save-oriented task groups, exposing one-sided policies that always spend or always save.
works.domains_text: Question answering across multiple knowledge domains (adapted from existing QA benchmarks); no single science domain.

zh.overview: EcoAgent-Bench 是面向预算受限 LLM agent 经济决策的 benchmark：每个任务都指定带定价的动作与显式预算，评分对象是决策是否经济合理，而不仅是任务是否完成。
zh.summary: EcoAgent-Bench 包含 304 个源自真实数据的任务，分五个族，改编自 GAIA、HotpotQA 与 MuSiQue，考察四类决策：避免不必要的升级、需要时升级、选择模型档位、在前提不成立时停止。经济一致性分数比较升级导向与节省导向两组任务上的表现，从而暴露一味花钱或一味省钱的单边策略。

works.title: Skill²-Bench
works.overview: Skill²-Bench is a benchmark of *cross-skill long-horizon tasks* — multi-step problems whose consecutive steps require different reasoning skills and depend on earlier answers — calibrated by **skill entropy**, a directed pairwise measure of how hard it is to switch from one skill to another. It is introduced together with Skill-Entropy RL, a training method that reuses the same measure as a reward signal.
works.summary: Frontier models often do well on single-skill benchmarks yet remain brittle when one reasoning chain must move between skills — a math derivation whose result feeds a scheduling step, which in turn guides an extraction step. The authors formalize such problems as cross-skill long-horizon tasks and define skill entropy SkE(s_a, s_b) as a smoothed ratio between average single-skill accuracy and cross-skill accuracy under a fixed reference model, with values above 1 meaning the switch is hard. Task-level skill entropy averages the pairwise values along a task's skill sequence and is used to sample tasks at low, medium and high difficulty levels. Evaluating eight frontier and four open-source models exposes a skill-switching gap that single-domain evaluations do not surface, after which the same quantity is converted into a reward for Skill-Entropy RL.
works.domains_text: Nine general reasoning domains, of which "science" is drawn from MMLU-Pro and "math" from OpenR1-Math. No canonical science or engineering domain is assigned: the evaluated objective is the difficulty of switching between skills, and the domain-specific items serve as calibrated substrate rather than as the target of measurement.

zh.overview: Skill²-Bench 是一个由*跨 skill 长程任务*组成的 benchmark——这类多步问题的相邻步骤需要不同的推理 skill，且后一步依赖前一步的答案——难度由 **skill 熵** 校准——这是一个有向的成对度量，衡量从一个 skill 切换到另一个 skill 有多难。它与 Skill-Entropy RL 一同提出，后者是把同一度量复用为奖励信号的训练方法。
zh.summary: 前沿模型在单 skill benchmark 上往往表现不错，可一旦同一条推理链要在不同 skill 之间腾挪就变得脆弱——比如一段数学推导的结果喂给一个排程步骤，排程结果又指导一个抽取步骤。作者把这类问题形式化为跨 skill 长程任务，并定义 skill 熵 SkE(s_a, s_b)：在固定参考模型下，单 skill 平均准确率与跨 skill 准确率之比，经平滑处理，取值大于 1 意味着这次切换是难的。任务级 skill 熵取任务 skill 序列上两两取值的平均，用来按低、中、高三档难度采样任务。对八个前沿模型与四个开源模型的评估，暴露出一个单领域评测看不见的 skill 切换缺口；随后同一个量被转换成奖励，用于 Skill-Entropy RL。

works.title: SkillSV
works.overview: SkillSV (structure-aware Shapley valuation of agent skills) is an attribution framework that assigns credit to the internal units of an agent skill — compiling a skill into units, dependencies, and hierarchy so that only valid counterfactual skills are evaluated.
works.summary: SkillSV answers 'what is a skill worth, and which parts of it carry the value?' by Shapley valuation over a skill's compiled structure. Paired deletion and length-neutral padding separate content value from context cost. Evaluated on four agentic benchmarks for faithfulness, actionability, and explanation quality, the framework recovers unit interactions, preserves aggregate skill lift, and guides safe pruning and compression.
