works.domains_text: Agent skills as structured artifacts; no single science domain.

zh.overview: SkillSV（结构感知的 agent skill Shapley 估值）是把 credit 分配到 skill 内部单元的归因框架——将 skill 编译为单元、依赖与层级，从而只评估合法的反事实 skill。
zh.summary: SkillSV 通过在 skill 的编译结构上做 Shapley 估值来回答“一个 skill 值多少、价值由哪些部分承载”。成对删除与长度中性填充把内容价值与上下文成本分开。在四个 agentic benchmark 上按忠实性、可操作性与解释质量评估，该框架恢复了单元间交互、保持了整体 skill 增益，并指导安全的剪枝与压缩。

works.title: Skill-Use
works.overview: Skill-Use is a benchmark asking whether LLM agents can actually use skills in agentic harnesses: 79 real skills with 177 executable tasks across nine domains, each grounded in real files and run in an isolated Docker sandbox.
works.summary: Skill-Use measures three separable facets of skill use — triggering (does the agent invoke the relevant skill), procedural compliance (does it faithfully follow the prescribed procedure), and boundary adherence (does it avoid forbidden operations) — combined into an SU score in which execution earns credit only after the skill is triggered. The strongest configuration reaches an SU of only 0.613, and triggering and compliance emerge as independent bottlenecks that vary across harnesses.
works.domains_text: Nine domains; the abstract does not enumerate them.

zh.overview: Skill-Use 是追问 LLM agent 能否真正在 agentic harness 中使用 skill 的 benchmark：79 个真实 skill、177 个可执行任务，横跨九个领域，任务锚定真实文件并在隔离的 Docker 沙箱中运行。
zh.summary: Skill-Use 度量 skill 使用的三个可分离侧面——触发（agent 是否调用相关 skill）、流程遵从（是否忠实执行规定流程）、边界遵守（是否避免被禁止的操作）——合并为 SU 分数，其中执行只有在 skill 被触发后才计分。最强配置的 SU 仅 0.613，触发与流程遵从表现为相互独立的瓶颈，且随 harness 不同而变化。

works.title: SearchAuditor
works.overview: SearchAuditor is a multi-perspective auditing framework that localizes, attributes, and repairs failures in long-horizon search agents, released with SearchAuditBench — 1,243 expert-annotated failed trajectories collected from eight open-weight models on five deep-search benchmarks.
works.summary: SearchAuditBench's failed trajectories average 73.1 messages and 65.1K tokens; each is expert-annotated with the critical error step, a search-specific root cause, and a reference repair with grading rubrics. SearchAuditor performs evidence-grounded adjudication across multiple perspectives to localize and attribute failures and to propose repairs whose application improves agent recovery.
works.domains_text: Long-horizon deep-search agent trajectories.

zh.overview: SearchAuditor 是对长 horizon 搜索 agent 的失败做定位、归因与修复的多视角审计框架，随之发布 SearchAuditBench——1,243 条专家标注的失败轨迹，采集自八个开源权重模型在五个 deep-search benchmark 上的运行。
zh.summary: SearchAuditBench 的失败轨迹平均 73.1 条消息、65.1K token；每条都由专家标注关键错误步骤、搜索特有的根因，以及带评分 rubric 的参考修复。SearchAuditor 通过证据锚定的多视角裁决来定位与归因失败并提出修复，应用修复可提升 agent 的恢复表现。

works.title: Agentic Self-Driving Microscopy Benchmarks
works.overview: An industry study (Carl Zeiss Research Microscopy Solutions) pairing a benchmark-and-trace-logging framework for agentic self-driving microscopy with a meta-finding: 53 benchmark tests across 105 agent configurations support qualification, regression testing, and diagnosis — but do not predict performance on unseen tasks.
works.summary: The study runs 1,949 individual test runs and 49,109 RAG retrievals over 53 microscopy benchmark tests, varying one-, two-, and three-agent graph topologies, five LLMs, and RAG and context parameters, with full trace logging plus latency, token-use, cost, and failure-mode comparisons. Its central negative result: surrogate models trained on agent architecture and test results did not reliably predict an agent's performance on new, unseen tasks — the heterogeneous test suite supports qualification but not a task-independent global configuration model.
works.domains_text: Microscopy and materials characterization instrumentation (cond-mat.mtrl-sci); self-driving scientific instruments.

zh.overview: 一项来自业界（Carl Zeiss Research Microscopy Solutions）的研究，为 agentic 自主（self-driving）显微术配套了 benchmark 与轨迹日志框架，并给出一个元发现：53 个 benchmark 测试、105 种 agent 配置足以支撑资格验证（qualification）、回归测试与诊断——但预测不了在未见任务上的表现。
zh.summary: 研究在 53 个显微术 benchmark 测试上共运行 1,949 次、记录 49,109 次 RAG 检索，变量覆盖一、二、三 agent 的图拓扑、五个 LLM 以及 RAG 与上下文参数，并附完整轨迹日志与时延、token 用量、成本、失败模式的比较。核心的否定性结果是：用 agent 架构与测试结果训练的代理模型无法可靠预测 agent 在全新任务上的表现——这套异质测试套件支撑资格验证，却给不出一个与任务无关的全局配置模型。

works.title: BrainBench (EEG)
works.overview: BrainBench (EEG) benchmarks LLMs on comprehensive EEG understanding: instruction-conditioned analysis across four subsets — Foundational Analysis, Sleep Assessment, Neurocognitive Assessment, and Physiological Integration — over 17 datasets, where a system must analyze EEG recordings and produce a scientifically grounded report.
works.summary: Distinct from the earlier neuroscience-result-prediction BrainBench, this benchmark targets EEG signal understanding. Given an instruction and EEG recordings (with optional physiological signals), a system must perform the analysis and produce a scientifically grounded report and, when required, artifacts. It spans four subsets — Foundational Analysis, Sleep Assessment, Neurocognitive Assessment, and Physiological Integration — over 17 datasets, and evaluates models under two execution paradigms: autonomous code execution with CodeAct and structured agentic analysis with BrainAgent, across more than 100K executions. Outputs are validated along numerical, categorical, set, sequence, semantic, and artifact dimensions, with results varying substantially across models, subsets, difficulty, and paradigm.
works.domains_text: Neuroscience & Cognitive Science — electroencephalography analysis: signal processing, quantitative evidence, and scientific interpretation across foundational, sleep, neurocognitive, and physiological tasks.

zh.overview: BrainBench (EEG) 评测 LLM 的综合 EEG 理解：指令条件下的分析，覆盖四个子集——基础分析、睡眠评估、神经认知评估、生理整合——共 17 个数据集，系统须分析 EEG 记录并产出有科学依据的报告。
zh.summary: 与更早那个「预测神经科学结果」的 BrainBench 不同，本 benchmark 瞄准 EEG 信号理解。给定一条指令与 EEG 记录（可含生理信号），系统须完成分析并产出有科学依据的报告，必要时还有产物。它覆盖四个子集——基础分析、睡眠评估、神经认知评估、生理整合——共 17 个数据集，并在两种执行范式下评估模型：以 CodeAct 做自主代码执行、以 BrainAgent 做结构化 agent 分析，累计逾 10 万次执行。输出沿数值、类别、集合、序列、语义与产物六个维度校验，结果在模型、子集、难度与范式之间差异显著。

works.title: Agents Catching Agents
works.overview: A study of whether committees of language-model agents deliberating on a shared workspace can be gamed by shortcuts — cues a benchmark rewards but a clinician would ignore. Across seven cohorts on six public clinical datasets it finds that agents largely resist such cues in isolation but adopt them when peers assert them, and it evaluates three oversight agents on whether they can tell shortcut adoption from honest agreement.
works.summary: Clinical decision support is moving toward committees of agents deliberating in a shared workspace, and the paper asks what that architecture does to benchmark validity. It separates two questions that are usually conflated. First, is an individual agent susceptible to a shortcut cue — an option ordering, a corner tag on an image, a rescaled unit in a table? Largely not: flip rates in isolation are low. Second, does a socially plausible signal move it? Substantially: when two peers assert the same wrong answer, the holdout under test adopts it in more than a third of cases, and a fabricated "pre-screen" system flag does the same. The asymmetry is the paper's central result, and it is sharpened by a control: tripling a cue's visual salience does not increase contagion, while adding a second peer voice raises it by half again. What games a committee, in other words, is social plausibility rather than perceptual strength. The paper then turns to oversight, evaluating three detector designs and finding that only a referee that privately re-queries the holdout — an interventional check rather than a reading of the transcript — transfers across modalities.
works.domains_text: **Medicine & Health.** Every cohort is clinical — USMLE-style examination items, chest radiographs and reports, and ICU records — and the failure mode under study is specifically framed as one affecting clinical decision-support committees. The clinical content is the substrate rather than the object of discovery, which is why no research activity is assigned, but the domain membership is direct.

zh.overview: 一项研究，考察在共享工作区中议事的语言模型 agent 委员会会不会被捷径带偏——所谓捷径，是 benchmark 会给分、临床医生却会无视的线索。在六个公开临床数据集的七个 cohort 上，作者发现 agent 单独面对这类线索时基本不为所动，但只要同伴把它说出口就会跟着采纳；随后作者又评估了三种监督 agent，看它们能否把捷径采纳与诚实的意见一致区分开来。
zh.summary: 临床决策支持正在走向由多个 agent 在共享工作区中议事的形态，论文要问的是这种架构对 benchmark 效度做了什么。它把两个通常被混为一谈的问题拆开。第一，单个 agent 会被捷径线索带偏吗——选项顺序、图像角落的标记、表格里换了单位的数值？基本不会：孤立条件下的翻转率很低。第二，一个社会意义上说得通的信号会不会撬动它？相当会：当两个同伴异口同声给出同一个错误答案时，受测的那个 agent 在超过三分之一的情形下跟着走，而一个伪造的「预筛」系统标记同样奏效。这种不对称正是全文的核心结果，并由一个对照进一步锐化：把线索的视觉显著度提到三倍，传染纹丝不动；而多加一个同伴的声音，传染就上升了一半。换句话说，撬动委员会的是社会可信度，而不是感知强度。随后作者转向监督，比较三种检测器设计，发现只有那个私下重新询问受测 agent 的仲裁者——一种介入式检查，而非读记录——才能跨模态迁移。

works.title: onepot-Bench 0
works.overview: onepot-Bench 0 is a proprietary, lab-aware chemistry benchmark suite in three parts: ChemAbacus (tool-free cheminformatics literacy and numerical reasoning), SynthRefusal (safety and refusal behavior across benign, controlled, and designer-drug targets), and SynthBench (reaction-outcome prediction and catalyst selection on private experimental data generated in the authors' laboratory).
works.summary: The suite's motivating claim is that public chemistry evaluations may already sit inside model training corpora, so onepot-Bench 0 anchors its hardest component to data that cannot have leaked: experiments run in the authors' own lab. ChemAbacus probes what a model can compute about molecules unaided; SynthRefusal characterizes where models draw safety lines across a spectrum from benign to designer-drug synthesis targets; SynthBench asks for reaction outcomes and catalyst selections that only the private experimental record can confirm.
works.domains_text: Chemistry — synthetic chemistry and cheminformatics, with catalyst selection and wet-lab-generated ground truth.

zh.overview: onepot-Bench 0 是一套私有的、面向实验室现实的化学 benchmark 套件，分三部分：ChemAbacus（不借助工具的化学信息学素养与数值推理）、SynthRefusal（在良性、管制与设计毒品类目标上刻画安全与拒答行为）、SynthBench（用作者实验室产生的私有实验数据评估反应结果预测与催化剂选择）。
zh.summary: 这套套件的出发点是：公开的化学评测可能早已进入模型训练语料，因此 onepot-Bench 0 把最硬的部分锚定在不可能泄漏的数据上——作者自己实验室做出的实验。ChemAbacus 探测模型不借助工具能对分子算出什么；SynthRefusal 刻画模型在从良性到设计毒品合成目标的谱系上把安全线画在哪里；SynthBench 要求预测只有私有实验记录才能证实的反应结果与催化剂选择。

works.title: Position: AI Agents in Scientific Teams Should Be Studied as Human-Agent Systems
works.overview: A position paper arguing that research on "AI Scientists" has concentrated on autonomous capability and thereby overlooked the social reality of scientific teamwork. It proposes that the unit of analysis should be the human-agent pair rather than the agent, assembles evidence that ignoring human-agent dynamics carries near-term risks, and sketches a decision-theoretic frame for measuring human-AI synergy.
works.summary: A human-agent system (HAS) is defined by four components — agents, human participants, an interface mediating interaction through actions, and the environment the system sits in — and its defining commitment is that the *pair* is what gets studied. The authors argue that current AI-Scientist work supports human participation mainly at two points, setting goals and verifying finished work, with few systems supporting the sustained, iterative, joint collaboration typical of human teams; and that the HAS literature has largely stayed isolated from the socio-technical realities of science. The paper builds its case in three moves. It surveys accruing evidence that deploying AI in science at scale carries risks that are invisible to autonomy-focused evaluation. It then analyses two published accounts of working scientists collaborating with agents, drawing out reciprocal augmentation — humans supplying conceptual framing, domain judgment and epistemic verification; agents compressing implementation while occasionally contributing conceptually. Finally it introduces a toy utility model and a set of open questions, and reports a small preliminary experiment on feedback-seeking behaviour. It also acknowledges that complementarity has empirically appeared rarely, suggesting this may reflect structural barriers — incentives favouring autonomy research, and the cost of rigorous human studies.
works.domains_text: No canonical domain is assigned. The paper's subject is the methodology of studying scientific agents rather than any scientific field; its two case studies happen to sit in complexity theory and plasma physics, but they are illustrative accounts rather than evaluated tasks.

zh.overview: 一篇立场论文，主张关于「AI 科学家」的研究一直集中在自主能力上，因而忽略了科研协作的社会性现实。作者提出分析单元应当是人—agent 这个二元组而非 agent 本身，汇集了「忽视人机互动会带来近期风险」的证据，并勾勒出一个衡量人机协同增益的决策论框架。
zh.summary: 人—agent 系统（HAS）由四个部分定义——agent、人类参与者、通过动作促成人机交互的界面，以及系统所处的环境——它的核心主张是：被研究的对象应当是这个**二元组**。作者指出，当前的 AI 科学家工作主要在两个节点支持人类参与，即设定目标与验收成果，而很少有系统支持人类团队中那种持续、迭代、共同推进的协作；同时，HAS 这一支文献又基本与科研的社会技术现实相隔离。论文分三步立论。它先梳理了「大规模部署 AI 科学家会带来风险」的累积证据，而这些风险恰恰是以自主性为中心的评估看不见的。接着它分析两份已发表的、真实科学家与 agent 协作的记录，从中抽出相互增益的模式——人类提供概念框定、领域判断与认识论把关；agent 压缩实现工作，偶尔也在概念层面有所贡献。最后它给出一个玩具效用模型和一组开放问题，并报告了一项关于「主动求反馈」行为的小型实验。论文也承认互补性在经验上很少出现，并提出这可能反映的是结构性障碍：激励机制偏向自主性研究，而严谨的人类实验成本高昂。

works.title: PATH-Bench
works.overview: PATH-Bench is a benchmark for path-dependent evaluation of lifelong LLM agents: it constructs controlled sequences of tasks with known transfer relationships and measures how the *order and content* of accumulated experience — stored as retrieved memories or as reusable skills — changes what a frozen-backbone agent transfers, retains, and forgets.
works.summary: Lifelong agents adapt by writing past interactions into an external learning state around a frozen backbone, but benchmarks normally run fixed or randomized task streams, which cannot reveal how the *path* of experience shapes later performance. PATH-Bench replaces exhaustive enumeration of histories with sampling guided by an estimated task-relation matrix, and replaces repeated re-evaluation of the whole task set with longitudinal tracking of a single recurring probe task. It reports one overall metric (Average Performance) and three learning-dynamics metrics (forward transfer, backward transfer, forgetting) read from the probe trajectory alone, and evaluates eight lifelong agents spanning retrieval-augmented generation, agentic memory, and skill accumulation. The authors additionally propose Selective Experience Use (SEU), an agent harness that filters which accumulated items may influence each new task.
works.domains_text: General-purpose agent settings — program synthesis and multi-turn tool use. No canonical science or engineering domain is targeted; the evaluated object is the path dependence of experience accumulation, not a domain task.

zh.overview: PATH-Bench 是面向终身 LLM agent 的路径依赖评估 benchmark：它构造迁移关系已知的受控任务序列，度量累积经验的*顺序与内容*——无论存成可检索的记忆还是可复用的 skill——如何改变一个骨干冻结的 agent 迁移什么、保留什么、遗忘什么。
zh.summary: 终身 agent 的适应方式，是把过往交互写进冻结骨干之外的外部学习状态；但 benchmark 通常只跑固定或随机打乱的任务流，无法揭示经验的*路径*如何塑造后续表现。PATH-Bench 做了两处替换：用一个估计出来的任务关系矩阵引导采样，代替对历史的穷举枚举；用对单个反复出现的探针任务做纵向追踪，代替对整套任务的反复重测。它报告一个总体指标（Average Performance）与三个学习动力学指标（前向迁移、后向迁移、遗忘），全部只从探针轨迹上读出；并评估了八个终身 agent，涵盖检索增强生成、agentic 记忆与 skill 累积三类。作者另外提出 Selective Experience Use（SEU）——一套 agent harness，它会筛选哪些累积条目可以影响新任务。

works.title: CRAFTS
works.overview: CRAFTS is a role-decomposed, fine-tuned LLM-agent system for automated construction of executable chemical-process simulation models, introduced together with OpenIDAES-450, a 450-case IDAES process-simulation dataset with a held-out evaluation split and structured validation contracts.
works.summary: CRAFTS (Collaborative Role-Adaptive Fine-Tuning of LLM Agents for Chemical Process Simulation) builds executable IDAES/Pyomo process-simulation models from natural-language requests and process flowsheet diagram (PFD) evidence. The task is decomposed into seven bounded roles that mirror the staged workflow of chemical engineers, with deterministic IDAES/Pyomo gates validating typed intermediate artifacts between stages. The work is evaluated on OpenIDAES-450, a 450-case IDAES process-simulation dataset introduced by the same paper, using a workflow-success contract and structural F1 metrics on a frozen held-out split.
works.domains_text: Chemical Engineering — the evaluated objective is automated construction of executable chemical-process simulation models (flowsheeting) in IDAES/Pyomo, a process systems engineering task centered on unit operations, streams, and process topology.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: CRAFTS 是一套角色分工、经微调的 LLM agent 系统，用于自动构建可执行的化工过程仿真模型；随之一同提出的还有 OpenIDAES-450——一个含 450 个案例的 IDAES 过程仿真数据集，配有留出评测划分与结构化的校验契约。
zh.summary: CRAFTS（Collaborative Role-Adaptive Fine-Tuning of LLM Agents for Chemical Process Simulation）从自然语言请求与工艺流程图（PFD）证据出发，构建可执行的 IDAES/Pyomo 过程仿真模型。它把任务拆解为七个边界清晰的角色，对应化学工程师分阶段推进的工作流；阶段之间由确定性的 IDAES/Pyomo 关卡校验带类型的中间产物。评测在同篇论文提出的 450 案例 IDAES 过程仿真数据集 OpenIDAES-450 上进行，取其中冻结的留出划分，以工作流成功契约与结构 F1 为指标。

works.title: MDArena
works.overview: MDArena is a benchmark that evaluates coding agents on realistic molecular dynamics (MD) workflows. It comprises 50 containerized tasks sourced from active research projects, spanning 29 molecular systems and 14 research protocols.
works.summary: MDArena argues that while coding agents show promise for automating scientific workflows, their reliability on realistic molecular dynamics tasks remains poorly characterized. The benchmark packages authentic biomolecular simulation work — trajectory analysis, system preparation, free-energy calculations, and enhanced sampling — into containerized tasks and scores agents with strict success rates alongside process-level partial credit.
works.domains_text: Biomolecular simulation and computational chemistry, including membrane-protein systems and alchemical free-energy calculations.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: MDArena 是评估 coding agent 在真实分子动力学（MD）工作流上表现的 benchmark，包含 50 个容器化任务，来源于进行中的研究项目，覆盖 29 个分子体系与 14 种研究方案。
zh.summary: MDArena 指出：尽管 coding agent 在自动化科学工作流上被寄予厚望，它们在真实分子动力学任务上的可靠性仍缺乏刻画。该 benchmark 把真实的生物分子模拟工作——轨迹分析、体系搭建、自由能计算与增强采样——打包为容器化任务，用严格成功率与过程级部分得分共同计分。

works.title: LoopsBench
works.overview: LoopsBench is a long-horizon benchmark for evaluating coding agents on "loop engineering" — sustained, multi-step software development — where each task is a dependency DAG over separately testable development units with source-evidenced prerequisite edges.
works.summary: LoopsBench targets the shift in coding-agent infrastructure from harness engineering toward loop engineering, arguing that existing benchmarks center on localized tasks or end-state outcomes and give limited insight into sustained execution. Each task is modeled as a dependency DAG whose nodes are separately testable development units connected by source-evidenced prerequisite edges. A flow-aware runtime releases tests along the "ready frontier" as prerequisites are satisfied and retains completed nodes as regression obligations, so an agent must both make forward progress and avoid breaking earlier work. The authors evaluate frontier coding agents paired with widely used loop implementations.
works.domains_text: Software development across 8 programming languages and 9 domains (specific domain names: `TODO(reference)`). The benchmark evaluates coding agents on sustained software-engineering work.

zh.overview: LoopsBench 是一个长 horizon benchmark，用于评估 coding agent 的「循环工程（loop engineering）」——即持续、多步的软件开发；其中每个任务都是一张由可分别测试的开发单元构成的依赖 DAG，先决关系的边有源码证据支撑。
zh.summary: LoopsBench 关注 coding-agent 基础设施从 harness 工程向循环工程的转变，认为既有 benchmark 多聚焦于局部任务或终态结果，对持续执行的洞察有限。每个任务被建模为一张依赖 DAG，其节点是可分别测试的开发单元，由有源码证据的先决边相连。一个「流感知」（flow-aware）运行时会随着先决条件被满足，沿「就绪前沿」逐步释放测试，并把已完成的节点保留为回归义务，因此 agent 既要向前推进，又要避免破坏此前的成果。作者评估了与广泛使用的循环实现配对的前沿 coding agent。

works.title: OSReward
works.overview: OSReward is a standardized benchmark for evaluating cross-platform computer-use reward models — vision-language judges of computer-using agent trajectories — released together with the OS-Shepherd-100K corpus of reasoning-annotated trajectory judgments and trained OS-Shepherd reward models (9B and 35B).
works.summary: OSReward establishes ground-truth verdicts through multi-stage human annotation of trajectories from diverse agent backbones across platforms, and identifies systematic leniency bias in state-of-the-art model judges. It ships three variants — the main benchmark, OSReward-Hard for difficult cases, and OSReward-Multi for fine-grained efficiency and alignment scoring — plus OS-Shepherd-100K and open reward models that match commercial judges at 30–60× lower cost.
works.domains_text: Cross-platform computer-use trajectories (evaluated as reward-model input, not as a science domain).

zh.overview: OSReward 是评估跨平台 computer-use 奖励模型——对 computer-using agent 轨迹做评判的视觉语言评判者——的标准化 benchmark，随之发布带推理标注的轨迹评判语料 OS-Shepherd-100K 与训练好的 OS-Shepherd 奖励模型（9B 与 35B）。
zh.summary: OSReward 通过对来自多平台、多 agent backbone 的轨迹做多阶段人工标注来确立真值判定，并发现最先进模型评判者存在系统性宽松偏差。它提供三个变体——主 benchmark、面向疑难案例的 OSReward-Hard、面向细粒度效率与对齐评分的 OSReward-Multi——外加 OS-Shepherd-100K 语料与开源奖励模型，后者能以约三十到六十分之一的成本达到商业评判者的水平。

works.title: Cognitive Agents for Bridge Inspection Prioritization
works.overview: An empirical evaluation that places a standards-grounded LLM agent for highway-bridge inspection prioritization against three non-LLM baselines on six consecutive annual National Bridge Inventory (NBI) snapshots, scoring every method against observed future bridge deterioration and adding an independent blind rating of the agent's written rationales by a licensed bridge inspector.
works.summary: The study asks two questions about an LLM agent applied to a regulated civil-infrastructure decision: how much of sustained bridge deterioration is predictable from inventory data at all, and what auditable reasoning contributes when that predictive signal is weak. Four prioritization methods — the fixed 24-month calendar cycle that represents present practice, a transparent weighted rule-based risk index, a cross-validated gradient-boosted ensemble, and a retrieval-grounded LLM agent — are run on an identical analytic sample of Connecticut bridges and scored against three progressively more specific definitions of observed future deterioration. The agent matches the transparent index on ranking performance (per-bridge priority scores correlate at r = 0.85) and trails the statistical learner on the two outcomes where the learner recovers signal, while both interpretable methods beat the opaque learner on the policy-relevant poor-condition outcome. The authors frame the contribution as a reproducible benchmark of how outcome definition governs predictability, and position language-model agents in a measured accuracy-versus-transparency tradeoff rather than claiming predictive superiority.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering — highway bridge inspection and infrastructure asset management. The evaluated objective is a regulated civil-engineering decision: which physical bridges an agency should inspect first and at what interval, judged against recorded deterioration of deck, superstructure and substructure components on the FHWA zero-to-nine condition scale, with the agent's reasoning grounded in the National Bridge Inspection Standards and the AASHTO *Manual for Bridge Element Inspection* (2nd ed., 2019). No co-domain is claimed; the deterioration modelling is applied to bridge structures rather than to an earth-science or generic-ML object.

zh.overview: 一项实证评估：把一个以标准为依据、用于公路桥梁检测排序的 LLM agent，与三个非 LLM 基线放在连续六年的 National Bridge Inventory（NBI）年度快照上比较，所有方法都对照实际观测到的桥梁劣化情况计分；另请一位持证桥梁检测工程师对 agent 写出的理由做独立盲评。
zh.summary: 围绕「把 LLM agent 用于一项受规范约束的土木基础设施决策」，研究提出两个问题：单凭台账数据，桥梁的持续性劣化究竟有多少是可预测的；当这种预测信号本就微弱时，可审计的推理又能带来什么。四种排序方法在同一份康涅狄格州桥梁分析样本上运行——代表现行做法的固定 24 个月周期、一个透明的加权规则风险指数、一个经交叉验证的梯度提升集成模型，以及一个由检索提供依据的 LLM agent——并按三种越来越具体的「未来劣化」定义分别打分。在排序表现上，agent 与那个透明指数不相上下（两者逐桥的优先级分数相关系数 r = 0.85）；在统计学习器能捕到信号的那两个结果上，agent 落后于它；而在与政策最相关的「跌入 poor 状态」这一结果上，两个可解释方法都胜过不透明的学习器。作者把贡献定位为一个可复现的 benchmark，用以说明结果定义如何左右可预测性；并把语言模型 agent 放进一个经过实测的「准确性对透明性」权衡里，而不是宣称它预测更准。

works.title: BACKROOMBench
works.overview: BACKROOMBench is a verified testbed, built on the BACKTRACE evaluation framework, that measures whether a skill-augmented language agent's *stated* skill use matches the skill's *intervention-measured* causal influence on its answer.
works.summary: Evaluators of skill-augmented agents normally infer skill use from the agent's visible reasoning or from its own self-attribution, but those signals report what the agent *appears* to use rather than whether the skill changed the decision. BACKTRACE closes that gap by pairing every skill-conditioned answer with a matched no-skill counterfactual, intervening on the skill's meaning, wording, identity, content, and assignment, and eliciting the agent's attribution only after the answer has been committed. BACKROOMBench instantiates the framework over controlled logic and competition mathematics, across single-agent and multi-agent settings and several model families. The authors name the resulting phenomenon the *Reasoning Backroom*: a systematic divergence between stated skill use and measured causal reliance.
works.domains_text: No canonical science or engineering domain is assigned. The two task sources — PrOntoQA-style synthetic logic and MATH-500 competition problems — are used as controlled substrates chosen for verifiability, and the measured quantity is the provenance of skill influence rather than mathematical or logical competence. Assigning Mathematics on the basis of the substrate would over-extend the domain axis.

zh.overview: BACKROOMBench 是建立在 BACKTRACE 评估框架之上的可验证测试床，用来度量 skill 增强的语言 agent *自述*的 skill 使用，与该 skill 对其答案的因果影响是否一致——后者由*干预实验测得*。
zh.summary: 评估 skill 增强 agent 时，通常从 agent 可见的推理过程、或它自己的归因陈述来推断它用了哪些 skill；但这些信号说明的是 agent *看起来*用了什么，而非该 skill 是否真的改变了决策。BACKTRACE 用三件事补上这道缺口：为每个带 skill 的作答配一个条件匹配的无 skill 反事实；在 skill 的含义、措辞、身份、内容与指派上施加干预；并且只在答案已经落定之后才向 agent 索取归因。BACKROOMBench 把这套框架落到受控逻辑题与竞赛数学题上，覆盖单 agent 与多 agent 设定以及多个模型家族。作者把由此浮现的现象命名为 *Reasoning Backroom*：自述的 skill 使用与实测的因果依赖之间存在系统性背离。

works.title: AI's Capability in Assisting Scientific Research in Physics, Astrophysics, and Cosmology I: Literature Review
works.overview: A controlled head-to-head comparison of AI-assisted and human-expert literature review on eight real frontier research projects in physics, astrophysics and cosmology, measuring how far AI-selected references overlap with expert-selected ones and quantifying fabrication and metadata-mismatch rates across 701 AI-generated references.
works.summary: Eight frontier research projects were designed by working researchers, each accompanied by a title, background and goal of at most three sentences. For every project, one human expert — a graduate student or postdoc active on that topic — performed an independent literature search, while separate non-expert student "prompters" issued standardized prompts to three AI systems and collected their reference lists. Both sides were capped at 50 papers and required to sort them into four categories: recent review papers, historically important highly cited papers, recent papers, and other relevant papers. The domain expert then judged the relevance of every AI-returned reference, and every AI reference was verified by sequential DOI resolution, link resolution and title search. The two headline findings are that human–AI overlap is under 6% on every model, and that only a third of AI-produced references are metadata-perfect.
works.domains_text: Astronomy and astrophysics is the dominant field: six of the eight projects are astrophysical or cosmological (AGN and galaxy evolution, Lyman-break galaxies, weak-lensing intrinsic alignments, CMB foreground radio galaxies, gravitational-wave binary environments, and pulsar timing arrays). Physics is a genuine co-domain — the pulsar-timing project tests deviations from general relativity, the massive Yang–Mills project is theoretical field theory, and the laser-ablation project is instrumentation and materials physics rather than astronomy.

zh.overview: 一项对照实验，把 AI 辅助的文献综述与人类专家的文献综述放在物理、天体物理与宇宙学的八个真实前沿项目上正面比较：既测量 AI 选出的参考文献与专家所选的重合程度，也在 701 条 AI 生成的参考文献上量化编造率与元数据错配率。
zh.summary: 八个前沿项目由在职研究者设计，每个项目配一份不超过三句话的标题、背景与目标。每个项目上，一位人类专家——正在该方向工作的研究生或博士后——独立完成一次文献检索；与此同时，由并非该方向专家的学生充当「提示员」，用标准化提示词向三个 AI 系统提问并收集其参考文献列表。双方都以 50 篇为上限，且都必须把文献归入四类：近期综述、历史上重要的高被引论文、近期论文，以及其他相关论文。随后由领域专家逐条判断 AI 返回文献的相关性，每条 AI 文献还要依次经 DOI 解析、链接解析与标题检索来核验。两条头条结论是：所有模型的人–AI 重合度都不足 6%；AI 产出的参考文献中，元数据完全正确的只有三分之一。

works.title: AI's Capability in Assisting Scientific Research in Physics, Astrophysics and Cosmology II: Project Planning and Proposal Evaluation
works.overview: A blind comparison of human-written and LLM-written research project proposals for eight real physics, astrophysics and cosmology projects, scored by four human reviewers and two frontier LLM reviewers against a shared four-aspect rubric, which also measures whether reviewers can tell the two apart and how strongly LLM judges favour LLM-written text.
works.summary: Using the same eight expert-designed projects as the companion literature-review study, the authors gave each project's title, background and goal to one human domain expert and to three LLMs, each of which produced a one-page project proposal on an identical template. The resulting 32 proposals (8 human, 24 AI) were anonymized and uniformly formatted, then given to four faculty or senior-postdoc reviewers and to two frontier LLM reviewers, who each performed two tasks: guess whether the proposal was human- or AI-written, and score it 1–5 on four rubric aspects. Human reviewers rated human and AI proposals about equally overall, while both LLM reviewers scored AI-written proposals roughly one full point higher — a self-preference effect absent from the human panel. Where AI proposals did win with human reviewers, it was concentrated on the projects where the human author had invested least effort, an anti-correlation the authors quantify at r ≈ −0.95.
works.domains_text: Astronomy and astrophysics dominates: six of the eight projects are astrophysical or cosmological, covering AGN and galaxy evolution, large-scale structure, weak lensing, CMB foregrounds, gravitational-wave source environments, and pulsar timing arrays — and the proposals must plan real observational or survey analyses using named datasets and instruments. Physics is a co-domain through the massive Yang–Mills project and the laser-ablation instrumentation project.

zh.overview: 围绕八个真实的物理、天体物理与宇宙学项目，把人类撰写与 LLM 撰写的研究项目计划书做盲评对照：四位人类评审和两个前沿 LLM 评审依同一套四维评分细则打分，同时测量评审能否分辨两者出自谁手，以及 LLM 评判者偏向 LLM 文本的程度有多强。
zh.summary: 作者沿用配套的文献综述研究中那八个由专家设计的项目，把每个项目的标题、背景与目标交给一位人类领域专家和三个 LLM，各自按同一份模板写出一页篇幅的项目计划书。产出的 32 份计划书（8 份人类、24 份 AI）经匿名化和统一排版后，交给四位教职人员或资深博士后，以及两个前沿 LLM 评审，每位评审做两件事：判断这份计划书出自人类还是 AI，并按四个维度打 1–5 分。人类评审给人类和 AI 计划书的总体评分大体持平，两个 LLM 评审却给 AI 撰写的计划书高出约整整一分——这种自我偏好在人类评审组中并不存在。AI 计划书在人类评审那里占上风的场合，集中在人类作者投入精力最少的那几个项目上，作者把这一负相关量化为 r ≈ −0.95。

works.title: LabRobFail
works.overview: LabRobFail benchmarks robotic failure analysis in chemical self-driving laboratories: over 20,000 trajectories across 70+ task scenarios with failures injected at the control, physics, and semantic levels (five categories, 11 fine-grained types), evaluating six capabilities from failure detection to actionable correction — the paired domain-specialized VLM reaches 90.83% detection accuracy and lifts downstream task success by 4–16 percentage points as a real-time supervisor.
works.summary: Self-driving labs fail in ways household robots don't — a mis-gripped vial or mis-timed transfer silently corrupts an experiment. LabRobFail builds the failure-centric evaluation stack for this setting: LabRobFail-Sim injects anomalies into Isaac Sim lab-robot executions at three levels, LabRobFail-Data accumulates 20,000+ trajectories over 70+ scenarios, and LabRobFail-Bench scores six capabilities — task understanding, failure detection, temporal localization, severity assessment, failure classification, and actionable correction. LabRobFail-VLM, the domain-specialized model, achieves 90.83% failure-detection and 77.21% temporal-localization accuracy, substantially outperforming general-purpose VLMs, and improves downstream task success by 4–16 points when integrated as a real-time supervisor.
works.domains_text: Robotics — laboratory-robot manipulation failure analysis: control-, physics-, and semantic-level anomalies in simulated chemical self-driving-lab executions, with the VLM deployed as a closed-loop supervisor.

zh.overview: LabRobFail 评测化学自主实验室中的机器人失败分析：20,000+ 条轨迹、70+ 个任务场景，失败在控制、物理、语义三个层级被注入（五个类别、11 种细粒度类型），评估从失败检测到可执行纠正的六项能力——配套的领域专用 VLM 达到 90.83% 检测准确率，作为实时监督者把下游任务成功率抬高 4–16 个百分点。
zh.summary: 自主实验室的失败方式与家用机器人不同——一次夹错的样品瓶或一次错时的转移会悄无声息地毁掉一次实验。LabRobFail 为这一场景搭起失败中心的评估栈：LabRobFail-Sim 在 Isaac Sim 的实验室机器人执行中于三个层级注入异常，LabRobFail-Data 汇聚 20,000+ 条覆盖 70+ 场景的轨迹，LabRobFail-Bench 评估六项能力——任务理解、失败检测、时间定位、严重度评估、失败分类与可执行纠正。领域专用模型 LabRobFail-VLM 达到 90.83% 的失败检测与 77.21% 的时间定位准确率，明显优于通用 VLM，作为实时监督者接入后把下游任务成功率提高 4–16 个百分点。

works.title: SciExplore
works.overview: SciExplore is a benchmark evaluating autonomous agents on scientific information seeking, from database navigation to cross-source information integration. It comprises 103 expert-curated tasks in four progressive task types across more than ten scientific disciplines.
works.summary: SciExplore evaluates the scientific information-seeking and reasoning capabilities of LLMs and agents through four progressive task types — scientific database navigation, ambiguous literature retrieval, missing reference completion, and cross-source structured knowledge synthesis — assessing capabilities from entity-level reasoning and document-level identification to evidence-level grounding and domain-level synthesis.
works.domains_text: More than ten scientific disciplines; the abstract does not itemize them.

zh.overview: SciExplore 是评估自主 agent 科学信息获取能力的 benchmark，覆盖从数据库导航到跨源信息整合，含四类渐进任务、103 个专家整理的任务，横跨十余个科学学科。
zh.summary: SciExplore 通过四类渐进任务评估 LLM 与 agent 的科学信息获取与推理能力——科学数据库导航、表述模糊的文献检索、缺失参考文献补全、跨源结构化知识综合——考察从实体级推理、文档级识别到证据级 grounding 与领域级综合的能力谱。

works.title: AutoWorldModel-Bench
works.overview: AutoWorldModel-Bench is a closed-loop benchmark in which a frontier coding agent is handed a working world model and a fixed compute budget and asked to make it better, with no improvement direction specified in advance. Eight game environments share a unified structured-state representation that strips out perception, isolating dynamics modeling and keeping each training run short enough for many iterations inside a session.
works.summary: The authors argue that world modeling is a good testbed for autonomous research precisely because it is unsettled: architectures, training objectives and state representations interact in complicated ways and no recipe dominates across environments, so there is no specification to code to. That distinguishes it from the engineering-to-spec tasks that dominate current agent benchmarks. The benchmark supplies a single-file base world model — one of four architectures — and asks the agent to improve it however it sees fit, whether by changing the architecture, the loss, the hyperparameters or the training procedure. All eight games expose ground-truth entity state through a shared tensor format, so the agent never confronts pixels and the measured quantity is transition modeling over known entities. Runs are short by design, allowing minutes-per-run iteration inside a bounded session. Beyond the aggregate improvement rates, the paper audits *what kind* of edit won each session, finding that in the overwhelming majority the winning change was substantive rather than a hyperparameter tweak.
works.domains_text: **AI & Machine Learning Research.** The evaluated object is a learned world model and the agent's work is machine-learning research — architecture, loss and training-procedure changes measured by held-out predictive accuracy. The game environments are a substrate for generating dynamics, not a domain of study in themselves, so no other canonical domain is assigned.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: AutoWorldModel-Bench 是一个闭环 benchmark：交给前沿编码 agent 一个能用的世界模型和一份固定算力预算，让它把模型改好，而改进方向事先并不指定。八个游戏环境共用一套结构化状态表示，把感知整个剥离出去，从而单独隔离出动力学建模，也让每次训练短到足以在一个会话内反复迭代。
zh.summary: 作者的论点是：世界建模恰恰因为悬而未决，才是自主研究的好试验场——架构、训练目标与状态表示之间相互影响的方式很复杂，跨环境也没有哪一套配方占优，于是根本无「规格」可写。这一点把它与当前 agent benchmark 中占主导的「照规格施工」任务区分开来。benchmark 提供一份单文件的基础世界模型——四种架构之一——让 agent 自行决定怎么改进：动架构、动损失、动超参，或动训练流程都可以。八个游戏都通过共享张量格式暴露真值实体状态，agent 因此从不面对像素，被测的量就是已知实体上的转移建模。运行时间刻意压得很短，使会话预算内能做到分钟级的迭代。除了总体改进率之外，论文还审计了每个会话里**赢在哪种改动**上，发现绝大多数会话中胜出的改动是实质性的，而非调参。

works.title: Automating Structural Reliability Analysis with a Multi-Agent Large Language Model Framework
works.overview: A five-agent LLM framework that carries component-level structural reliability analysis from a natural-language problem statement to an interpreted reliability index and failure probability, released with a held-out 20-problem reliability benchmark whose reference solutions come from validated solvers and whose method-category labels come from a published deterministic criterion.
works.summary: Structural reliability analysis quantifies the probability that a building or piece of civil infrastructure exceeds a prescribed limit state, but running one requires expertise in probability theory, structural mechanics and numerical simulation simultaneously. The paper builds a multi-agent pipeline in which specialized LLM agents handle problem formulation, method planning, solver-code generation and result interpretation, while the reliability index β and failure probability P_f are produced only by a deterministic non-LLM runner executing validated solvers, so no numerical result is ever generated by a language model. The single hardest decision — choosing a priori which family of reliability methods will be accurate enough at acceptable cost — is isolated in a Method Planner, the only fine-tuned agent, adapted with QLoRA on 150 synthetic examples labelled by a deterministic reference criterion. Evaluation is on a held-out set of 20 hand-authored reliability problems disjoint from training, used both for end-to-end execution against reference solutions and for an independent comparison of three model configurations on method-category selection.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering. The evaluated objective is reliability-based safety assessment of structural components and civil infrastructure — beam yielding, concrete compression, column buckling, bridge girders under correlated loads, an offshore jacket, a pile group, and a Mohr–Coulomb slope — with results interpreted against code target reliability levels such as the β = 3.8 ultimate-limit-state value in Eurocode EN 1990 over a 50-year reference period. This spans the domain's structural analysis, geotechnical engineering and design-code scope. The authors are in civil engineering departments at the University of Toronto, Seoul National University and Yonsei University. The problem set touches geotechnical (slope stability, pile group) and offshore (jacket structure, wave overtopping) cases, but these are individual items within a structural-reliability set rather than separate evaluated fields, so no Earth Science or Energy Systems co-domain is assigned.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: 一个由五个 agent 组成的 LLM 框架，把构件级结构可靠度分析从自然语言题面一路做到给出可靠指标与失效概率并加以解读；随论文发布的还有一套留出的 20 题可靠度 benchmark，其参考解由经过验证的求解器给出，方法类别标签则由一条公开的确定性判据生成。
zh.summary: 结构可靠度分析量化的是建筑或土木基础设施超出规定极限状态的概率，但要真正做一次，需要同时具备概率论、结构力学与数值仿真三方面的专长。论文搭建了一条多 agent流水线：问题表述、方法规划、求解器代码生成与结果解读由专门的 LLM agent 负责，而可靠指标 β 与失效概率 P_f 只由一个确定性的非 LLM 运行器调用经过验证的求解器算出——任何数值结果都不出自语言模型。整条流程中最难的一步判断，是事先选定哪一族可靠度方法既够准又代价可接受；论文把这一步单独交给 Method Planner，也是唯一经过微调的 agent，用 QLoRA 在 150 个由确定性参考判据打标的合成样例上适配得到。评估在一套留出的、与训练数据不相交的 20 道手工编写可靠度题目上进行，既用于端到端执行与参考解的对照，也用于在方法类别选择这一环节上独立比较三种模型配置。

works.title: StructureClaw
works.overview: StructureClaw pairs a traceable LLM-agent workbench for structural engineering with an executable benchmark of 150 controlled scenarios spanning standard workflows, interactive robustness, and multimodal structural-model reconstruction, verified by strict structural-model matching and numerical agreement with frozen reference solver responses.
works.summary: Agents operate an artifact-centered workbench — governed engineering skills, typed tools, shared artifact state, and local analysis backends (OpenSees among them, per the official repository) — carrying tasks from structural model through validation, solver execution, code checks, and reporting. A trial succeeds only when every fixture-required assertion passes: one-to-one structural-model matching plus numerical-response agreement with frozen reference responses; interactive cases additionally require positive clarification or recovery evidence, together with safe non-execution when appropriate. Across nine text-agent configurations, generic-only execution passes the model-artifact check 87.0% of the time but achieves only 22.0% end-to-end success, while the automatic StructureClaw configuration reaches 82.9%.
works.domains_text: Structural engineering: structural analysis workflows, model validation, solver execution, and code compliance checks.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: StructureClaw 把一个可追溯的结构工程 LLM agent 工作台与一个可执行 benchmark 配对：150 个受控场景横跨标准工作流、交互鲁棒性与多模态结构模型重构，以严格的结构模型匹配与「对照冻结参考求解器响应的数值一致性」验证。
zh.summary: agent 在以工件为中心的工作台上操作——受治理的工程技能、带类型的工具、共享工件状态与本地分析后端（据官方仓库含 OpenSees）——把任务从结构模型一路做到验证、求解、规范校核与报告。一次试验只有在每条 fixture 要求的断言都通过时才算成功：结构模型一对一匹配，加上与冻结参考响应的数值一致；交互类算例还须给出澄清或恢复的正面证据，并在恰当时安全地不执行。在九种文本 agent 配置中，仅通用执行的配置有 87.0% 通过模型工件检查，端到端成功率却只有 22.0%；自动化的 StructureClaw 配置达到 82.9%。

works.title: LQCDMaster
works.overview: LQCDMaster is a skill-guided lattice-QCD computing agent released together with a 70-task benchmark of lattice-QCD measurement code, in which each generated PyQUDA workflow is checked by direct numerical comparison against an expert-written reference implementation at machine precision.
works.summary: Lattice quantum chromodynamics (LQCD) computes hadronic observables from first principles, but turning a research motivation into a reliable computing workflow demands substantial expertise. LQCDMaster converts natural-language LQCD research tasks into executable PyQUDA workflows — measurement scripts, job-submission artifacts, execution logs and numerical outputs — by combining agentic planning, expert-annotated LQCD skills, and a deterministic Wick-contraction tool (`generate_einsum`) that constrains the algebraically fragile part of code generation. The evaluation contribution is a 70-task LQCD computing benchmark with expert reference implementations and a machine-precision verification protocol, released with the code.
works.domains_text: Physics — lattice quantum chromodynamics, a first-principles hadronic-structure and spectroscopy setting (mesons, baryons, Wilson loops, light-cone distribution amplitudes, light nuclei and hypernuclei spectra). The workflows are executed through the PyQUDA/QUDA GPU stack with SLURM job submission, so the tasks also exercise scientific software and HPC workflow engineering, but the evaluated objective is a physics observable.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: LQCDMaster 是一个 skill 引导的格点量子色动力学计算 agent，随之发布一个含 70 个任务的格点 QCD 测量代码 benchmark：每一份生成的 PyQUDA 工作流都要与专家手写的参考实现在机器精度上做直接数值比对来验收。
zh.summary: 格点量子色动力学（LQCD）从第一性原理计算强子可观测量，但要把一个研究动机变成可靠的计算工作流，需要相当深的专业积累。LQCDMaster 把自然语言表述的 LQCD 研究任务转成可执行的 PyQUDA 工作流——测量脚本、作业提交产物、执行日志与数值输出——做法是把 agentic 规划、专家标注的 LQCD skill，以及一个确定性的 Wick 缩并工具（`generate_einsum`）结合起来，用后者约束代码生成中代数上最脆弱的那一环。评测方面的贡献是一个含 70 个任务的 LQCD 计算 benchmark，配专家参考实现与机器精度的验证协议，与代码一同发布。

works.title: SkillSec-Eval
works.overview: SkillSec-Eval is a lifecycle-aware evaluation framework for reusable agent skills: it decomposes the skill lifecycle into five stages with distinct trust boundaries — repository admission, semantic retrieval, planner selection, runtime execution, and skill evolution — and evaluates attacks and defenses separately at each stage over a repository of 327 real-world skills.
works.summary: Reusable skills package agent capabilities for sharing and reuse, but security research has concentrated on prompt injection and runtime execution, leaving the rest of the lifecycle unexamined. The paper builds a threat taxonomy organized by the trust boundary each attack violates, instantiates it as SkillSec-Eval, and runs a stage-by-stage empirical study with attack and defense conditions at every stage. The result is a per-stage vulnerability profile rather than a single aggregate safety score, showing that failures arise well before execution — at admission, retrieval and planner selection.
works.domains_text: Reusable skills for general-purpose LLM agents, sourced from an enterprise skill repository whose clusters are infrastructure, DevOps, software and data engineering, and business automation. The evaluated object is the security of the skill lifecycle rather than a domain task, so no canonical science or engineering domain is assigned.

zh.overview: SkillSec-Eval 是面向可复用 agent skill 的生命周期感知评估框架：它把 skill 生命周期拆成五个信任边界各异的阶段——仓库准入、语义检索、规划器选择、运行时执行与 skill 演化——并在一个含 327 个真实 skill 的仓库上逐阶段分别评估攻击与防御。
zh.summary: 可复用 skill 把 agent 能力打包起来以便共享与复用，但安全研究一直集中在 prompt injection 与运行时执行上，生命周期的其余环节无人审视。论文按每类攻击所突破的信任边界组织出一套威胁分类法，把它实例化为 SkillSec-Eval，并逐阶段开展实证研究，每个阶段都设攻击与防御两种条件。得到的是一份逐阶段的脆弱性画像，而非单一的聚合安全分数；它表明失效远在执行之前就已出现——在准入、检索与规划器选择环节。

works.title: FukuyamaBench
works.overview: FukuyamaBench is a difficult benchmark for hierarchical reaction-mechanism reasoning, derived from Fukuyama's Advanced Organic Reaction Mechanism book; it is released by a training-focused paper on mechanistic reasoning, whose fine-tuned Qwen3-30B-A3B reaches 8.3% exact pathway match on Set A, surpassing the specialized FlowER model (5.1%).
works.summary: The paper "Learning Mechanistic Reasoning for Chemical Reactions with Large Language Models" builds a large-scale reasoning dataset of reaction mechanisms for training, then establishes FukuyamaBench to rigorously evaluate hierarchical mechanism reasoning — deducing full elementary-reaction pathways, not just products. The headline evaluation result: mechanism-aware fine-tuning brings Qwen3-30B-A3B to 8.3% exact pathway match on FukuyamaBench Set A versus 5.1% for the specialized FlowER model — numbers that mostly demonstrate how hard the benchmark is.
works.domains_text: Chemistry — organic reaction mechanisms: elementary-step pathway reasoning underlying product prediction and retrosynthesis.

zh.overview: FukuyamaBench 是层级化反应机理推理的高难度 benchmark，题目取自 Fukuyama 的《Advanced Organic Reaction Mechanism》一书；它由一篇以训练为主的机理推理论文发布，该文微调的 Qwen3-30B-A3B 在 Set A 上达到 8.3% 的完整路径精确匹配，超过专用模型 FlowER 的 5.1%。
zh.summary: 论文「Learning Mechanistic Reasoning for Chemical Reactions with Large Language Models」先构建了大规模的反应机理推理训练数据集，再建立 FukuyamaBench 来严格评估层级化机理推理——推导完整的基元反应路径，而不只是预测产物。头条评估结果是：机理感知的微调让 Qwen3-30B-A3B 在 FukuyamaBench Set A 上达到 8.3% 的路径精确匹配，超过专用的 FlowER 模型（5.1%）——这些数字主要说明了这个 benchmark 有多难。

works.title: Imaging-101
works.overview: Imaging-101 is a benchmark of 57 expert-verified computational-imaging tasks spanning six scientific domains, each grounded in a peer-reviewed paper and its open-source reference implementation, used to evaluate LLM coding agents on building complete reconstruction pipelines.
works.summary: Computational imaging recovers hidden signals from indirect, noisy measurements, and assembling a correct reconstruction pipeline requires domain expertise in the measurement physics as well as in numerical inverse solvers. Imaging-101 canonicalizes 57 such tasks into a standardized four-stage pipeline — preprocessing, forward physics modeling, inverse solver, and visualization — so that agent output can be graded stage by stage. Three evaluation tracks (planning, function-level unit tests, and end-to-end reconstruction) probe different agent capabilities over the same task set. Seven frontier LLMs are evaluated, and the authors report systematic failures in algorithm selection, physical-convention handling, and pipeline integration that general coding benchmarks do not surface.
works.domains_text: Astronomy is one of the six named domains, instantiated as radio-interferometric imaging (Event Horizon Telescope black-hole reconstruction from visibilities), high-contrast exoplanet imaging, atmospheric-turbulence lucky imaging, Shack–Hartmann wavefront sensing, and shapelet-based source reconstruction — the scored output in each case is an astronomical image or source estimate. Co-domains from the remaining task groups are Biology, Chemistry, Materials Science, Earth Science, Medicine & Health, and Physics.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: Imaging-101 是一个计算成像 benchmark，含 57 个经专家验证的任务，横跨六个科学领域；每个任务都以一篇同行评审论文及其开源参考实现为依托，用来评估 LLM coding agent 能否搭出完整的重建管线。
zh.summary: 计算成像要从间接且带噪的测量中还原出隐藏的信号，而搭起一条正确的重建管线，既要懂测量物理，也要懂数值反问题求解。Imaging-101 把 57 个这样的任务统一规范成四段式管线——预处理、正向物理建模、反问题求解、可视化——于是 agent 的产出可以逐段打分。三条评估赛道（规划、函数级单元测试、端到端重建）在同一套任务上考察 agent 的不同能力。论文评估了七个前沿 LLM，报告了算法选择、物理约定处理与管线整合三方面的系统性失败——这些都是通用编码 benchmark 暴露不出来的。

works.title: Who&When Pro
works.overview: Who&When Pro is a benchmark that measures how well LLMs attribute a failed agent trajectory to the agent, the step, and the error mode responsible for it. It contains 12,326 failed trajectories whose labels are fixed by construction: every trace replays the prefix of a successful rollout exactly, then substitutes a single injected error.
works.summary: Automated failure attribution asks an LLM to read a failed agent trajectory and say where and why it went wrong, and the authors argue that as agents become more capable their failures become subtler, which makes that judgement both harder to reach and harder to label. Who&When Pro builds its traces through a strictly controlled pipeline that replays the prefix of a successful rollout exactly, substitutes one erroneous action at a sampled step, and keeps the run only if it then ends in task failure, so the injected agent and step are the only controlled change separating success from failure. The benchmark holds 12,326 failed trajectories spanning 26 source benchmarks, 9 task categories, and 3 modalities, and the strongest judge reaches 73.9% step-level accuracy on text, while error-mode macro-F1 tops out at 22.2% on text and 40.0% on video.
works.domains_text: Recorded agent trajectories rather than a live environment — text, image, and video traces from single-agent and multi-agent systems across 9 task categories.

zh.overview: Who&When Pro 是一个基准，用于衡量 LLM 将失败的智能体轨迹归因到应负责的智能体、步骤与错误类型的能力。它包含 12,326 条失败轨迹，其标签由构造方式决定：每条轨迹都先精确重放一段成功回合的前缀，再替换入单个注入的错误。
zh.summary: 自动失败归因要求 LLM 阅读一条失败的智能体轨迹，并指出错在何处、为何出错；作者认为，随着智能体能力增强，其失败变得更加隐蔽，使这一判断既更难做出，也更难标注。Who&When Pro 通过一条严格受控的流水线构造轨迹：精确重放成功回合的前缀，在采样得到的步骤上替换入一个错误动作，并且只保留此后确实以任务失败告终的回合，因此被注入的智能体与步骤是区分成功与失败的唯一受控变化。该基准包含 12,326 条失败轨迹，覆盖 26 个来源基准、9 类任务与 3 种模态；最强的评判模型在文本模态上达到 73.9% 的步骤级准确率；错误类型宏 F1 在文本上最高为 22.2%，在视频上最高为 40.0%。

works.title: SLBench
works.overview: SLBench is an 86-case executable benchmark testing whether LLM agents resolve the logical relations that hold among the instructions inside an agent skill — preconditions, constraints, fallbacks and five further relation types catalogued by its companion framework SkillLogic.
works.summary: Agent skills package reusable procedures, tools, and domain workflows, but their safe execution depends on the agent honouring dependencies among interacting instructions. SkillLogic analyses logical relations in skill files under a taxonomy of eight relation types and compiles executable tests from them; a scan of over 5000 public skills finds that 70% contain at least one logical relation. SLBench selects the high-confidence, high-impact, locally testable relations into 86 executable cases, and an inference-time scaffold, SLGuard, is evaluated as a mitigation.
works.domains_text: Agent skills for general-purpose LLM agents, exercised through coding-agent harnesses; the reported failure consequences are software and system operations (privacy leaks, unsafe configuration changes, incomplete cleanup). No canonical science or engineering domain is assigned.

zh.overview: SLBench 是一套 86 个用例的可执行基准，考察 LLM agent 能否理清一个 agent skill 内部各条指令之间的逻辑关系——前置条件、约束、回退，以及配套框架 SkillLogic 编目的另外五种关系类型。
zh.summary: Agent skill 把可复用的流程、工具与领域工作流打包在一起，但能否安全执行下来，取决于 agent 是否守住各条指令彼此之间的依赖。SkillLogic 以一套八类关系的分类法分析 skill 文件中的逻辑关系，并据此编译出可执行测试；对 5000 多个公开 skill 的扫描发现，其中 70% 至少含有一条逻辑关系。SLBench 从中挑出高置信、高影响、可局部测试的关系，构成 86 个可执行用例，并评估了推理时脚手架 SLGuard 作为缓解手段。

works.title: UniClawBench
works.overview: UniClawBench is a universal benchmark for proactive agents on real-world tasks, organized around five model capabilities and evaluated in live Docker containers via a closed-loop executor / supervisor / user simulation.
works.summary: UniClawBench targets proactive agents that operate everyday tools and assist users in real-world environments. Tasks are executed in live Docker containers with step-by-step checkpoints, and evaluation runs in a closed loop with executor, supervisor, and user agents simulating multi-turn feedback without exposing grading criteria to the agent under test.
works.domains_text: Cross-platform proactive-agent tasks. Task construction is capability-driven across five axes rather than domain-partitioned.

zh.overview: UniClawBench 是面向 proactive agent 的通用 benchmark，围绕五个模型能力组织任务，并通过 executor / supervisor / user 三方闭环 agent 模拟，在实时 Docker 容器中进行评估。
zh.summary: UniClawBench 面向能在真实环境中操作日常工具、辅助用户的 proactive agent。任务在实时 Docker 容器中运行，配有分步 checkpoints；评估以闭环方式进行——由 executor、supervisor 和 user agent 共同模拟多轮反馈，且评分标准对被评估的 agent 隐藏。

works.title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench
works.overview: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench extends Terminal-Bench to substantially longer execution horizons. It uses fine-grained graded subtasks to enable dense intermediate rewards and partial credit rather than binary end-task pass/fail.
works.summary: The benchmark evaluates agents on long-horizon terminal tasks with a graded-subtask reward structure. Instead of relying on binary end-task success, tasks are decomposed into scored subtasks so that partial progress can be measured under configurable reward thresholds.
works.domains_text: Terminal-based long-horizon workflows across scientific computing, software engineering, multimodal analysis, and interactive games.

zh.overview: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 将 Terminal-Bench 扩展到显著更长的执行 horizon。它使用细粒度分级子任务提供密集的中间奖励与部分得分，而不是仅采用二值的端到端 pass/fail。
zh.summary: 该 benchmark 使用分级子任务奖励结构评估 agent 在长 horizon terminal 任务上的表现。任务被分解为可打分的子任务，可在可配置的奖励阈值下衡量部分进展。

works.title: AgentLens
works.overview: AgentLens is a production-assessed benchmark for interactive code agents that evaluates whole interaction trajectories rather than final pass/fail outcomes, pairing formal verification with LLM-written trajectory reviews and side-by-side comparisons. It releases an initial fold of 16 Java coding scenarios, each run under a relaxed default user and a mildly adversarial toxic user for 32 trajectories per evaluated agent.
works.summary: AgentLens argues that most code-agent benchmarks reduce a run to a single pass/fail bit, whereas the people who use these agents experience the entire trajectory — how the agent follows instructions, uses tools, verifies its own work, recovers from mistakes, and communicates. It evaluates the whole trajectory, pairing formal verification where an objective check exists with LLM-written trajectory reviews and side-by-side comparisons, so that each run yields a readable explanation of why the score is what it is. The authors use it not only to rank models but to diagnose model behavior, compare successive versions of their own agent, and catch product regressions in a nightly evaluation pipeline.
works.domains_text: Java coding-assistant work over real open-source repositories: unit testing, database-logic migration, and API documentation in Spring Boot projects.

zh.overview: AgentLens 是一个面向 interactive code agent 的 production-assessed benchmark，它评估整条交互 trajectory 而非最终的 pass/fail 结果，将形式化验证（formal verification）与 LLM 撰写的 trajectory review 以及 side-by-side 对比相结合。它发布了一个包含 16 个 Java 编码场景的初始 fold，每个场景在一个宽松的 default 用户与一个略带对抗性的 toxic 用户下各运行一次，为每个受评 agent 产生 32 条 trajectory。
zh.summary: AgentLens 认为，大多数 code-agent benchmark 把一次运行压缩为单个 pass/fail 比特，而真正使用这些 agent 的人体验到的是整条 trajectory——agent 如何遵循指令、使用工具、验证自己的工作、从错误中恢复以及与用户沟通。它评估整条 trajectory，在存在客观检查之处将形式化验证与 LLM 撰写的 trajectory review 以及 side-by-side 对比相结合，使每次运行都给出一段关于得分缘由的可读解释。作者不仅用它对模型排名，还用它诊断模型行为、对比自家 agent 的历次版本，并在每晚运行的评估 pipeline 中捕捉产品回归。

works.title: SkillCoach
works.overview: SkillCoach is a self-evolving rubric framework for process-level evaluation of agentic skill-use: it derives skill-grounded rubrics from real rollouts and scores trajectories along four dimensions — skill selection, skill following, skill composition, and skill-grounded reflection — while keeping the external verifier as a separate outcome signal.
works.summary: The motivating observation is that in realistic skill repositories, overlapping skills make reliable skill-use hard, and final verifier success is too coarse a signal: an agent can pass by trial and error while selecting distractor skills, skipping required steps, composing workflows incorrectly, or omitting final checks. SkillCoach builds an initial rubric from the task instruction, the gold skills, and oracle solutions, then evolves it against real rollouts under a validation gate. Because process quality is scored separately from the outcome verifier, accidental task success can be told apart from correct procedure — and the evolved rubrics are reused as process supervision to select training trajectories.
works.domains_text: General agent-skill repositories with overlapping and distractor skills. No canonical science or engineering domain is targeted.

zh.overview: SkillCoach 是面向 agent skill 使用的过程级评估框架，其 rubric 会自我演化：rubric 从真实 rollout 中归纳而来，沿四个维度为轨迹打分——skill 选择、skill 遵循、skill 组合，以及基于 skill 的反思——同时把外部 verifier 保留为独立的结果信号。
zh.summary: 出发点的观察是：真实的 skill 仓库里 skill 彼此重叠，可靠地使用 skill 因而很难，而最终 verifier 的成败又是过于粗糙的信号——agent 完全可能靠反复试错通过，同时选中干扰 skill、跳过必需步骤、把工作流组合错，或者省掉最后的检查。SkillCoach 先由任务指令、gold skill 与 oracle 解构造出初始 rubric，再在验证门控下对照真实 rollout 演化这套 rubric。由于过程质量与结果 verifier 分开计分，侥幸完成任务与流程正确得以区分开来；演化后的 rubric 还会复用为过程监督信号，用来筛选训练轨迹。

works.title: OntoLearner
works.overview: OntoLearner is a modular Python library and benchmark for ontology learning with large language models: it releases 180 machine-readable ontologies spanning 22 domains with pipeline-ready train/dev/test splits for three ontology-learning tasks, and uses that infrastructure to evaluate 22 retrieval models and 12 LLMs on constructing structured knowledge models.
works.summary: The paper's premise is that ontology learning has no shared evaluation infrastructure — methods, domains, and evaluation practices are fragmented, so results are not comparable across papers. OntoLearner responds with three coupled components: unified programmatic access to a large ontology collection, LLM-driven learning pipelines, and standardized benchmarking over fixed splits. Using that infrastructure the authors run a large-scale empirical study across domains and tasks, and report that failure modes scale with ontological complexity rather than with model size or architectural sophistication, locating the bottleneck in a structural mismatch between how models encode knowledge and how ontologies organize it. The library is released open-source under an MIT license.
works.domains_text: Cross-domain by design: 22 ontology domains. Domain datasets published on the official hub include chemistry, medicine, materials science and engineering, agriculture, industry, education, events, and social sciences, and the paper's benchmark table further lists biology & life sciences, ecology & environment, geography, units and measurements, scholarly knowledge, food & beverage, finance, and general knowledge. The scientific and engineering share of the taxonomy therefore covers Chemistry, Biology, Medicine & Health, Materials Science, and Environmental Science, alongside a substantial set of non-scientific domains that fall outside this repository's domain axis.

zh.overview: OntoLearner 是一个模块化的 Python 库，同时也是一套 benchmark，用来做基于大语言模型的本体学习：它发布了覆盖 22 个领域的 180 个机器可读本体，为三项本体学习任务配好可直接接入流水线的 train/dev/test 划分，并借这套基础设施评测 22 个检索模型与 12 个 LLM 构建结构化知识模型的能力。
zh.summary: 论文的前提是：本体学习没有共用的评估基础设施——方法、领域与评估做法各行其是，各篇论文的结果无从相互比较。OntoLearner 的回应是三个相互耦合的组件：对大规模本体集合的统一编程式访问、由 LLM 驱动的学习流水线，以及在固定划分上的标准化评测。作者以这套基础设施做了一项跨领域、跨任务的大规模实证研究，报告称失败模式随本体复杂度放大，而不是随模型规模或架构精巧程度变化；他们据此把瓶颈定位在一种结构性错配上——模型编码知识的方式与本体组织知识的方式对不上。该库以 MIT 许可开源发布。

works.title: QVal
works.overview: QVal is a training-free evaluation methodology and testbed that scores dense supervision signals by how well they order an agent's candidate actions according to the Q-values of a strong reference policy. It is instantiated as QVal-v1.0, which benchmarks 21 dense supervision methods from seven methodological families across four environments and six open-weight model backbones.
works.summary: QVal addresses the common practice of evaluating dense supervision methods by the downstream performance of a training pipeline that integrates them, which the authors argue is expensive, conflates supervision quality with training-engineering confounders, and leaves methodological families requiring distinct training setups incomparable. Given a state-action pair, QVal measures whether a method's score is Q-aligned — whether it orders actions as the Q-values of a strong reference policy do — so that signals can be compared before any training run. QVal-v1.0 covers 21 dense supervision methods, seven methodological families, four environments and six open-weight model backbones in over 1.2K evaluation experiments, and finds that simple prompting baselines consistently outperform recent dense supervision methods from the literature.
works.domains_text: Goal-directed navigation, embodied reasoning, browser-based computer use, and terminal-based problem solving — FrozenLake, ALFWorld, OpenApps, and TerminalBench, of which TerminalBench is text-only and the rest supply both textual and visual observations.

zh.overview: QVal 是一个 training-free 的评估方法学与 testbed，通过稠密监督（dense supervision）信号在多大程度上能按强 reference policy 的 Q 值排序 agent 的候选 action，来为这些信号打分。它被实例化为 QVal-v1.0，在四个环境与六个开放权重模型 backbone 上，对来自七个方法学家族的 21 个稠密监督方法做 benchmark。
zh.summary: QVal 针对的是这样一种常见做法：通过集成了稠密监督方法的训练流水线的下游表现来评估这些方法；作者认为它代价高昂，把监督质量与训练工程上的混杂因素纠缠在一起，并使需要不同训练设置的方法学家族之间无法比较。给定一个 state-action 对，QVal 度量某方法的分数是否 Q 对齐——即它是否像强 reference policy 的 Q 值那样排序 action——从而使信号可以在任何训练运行之前就被比较。QVal-v1.0 覆盖 21 个稠密监督方法、七个方法学家族、四个环境与六个开放权重模型 backbone，共超过 1.2K 次评估实验，并发现简单的 prompting baseline 一致优于文献中较新的稠密监督方法。

works.title: GeneBench-Pro
works.overview: GeneBench-Pro is a benchmark for AI agents performing realistic multistage statistical analyses in genomics, quantitative biology, and translational biomedicine. Its 129 problems are built on constructively simulated data-generating processes rather than real datasets, so that a wrong answer is attributable to a scientific error rather than to one of several equally defensible analyst choices.
works.summary: The authors argue that existing biology benchmarks begin from a curated dataset and a highly specified prompt and evaluate a narrowly scoped analysis step with a cleanly verifiable answer, while real analysis spans a wider and more iterative process. GeneBench-Pro stages each problem in an isolated container with deliberately messy simulated data and a minimal prompt that fixes the target estimand but gives no prescriptive instruction on method, then grades a single binary pass on whether the agent recovered the decision-relevant number. Over the full suite the best configuration measured, GPT-5.6 Sol at the `max` reasoning level, reaches an eval-level pass rate of 28.7%.
works.domains_text: Statistical genetics and genetic epidemiology, population and evolutionary genetics, quantitative genetics, regulatory and molecular omics, functional genomics, proteomics and biomarkers, clinical variant interpretation and penetrance, pharmacogenomics, prenatal and reproductive genetics, cancer somatic genomics and liquid biopsy, microbial and metagenomic genomics, and forensic genetics.

zh.overview: GeneBench-Pro 是一个面向 AI agent 的 benchmark，考察其在基因组学、定量生物学与转化医学中执行真实多阶段统计分析的能力。其 129 个问题构建于人工模拟的数据生成过程（DGP）而非真实数据集之上，从而使一个错误答案可归因于科学判断失误，而非归因于若干同样站得住脚的分析选择之一。
zh.summary: 作者指出，现有生物学 benchmark 大多从一个已整理好的数据集与高度具体化的 prompt 出发，评估的是范围狭窄、答案可干净验证的单个分析步骤，而真实分析所跨越的过程要宽得多、迭代性也强得多。GeneBench-Pro 把每个问题置于隔离容器中，配以刻意保留杂讯的模拟数据，以及一段只锁定目标估计量、不给出任何方法指令的极简 prompt，随后仅以二元通过与否判定 agent 是否复原了那个与决策相关的数值。在完整题集上，所测得的最佳配置 GPT-5.6 Sol（`max` 推理档）达到 28.7% 的 eval 级通过率。

works.title: A Tutorial on Autonomous Fault-Tolerant Control Using Knowledge-Grounded LLM Agents
works.overview: A tutorial paper on using LLM agents as constrained supervisory planners for fault recovery in process plants, released with two openly available executable Python environments — a modular mixing module and a continuous stirred-tank reactor — that expose configurable faults and pluggable interfaces for custom recovery and validation methods.
works.summary: Fault recovery in process plants still depends on operators who read alarms, procedures, P&IDs, interlocks, and process trends and then decide how to move the plant to a safe operating mode without triggering a shutdown. The paper frames the LLM as a constrained supervisory planner: it proposes recovery actions from plant-specific knowledge, and every proposal is checked by an external validator — symbolic or simulation-based — before actuation. Around that framing it develops three design dimensions: the recovery patterns for which LLM agents are useful, the validation strategies that separate admissible from inadmissible proposals, and the deployment constraints imposed by latency, knowledge engineering, safety integration, and model lifecycle management. To make the framework directly usable, the paper ships two executable environments that re-implement established case studies with configurable faults and defined interfaces for plugging in custom recovery and validation logic.
works.domains_text: Chemical Engineering — process-plant operations and process control: supervisory fault handling and recovery on a modular batch mixing unit and on a continuous stirred-tank reactor, with faults (clogging, leakage, pump degradation, heat-exchanger fouling, cooling-valve saturation) drawn from process-equipment failure modes and recovery expressed as operating-mode changes and setpoint adjustments.

zh.overview: 一篇教程性质的论文，讲的是把 LLM agent 用作受约束的监督层规划者，去做流程装置的故障恢复；随文公开了两套可执行的 Python 环境——一个模块化混合单元和一个连续搅拌釜反应器——两者都提供可配置的故障注入，并留出可插拔接口，以便接入自定义的恢复与校验方法。
zh.summary: 流程装置的故障恢复至今仍依赖操作员：读报警、查规程、看 P&ID、核联锁、盯趋势，然后判断如何把装置切到安全工况而不触发停车。论文把 LLM 定位为受约束的监督层规划者——它依据装置专属知识提出恢复动作，而每一条提案在执行前都要经外部校验器（符号式或仿真式）审查。围绕这一定位，论文展开三个设计维度：LLM agent 真正派得上用场的恢复模式、区分可行与不可行提案的校验策略，以及由延迟、知识工程、安全集成和模型生命周期管理带来的部署约束。为使这套框架能被直接拿来用，论文还随文提供两套可执行环境，它们重新实现了已有的案例研究，加入可配置的故障，并定义了接口以便接入自定义的恢复与校验逻辑。

works.title: SWE-Together
works.overview: SWE-Together is a multi-turn coding benchmark reconstructed from real user-agent sessions: 109 repository-level tasks curated from 11,260 recorded sessions, replayed across agents through a reactive LLM-based user simulator that preserves the original users' intents.
works.summary: Most coding-agent benchmarks are static — full task up front, judged on final code — while real assistance is interactive. SWE-Together makes real interactions verifiable by selecting sessions with recoverable repository states, clear user goals, and observable outcomes, then replaying them via a user simulator that preserves original intent and intervenes when the agent's progress requires it. Agents are scored as collaborators: final repository correctness plus the number of corrective feedback turns needed. Stronger agents generally achieve higher success with fewer interventions.
works.domains_text: Interactive software engineering grounded in real user sessions.

zh.overview: SWE-Together 是从真实用户-agent 会话重建的多轮编码 benchmark：从 11,260 条录制会话中整理出 109 个仓库级任务，通过一个保持原始用户意图的反应式 LLM 用户模拟器，在不同 agent 之间回放。
zh.summary: 多数 coding-agent benchmark 是静态的——任务一次给全、只看最终代码——而真实的编码辅助是交互式的。SWE-Together 通过筛选仓库状态可恢复、用户目标清晰、结果可观察的会话，让真实交互变得可验证，再用保持原意的用户模拟器回放，在 agent 进展需要时给予反馈。agent 被当作协作者来评分：最终仓库正确性，加上交互中所需的纠正反馈轮数。更强的 agent 总体上成功率更高、所需干预更少。

works.title: SWE-Interact
works.overview: SWE-Interact is a testbed for evaluating coding agents on multi-turn, interactive, user-driven software-engineering tasks: a user simulator reveals requirements progressively and gives feedback, testing whether agents can discover intent, adapt to changes, and build on prior work.
works.summary: SWE-Interact reimagines SWE benchmarks as user-driven long-horizon coding sessions: instead of a complete task description up front, requirements arrive progressively through a simulated user who also reacts to the agent's work. The headline finding is a transfer gap — frontier models (Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, and open-weight variants) that solve roughly 50% of the tasks in single-turn form drop to roughly 25% in the multi-turn, user-driven setting: strong single-turn SWE performance does not reliably transfer to interactive workflows.
works.domains_text: Interactive software engineering with simulated users.

zh.overview: SWE-Interact 是评估 coding agent 在多轮、交互式、用户驱动的软件工程任务上的测试平台：用户模拟器逐步披露需求并给出反馈，考察 agent 能否发现意图、适应变化并在已有工作上继续推进。
zh.summary: SWE-Interact 把 SWE benchmark 重新构想成用户驱动的长 horizon 编码会话：任务描述不再一次性给全，需求通过一个会对 agent 工作做出反应的模拟用户逐步到来。最突出的发现是迁移落差——前沿模型（Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5 及开放权重变体）在单轮形式下能解约 50% 的任务，在多轮用户驱动设定下跌到约 25%：单轮 SWE 上的强表现并不能可靠迁移到交互式工作流。

works.title: Autonomous Research Agents: A Survey of AI Scientists and the Verification Gap
works.overview: A survey of autonomous research agents ('AI scientists') centered on the verification gap: the distance between systems' ability to complete research tasks and the field's ability to verify their claims. From 125 screened candidates, 35 works are included, 26 with full-text coding across seven audit dimensions.
works.summary: The survey codes systems along seven audit dimensions — lifecycle stage, autonomy level, evaluation method, released artifacts, human-in-the-loop points, novelty verification, and result-selection disclosure. It finds that 83% of systems release code while only 38% release seeds or execution traces and only 38% report any novelty-verification method; among nine closed-loop L4 systems, seven verify by mechanical reruns and one is author-claimed without external check; no LLM-era system in the corpus demonstrates an externally validated in-loop oracle. A reviewer checklist operationalizes the audit.
works.domains_text: Autonomous research agents across scientific fields; the survey itself is field-agnostic.

zh.overview: 一篇关于自主研究 agent（“AI scientist”）的综述，聚焦验证缺口：系统完成研究任务的能力，与学界验证其宣称的能力之间的落差。从 125 篇候选筛出 35 篇收录，其中 26 篇做了全文编码，覆盖七个审计维度。
zh.summary: 综述沿七个审计维度为系统编码——生命周期阶段、自主等级、评估方法、发布工件、人在环节点、新颖性验证、结果挑选的披露情况。发现 83% 的系统发布代码，但仅 38% 发布随机种子或执行轨迹、仅 38% 报告任何新颖性验证方法；九个闭环 L4 系统中七个仅靠机械重跑验证、一个仅有作者自述而无外部检查；语料中没有任何 LLM 时代的系统展示过经外部验证的在环 oracle。一份审稿人清单使该审计可操作化。

works.title: scBench-Long
works.overview: scBench-Long is a verifiable benchmark of long-horizon single-cell biology: 21 evaluations in which agents must recover scientific conclusions from raw or near-raw data without prescribed methods, spanning melanoma CD8 T-cell reactivity, RNA+ATAC regulatory inference, human–monkey chimera development, KRAS-driven lung tumor aging, and lethal COVID-19 lung pathology.
works.summary: Where scBench isolates single analysis steps, scBench-Long asks for the whole journey: from near-raw data — integrating metadata, assay context, and auxiliary evidence — to the study's actual scientific conclusions, with no prescribed method. Candidate claims are reproduced, reviewed, and converted into controlled answer vocabularies with deterministic grading and trajectory rubrics. Across 1,068 completed trajectories, the strongest model-harness pair passes only 16 of 63 runs (25.4%).
works.domains_text: Long-horizon single-cell biology across melanoma T-cell biology, developmental biology (human–monkey chimera), lung cancer, and COVID-19 lung pathology.

zh.overview: scBench-Long 是长 horizon 单细胞生物学的可验证 benchmark：21 项评估要求 agent 在不预设方法的前提下，从原始或近原始数据复原科学结论，涵盖黑色素瘤 CD8 T 细胞反应性、RNA+ATAC 调控推断、人-猴嵌合体发育、KRAS 驱动的肺肿瘤衰老与致死性 COVID-19 肺部病理。
zh.summary: scBench 隔离单个分析步骤，scBench-Long 则要求走完全程：从近原始数据出发——整合元数据、实验检测方法背景与辅助证据——一路推到研究的实际科学结论，方法不作规定。候选结论经复现、评审后转换为受控答案词表，配确定性判分与轨迹评分标准。在 1,068 条完成的轨迹中，最强的模型-harness 组合也只通过 63 次运行中的 16 次（25.4%）。

works.title: NatureBench
works.overview: NatureBench evaluates whether AI coding agents can match the published state-of-the-art of Nature-family scientific publications — framed as a move beyond reproduction toward the claim of methodological discovery.
works.summary: NatureBench distills tasks from peer-reviewed Nature-family publications and asks whether coding agents can reach or exceed the published SOTA. The benchmark tests both cross-discipline scientific coverage and the depth needed to match a real publication's results.
works.domains_text: Six domains distilled from Nature-family publications: Cellular Omics, Protein Biology, Biomedical Modeling, Physical Modeling, Molecular Design, and Relational Reasoning.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: NatureBench 评估 AI coding agent 是否能匹敌 Nature-family 科学出版物的已发表 SOTA——被作者框定为一次从"复现"走向"方法论发现"的评估尝试。
zh.summary: NatureBench 从同行评审的 Nature-family 论文中蒸馏任务，追问 coding agent 是否能达到甚至超越已发表 SOTA。该 benchmark 同时考察跨学科的科学覆盖，以及要匹敌一份真实出版物结果所需的深度。

works.title: Autonomous Action Execution (AAE) Framework
works.overview: The AAE framework is a four-layer multi-agent architecture for safely admitting LLM reasoning into industrial process control, in which the LLM is confined to an observation-only Monitor layer and every proposed action is checked by a deterministic validator that traverses the plant's P&ID topology; it is assessed with a graduated baseline ladder, an error-injection study over crafted proposals, and a repeated-run robustness study across five process-plant scenarios.
works.summary: The paper argues that the non-determinism, hallucination susceptibility, and lack of intrinsic physical understanding of LLMs make their direct deployment in safety-critical process automation unacceptable, and organizes its contribution around five research questions on integrating LLM reasoning safely. Architecturally, it proposes a four-layer multi-agent design that restricts LLM inference to an observation-only Monitor layer while safety-critical decisions are taken by deterministic Verification and Execution agents. To feed that Monitor layer, it introduces a text-level aggregation framework with pluggable analyzers that turns SCADA states, time-series measurements, Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) into contextually rich documents. The remaining research questions are evaluative: an automated P&ID-grounded validation method, a graduated baseline comparison that quantifies the incremental value of each pipeline component, and a cross-scenario generalisability study.
works.domains_text: Chemical Engineering — industrial process control and process safety. The scenarios are chemical process plants: the Tennessee Eastman Process, a polymerization reactor (PolyReactor), and a dryer, spanning continuous and batch operation. The evaluated objects are proposed control actions on plant equipment, validated against P&ID topology for tag existence, actuatability, fail-state consistency, and downstream impact — i.e. plant-operations and functional-safety tasks, not chemistry tasks. The publisher-assigned keywords are multi-agent systems, large language models, industrial process control, functional safety, P&ID validation, and SCADA.

zh.overview: AAE 框架是一套四层多 agent 架构，用于把 LLM 推理安全地引入工业过程控制：LLM 只出现在仅做观察的 Monitor 层，模型提出的每一个动作都要交由确定性校验器审查，而校验器沿装置的 P&ID 拓扑做图遍历。评估由三部分构成——分级基线阶梯、针对人工构造提案的错误注入研究，以及横跨五个流程装置场景的重复运行稳健性研究。
zh.summary: 论文的出发点是：LLM 具有非确定性、容易产生幻觉，又缺乏内在的物理理解，把它直接部署到安全攸关的过程自动化中是不可接受的；全文围绕「如何安全地引入 LLM 推理」提出五个研究问题来组织贡献。架构上，它给出一套四层多 agent 设计——LLM 推理只出现在仅做观察的 Monitor 层，安全攸关的决策交由确定性的 Verification 与 Execution agent 作出。为了给这一层提供输入，论文引入一个带可插拔分析器的文本级聚合框架，把 SCADA 状态、时序测量、管道仪表流程图（P&ID）与标准操作规程（SOP）统一转写为上下文丰富的文档。其余研究问题都落在评估上：一套以 P&ID 为依据的自动校验方法、一组量化管线中各组件增量价值的分级基线对照，以及一项跨场景的泛化性研究。

works.title: SkillAudit
works.overview: SkillAudit is an end-to-end evaluation framework that takes an arbitrary agent skill package as input and automatically produces a multi-dimensional deployment report covering utility, efficiency/cost, and safety — replacing fixed task suites with tasks constructed from the skill artifact itself.
works.summary: The framework argues that fixed suites conflate a skill's marginal contribution with backbone model strength and miss the skill's value when tasks fall outside its intended scope. SkillAudit therefore generates capability-aligned tasks directly from the skill package, runs them in isolated sandboxes to collect execution evidence, and combines rule-based checks with LLM judging to produce auditable per-skill reports. Utility and efficiency rest on a baseline-comparison principle — matched with-skill and no-skill runs sharing identical instruction, inputs, environment, and criteria — while safety uses a two-stage paradigm of static semantic analysis followed by dynamic runtime verification.
works.domains_text: General agent-skill packages spanning 23 occupational categories from public skill marketplaces. No canonical science or engineering domain is targeted; the evaluated object is the skill artifact, not a domain task.

zh.overview: SkillAudit 是一套端到端的评估框架：输入任意一个 agent skill 包，自动产出一份涵盖效用、效率/成本与安全的多维部署报告——任务不再取自固定套件，而是由 skill 工件本身生成。
zh.summary: 框架的立论是：固定套件会把 skill 的边际贡献与骨干模型自身的强弱混为一谈，而当任务落在 skill 的既定范围之外时，又看不出这个 skill 的价值。为此，SkillAudit 直接从 skill 包生成能力对齐的任务，在隔离沙箱中运行以收集执行证据，再把规则检查与 LLM 判定结合起来，产出可稽核的逐 skill 报告。效用与效率建立在基线对照原则之上——带 skill 与不带 skill 两次运行的指令、输入、环境与评判标准完全一致；安全则采用两段式范式：先做静态语义分析，再做动态运行时验证。

works.title: RigorBench
works.overview: RigorBench is a benchmark that scores autonomous AI coding agents on **engineering process discipline** — how a solution was reached — rather than on outcome correctness alone. It decomposes process discipline into seven separately scored pillars, computes them from the full execution trajectory, and aggregates them into a composite RigorScore.
works.summary: The paper surveys nine existing AI coding benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, SWE-bench, BigCodeBench, DevBench, Terminal-Bench, ProjDevBench, AgentBench, LiveCodeBench) and reports that none measure planning quality, verification behaviour, recovery strategy, abstention appropriateness, or codebase health — a gap the authors call the *lab-to-production gap*. RigorBench addresses it with three design decisions: a seven-pillar scoring framework, a task suite whose five categories each stress specific pillars, and a trajectory-based scoring pipeline that parses states (codebase snapshots) and actions (agent operations) rather than only the final artifact.
