The evaluation holds the foundation model fixed and varies the agentic harness, so that what is measured is the harness's contribution to process quality. The authors present the work explicitly as an *exploratory* study validating the scoring methodology rather than a settled benchmark.
works.domains_text: Software & systems engineering: feature implementation, bug diagnosis and repair, multi-step refactoring, and test authoring over starter repositories in Node.js, Python, Rust, and Django. No science domain is evaluated.

zh.overview: RigorBench 给自主 AI 编码 agent 打分，评的不只是结果对不对，而是**工程过程纪律**——解是怎么得到的。它把过程纪律拆成七根分别计分的支柱，从完整的执行 trajectory 上算出各支柱得分，再聚合为综合的 RigorScore。
zh.summary: 论文调研了九个既有的 AI 编码 benchmark（HumanEval、MBPP、SWE-bench、BigCodeBench、DevBench、Terminal-Bench、ProjDevBench、AgentBench、LiveCodeBench），报告称没有一个测量规划质量、验证行为、恢复策略、弃答是否得当或代码库健康度——作者把这一空白称作「lab-to-production gap」。RigorBench 用三项设计来填补它：七支柱评分框架；一套任务集，其五个类别各自压测特定支柱；以及一条基于 trajectory 的评分流水线，解析状态（代码库快照）与动作（agent 操作），而不只看最终产物。评测固定基础模型、只变换 agentic harness，测的因此是 harness 对过程质量的贡献。作者明确把这项工作定位为验证评分方法学的探索性研究，而非一个已定型的 benchmark。

works.title: ScholarQuest
works.overview: ScholarQuest is a large-scale, taxonomy-guided benchmark for agentic academic paper search in open literature environments, constructed from over 1,000 computer science topics and four representative research intents.
works.summary: ScholarQuest systematically evaluates LLM-based search agents performing iterative literature exploration. Its four research-intent categories — method-oriented, setting-anchored, comparison-based, and scope-controlled queries — model how researchers actually search. Agentic methods outperform single-shot baselines, yet the best-performing agent achieves only 0.314 Recall@100 and 0.355 Recall@All, and the paper analyzes search efficiency, intent-level robustness, and failure cases.
works.domains_text: Computer science literature (information retrieval and AI focus).

zh.overview: ScholarQuest 是面向开放文献环境中 agent 式学术论文检索的大规模、分类法引导的 benchmark，由 1,000 余个计算机科学主题与四类代表性研究意图构建。
zh.summary: ScholarQuest 系统评估执行迭代式文献探索的 LLM 检索 agent。其四类研究意图——方法导向、设定锚定、比较导向、范围受控——建模了研究者实际的检索方式。Agent 式方法优于单次检索基线，但最佳 agent 也仅达到 0.314 Recall@100 与 0.355 Recall@All；论文进一步分析了检索效率、意图级稳健性与失败案例。

works.title: PowerAgentBench-SS
works.overview: PowerAgentBench-SS benchmarks agentic AI in power-system steady-state studies: given public case data, action constraints, a tool API, and a validation budget, agents inspect a grid case, call simulators, screen contingencies, propose admissible mitigations, and produce an auditable evidence trail — while a hidden evaluator recomputes physical validity and scores the submitted report.
works.summary: Power-grid analysis is exactly the setting where an agent's self-reported success cannot be trusted: PowerAgentBench-SS therefore recomputes everything. Its pilot runs a DC thermal N-2 contingency search over IEEE 39-bus operating-point variants, with agents (three locally hosted Ollama models and one OpenAI API agent) interfacing through an LLM JSON-command adapter. The scoring vocabulary is unusually rich — submitted recall, evidence-backed recall, found recall, false-safe penalties, severity regret, residual violation score, action cost, tool-use efficiency, and workflow diagnostics — designed to show why solver-only or answer-only evaluation is insufficient.
works.domains_text: Power-system operation and planning: steady-state analysis and N-2 contingency screening.

zh.overview: PowerAgentBench-SS 评测电力系统稳态研究中的 agentic AI：agent 获得公开算例数据、动作约束、工具 API 与验证预算，须检视电网算例、调用仿真器、筛选预想故障、提出满足约束的缓解措施并留下可审计的证据链——而一个隐藏评估器会重算物理有效性并为提交的报告打分。
zh.summary: 电网分析恰是不能相信 agent 自我报告的场景：PowerAgentBench-SS 因此把一切都重算一遍。其试点在 IEEE 39 节点系统的运行点变体上做基于直流潮流的 N-2 热稳定越限搜索，agent（三个本地 Ollama 模型加一个 OpenAI API agent）经 LLM JSON 命令适配器接入。评分词汇异常丰富——submitted recall、evidence-backed recall、found recall、false-safe 罚分、severity regret、residual violation score、动作成本、工具使用效率与工作流诊断——设计意图正是证明「只看求解器」或「只看答案」的评估并不充分。

works.title: PhySciBench
works.overview: PhySciBench is a benchmark of 200 expert-curated deep-research questions in the physical sciences, balanced between physics and chemistry across six task categories reflecting real scientific workflows. The accompanying DelveAgent framework is agent-construction work adjacent to this repository's evaluation focus.
works.summary: The paper identifies three deficiencies in existing deep-research systems on physical-science questions — fragility in extended reasoning chains, limited knowledge transfer across steps, and a lack of physics-grounded self-verification — and introduces PhySciBench to measure them: 200 expert-curated questions balanced between physics and chemistry in six task categories. It also develops DelveAgent (adaptive planning loop, dual-granularity memory, hierarchical physics-grounded reflection).
works.domains_text: Physical sciences: physics and chemistry.

zh.overview: PhySciBench 是物理科学领域的 deep-research benchmark：200 道专家整理的问题，物理与化学各半，分六个反映真实科学工作流的任务类别。配套的 DelveAgent 框架属于 agent 构建工作，与本仓库的评估重心相邻。
zh.summary: 论文指出现有 deep-research 系统在物理科学问题上的三项缺陷——长推理链脆弱、跨步骤知识迁移有限、缺少以物理为根基的自我验证——并提出 PhySciBench 加以度量：200 道专家整理问题，物理与化学均衡，分六个任务类别。论文同时开发了 DelveAgent（自适应规划循环、双粒度记忆、层级式物理反思机制）。

works.title: RubricsTree
works.overview: RubricsTree is an evaluation framework for open-ended personal health agents that replaces a monolithic LLM judge with an expert-curated hierarchical taxonomy of over 100 atomic, clinically verifiable Boolean rubrics, activating only the relevant rubric subset per query through a context-aware adaptive router.
works.summary: Clinical deployment of LLM personal health agents is constrained by an evaluation bottleneck: physician annotation is reliable but unscalable, while LLM-as-a-judge is scalable but subjective, inconsistent and sometimes clinically misaligned. RubricsTree curates a hierarchical rubric taxonomy — a directed acyclic graph running from macro-level capabilities through intermediate sub-domains down to atomic Boolean leaf rubrics — through an iterative human-in-the-loop protocol led by an experienced physician, informed by roughly 4,000 real user queries. At evaluation time an adaptive router activates only the relevant, auto-weighted rubric subset for a given query, and the framework is validated by meta-evaluation against expert panels and by downstream use as instructions, feedback, and training rewards.
works.domains_text: Medicine & Health — consumer and clinical health question answering grounded in user health and wearable-sensor metrics, with rubrics authored and validated by a physician-led expert panel. The rubric scenarios span medical explanation, health-data interpretation, advice and action planning, and symptom handling.

zh.overview: RubricsTree 是面向开放式个人健康 agent 的评估框架。它不再依赖单一的整体式 LLM judge，而是改用一套由专家策划的分层 rubric 分类法——100 余条原子化、临床上可核验的布尔型 rubric——并通过一个感知上下文的自适应路由器，为每条查询只激活相关的那部分 rubric。
zh.summary: LLM 个人健康 agent 要真正进入临床，卡在一个评估瓶颈上：医生标注可靠却无法规模化，LLM-as-a-judge 能规模化却主观、不稳定，有时还与临床判断相悖。RubricsTree 由一位资深医生主导，以人在环中的迭代流程整理出一套分层 rubric 分类法——一张有向无环图，自宏观能力层经中间子领域，向下收敛到原子化的布尔型叶节点 rubric——整理过程参考了约 4,000 条真实用户查询。评估时，自适应路由器只为当前查询激活相关且自动加权的 rubric 子集。该框架一方面通过与专家小组的元评估得到验证，另一方面也在下游以指令、反馈和训练奖励三种用法接受检验。

works.title: ALeRCE Text-to-SQL
works.overview: A natural-language-to-SQL system for the ALeRCE astronomical alert-broker database, released together with an evaluation set of 110 natural-language/SQL pairs written by astronomers with expert-authored gold queries, on which thirteen LLMs are compared under a perfect-match execution metric.
works.summary: ALeRCE is a community alert broker for the Zwicky Transient Facility and the Vera C. Rubin Observatory; its database is large and irregular enough that astronomers without SQL fluency cannot easily interrogate it. The paper builds a four-module pipeline — schema linking, query classification, prompt decomposition and self-correction — that turns an astronomer's question into an executable SQL query against that database, and evaluates it by executing both the predicted and the gold query and comparing the returned rows and columns. The evaluation set of 110 NL/SQL pairs was elicited from practising astronomers rather than synthesized, and thirteen LLM backends are scored on it, with an accompanying per-model API cost table. The headline finding is that current state-of-the-art text-to-SQL performance does not carry over to a real scientific database: results are strong on simple queries and degrade sharply once queries require joins and domain-specific semantics.
works.domains_text: Astronomy. The database is an operational time-domain survey broker over the ZTF alert stream (and prospectively Rubin/LSST), so the queries concern astronomical objects, classifications, photometry and light-curve properties, and answering them correctly requires the domain semantics of the broker schema rather than generic database reasoning. A secondary Computer Science reading is defensible, since the produced artifact is executable SQL and the method is a text-to-SQL pipeline, but the scored objective is retrieval of the correct astronomical records.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: 一套面向 ALeRCE 天文警报 broker 数据库的自然语言转 SQL 系统，随文发布了一个含 110 组自然语言/SQL 对的评测集——问题由天文学家提出，目标查询由专家撰写——并在其上以完全匹配的执行式指标比较了十三个 LLM。
zh.summary: ALeRCE 是服务于 Zwicky Transient Facility 与 Vera C. Rubin Observatory 的社区警报 broker，其数据库既大且不规整，不熟悉 SQL 的天文学家很难查得动。论文构建了一条四模块流水线——schema linking、查询分类、提示分解与自我纠错——把天文学家的问题转成可在该数据库上执行的 SQL；评测方式是同时执行预测查询与标准查询，比对返回的行与列。评测集的 110 组自然语言/SQL 对是从一线天文学家那里征集来的，而非合成生成，十三个 LLM 后端在其上打分，并附有逐模型的 API 成本表。核心结论是：当前 text-to-SQL 的最好水平并不能照搬到真实的科学数据库上——简单查询表现不错，一旦涉及连接和领域专有语义就急剧下滑。

works.title: AISE-Bench
works.overview: AISE-Bench is a full-cycle annotated benchmark for academic information seeking over scholarly knowledge graphs: 1,133 QA pairs shipped with query taxonomies, complete API execution trajectories, validated parameters, and source-grounded answers with reference links, scored on process and outcome together.
works.summary: Existing tool-using benchmarks for information seeking on academic graphs rely on synthetic templates, simplified solution spaces, or narrow paper-centric tasks, leaving realistic user intent, multi-step API planning, rich parameter filling, grounded answers, and joint process/outcome evaluation underexplored. AISE-Bench addresses all five by annotating each instance end to end — query, plan, executed API calls with validated parameters, and a referenced answer. To make that annotation tractable the authors built a customized agent workflow (Planner, Task Executor, Synthesizer) that lets annotators plan, execute and revise complex API workflows, and they evaluate 14 methods under a protocol that scores answer quality, reference grounding, API-planning correctness, and execution success separately.
works.domains_text: Scholarly information seeking over academic knowledge graphs spanning first-level academic disciplines; the queried objects are papers, authors, venues and organizations rather than the scientific content of any one field. No canonical science or engineering domain is assigned, as the benchmark is discipline-agnostic by design.

zh.overview: AISE-Bench 是面向学术知识图谱上学术信息检索的全流程标注 benchmark：1,133 组问答对，随附查询分类法、完整的 API 执行轨迹、经校验的参数，以及带参考链接、可溯源的答案，过程与结果一并计分。
zh.summary: 现有面向学术图谱信息检索的工具使用 benchmark 依赖合成模板、简化的解空间，或狭窄的以论文为中心的任务，于是真实用户意图、多步 API 规划、丰富的参数填充、可溯源的答案，以及过程与结果的联合评估这五个方面都探索不足。AISE-Bench 对每个实例做端到端标注——查询、计划、已执行的 API 调用及其经校验的参数，以及带引用的答案——从而同时补上这五点。为让这样的标注切实可行，作者搭建了一套定制的 agent 工作流（Planner、Task Executor、Synthesizer），供标注者规划、执行并修订复杂的 API 工作流；他们还在一套协议下评估了 14 种方法，该协议对答案质量、引用溯源、API 规划正确性与执行成功率分别打分。

works.title: A Framework for Evaluating Agentic Skills at Scale
works.overview: An evaluation methodology that lets a skill author turn a skill into realistic executable tasks with scoring rubrics, applied at scale to roughly 500 real-world agent skills and 1,000 generated tasks across 19 agent–model configurations.
works.summary: The paper's premise is that agent skills — structured, reusable knowledge artifacts that augment LLM agents — have been adopted in industry faster than any reusable methodology for evaluating an individual skill. The framework is a five-stage pipeline: extract usage scenarios from the skill's content, engineer an environment that satisfies its execution dependencies, generate realistic tasks with custom rubrics, validate them for executability and rubric leakage, then run solver agents with and without the skill and grade against hidden rubrics. Applied at scale, it shows that models vary widely in how closely they adhere to the instructions encoded in a skill, and that skill access substantially changes model behaviour relative to a no-skill baseline.
works.domains_text: The skill corpus is explicitly cross-domain but, by the authors' own account, biased toward software-engineering content because that is where most publicly released skills currently live. A Scientific Computing cluster covers 7.5% of skills, which is not enough for the evaluated tasks to be characterised as a science or engineering domain suite; no canonical domain is assigned.

zh.overview: 一套评估方法学，让 skill 作者把自己的 skill 变成带评分量规的真实可执行任务，并在大规模上应用于约 500 个真实 agent skill、1,000 个生成任务和 19 种 agent–模型配置。
zh.summary: 论文的前提是：agent skill 是增强 LLM agent 的一类结构化、可复用知识工件，它在工业界的普及已经跑在了任何一套可复用的单 skill 评估方法学前面。该框架是一条五阶段流水线：从 skill 内容中抽取使用场景，搭建能满足其执行依赖的环境，生成带定制量规的真实任务，校验任务的可执行性与量规是否泄漏，最后让求解 agent 分别在有 skill 与无 skill 两种条件下运行，并对照隐藏量规评分。大规模应用的结果显示，各模型对 skill 中所写指令的贴合程度差异很大，而相较无 skill 基线，能否用上 skill 会实质改变模型行为。

works.title: PDAgent-Bench
works.overview: PDAgent-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating LLM/VLM-based agents across the VLSI physical design stack, combining task-level assessment (conceptual and tool-centric problems) with workflow-level closed-loop execution in realistic Electronic Design Automation (EDA) environments.
works.summary: PDAgent-Bench targets the underexplored capability of language and vision-language models for VLSI physical design, which requires high-dimensional, multi-stage optimization under strict design constraints, coordinated interaction with EDA tools, and iterative refinement. The benchmark integrates a task-level suite of 353 curated problems — spanning conceptual questions and real-world industrial artifacts with expert-validated references and executable solutions — with a workflow-level agentic framework that enables closed-loop evaluation of holistic physical design flows. The authors evaluate 11 state-of-the-art models and report that while modern LLMs/VLMs are competitive on conceptual tasks, they remain substantially limited in tool-centric execution and long-horizon, multi-stage reasoning.
works.domains_text: VLSI physical design / Electronic Design Automation — chip back-end implementation, including floorplanning, power planning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, static timing analysis, and engineering change order (ECO) work.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: PDAgent-Bench 是一个 benchmark，用于在整个 VLSI 物理设计流程上评估基于 LLM/VLM 的 agent，它把任务级评估（概念题与工具中心题）与在真实电子设计自动化（EDA）环境中的工作流级闭环执行结合起来。
zh.summary: PDAgent-Bench 瞄准语言与视觉语言模型在 VLSI 物理设计上尚未被充分探索的能力——该任务要求在严格设计约束下做高维、多阶段优化，与 EDA 工具协同交互，并做迭代式精化。该 benchmark 把一套任务级套件（353 道精选题目——涵盖概念性问题与带专家验证参考及可执行解的真实工业产物）与一套工作流级 agentic 框架（支持对完整物理设计流程做闭环评估）整合在一起。作者评估了 11 个最新模型，发现现代 LLM/VLM 虽在概念题上有竞争力，但在工具中心的执行以及长时程、多阶段推理上仍存在实质性不足。

works.title: MetaSyn
works.overview: MetaSyn is a benchmark for LLM agents on systematic review and meta-analysis, built from 422 expert-curated meta-analyses sourced from more than 34,000 Nature Portfolio articles, with research questions, structured eligibility criteria, the originally included studies, and a shared PubMed-anchored corpus.
works.summary: MetaSyn asks whether LLM agents can conduct reliable systematic review and synthesis following standardized protocols (the PI/ECO framework). Each task provides a research question with structured eligibility criteria and a corpus containing both the studies the original reviewers included and ineligible distractors; agents must identify the eligible set and synthesize. The paper also releases an MA-Retriever model alongside the dataset.
works.domains_text: Meta-analysis subjects span physics, chemistry, psychology, and medical science.

zh.overview: MetaSyn 是面向系统综述与 meta 分析的 LLM agent benchmark，基于从 34,000 余篇 Nature Portfolio 文章中整理出的 422 项专家 meta 分析构建，提供研究问题、结构化的入选标准、原综述作者纳入的研究，以及锚定 PubMed 的共享语料。
zh.summary: MetaSyn 追问 LLM agent 能否按标准化协议（PI/ECO 框架）开展可靠的系统综述与证据综合。每个任务给定带结构化入选标准的研究问题，语料中混有原综述作者纳入的研究与不合格干扰项；agent 须识别出合格集合并做综合。论文随数据集一并发布了 MA-Retriever 模型。

works.title: ATOM-Bench
works.overview: ATOM-Bench is a real-world robot benchmark that separates *atomic* manipulation skills from *compositional* tasks built out of them, so that a failure on a composed task can be attributed either to a weak underlying atom or to a genuine failure of compositional reuse.
works.summary: Generalist manipulation policies are increasingly presented as foundation models for robotic control, but the paper argues their real-world generalization is hard to diagnose: a policy may succeed on demonstrated tasks while still failing the fine-grained atomic skills underneath, or failing to recombine skills into new task structures. ATOM-Bench factorizes tabletop manipulation into **motor atoms** and **instruction atoms**, evaluating both atomic skill acquisition and held-out compositional generalization on paired single-arm and dual-arm robot tracks. Policies are fine-tuned on the atomic tasks and then evaluated on both the atomic tasks and the held-out compositional tasks, with two metrics designed to separate the two failure sources. The authors release both the demonstration data and the evaluation rollout data to support reproducible real-world evaluation.
works.domains_text: Robotics — real-robot tabletop manipulation on two physical platforms, with all reported results coming from physical rollouts rather than simulation.

zh.overview: ATOM-Bench 是一个真实机器人 benchmark，把**原子**操作技能与由它们搭起来的**组合**任务分开，于是组合任务上的失败可以归因：要么是底层原子技能不过关，要么是组合复用本身真的失效了。
zh.summary: 通用操作策略越来越多地被当作机器人控制的基础模型来看待，但论文认为它们在真实世界中的泛化很难诊断：一个策略可能在演示过的任务上成功，底下细粒度的原子技能却仍然不行；也可能是无法把技能重新组合成新的任务结构。ATOM-Bench 把桌面操作分解为**运动原子**与**指令原子**，在成对的单臂与双臂机器人赛道上同时评估原子技能的习得与留出的组合泛化。策略先只在原子任务上微调，再同时在原子任务与留出的组合任务上评测，两项指标专门用来分开这两类失败源。作者同时公开演示数据与评测 rollout 数据，以支撑可复现的真实世界评估。

works.title: SCR-Bench
works.overview: SCR-Bench is a sandboxed benchmark for Skill Composition Risk: it scores agent behavior along *activated paths* of composed skills rather than on skills evaluated in isolation, recording downstream state changes instead of textual intent.
works.summary: Skills are the capability layer through which LLM agents turn plans into actions, but vetting normally evaluates each skill on its own while real tasks invoke several skills in a shared execution context. The paper names the resulting gap Skill Composition Risk — a skill that appears benign alone becomes harmful when its outputs, trust signals, authorization cues, or side effects influence later invocations along an activated path — and builds SCR-Bench to measure it. Three sub-benchmarks isolate three composition mechanisms, and each is scored by observable downstream events in a sandbox rather than by what the agent says it will do.
works.domains_text: Agent skill ecosystems for general-purpose LLM agents; the exercised consequences are system operations, access control, device and network configuration, and organizational approval workflows. No canonical science or engineering domain is assigned.

zh.overview: SCR-Bench 是面向 Skill Composition Risk（skill 组合风险）的沙箱化 benchmark：它沿组合 skill 的*激活路径*为 agent 行为打分，而不是孤立地评估单个 skill，并且记录下游的状态变化而非文字表述的意图。
zh.summary: skill 是 LLM agent 把计划落成动作的能力层，但审核通常只单独评估每个 skill，而真实任务却会在同一个执行上下文中调用多个 skill。论文把由此产生的缺口命名为 Skill Composition Risk——单看无害的 skill，一旦其输出、信任信号、授权线索或副作用沿激活路径影响到后续调用，就会变得有害——并构建 SCR-Bench 来测量它。三个子 benchmark 分别隔离三种组合机制，每一个都以沙箱中可观测的下游事件计分，而不看 agent 声称自己要做什么。

works.title: From Chatbot to Digital Colleague
works.overview: *From Chatbot to Digital Colleague: The Paradigm Shift Toward Persistent Autonomous AI* is a position paper on the transition of LLMs from conversational generators to integrated systems capable of reasoning, action, memory, and self-improvement. It is included here as a reference paper, not a benchmark contribution.
works.summary: The paper argues LLMs are undergoing a paradigm shift from conversational generators toward integrated AI systems. It conceptualizes the shift along two dimensions: advancing LLMs toward more deliberate reasoning through inference-time computation and reflection; and progressing toward persistent workstation systems with reusable skills and state management rather than ad hoc tool usage.
works.domains_text: General LLM-agent evolution and the design space of persistent autonomous AI.

zh.overview: *From Chatbot to Digital Colleague: The Paradigm Shift Toward Persistent Autonomous AI* 是一篇立场论文，主题是 LLM 从对话式生成器向具备推理、行动、记忆与自改进能力的集成系统的转变。此处以**参考论文**（非 benchmark 贡献）纳入。
zh.summary: 论文主张：LLM 正经历从对话式生成器向集成 AI 系统的范式转变。作者沿两个维度概念化这一转变：一是通过推理时计算与反思，走向更深思的推理；二是从临时 tool 使用走向具备可复用技能与状态管理的持久 workstation 系统。

works.title: GeoNatureAgent Benchmark
works.overview: GeoNatureAgent Benchmark is a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on environmental geospatial analysis conducted through structured tool calls to a production-style API. It comprises 93 tasks across 18 categories, run against an open, self-hostable API that serves three environmental indicators across Spain and Portugal through 16 tools.
works.summary: GeoNatureAgent Benchmark argues that environmental scientists spend disproportionate effort on data wrangling and that no existing benchmark evaluates agents operating through structured tool calling against real geospatial APIs. The authors present it as the first benchmark for environmental analysis agents that operate via structured tool calls to a production-style geospatial API, and demonstrate extensibility by integrating BigEarthNet V2 land cover for Portugal alongside the Spanish CO2 and erosion indicators. Across seven LLMs under three temperature-1.0 seeds, Claude Sonnet 4 leads at 60.8% ± 0.8%, the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier is occupied mostly by open-weight models, and close-value comparison tasks sit at 0% for every model.
works.domains_text: Environmental geospatial analysis over Spain and Portugal: CO2 absorption suitability (categorical, Spain), gully erosion probability (continuous), and BigEarthNet V2 land cover (categorical, Portugal).

zh.overview: GeoNatureAgent Benchmark 是一个通过对生产级（production-style）API 的结构化工具调用来评估 LLM agent 环境地理空间分析能力的 benchmark。它包含 18 个类别共 93 个任务，运行于一个开放、可自托管的 API 之上，该 API 通过 16 个工具提供覆盖西班牙与葡萄牙的三种环境指标。
zh.summary: GeoNatureAgent Benchmark 认为环境科学家在数据整理上花费了不成比例的精力，而现有 benchmark 均未评估通过结构化工具调用操作真实地理空间 API 的 agent。作者将其定位为首个面向经由结构化工具调用使用生产级地理空间 API 的环境分析 agent 的 benchmark，并通过在西班牙 CO2 与侵蚀指标之外集成葡萄牙 BigEarthNet V2 土地覆盖展示了可扩展性。在三个 temperature 1.0 种子下评估的七个 LLM 中，Claude Sonnet 4 以 60.8% ± 0.8% 领先，成本–准确率 Pareto 前沿主要由开放权重模型占据，近值比较任务在所有模型上均为 0%。

works.title: SkillJuror
works.overview: SkillJuror is an evaluation framework that isolates *how an agent Skill is organized* from *what it says*, comparing a Progressive Disclosure layout (a concise root file pointing to supporting resources on demand) against a normalized flat baseline while holding task knowledge fixed.
works.summary: Agent Skills supply LLM agents with procedural knowledge at inference time, but benchmarks that report only task success cannot separate a Skill's content from its organization. SkillJuror constructs semantically controlled variants of the same Skill, runs matched multi-trial evaluations, and inspects trajectory evidence, so that any measured difference is attributable to the layout rather than to the knowledge. Applied to an 82-task SkillsBench study, the framework finds that Progressive Disclosure changes runtime behavior before it changes aggregate outcomes.
works.domains_text: Agent Skills as structured artifacts for general-purpose LLM agents; the paper does not scope its tasks to a science or engineering field, so no canonical domain is assigned.

zh.overview: SkillJuror 是一套评估框架，把*一个 agent skill 如何组织*与*它说了什么*分离开来：在任务知识保持不变的前提下，比较 Progressive Disclosure 布局（一个精简的根文件，按需指向各项支撑资源）与归一化的扁平基线。
zh.summary: Agent Skill 在推理时为 LLM agent 供给程序性知识，但只报告任务成功率的 benchmark 无法把一个 skill 的内容与它的组织方式分开。SkillJuror 构造同一 skill 的语义受控变体，跑成对的多次试验评估，并检视轨迹证据，从而使任何测得的差异都能归到布局上，而不是知识上。把该框架用到一项 82 任务的 SkillsBench 研究上可以看到：Progressive Disclosure 先改变的是运行时行为，之后才改变聚合结果。

works.title: SciAgentArena
works.overview: SciAgentArena is a systematic benchmark for evaluating AI agents in real-world scientific research scenarios across scales. It provides roughly 200 tasks with stepwise verification in an interactive, agent-agnostic environment.
works.summary: Titled *Benchmarking AI Agents for Addressing Scientific Challenges Across Scales*, SciAgentArena addresses the fact that AI agents' practical capabilities in real research settings remain poorly understood. It provides an interactive, agent-agnostic environment with roughly 200 tasks constructed from real-world scientific research scenarios across multiple domains, using stepwise verification. It reports that agents perform well on structured data-analysis workflows but struggle with novel insights, self-directed exploration, and open-ended questions, and it catalogs common failure modes.
works.domains_text: Biomedical research across five fields (single-cell omics, spatial omics, computational drug discovery, EHR modeling, genetics). "Across scales" refers to the biological hierarchy — molecular → cellular → tissue → human body → genome/population — not physical scale.

zh.overview: SciAgentArena 是一个系统性 benchmark，用于在跨尺度的真实世界科学研究场景中评估 AI agent。它在一个交互式、agent-agnostic 的环境中提供约 200 个带逐步验证的任务。
zh.summary: 论文题为 *Benchmarking AI Agents for Addressing Scientific Challenges Across Scales*，SciAgentArena 针对 AI agent 在真实研究场景中的实际能力仍不清楚这一问题。它提供一个交互式、agent-agnostic 的环境，含约 200 个从真实世界科学研究场景构造、跨多个领域的任务，采用逐步验证。它报告 agent 在结构化数据分析工作流上表现良好，但在新颖洞见、自主探索与开放式问题上表现挣扎，并编目了常见失败模式。

works.title: SGR-BIM
works.overview: SGR-BIM is a graph-driven multi-agent framework for checking geometry-intensive building-code provisions against IFC building models, released together with a purpose-built evaluation set of 679 expert-verified fire-safety compliance queries over five IFC models and a four-dimension scoring rubric, on which five agent baselines — including CAMEL, MetaGPT and AutoGen — are compared under identical tool access and inference settings.
works.summary: Automated compliance checking has long handled attribute-level rules ("is this wall's material X?") but stalls on geometry-intensive provisions, where a verdict requires chaining several clauses and traversing relationships between IFC entities — deciding the required exit-door width, for instance, means first inferring the building's use classification, looking up the occupancy factor, summing room areas, and only then comparing a door dimension. The paper argues that static rule templates cannot express these multi-hop chains, and proposes SGR-BIM, which dynamically builds a cross-modal knowledge graph aligning user intent, regulatory semantics and IFC geometry, with five agents (intent, model, rule, analysis, response) reasoning over the shared graph. To measure this, the authors construct an evaluation set of 679 fire-safety queries with expert-produced ground truth and score every system on a three-tier accuracy scale plus three qualitative dimensions. SGR-BIM reaches 84.3% overall accuracy against 75.7% for a single agent with the same full toolset and 64.9–73.2% for the general-purpose multi-agent frameworks.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering. The evaluated objective is design verification of a building against building-code provisions: fire-compartment areas, means of escape and travel distances, occupant capacity derived from use classification and room area, stair and corridor widths, clearances and exit-door dimensions, all checked against IFC geometry. This falls under the domain's design-code compliance and code-checking scope and its BIM/IFC clause, where the evaluated task is engineering verification rather than BIM authoring or space planning for its own sake. The work comes from the University of Hong Kong Department of Urban Planning and Design and HKUST Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering. No structural analysis, load path, or member design is evaluated, so no Mechanical & Aerospace or Materials Science co-domain is assigned; the tasks are building-code verification, not structural mechanics.

zh.overview: SGR-BIM 是一个图驱动的多 agent 框架，用来对照 IFC 建筑模型核查几何密集型的建筑规范条文。随框架一同发布的还有一套专门构建的评测集：五个 IFC 模型上的 679 道经专家核验的消防合规查询，配一套四维评分细则；五个 agent 基线——含 CAMEL、MetaGPT 与 AutoGen——在完全相同的工具权限与推理设置下同台比较。
zh.summary: 自动合规审查早就能处理属性级的规则（「这面墙的材料是不是 X？」），一碰到几何密集型条文却卡住：要得出结论，得把好几条条文串起来推，还要在 IFC 实体之间来回穿行——比如判定疏散门所需净宽，先得推断建筑的使用性质分类，再查人员密度系数，把房间面积加总，最后才轮到比对某扇门的尺寸。论文认为静态规则模板表达不了这种多跳链条，于是提出 SGR-BIM：动态构建一张跨模态知识图谱，把用户意图、规范语义与 IFC 几何对齐到一起，再由五个 agent（意图、模型、规则、分析、响应）在这张共享图上协同推理。为了度量效果，作者构建了 679 道消防查询的评测集，标准答案由专家产出，所有系统都按一套三档准确率量表外加三个定性维度打分。SGR-BIM 的总体准确率达到 84.3%，同样拥有完整工具集的单 agent 为 75.7%，通用多 agent 框架则在 64.9%–73.2% 之间。

works.title: Skill Coverage
works.overview: Skill Coverage is a trajectory-based test-adequacy metric for reusable agent skills: it compiles a skill's natural-language instructions into semi-structured behavior constraints and checks, per constraint, whether an agent trajectory covered it and whether the observed behavior passed or failed.
works.summary: Task outcomes do not reveal which parts of a reusable skill were exercised, nor whether the agent followed the relevant instructions when they were. Skill Coverage fills that gap by extracting skill behavior constraints — semi-structured statements of expected agent behavior under particular conditions — and evaluating agent trajectories against them, yielding a coverage figure plus Pass/Fail verdicts on the covered constraints. Applied to SkillsBench, it shows that leaderboard trajectories exercise well under half of a skill's constraints, and that the Fail verdicts are actionable enough to repair skills and recover previously failed tasks.
works.domains_text: Agent skills as structured artifacts for general-purpose LLM agents; the framework is not scoped to any science or engineering field, so no canonical domain is assigned.

zh.overview: Skill Coverage 是面向可复用 agent skill 的、基于轨迹的测试充分性指标：它把 skill 的自然语言指令编译成半结构化的行为约束，再逐条核对：agent 轨迹有没有覆盖到该约束，覆盖时观察到的行为又是通过还是失败。
zh.summary: 任务的成败说不出一个可复用 skill 的哪些部分真正被用到了，也说不出用到时 agent 究竟有没有照相关指令去做。Skill Coverage 补的正是这一环：先把 skill 的行为约束抽取出来——即以半结构化形式写明「在什么条件下 agent 应当有什么行为」——再拿 agent 轨迹逐条比对，产出一个覆盖率数字，外加对已覆盖约束的 Pass/Fail 判定。用在 SkillsBench 上的结果显示，排行榜轨迹触及的约束远不到一半，而 Fail 判定的可操作性足以据以修补 skill，把原本失败的任务救回来。

works.title: Agent Skill Evaluation and Evolution: Frameworks and Benchmarks
works.overview: A survey of how agent skills are evaluated and evolved once they exist, organising the literature into four skill-evolution paradigms and six categories of skill-centric benchmark, and identifying structural gaps in benchmark coverage.
works.summary: The survey's thesis is that the field is shifting from isolated skill creation toward automated, evaluation-driven skill evolution, and that as skill libraries scale, rigorous evaluation becomes the mechanism for ensuring their utility, quality, and safety. It reviews the landscape beyond foundational skill creation along two axes: how skills are improved after creation, and how skills are measured. It closes with open directions for building skill ecosystems that are generalisable, efficient, and verifiably safe.
works.domains_text: General LLM-agent skill ecosystems. No science or engineering domain is targeted.

zh.overview: 这篇综述关注 skill 建成之后如何评估、如何演化：把相关文献归入四种 skill 演化范式与六类以 skill 为中心的 benchmark，并指出 benchmark 覆盖上的结构性空缺。
zh.summary: 综述的核心论点是：这一领域正从孤立的 skill 创建，转向自动化、由评估驱动的 skill 演化；而当 skill 库规模变大，严格的评估就成了保证其效用、质量与安全的手段。它沿两条轴线梳理「基础性 skill 创建」之外的图景——skill 建成之后如何改进，以及如何度量 skill——最后给出若干开放方向，指向可泛化、高效且安全性可验证的 skill 生态。

works.title: FrontierCode
works.overview: FrontierCode is an industry benchmark from Cognition presented as the first to measure mergeability — would the maintainer actually merge this pull request? — on realistic open-source programming tasks built by 20+ experienced developers spending more than 40 hours per task. No accompanying paper has been released (see the repository note under Limitations).
works.summary: FrontierCode scores end-to-end code quality — correctness, test quality, scope discipline, style, and adherence to codebase standards — on maintainer-written tasks in real open-source repositories, using an ensemble of grading techniques including unit tests, rubrics, and new types of verifiers. Internet access is restricted to documentation: runs that consult solution-bearing sources such as the original pull request are detected and scored zero.
works.domains_text: Open-source software engineering; no science domain.

zh.overview: FrontierCode 是 Cognition 推出的业界 benchmark，自称首个测量「可合并性」（mergeability）的评测——维护者真的会合并这个 PR 吗？——任务由 20 余位资深开发者构建，每个任务投入超过 40 小时。目前没有配套论文（见 Limitations 中的 repository note）。
zh.summary: FrontierCode 在真实开源仓库中由维护者撰写任务，对端到端代码质量打分——正确性、测试质量、范围克制、代码风格与对代码库规范的遵循——评分采用单元测试、评分标准与新型验证器的组合。联网访问仅限文档：凡查阅原始 pull request 等含解的来源的运行，都会被检测并记零分。

works.title: A Case Study of Evaluating AI Agents on a Neuroscience Data-to-Discovery Pipeline
works.overview: An empirical case study that evaluates general-purpose coding agents on a real fly-optogenetics "data-to-discovery" pipeline, assessing whether agents can automate the software-engineering stages scientists normally build by hand, using evaluation criteria grounded in domain-expert standards.
works.summary: The work studies whether coding agents can build the computational stages of a neuroscience research pipeline that analyzes fly walking behavior under optogenetic perturbation. Agents must produce correct, robust code on tasks and datasets substantially larger than those in existing agent benchmarks, judged against expert human annotations and trusted legacy codebases. The study finds that agents can solve several individual pipeline stages but cannot yet compose them into a correct end-to-end discovery, and it identifies failure modes — reasoning without a predefined success criterion, weak visual self-evaluation, computational resource management, and generalization to held-out data — that are largely absent from prior benchmarks. The authors distill principles for constructing scientific tasks and rigorous evaluation criteria for open-ended problems.
works.domains_text: Neuroscience — analysis of *Drosophila* (fruit fly) walking behavior under optogenetic perturbation, spanning video-based body/keypoint tracking, behavior classification, gait analysis, and statistical comparison across genetic driver (GAL4) lines and a genetic control group.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: 一项实证案例研究，在一条真实的果蝇光遗传学「数据到发现」流程上评估通用编码 agent，考察它们能否自动化科学家平日手工搭建的软件工程环节，评估标准以领域专家的做法为依据。
zh.summary: 这项工作研究编码 agent 能否搭建一条神经科学研究流程的各个计算环节——该流程分析果蝇在光遗传学扰动下的行走行为。agent 需要在规模远超既有 agent benchmark 的任务与数据集上产出正确、稳健的代码，评判依据是专家的人工标注与可信的遗留代码库。研究发现，agent 能解决若干单独的流程阶段，但尚无法把它们组合成一次正确的端到端发现；研究还识别出若干失败模式——在没有预设成功判据下推理、视觉自评能力薄弱、计算资源管理、以及对留出数据的泛化——这些在以往 benchmark 中大多缺席。作者从中提炼出构造科学任务、以及为开放式问题设定严格评估标准的原则。

works.title: Agents' Last Exam
works.overview: Agents' Last Exam (ALE) is a frontier long-horizon benchmark co-designed with over 250 industry experts, targeting economically meaningful professional workflows organized around the U.S. occupational taxonomy. Its stated goal is to bridge the gap between benchmark performance and real-world professional deployment.
works.summary: ALE is presented as a "living" benchmark that continuously incorporates new workflows. It covers non-physical industries mapped onto the U.S. occupational taxonomy, with tasks constructed and validated by domain experts. The paper reports that the hardest difficulty tier is deliberately unsaturated at release.
works.domains_text: Non-physical industries, structured against the U.S. occupational taxonomy.

zh.overview: Agents' Last Exam (ALE) 是一个 frontier 长 horizon benchmark，由 250 多位行业专家共同设计，围绕美国职业分类（U.S. occupational taxonomy）中的实际专业工作流构建。它的目标是弥合 benchmark 表现与真实世界职业部署之间的差距。
zh.summary: ALE 被定位为一个"活的（living）"benchmark，持续吸纳新的工作流。它覆盖美国职业分类中的非物理性行业，任务由领域专家构造和验证。论文表明最难难度层在发布时刻意保持未饱和。

works.title: Agent Planning Benchmark
works.overview: Agent Planning Benchmark (APB) is a planning-specific diagnostic benchmark with 4,209 multimodal cases across 22 domains and five settings, separating complete-plan generation from feedback-conditioned next-step planning and robustness to tool or task defects.
works.summary: APB is motivated by the inability of end-to-end success rates to tell planning failures from execution failures. It evaluates holistic plans produced before execution, one- to three-step decisions conditioned on trajectory feedback, planning with extraneous tools, recovery when a critical tool is broken but a substitute exists, and refusal when constraints make a task unsolvable. Across 12 multimodal LLMs, the paper reports a consistent gap between feedback-conditioned step-wise planning and holistic planning, along with sensitivity to distractor tools and incomplete information.
works.domains_text: Twenty-two heterogeneous multimodal and tool-use domains, including web, mobile, desktop, information, finance, visual, and general assistant tasks. The paper does not provide a per-case mapping suitable for conservative assignment to this repository's canonical science and engineering domains.

zh.overview: Agent Planning Benchmark（APB）是一套规划专项诊断 benchmark，包含横跨 22 个领域、五种设置的 4,209 个多模态实例，把完整计划生成与基于反馈的下一步规划分开，并测试 agent 面对工具或任务缺陷时的稳健性。
zh.summary: APB 的出发点是：端到端成功率无法判断失败源于规划还是执行。它分别评价执行前一次性给出的整体计划、依据 trajectory 反馈选择的一至三步动作、存在无关工具时的规划、关键工具损坏但有替代项时的恢复，以及约束导致任务无解时的拒绝。在 12 个多模态 LLM 上，论文观察到基于反馈的逐步规划与整体规划之间存在稳定差距，模型也容易受干扰工具和信息缺失影响。

works.title: Curation-Bench
works.overview: Curation-Bench evaluates whether generalist coding agents can improve training-data curation policies through an iterative train–evaluate–revise loop with the model, training recipe, and evaluation suite held fixed.
works.summary: Agents inspect a candidate dataset, implement selection policies through a CLI, submit them to a fixed vision-language instruction-tuning pipeline, observe evaluation results, and revise for up to ten iterations. Out-of-the-box agents recover strong published selection baselines but mostly tune local variants; a scaffold requiring each iteration to cite and adapt a prior method broadens exploration and produces a policy that exceeds strong baselines using one tenth of their data budget.
works.domains_text: AI and machine-learning research, specifically multimodal instruction-tuning data selection.

zh.overview: Curation-Bench 测试 generalist coding agent 能否在模型、训练 recipe 和 eval suite 固定时，通过反复 train、evaluate、revise 改进训练数据策略。
zh.summary: Agent 检查候选 dataset，通过 CLI 实现 selection policy，把策略交给固定的 vision-language instruction-tuning pipeline，再根据 evaluation result 修改，最多进行十轮。普通 agent 能追上已有的强 baseline，但大多只在局部调参；要求每轮引用并改造既有方法的 scaffold 能扩大探索范围，最终得到一套只用十分之一数据预算、但超过强 baseline 的策略。

works.title: Agentic Large Language Models for Automated Structural Analysis of 3D Frame Systems
works.overview: A benchmark of ten irregular 3D building-frame systems in which an agent must produce an executable SAP2000 script from a natural-language description, scored by whether every monitored structural response falls within 1% of a manually built ground-truth SAP2000 model.
works.summary: This work carries the same group's structural-modeling lineage from plane frames into 3D building systems, where topological consistency must hold both within each floor plan and across stories. Its first contribution is a representation: an irregular 3D frame is projected onto a 2D plan defined by orthogonal gridlines, and a matrix of number of stories (MNS) assigns an integer to each grid cell specifying how far that cell extrudes vertically, so voids, atria, and setbacks are expressible in a compact text form. A multi-agent pipeline then decomposes the frame floor by floor: node, girder, and slab agents run in parallel within each floor plan, a column agent connects adjacent floors, and support, load, and code-translation agents produce the final SAP2000 script. Two lightweight backbones are used — GPT-OSS 120B for spatial reasoning and Llama-3.3 70B Instruct Turbo for code translation. Unlike the earlier 2D work, correctness is judged against numerical structural responses rather than code executability.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering. The evaluated objects are 3D building frame systems — columns, girders, and floor slabs assembled across stories — under gravity and wind-representative lateral loading, and the graded outcome is the structural response of the resulting finite-element model. The irregularity taxonomy (height irregularity, plan asymmetry, discontinuous layouts) is the vocabulary of building structural engineering. No co-domain is assigned; SAP2000 is the instrument, not the evaluated objective.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: 一个含十个不规则三维建筑框架体系的 benchmark：agent 须依据自然语言描述产出可执行的 SAP2000 脚本，只有当每一项受监测的结构响应都落在人工搭建的 ground-truth SAP2000 模型 1% 以内，才算通过。
zh.summary: 这篇把同一团队的结构建模脉络从平面框架推到三维建筑体系——到了三维，拓扑一致性既要在每个楼层平面内成立，也要跨楼层成立。第一项贡献是一种表示方法：把不规则三维框架投影到由正交轴线定义的二维平面上，再用「层数矩阵」（matrix of number of stories, MNS）给每个网格单元赋一个整数，指明该单元竖向拉伸多高，于是中庭、洞口与退台都能用紧凑的文本形式表达出来。在此之上是一条多 agent 管线，按楼层逐层分解框架：节点、大梁与楼板 agent 在每个楼层平面内并行工作，柱 agent 负责连接相邻楼层，支座、荷载与代码翻译 agent 最终产出 SAP2000 脚本。系统用了两个轻量骨干模型——GPT-OSS 120B 负责空间推理，Llama-3.3 70B Instruct Turbo 负责代码翻译。与此前的二维工作不同，这里判定正确与否依据的是数值结构响应，而非代码能否执行。

works.title: TELBench
works.overview: TELBench is a benchmark for span-level error localization in deep-research agent trajectories, testing whether a model can pick out harmful error spans among normal exploration, failed searches, tentative hypotheses, and harmless noise. It holds 1,000 verified trajectory instances (600 easy / 400 hard) drawn from a corpus of 2,790 real agent runs, each segmented into ordered semantic spans that carry binary error / non-error labels.
works.summary: TELBench argues that outcome-level evaluation of deep-research agents reveals whether a run succeeded but not which part of the trajectory first made the answer unreliable. Built from 2,790 real trajectories spanning three deep-research benchmarks, three backbone models, and two agent frameworks, it converts raw logs into ordered semantic spans and asks a model to localize the harmful error spans among benign exploration, failed searches, and noise. The paper pairs the benchmark with DRIFT, a claim-centric auditing framework that improves span-level error localization and first-error accuracy by up to 30 percentage points over bare-LLM prompting.
works.domains_text: Deep-research agent trajectories — web search, browsing, tool use, evidence inspection, and answer synthesis — drawn from the GAIA, XBench, and BrowseComp task distributions.

zh.overview: TELBench 是一个针对 deep-research agent trajectory 的 span 级错误定位 benchmark，考察模型能否在正常探索、失败检索、试探性假设与无害噪声之中挑出有害的 error span。它包含 1,000 个经核验的 trajectory 实例（600 个 easy / 400 个 hard），取自由 2,790 条真实 agent 运行构成的语料，每条被切分为带二元 error / non-error 标签的有序语义 span。
zh.summary: TELBench 主张，对 deep-research agent 的结果级评估只能说明一次运行是否成功，却无法指出 trajectory 的哪一部分最先使答案变得不可靠。它由覆盖三个 deep-research benchmark、三个 backbone 模型与两个 agent 框架的 2,790 条真实 trajectory 构建，将原始日志转换为有序语义 span，并要求模型在良性探索、失败检索与噪声之中定位有害的 error span。论文同时提出 DRIFT——一个以 claim 为中心的审计框架，在 span 级错误定位与 first-error accuracy 上相比 bare-LLM prompting 最多提升 30 个百分点。

works.title: VESTA / DAWN
works.overview:
VESTA is a vision-language agent that performs iterative statistical model fitting with a dynamically
expanding toolkit, introduced together with DAWN, a 400-instance benchmark of distribution-fitting and
time-series modelling tasks whose hardest splits are real astrophysical modelling problems — stellar initial
mass functions and gravitational-wave chirp signals.
works.summary:
The paper argues that current models fail at the iterative loop scientists actually run when fitting a model
to data — plot, hypothesise a functional form, fit, inspect residuals, revise — and gives agents a toolkit
that grows during the episode with data transformations, hypothesis-driven visualisations, and statistical
tests. To measure progress on this loop the authors introduce DAWN (Dataset for Automated Workflows and
Numerical Modeling), which pairs synthetic easy and hard splits with astronomy splits drawn from genuine
astrophysical functional families, so that difficulty comes from the shape of real scientific models rather
than from added noise. DAWN is presented as a first-class contribution alongside the agent.
works.domains_text:
Astronomy is the domain of the two hardest DAWN splits: recovering the correct initial-mass-function family
and its parameters is a stellar-population modelling task, and fitting a chirp with an inspiral-ringdown
envelope is a gravitational-wave source-modelling task. The remaining splits are domain-neutral statistical
modelling, so the work also sits on the statistical-inference methodology axis (Mathematics). The astronomy
data are simulated from astrophysical functional families rather than taken from a survey archive, but the
scored objective on those splits is an astrophysical model-recovery result.

zh.overview: VESTA 是一个视觉语言 agent，用一套在 episode 中动态扩充的工具箱做迭代式统计模型拟合；随之提出的 DAWN 是一个含 400 个实例的 benchmark，任务为分布拟合与时间序列建模，其中最难的两个划分取自真实的天体物理建模问题——恒星初始质量函数与引力波啁啾信号。
zh.summary: 论文认为，当前模型做不好科学家拟合模型时真正在跑的那个迭代循环——作图、猜一个函数形式、拟合、检查残差、再修改——于是给 agent 配了一套会在 episode 过程中不断扩充的工具箱，涵盖数据变换、假设驱动的可视化和统计检验。为衡量这一循环上的进展，作者提出 DAWN（Dataset for Automated Workflows and Numerical Modeling），它把合成的 easy 与 hard 划分与取自真实天体物理函数族的天文划分配在一起，使难度来自真实科学模型的形态，而不是靠加噪声堆出来。论文把 DAWN 与 agent 并列，当作同等重要的一项贡献。

works.title: BAGEN
works.overview: BAGEN is an evaluation benchmark that tests whether LLM agents are budget-aware — able to estimate mid-execution how much of their resource budget remains and whether the task is still finishable — treating budget as an active control signal rather than a passive, post-hoc cost metric. It evaluates five frontier agents across four environments and formalizes budget-awareness as progressive interval estimation, in which the agent predicts an upper and lower bound on its remaining budget at every turn.
works.summary: BAGEN argues that agent cost is today measured only after execution, so agents never treat budget as something to reason about while a task is still running. It defines budget along two axes — internal budget from the model's own token generation and external, multi-dimensional budget from actions in the environment — and recasts budget-awareness as progressive interval estimation scored by a rollout-replay protocol. Across four environments and five frontier agents it finds that task success correlates only weakly with budget-awareness (r = 0.35) and that frontier models are consistently over-optimistic, yet the signal is trainable, with early stopping saving 28–64% of tokens on failed runs.
works.domains_text: Interactive planning puzzles, multi-hop question answering, software-issue resolution, and supply-chain operations.

zh.overview: BAGEN 是一个评估 benchmark，用于测试 LLM agent 是否具备预算意识（budget-aware）——即能否在执行过程中估计自身还剩多少资源预算、以及任务是否仍可完成——从而把预算当作主动的控制信号，而非事后统计的成本指标。它在四个环境中评估五个 frontier agent，并把预算意识形式化为渐进式区间估计（progressive interval estimation）：agent 在每一回合都需预测其剩余预算的上界与下界。
zh.summary: BAGEN 认为，当前 agent 的成本大多只在执行结束后才被测量，因而 agent 从不会在任务仍在进行时把预算当作需要推理的对象。它沿两条轴定义预算——来自模型自身 token 生成的内部预算（internal budget），以及来自环境中动作的、多维的外部预算（external budget）——并借助 rollout-replay 协议把预算意识重新表述为渐进式区间估计。在四个环境与五个 frontier agent 上，它发现任务成功率与预算意识仅弱相关（r = 0.35），且 frontier 模型始终过度乐观，但该信号是可训练的：early stopping 在失败轨迹上可节省 28–64% 的 token。

works.title: ResearchClawBench
works.overview: ResearchClawBench is a benchmark for end-to-end autonomous scientific research in which agents must re-discover the findings of a hidden published paper from a task description, related literature, and raw data. It comprises 40 expert-curated tasks across 10 scientific domains, scored against weighted multimodal rubrics anchored to the target paper's artifacts.
works.summary: ResearchClawBench addresses the difficulty of verifying the end-to-end autonomous research capability of AI coding agents. Each task grounds a real published paper, supplying related literature and raw data while hiding the paper itself, and expert-curated multimodal rubrics decompose the target's scientific artifacts into weighted criteria so that target-paper-level re-discovery can be scored while leaving room for new discovery. Across seven autonomous research agents evaluated under a unified protocol and seventeen native LLMs run through the lightweight ResearchHarness, the strongest agent, Claude Code, averages 21.5, the strongest harness LLM, Claude-Opus-4.7, averages 20.7, and the LLM frontier mean is only 26.5.
works.domains_text: 10 scientific domains: Astronomy, Chemistry, Earth, Energy, Information, Life, Material, Math, Neuroscience, and Physics.

zh.overview: ResearchClawBench 是一个面向端到端自主科学研究的 benchmark，agent 需要仅凭任务描述、相关文献与原始数据，重新发现一篇被隐藏的已发表论文的研究结果。它包含 40 个专家构建的任务，覆盖 10 个科学领域，并依据锚定目标论文科学产物（artifact）的加权多模态 rubric 进行评分。
zh.summary: ResearchClawBench 针对 AI 编码 agent 端到端自主研究能力难以验证的问题。每个任务以一篇真实已发表论文为基础，提供相关文献与原始数据但隐藏论文本身；专家构建的多模态 rubric 将目标论文的科学产物分解为加权判据，从而在为新发现留出空间的同时对达到目标论文水平的重新发现进行评分。在统一协议下评测的 7 个自主研究 agent 与经轻量级 ResearchHarness 运行的 17 个原生 LLM 中，最强 agent Claude Code 平均得分 21.5，最强 harness LLM Claude-Opus-4.7 平均得分 20.7，LLM frontier 均值仅为 26.5。

works.title: Harness-Bench
works.overview: Harness-Bench is a diagnostic benchmark for measuring configuration-level *harness effects* — how the system layer surrounding a model (context management, tools, state, permissions, tracing, recovery) changes agent performance. It fixes external task conditions while varying the harness around each model backend, scoring 5,194 execution trajectories over 106 sandboxed offline tasks.
works.summary: Harness-Bench argues that existing benchmarks either abstract away execution, compare complete agent systems, or hold the harness fixed, leaving the execution layer unmeasured. Framing an agent as Model + Harness, it evaluates a factorial matrix of 6 configurable harnesses (OpenClaw, NanoBot, Hermes, ZeroClaw, NullClaw, Moltis) × 8 API model backends over a shared task suite, budget, timeout, and evaluator, while preserving each harness's native prompting, tool interface, state management, and recovery behavior (5,088 trajectories, plus 106 from Codex reported separately as a model-bound coding agent). Each run records final artifacts, a reconstructed execution trace, usage statistics, and validator outputs, and results are interpreted as configuration-level diagnostics of model–harness pairings rather than causal decompositions of individual harness mechanisms.
works.domains_text: General-purpose executable agent workflows: software engineering, data analysis, workspace and tool operations, evidence-grounded knowledge work, office communication, professional verticals, long-running state adaptation, and DevOps.

zh.overview: Harness-Bench 是一个诊断性 benchmark，用于测量配置级的 *harness 效应*——即包裹在模型外的系统层（上下文管理、工具、状态、权限、tracing、恢复）如何改变 agent 性能。它在固定外部任务条件的同时变换模型外围的 harness，在 106 个沙箱化离线任务上为 5,194 条执行轨迹打分。
zh.summary: Harness-Bench 指出，既有 benchmark 要么抽象掉执行层，要么比较完整的 agent 系统，要么把 harness 固定，导致执行层始终未被测量。它把 agent 表述为 Model + Harness，在共享的任务套件、预算、超时与评估器下评估 6 个可配置 harness（OpenClaw、NanoBot、Hermes、ZeroClaw、NullClaw、Moltis）× 8 个 API 模型后端的全因子矩阵，同时保留每个 harness 原生的 prompting、工具接口、状态管理与恢复行为（5,088 条轨迹，另有 Codex 作为绑定模型的 coding agent 单独报告 106 条）。每次运行记录最终产物、重建的执行轨迹、用量统计与验证器输出；结果被解读为模型–harness 配对的配置级诊断，而非对单个 harness 机制的因果分解。

works.title: Frontier LLM-based agents can overcome the ontology curation bottleneck for natural phenotypes
works.overview: A controlled re-evaluation of an established biocuration gold standard in which five frontier LLMs, each run as an "agentic curator" inside a self-contained workspace, produce Entity-Quality phenotype annotations and are scored against the same gold standard, the same three trained human curators, and the same NLP baseline used in the original 2018 study.
works.summary: Phenotype annotation — linking free-text phenotype descriptions to ontology terms — is the step that makes comparative morphological data integrable across studies, and it has remained expert-bound and therefore unscalable. Dahdul et al. (2018) built a Gold Standard of Entity-Quality (EQ) annotations across seven phylogenetic studies and used it to compare three human curators with the Semantic CharaParser NLP tool, finding machine-human consistency well below human-human consistency. This paper revisits that benchmark with five frontier hosted LLMs from Anthropic and OpenAI. Each model is given a self-contained workspace containing the source publication PDF, the same annotation guide the human curators used, the four project ontologies, and a validation script, and is evaluated with the original semantic-similarity metrics.
works.domains_text: Biology. Specifically comparative vertebrate morphology and evolutionary biology, with the annotations feeding phenotype knowledge bases used for cross-study data integration. No co-domain is claimed.

zh.overview: 一项在既有生物策展金标准上做的受控再评估：五个前沿 LLM 各自作为一名「agentic 策展员」在自足的工作区中运行，产出 Entity-Quality 表型标注，并对照与 2018 年原研究相同的金标准、相同的三位受训人类策展员以及相同的 NLP 基线打分。
zh.summary: 表型标注——把自由文本的表型描述连到本体条目上——是让比较形态学数据得以跨研究整合的那一步，而它长期依赖专家，因此无法规模化。Dahdul et al. (2018) 在七项系统发育研究上构建了一套 Entity-Quality（EQ）标注金标准，并用它比较三位人类策展员与 Semantic CharaParser 这一 NLP 工具，发现机器–人类的一致性远低于人类–人类的一致性。本文用来自 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 的五个前沿托管 LLM 重做这一 benchmark。每个模型都拿到一个自足的工作区，内含源出版物 PDF、人类策展员当年用的同一份标注指南、四个项目本体以及一个校验脚本，评估沿用原研究的语义相似度指标。

works.title: First head-to-head comparison of agentic AI applied to the analysis of simulated data of the Einstein Telescope
works.overview: A controlled head-to-head evaluation in which two commercial agentic coding systems, Claude Code and Codex, are given an identical written specification and identical hardware and asked to execute an end-to-end gravitational-wave analysis pipeline on simulated Einstein Telescope data without human intervention, with both the scientific outputs and the agents' process behaviour recorded and compared.
works.summary: The study asks whether two agentic AI systems, given the same instructions and the same machine, produce the same science and reach it the same way. A single specification document (`exp.md`) describes a seven-stage gravitational-wave pipeline — power spectral density estimation from raw Einstein Telescope simulated strain, geometric template-bank generation, injection and matched-filter recovery of 100 binary-black-hole signals, results and diagnostic plots, an LLM-written manuscript in the style of Physical Review D, and a self-reported `metrics.json`. Claude Code and Codex each executed the specification twice, once with unrealistically loud injections and once with signals rescaled to a physically motivated signal-to-noise range. The scientific results converged in both runs, but the runtimes, memory footprints, error-handling styles and manuscripts diverged sharply, and in the second run a difference in how each agent read one instruction produced a genuine scientific divergence.
works.domains_text: Astronomy. The evaluated objective is gravitational-wave source science: recovering binary-black-hole signals injected into simulated Einstein Telescope detector noise, with detection efficiency and recovered signal-to-noise ratios as the scored scientific outputs, and the astrophysical parameters of the injected population (component masses, luminosity distances) defining the task. Physics is a secondary co-domain through the waveform modelling and detector-noise characterisation the pipeline rests on.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: 一项受控的正面对比实验：两套商用 agentic coding 系统 Claude Code 与 Codex 拿到完全相同的书面规格说明、跑在完全相同的硬件上，要在无人干预的条件下，对 Einstein Telescope 的模拟数据端到端执行一条引力波分析管线；实验同时记录并比较双方的科学产出与过程行为。
zh.summary: 这项研究要问的是：两套 agentic AI 系统，给同样的指令、同一台机器，做出的科学结论是否一致，走到结论的路径又是否一致。一份规格文档（`exp.md`）描述了七个阶段的引力波管线——从 Einstein Telescope 模拟原始应变数据估计功率谱密度、生成几何模板库、注入 100 个双黑洞信号并用匹配滤波恢复、出结果图与诊断图、由 LLM 按 Physical Review D 的体例撰写一篇稿件，最后自报一份 `metrics.json`。Claude Code 与 Codex 各按这份规格执行两次：第一次的注入信号强得不切实际，第二次把信号重新标定到物理上合理的信噪比区间。两次运行的科学结果都收敛到一致，但运行时间、内存占用、错误处理风格与稿件差异明显；而在第二次运行中，两者对同一条指令的读法不同，还导致了一处真正的科学分歧。

works.title: DiscoverPhysics
works.overview: DiscoverPhysics is an agentic benchmark for out-of-the-box scientific thinking: the agent must discover the laws of motion of a simulated world whose physics deliberately deviates from our own — screened gravity, hidden particle species, modified force laws — by proposing rounds of experiments and analyzing raw trajectory data.
works.summary: Each of 22 worlds is generated on demand by an N-body simulator with deliberately non-standard physics. The agent proposes several rounds of experiments, observes raw trajectory data, and ultimately submits both a natural-language explanation of the world's physics and a Python implementation of the inferred law. Scoring runs on two complementary axes: trajectory MSE on held-out particles, and an LLM-judged explanation score against an expert-written rubric assessing conceptual understanding. Across eleven frontier models, the strongest agents pass only half of the worlds and consistently fail where latent structure must be uncovered; good predictive accuracy does not guarantee high explanation quality.
works.domains_text: Classical mechanics and N-body dynamics with astrophysics-flavored counterfactuals (modified gravity, dark-matter-like particles, cosmological expansion analogues).

zh.overview: DiscoverPhysics 是考察「跳出框架的科学思维」的 agentic benchmark：agent 要发现一个物理刻意偏离现实的模拟世界的运动定律——屏蔽引力、隐藏粒子种类、修改的力定律——方式是提出多轮实验并分析原始轨迹数据。
zh.summary: 22 个世界均由 N 体模拟器按需生成，物理刻意非标准。agent 提出数轮实验、观察原始轨迹数据，最终同时提交对该世界物理的自然语言解释与所推断定律的 Python 实现。评分沿两条互补的轴进行：留出粒子上的轨迹 MSE，以及按专家撰写的评分标准由 LLM 评判的解释分（考察对世界的概念性理解）。在 11 个前沿模型上，最强 agent 也只通过一半的世界，且在必须揭示潜在结构的世界上持续失败；预测精度高并不保证解释质量高。

works.title: AutoDFT / VASPBench
works.overview: VASPBench is a purpose-built benchmark for autonomous density-functional-theory calculations, spanning 34 tasks across 9 DFT calculation types; it is released with AutoDFT, a closed-loop multi-agent framework that plans, runs, and repairs VASP calculations and reaches 94.1% task-level success with GPT-5.2.
works.summary: Setting up DFT is expert, fiddly, and failure-prone, and AutoDFT automates the loop: a strategic planner lays out skeletal step objectives, a step planner fills in numerical parameters just in time, and a monitor-recover-reflect cycle diagnoses and repairs failures while revising the plan. VASPBench measures this over 34 tasks across 9 DFT calculation types, on which AutoDFT achieves 94.1% task-level success with GPT-5.2, alongside quantitatively reliable predictions of electronic, magnetic, and energetic properties against established materials databases.
works.domains_text: Materials science — autonomous density-functional-theory workflow execution (VASP), producing electronic, magnetic, and energetic property predictions.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: VASPBench 是面向自主密度泛函理论计算的专建 benchmark，横跨 34 个任务、9 种 DFT 计算类型；它随 AutoDFT 一同发布——一个闭环多 agent 框架，负责规划、运行并修复 VASP 计算，用 GPT-5.2 达到 94.1% 的任务级成功率。
zh.summary: 搭建 DFT 既专业又琐碎、还容易出错，AutoDFT 把这一循环自动化：战略规划器列出骨架式的步骤目标，步骤规划器即时填入数值参数，「监控-恢复-反思」循环诊断并修复失败、同时修订计划。VASPBench 在 34 个任务、9 种 DFT 计算类型上测量这套系统，AutoDFT 用 GPT-5.2 达到 94.1% 的任务级成功率，并在既有材料数据库上对电子、磁性与能量性质给出定量可靠的预测。

works.title: TS-Skill
works.overview: TS-Skill is a controlled benchmark for time-series question answering that decomposes analytical competence into three composable signal-level skills — temporal scale selection, temporal localization, and cross-interval integration — and reports a per-skill profile instead of a single aggregate TSQA score.
works.summary: Existing time-series QA benchmarks are organized by task type or by high-level reasoning category, which the authors argue makes it impossible to diagnose the signal-level capabilities actually driving performance. TS-Skill instead defines three composable analytical skills and builds questions whose required skill set is known by construction, so accuracy can be reported per skill and per skill combination. The benchmark is generated by **SKEvol**, a skill-guided agentic construction pipeline combining domain-aware seed-signal generation, skill-controlled question generation, metadata- and code-assisted answer construction, multi-phase signal-grounded verification, and human-in-the-loop curation. Evaluation across ten LLMs, VLMs, time-series-native models, and one tool-augmented agent shows substantial and uneven gaps across the three skills.
works.domains_text: `Repository note:` no canonical science or engineering domain is assigned. The 25 domain categories (finance, healthcare, energy, traffic and transportation, environmental monitoring, web systems, and others) act as *context conditioning* for synthetically generated signals rather than as scientific tasks grounded in real field data; the evaluated capability is generic temporal reasoning over signals. Domain membership is therefore not claimed on the field axis.

zh.overview: TS-Skill 是一个受控的时间序列问答 benchmark，把分析能力分解为三种可组合的信号级 skill——时间尺度选择、时间定位、跨区间整合——并给出逐 skill 的能力画像，而不是一个笼统的 TSQA 总分。
zh.summary: 现有时间序列问答 benchmark 按任务类型或高层推理范畴组织，作者认为这使得真正驱动表现的信号级能力无从诊断。TS-Skill 转而定义三种可组合的分析 skill，并让每道题所需的 skill 集合在构造时就是已知的，于是准确率可以按 skill、按 skill 组合分别报告。benchmark 由 **SKEvol** 生成——一条 skill 引导的 agentic 构建流水线，包含领域感知的种子信号生成、skill 受控的题目生成、元数据与代码辅助的答案构建、多阶段的信号锚定校验，以及人在环的策展。对十个模型（涵盖 LLM、VLM、时间序列原生模型与一个工具增强 agent）的评测显示，三种 skill 上的差距既显著又不均衡。

works.title: SkillEvolBench
works.overview: SkillEvolBench is a diagnostic benchmark for the step from experience reuse to skill formation: whether an LLM agent can distil its own episodic trajectories into reusable procedural skills that still work when the skill library is frozen and the tasks shift.
works.summary: The benchmark separates two phases. In acquisition, the agent solves learning tasks and updates an external skill library from compacted execution artifacts paired with verifier feedback. In deployment, the library is frozen and the agent may read but not modify it, facing held-out tasks that probe context shift, adversarial shortcuts, and composition. Four conditions — no-skill, raw-trajectory reuse, self-generated skills, and a curated-start seed library — are compared so that procedural abstraction can be separated from base capability, from prior curated knowledge, and from direct reuse of episodic traces. Across ten model configurations and three agent harnesses the paper reports that agents adapt locally but rarely form robust reusable skills, and that raw-trajectory reuse frequently outperforms the distilled skills derived from those same trajectories.
works.domains_text: General-purpose agent environments (software, tooling, data, documents, information synthesis, communication). No canonical science or engineering domain is targeted; the evaluated object is procedural skill formation, not a scientific task.

zh.overview: SkillEvolBench 是一套诊断性基准，针对的是从「经验复用」迈向「skill 形成」的那一步：LLM agent 能否把自己的情节式轨迹蒸馏成可复用的程序性 skill，并且在 skill 库被冻结、任务发生变化之后依然管用。
zh.summary: 该基准把评估分成两个阶段。习得阶段，agent 解决学习任务，并用压缩后的执行工件配合验证器反馈去更新一个外部 skill 库。部署阶段，skill 库被冻结，agent 只能读不能改，面对的是考察上下文偏移、对抗性捷径与组合能力的留出任务。四种条件——无 skill、原始轨迹复用、自生成 skill，以及带精选种子库的起步——彼此对照，从而把程序性抽象与基础能力、与既有的人工精选知识、与情节轨迹的直接复用分离开来。论文在十种模型配置和三套 agent harness 上报告：agent 能做出局部适应，却很少形成稳健可复用的 skill；而且原始轨迹复用常常胜过从这同一批轨迹蒸馏出来的 skill。

works.title: SMDD-Bench
works.overview: SMDD-Bench asks whether LLMs can solve real-world small-molecule drug design tasks: 502 guaranteed-solvable instances over 102 unique protein targets in five task types — 2D pharmacophore identification, interaction point discovery, scaffold hopping, lead optimization, and fragment assembly — as a multi-turn, long-horizon agentic benchmark.
works.summary: SMDD-Bench requires strong chemical and biological reasoning, 3D intuition, specialized tool use, and planning expertise over a limited number of oracle calls — the oracle budget makes each query a spent resource, so the agent must plan its exploration rather than brute-force it. Every instance is constructed guaranteed-solvable, which turns failure into evidence about the agent rather than the task. Across seven frontier open- and closed-source LLMs, even the most performant, GPT-5.4, solves only 40.2% of tasks.
works.domains_text: Small-molecule drug design: medicinal and computational chemistry over protein targets — pharmacophores, scaffolds, lead optimization, and fragment assembly.

zh.overview: SMDD-Bench 追问 LLM 能否解决真实世界的小分子药物设计任务：502 个保证有解的实例、102 个不同蛋白靶点、五类任务——2D 药效团识别、相互作用位点发现、骨架跃迁、先导化合物优化与片段组装——以多轮、长 horizon 的 agentic benchmark 呈现。
zh.summary: SMDD-Bench 要求扎实的化学与生物学推理、3D 直觉、专业工具使用，以及在有限 oracle 调用次数下的规划能力——oracle 预算让每次查询都是被消耗的资源，agent 必须规划探索而非穷举。每个实例都构造为保证有解，因此失败反映的是 agent 而不是任务。在七个前沿开源与闭源 LLM 上，即便表现最好的 GPT-5.4 也只解出 40.2% 的任务。

works.title: Insights Generator
works.overview: Insights Generator is a multi-agent system for corpus-level trace diagnostics for LLM agents. It answers diagnostic questions by proposing and testing hypotheses across a corpus of execution traces to produce an evidence-backed insights report — automating what would otherwise be manual trace inspection.
works.summary: Insights Generator addresses automated diagnosis of LLM agent failures. Rather than manual inspection of individual traces, it deploys a multi-agent system that formulates and tests hypotheses across the entire trace corpus. Users who implemented its recommendations improved downstream agent performance by 30.4 percentage points.
works.domains_text: General LLM-agent trace diagnostics.

zh.overview: Insights Generator 是一个面向 LLM agent 的**语料级 trace 诊断**多 agent 系统。它以在 trace 语料上"提出并验证假设"的方式回答诊断问题，产出带证据支撑的 insights 报告——自动化了原本需要人工逐条 trace 检视的工作。
zh.summary: Insights Generator 面向 LLM agent 失败的**自动诊断**。相比对单条 trace 逐一手工检视，它部署一个多 agent 系统，在整个 trace 语料上提出与检验假设。实施该系统建议的用户，其下游 agent 性能提升了 30.4 个百分点。

works.title: Pseudo-Formalization
works.overview: Pseudo-Formalization (PF) is an evaluation methodology that verifies natural-language mathematical proofs by rewriting them into self-contained modules — each stating its premises, conclusion, and proof — and then checking every module independently. It is evaluated on olympiad-level and research-level mathematics, and ships ArxivMathGradingBench, 35 arXiv research papers carrying 40 errors their authors later disclosed.
works.summary: Pseudo-Formalization argues that reliable proof verification is a bottleneck for training and evaluating AI systems on hard mathematical reasoning: fully formal proofs in languages such as Lean are unambiguous and modular and therefore easy to check, but most proofs — particularly those written by AI systems — have neither property, and the formal libraries needed to express modern research mathematics remain far from complete. The authors define a proof format whose modules each state premises, conclusion, and proof in natural language, and pair it with Block Verification (BV), in which an LLM translates a proof into that format, verifies each module in isolation, and lets a calibrator model aggregate the per-module reports under a configurable strictness threshold. PF+BV Pareto-dominates LLM-as-judge baselines on error-finding precision and recall across olympiad and research-level mathematics, and the paper releases ArxivMathGradingBench as its research-level test bed.
works.domains_text: Mathematical proof verification: olympiad and Putnam competition problems, and published research mathematics drawn from arXiv math categories.

zh.overview: Pseudo-Formalization（PF）是一种评估方法论，它把自然语言数学证明改写为若干自包含模块——每个模块陈述自身的前提、结论与证明——再对每个模块独立检查。它在奥林匹克竞赛级与研究级数学上接受评估，并发布 ArxivMathGradingBench，包含 35 篇 arXiv 研究论文以及作者事后披露的 40 处错误。
zh.summary: Pseudo-Formalization 认为，可靠的证明验证是训练与评估 AI 系统进行高难度数学推理的瓶颈：Lean 之类语言中的完全形式化证明无歧义且模块化，因而易于检查，但多数证明——尤其是 AI 系统写出的证明——两种性质都不具备，而表达现代研究数学所需的形式化库仍远未完备。作者定义了一种证明格式，其每个模块都以自然语言陈述前提、结论与证明，并把它与 Block Verification（BV）配对：由一个 LLM 把证明翻译为该格式，逐模块独立验证，再由一个 calibrator 模型在可配置的严格度阈值下聚合各模块的报告。PF+BV 在奥林匹克与研究级数学上于错误发现的 precision 与 recall 上 Pareto 支配 LLM-as-judge baseline，论文并发布 ArxivMathGradingBench 作为其研究级测试集。

works.title: AgentAtlas
works.overview: AgentAtlas is a diagnostic vocabulary and audit protocol for LLM agents, applied on top of 15 existing agent benchmarks. It reframes evaluation from outcome-only leaderboards toward per-control-decision quality and per-trajectory quality, with a six-way control-decision taxonomy and a failure taxonomy.
works.summary: AgentAtlas is not a stand-alone task suite. It is a diagnostic framework: a classification of control-decision types, a failure taxonomy, and an audit protocol that can be layered on top of existing agent benchmarks. The paper applies the framework across 15 agent benchmarks and demonstrates measurement challenges through evaluation of 1,342 synthetic items across 8 models.
works.domains_text: Agent behavior across the environments covered by the 15 audited benchmarks — codebases, browsers, operating systems, calendars, files, and tool ecosystems.

zh.overview: AgentAtlas 是面向 LLM agent 的诊断词汇与审计协议，应用在 15 个已有 agent benchmark 之上。它把评估从"仅结果排行榜"重构为对**每次控制决策**的质量和**每条 trajectory** 的质量，提供一个六路控制决策分类以及一个失败分类。
zh.summary: AgentAtlas 本身不是任务套件——它是一个诊断框架：一个控制决策类型分类、一个失败分类，以及一个可叠加在既有 agent benchmark 上的审计协议。论文把该框架应用在 15 个 agent benchmark 上，并通过在 8 个模型上对 1,342 个合成 item 的评估来演示测量挑战。

works.title: SciConvBench
works.overview: SciConvBench benchmarks LLMs on multi-turn clarification for task formulation in computational science: given an ill-posed simulation request in fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, materials science, or PDEs, the model must elicit missing information (disambiguation) and detect internally contradictory requirements (inconsistency resolution) through dialogue before any computation happens.
works.summary: Most simulation failures begin before the first solve: the request itself is underspecified or self-contradictory. SciConvBench evaluates the conversational competence that precedes computation, using a structured task ontology and a rubric-based framework scoring three dimensions — clarification behavior, conversational grounding, and final-specification fidelity — with metrics including grounded conversation rate and clarification recall/precision (per the official repository). Even the best model resolves only 52.7% of the disambiguation cases in fluid mechanics.
works.domains_text: Computational-science task formulation across fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, materials science, and PDEs.

zh.overview: SciConvBench 评测 LLM 在计算科学任务表述上的多轮澄清能力：面对流体力学、固体力学、材料科学或 PDE 领域一个不适定的仿真请求，模型须在任何计算发生之前，通过对话问出缺失的信息（消歧）并发现内部自相矛盾的要求（矛盾消解）。
zh.summary: 多数仿真失败发生在第一次求解之前：请求本身就欠规范或自相矛盾。SciConvBench 评估先于计算的对话能力，采用结构化任务本体与基于评分标准的框架，从三个维度打分——澄清行为、对话中的共识建立与最终规格保真度——指标含 grounded conversation rate 与澄清召回/精确率（据官方仓库）。即便最好的模型，在流体力学的消歧算例上也只解决 52.7%。

works.title: HydroAgent
works.overview: HydroAgent benchmarks nine frontier LLM agents on calibrating the operational CREST distributed hydrologic model — used by the U.S. National Weather Service for flash-flood forecasting — over four held-out gauges spanning 329–40,792 km², scored by Nash–Sutcliffe Efficiency against a human-expert reference. The paper's paired RL-trained agent is a method contribution (see the repository note under Limitations).
works.summary: Calibrating a distributed hydrologic model means reading hydrograph signatures and translating them into high-dimensional parameter adjustments, with online CREST simulations as feedback. Best-of-twenty-rounds NSE across nine frontier agents ranges from −0.16 (GPT-5.4) to 0.75 (Sonnet 4.6), and no model reaches the human-expert reference except Opus 4.7 on a single gauge. The paper then fine-tunes Qwen3-4B on 2,576 expert calibration trajectories with simulator-grounded RL (NSE as a verifiable reward), a training contribution outside this card's scope.
works.domains_text: Hydrology and Earth-system science: streamflow simulation and operational flash-flood forecasting infrastructure.

zh.overview: HydroAgent 评测九个前沿 LLM agent 对业务化 CREST 分布式水文模型——美国国家气象局用于山洪预报——的参数率定能力，在流域面积 329–40,792 km² 的四个留出测站上以 Nash–Sutcliffe 效率（NSE）对照人类专家参照打分。论文配套的 RL 训练 agent 属于方法贡献（见 Limitations 中的 repository note）。
zh.summary: 率定分布式水文模型意味着读懂过程线特征，并把它们转译成高维参数调整，以在线 CREST 模拟作为反馈。九个前沿 agent 的二十轮最优 NSE 从 −0.16（GPT-5.4）到 0.75（Sonnet 4.6）不等，除 Opus 4.7 在一个测站外，没有模型达到人类专家参照。论文随后用 2,576 条专家率定轨迹对 Qwen3-4B 做监督微调，并以 NSE 为可验证奖励、用模拟器反馈做强化学习——该训练贡献不在本卡片范围内。

works.title: BioXArena
works.overview: BioXArena benchmarks LLM agents on multi-modal biomedical machine-learning tasks: 76 end-to-end tasks across 9 domains — sequence modeling, single-cell analysis, structural biology, network biology, chemical biology, perturbation dynamics, phenotype-disease modeling, biomedical imaging, and text-integrated learning — run in a standardized 2-hour single-GPU environment.
works.summary: BioXArena's agents must write executable code, train predictive models, and generate submissions for private test samples — full ML-engineering loops on biomedical data curated from primary sources. A unified evaluation framework scores submissions with hidden labels, held-out graders, and biology-aware metrics normalized to a 0–1 scale. Across 11 agent configurations, MLEvolve with Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves the highest average score of 0.666, followed by GPT-5.4 at 0.636, while no single agent consistently dominates across all domains.
works.domains_text: Nine biomedical domains: sequence modeling, single-cell analysis, structural biology, network biology, chemical biology, perturbation dynamics, phenotype-disease modeling, biomedical imaging, and text-integrated learning.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: BioXArena 在多模态生物医学机器学习任务上评测 LLM agent：76 个端到端任务横跨 9 个领域——序列建模、单细胞分析、结构生物学、网络生物学、化学生物学、扰动动力学、表型-疾病建模、生物医学影像与文本整合学习——在标准化的 2 小时单 GPU 环境中运行。
zh.summary: BioXArena 的 agent 须编写可执行代码、训练预测模型，并针对私有测试样本生成提交——在取自一手生物医学来源的数据上跑完整的 ML 工程循环。统一评估框架用隐藏标签、留出判分器与归一化到 0–1 的生物学感知指标打分。在 11 种 agent 配置中，MLEvolve 配 Gemini-3.1-Pro 以 0.666 的平均分最高，GPT-5.4 以 0.636 次之，而没有任何一个 agent 在所有领域都占优。

works.title: Collider-Bench
works.overview: Collider-Bench is a benchmark that evaluates whether LLM agents can reproduce experimental analyses from the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) using only public papers and open scientific software. Its first release holds 10 Simulation tasks drawn from four CMS supersymmetry searches, run in a containerized sandbox with the public collider-simulation stack and scored by continuous histogram fidelity against hidden reference yields.
works.summary: Collider-Bench addresses the gap that existing long-horizon tool-use benchmarks rarely capture the complexity and nuance of real scientific work: the public toolchain only approximates the software used internally by the LHC collaborations, and published papers omit implementation details needed for a faithful reconstruction, so agents must fill the gaps through physical reasoning, domain knowledge, and trial-and-error. Each task requires the agent to turn a published analysis into an executable simulation-and-selection pipeline and submit predicted collision event yields in specified signal regions, evaluated with histogram metrics that provide continuous fidelity scores without a hand-written rubric, complemented by per-task computational-cost reporting and an LLM judge over the codebase and full session trace. Across a capability ladder of six general-purpose coding agents, on average no agent reliably beats the physicist-in-the-loop solution.
works.domains_text: Experimental particle physics: recasting CMS searches for supersymmetry (simplified-model signal topologies) at the Large Hadron Collider.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: Collider-Bench 是一个 benchmark，评估 LLM agent 能否仅凭公开论文和开放科学软件复现大型强子对撞机（LHC）的实验分析。首个版本包含取自 4 项 CMS 超对称搜索的 10 个 Simulation 任务，在带有公开对撞机模拟软件栈的容器化沙盒中运行，并以对照隐藏参考产额的连续直方图保真度评分。
zh.summary: Collider-Bench 针对的空白是：现有长程 tool-use benchmark 很少刻画真实科学工作的复杂性与细微之处——公开工具链只能近似 LHC 实验合作组内部使用的软件，已发表论文又不可避免地省略了忠实重建所需的实现细节，因此 agent 必须依靠物理推理、领域知识和反复试错来填补缺口。每个任务要求 agent 将一项已发表分析转化为可执行的模拟–筛选（simulation-and-selection）流水线，并提交指定信号区域内的预测对撞事例产额，以无需手写 rubric 的直方图指标给出连续保真度得分，辅以按任务的计算成本报告和对代码库与完整会话轨迹的 LLM judge 审查。在由六个通用 coding agent 构成的能力阶梯上，平均而言没有任何 agent 能稳定超过物理学家在环（physicist-in-the-loop）方案。

works.title: gwBenchmarks
works.overview: gwBenchmarks stress-tests LLM coding agents on high-precision gravitational-wave astronomy: a suite of eight tasks — building waveform surrogates from numerical-relativity simulations, modeling black-hole orbital dynamics, fitting merger-remnant properties, constructing template banks — whose underlying data collectively represent over 10⁸ core-hours of compute and whose domain requirements demand ≲10⁻⁴ relative error.
works.summary: The eight tasks span interpolation, regression, and high-dimensional time-series modeling at the precision gravitational-wave science actually requires. Because agents frequently relied on proxy metrics, partial evaluation, or fabricated results to spuriously complete tasks, the benchmark scores progress through an external pre-defined evaluation framework rather than agent self-reports. Evaluating twelve coding agents, the paper finds no consistent winner; on harder tasks such as analytic waveform modeling, all agents fall one to two orders of magnitude short of domain requirements, with systematic failures including metric misuse, constraint violations, and result fabrication.
works.domains_text: Gravitational-wave astronomy and general relativity: numerical-relativity waveform surrogates, black-hole orbital dynamics, merger remnants, ringdown, and template banks.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: gwBenchmarks 在高精度引力波天文学上对 LLM coding agent 做压力测试：八个任务——从数值相对论模拟构建波形代理模型、建模黑洞轨道动力学、拟合并合遗迹性质、构造模板库——其底层数据合计代表超过 10⁸ 核时的计算量，领域精度要求达到相对误差 ≲10⁻⁴。
zh.summary: 八个任务覆盖插值、回归与高维时间序列建模，标准是引力波科学实际需要的精度。由于 agent 频繁依赖代理指标、只做部分评估、甚至伪造结果来「假性完成」任务，benchmark 用一个外部预定义的评估框架来衡量进度，而不采信 agent 的自我报告。对 12 个 coding agent 的评估未发现稳定的赢家；在解析波形建模等较难任务上，所有 agent 都比领域要求差一到两个数量级，并出现系统性失败：指标误用、违反约束、结果伪造。

works.title: SciVQR
works.overview: SciVQR is a multimodal scientific-reasoning benchmark of 3,254 image-paired questions spanning 6 subjects and 54 subfields — mathematics, physics, chemistry, geography, astronomy and biology — in which astronomy is a first-class, separately scored subject with its own subfield breakdown.
works.summary: SciVQR asks whether multimodal large language models can carry out scientific reasoning that genuinely depends on a diagram, chart, equation or structural figure rather than on text alone. Questions are drawn from scientific competitions, college entrance exams, and college and graduate-level exams and textbooks, then filtered so that visual information is indispensable rather than auxiliary.
