works.overview: HiPER factorizes an interactive LLM-agent policy into a high-level subgoal planner and a low-level executor, then assigns reinforcement-learning credit at both levels.
works.summary: Flat agent RL operates at one time scale and propagates sparse terminal reward through long action sequences. HiPER instead lets a high-level policy propose a subgoal that the executor carries out over several environment actions. Hierarchical Advantage Estimation aggregates returns within each subgoal and coordinates planner and executor updates; the paper proves an unbiased estimator with lower variance than flat GAE under its assumptions.
works.domains_text: General embodied household and web interaction; no canonical scientific or engineering domain.

works.title: ERI Benchmark
works.overview: The Engineering Reasoning and Instruction (ERI) benchmark is a taxonomy-driven instruction dataset of 57,750 instruction–response records built as a controlled cross-product of nine engineering fields (55 subdomains, chemical engineering among them), seven task intents, and three difficulty tiers, released with validation scripts and an evaluation harness for scoring LLMs and agents.
works.summary: ERI is designed around the argument that a general-purpose benchmark cannot diagnose engineering competence, because pooled prompts hide where failures concentrate. Coverage is therefore treated as a controlled combination of field, task intent, and difficulty tier: every (field, subdomain, intent, difficulty) cell receives a fixed number of samples so that no high-volume prompt class dominates the aggregate score. Records are generated synthetically under that taxonomy, schema-validated, deduplicated, and spot-verified, then scored by a mix of automatic checks and rubric-based judging. The authors run a seven-model baseline study and pair it with a validation protocol intended to bound the hallucination risk inherent in an LLM-generated reference set.
works.domains_text: Chemical Engineering is one of the nine explicitly enumerated fields, with six subdomains: mass and energy balances, chemical thermodynamics, reaction engineering, separation processes, process control, and transport phenomena — core chemical/process engineering subject matter, and results are reported per field so the chemical-engineering slice is separately scoreable. The benchmark is genuinely multi-field, so co-domains include Civil & Structural (statics, mechanics of materials, structural analysis, steel and concrete design, geotechnical, structural dynamics, construction management), Mechanical & Aerospace (thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, machine design, dynamics and vibrations, manufacturing, HVAC; plus aerodynamics, flight mechanics, propulsion, aerospace structures, orbital mechanics), Electrical (circuits, electronics, signals and systems, power systems, electromagnetics, control systems), Materials Science (structure of materials, mechanical properties, phase diagrams, failure analysis, polymers and composites, corrosion), and Environmental Science (water treatment, air quality, hydrology, waste management, environmental impact). Industrial engineering and fire science are two further covered fields.

zh.overview: Engineering Reasoning and Instruction（ERI）benchmark 是一套由分类体系驱动的指令数据集：按九个工程领域（含 55 个子领域，化学工程在列）、七种任务意图与三个难度层级做受控笛卡尔积，共 57,750 条指令–回答记录，随附校验脚本与一套用于给 LLM 和 agent 打分的评估框架。
zh.summary: ERI 的设计立论是：通用 benchmark 诊断不了工程能力，因为混在一起的题目会掩盖失败究竟集中在哪里。于是 ERI 把覆盖度处理成领域、任务意图与难度层级的受控组合：每个（领域，子领域，意图，难度）单元都分到固定条数的样本，任何一类高产的题型都无法主导总分。记录在这套分类体系下合成生成，再经 schema 校验、去重与抽样核验，最后由自动检查与基于评分细则的判分共同打分。作者还做了一项覆盖七个模型的基线研究，并配上一套校验协议，用以给「参考答案本身由 LLM 生成」所固有的幻觉风险划定上界。

works.title: Gaia2
works.overview: Gaia2 is a benchmark for LLM agents in asynchronous environments, where the world evolves on its own clock rather than only when the agent acts. Its 1,120 scenarios run in a simulated smartphone universe and are scored by a verifier that checks every state-changing action against oracle annotations, making the benchmark directly usable for reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards.
works.summary: The authors observe that most agent benchmarks are static or synchronous — environments change only when the agent acts, and evaluation ignores intermediate actions — so challenges that dominate real deployments, such as asynchronous events and operating under temporal constraints, go untested. Gaia2 addresses this by running scenarios in event-driven environments that advance independently of the agent, and by scoring trajectories against a minimal oracle sequence of state-changing actions rather than a final answer. Across seven capability splits, GPT-5 (high) leads with 42.1% pass@1 overall while scoring 0.0 on the Time split, and no evaluated system dominates across all capabilities.
works.domains_text: A simulated consumer smartphone environment of twelve stateful apps — messaging, email, calendar, contacts, files, chats, cabs, shopping, city information, rentals, and a system app — rather than a scientific domain.

zh.overview: Gaia2 是一个面向异步环境中 LLM agent 的 benchmark——在这类环境里，世界按自己的时钟推进，而非仅在 agent 行动时才变化。它的 1,120 个场景运行在一个模拟的智能手机世界中，由一个验证器对照 oracle 标注检查每一个改变状态的动作来打分，使该 benchmark 可直接用于基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。
zh.summary: 作者指出，多数 agent benchmark 是静态或同步的——环境只在 agent 行动时改变，且评估忽略中间动作——因此真实部署中占主导的挑战，例如异步事件与在时间约束下工作，都未被考察。Gaia2 的应对方式是：把场景放进独立于 agent 推进的事件驱动环境中，并对照一条由改变状态的动作构成的最小 oracle 序列而非最终答案来给 trajectory 打分。在七个能力划分上，GPT-5（high）以 42.1% 的 pass@1 总分领先，但在 Time 划分上得分为 0.0，且没有任何受评系统能在所有能力上全面领先。

works.title: scBench
works.overview: scBench evaluates AI agents on single-cell RNA-seq analysis: 394 verifiable problems spanning six sequencing platforms and seven task categories, each handing the agent a snapshot of experimental data immediately prior to an analysis step and grading recovery of a key biological result deterministically.
works.summary: scBench isolates single analysis steps on real scRNA-seq data: the agent receives the data as it stood just before a step and must perform the analysis that recovers a known biological result, scored by a deterministic grader. Across eight frontier models, accuracy ranges from 29–53% with strong model-task and model-platform interactions — platform choice affects accuracy as much as model choice, with 40+ percentage-point drops on less-documented technologies. The benchmark complements SpatialBench to cover the two dominant single-cell modalities.
works.domains_text: Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis across six sequencing platforms.

zh.overview: scBench 评估 AI agent 的单细胞 RNA-seq 分析能力：394 个可验证问题，横跨六种测序平台与七类任务，每个问题把「某个分析步骤开始前一刻」的实验数据快照交给 agent，并以确定性判分器检验关键生物学结果是否被复原。
zh.summary: scBench 在真实 scRNA-seq 数据上隔离单个分析步骤：agent 拿到某步骤开始前的数据，须完成该步分析并复原已知的生物学结果，由确定性判分器打分。在八个前沿模型上，准确率介于 29–53%，且模型-任务与模型-平台交互效应显著——平台选择对准确率的影响不亚于模型选择，在文档较少的技术上会掉 40 个百分点以上。该 benchmark 与 SpatialBench 互补，覆盖单细胞领域两大主流模态。

works.title: FlyAOC
works.overview: FlyAOC is a benchmark for end-to-end agentic ontology curation: given only a gene symbol, an agent must search and read a corpus of 16,898 full-text Drosophila papers and emit ontology-grounded structured annotations, scored against 7,397 expert curations drawn from FlyBase. (The arXiv abstract of the same version also refers to the benchmark as "FlyBench"; the paper title, the released code, and the repository name all use FlyAOC.)
works.summary: Maintaining a scientific knowledge base requires expert curators to find the relevant papers, reconcile evidence across documents, and express the result as ontology-grounded annotations. FlyAOC argues that existing benchmarks capture only isolated subtasks of this workflow — named entity recognition, relation extraction — and instead scores the whole curator loop. The benchmark is built from FlyBase, the Drosophila melanogaster knowledge base, and pairs a fixed literature corpus with the expert annotations that curators actually produced from it. Four baseline agent architectures are compared, and the paper reports that architecture matters more than backbone scale, with all baselines leaving substantial headroom.
works.domains_text: Biology. The tasks are drawn from Drosophila melanogaster genetics and molecular biology as curated in FlyBase, and require reading primary biological literature and mapping evidence onto the Gene Ontology and anatomy/developmental-stage ontologies. No co-domain is claimed; the retrieval-augmented reasoning capability is presented as transferable, but the evaluated tasks are biological.

zh.overview: FlyAOC 是面向端到端 agentic 本体策展的 benchmark：agent 拿到的只有一个基因符号，须在 16,898 篇果蝇全文论文的语料中检索并阅读，产出以本体为锚的结构化标注，再与取自 FlyBase 的 7,397 条专家策展结果比对打分。（同一版本的 arXiv 摘要中也把该 benchmark 称作「FlyBench」；论文标题、发布的代码与仓库名用的都是 FlyAOC。）
zh.summary: 维护一个科学知识库，靠的是专家策展员去找到相关论文、跨文献调和证据，并把结果表达为以本体为锚的标注。FlyAOC 指出，现有 benchmark 只截取了这套工作流中孤立的子任务——命名实体识别、关系抽取——它要评的则是策展员完整的工作闭环。benchmark 建立在果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）知识库 FlyBase 之上，把一份固定的文献语料与策展员真正由此产出的专家标注配成一对。论文比较了四种基线 agent 架构，报告称架构的影响大于基座模型规模，且所有基线都留有相当大的提升空间。

works.title: AutoBM / BMEval
works.overview:
AutoBM defines the task of generating executable, physically consistent OpenSeesPy building-model code from a
natural-language structural specification, and BMEval is the accompanying verification-driven benchmark of
128 expert-validated modelling tasks scored by sandbox execution, fundamental-period agreement, and
design-code compliance.
works.summary:
The paper formalizes Automatic Building Modeling (AutoBM) as conditional program synthesis: given a
structural description (building function, plan dimensions, storey heights, seismic intensity), a set of
physical and engineering constraints, and a target modelling API, a model must emit OpenSeesPy code whose
execution yields a physically valid structural response. Around this task it releases three artefacts — the
CivilInstruct instruction corpus, the BMEval evaluation benchmark, and RLA-SPC, a two-stage supervised
fine-tuning plus physics-constrained GRPO alignment procedure. Sixteen open-source and commercial LLMs are
scored on BMEval under a unified protocol, and the fine-tuning results are reported as before/after
comparisons on the same benchmark.
works.domains_text:
Civil & Structural Engineering. Every evaluated instance is a building: the model must lay out nodes and
elements for a reinforced-concrete frame, assign sections and materials, apply loads consistent with the
stated seismic intensity, run modal analysis to obtain the first-order natural vibration period, and print a
verification conclusion against design specifications. Domain knowledge from Chinese seismic and concrete
design codes — GB 50011-2010, GB 50010-2010 and JGJ 3-2010 — is embedded in the prompt template, and
JGJ/T 415-2017 informs the data-construction practice. This is earthquake engineering applied to a structure,
not seismic hazard science; no co-domain is claimed, since the code-generation framing serves a structural
objective rather than being a general software-engineering task.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: AutoBM 定义了这样一项任务：依据自然语言的结构描述，生成可执行且物理自洽的 OpenSeesPy 建筑模型代码。配套的 BMEval 则是一个以验证为驱动的 benchmark，含 128 个经专家验证的建模任务，按沙箱执行、自振周期吻合度与设计规范符合性三方面判分。
zh.summary: 论文把自动建筑建模（Automatic Building Modeling, AutoBM）形式化为条件式程序合成：给定结构描述（建筑功能、平面尺寸、层高、抗震设防烈度）、一组物理与工程约束，以及目标建模 API，模型须产出 OpenSeesPy 代码，且该代码执行后能给出物理上有效的结构响应。围绕这项任务，论文发布了三样成果——CivilInstruct 指令语料、BMEval 评测 benchmark，以及 RLA-SPC：一套「两阶段监督微调 + 物理约束 GRPO 对齐」的流程。十六个开源与商业 LLM 在统一协议下于 BMEval 上评分，微调结果则以同一 benchmark 上的前后对比形式报告。

works.title: AIRS-Bench
works.overview: AIRS-Bench (AI Research Science Benchmark) is a suite of 20 frontier research-science tasks for LLM agents, covering the full research lifecycle across language modeling, mathematics, bioinformatics, and time-series forecasting — with no baseline code provided.
works.summary: AIRS-Bench evaluates agentic capabilities across the full research lifecycle rather than isolated coding subtasks. Tasks span four scientific domains and are set up without providing baseline code, so agents must design and execute end-to-end research workflows.
works.domains_text: Language modeling, mathematics, bioinformatics, time-series forecasting.

zh.overview: AIRS-Bench (AI Research Science Benchmark) 是面向 LLM agent 的 frontier 研究科学任务套件，共 20 个任务，覆盖全研究生命周期，跨越语言建模、数学、生物信息学与时间序列预测——且不提供 baseline 代码。
zh.summary: AIRS-Bench 在完整研究生命周期上评估 agent 能力，而不是孤立的编码子任务。任务跨越四个科学领域，设置上不提供 baseline 代码，因此 agent 必须从零构造端到端的研究工作流。

works.title: TRACE
works.overview: TRACE (Trajectory-Aware Comprehensive Evaluation) is an evaluation framework for deep research agents that scores whole reasoning trajectories via a hierarchical utility function, and quantifies latent agent capability by measuring the minimum guidance required for success. It ships with DeepResearch-Bench, an accompanying benchmark with controllable task complexity.
works.summary: TRACE argues that Pass@1-style evaluation creates a "high-score illusion" for deep research agents by ignoring reasoning quality and process efficiency. It introduces a two-component evaluation: a hierarchical trajectory utility function jointly scoring accuracy, efficiency, evidence grounding, and reasoning quality; and a scaffolded-capability assessment that quantifies the minimum guidance needed for successful completion. The paper also releases DeepResearch-Bench, an accompanying benchmark with controllable complexity levels.
works.domains_text: Deep-research agent tasks: web search, evidence collection, retrieval, reasoning, report generation.

zh.overview: TRACE (Trajectory-Aware Comprehensive Evaluation) 是面向 deep research agent 的评估框架：通过 hierarchical utility function 对整条推理 trajectory 打分，并通过测量"成功所需最少引导"来量化 agent 的潜在能力。论文同时发布 DeepResearch-Bench，一个可控复杂度的配套 benchmark。
zh.summary: TRACE 论文指出：Pass@1 类评估在 deep research agent 上会造成 "high-score illusion"——只看最终答案而忽略推理质量与过程效率。TRACE 提出两部分评估：一个 hierarchical trajectory utility function，联合评价 accuracy、efficiency、evidence grounding 与 reasoning quality；以及一个 scaffolded-capability assessment，量化成功所需的最少引导。论文同时发布 DeepResearch-Bench，一个可控复杂度的配套 benchmark。

works.title: LABBench2
works.overview: LABBench2 is an improved benchmark for AI systems performing biology research: nearly 1,900 tasks that reprise the LAB-Bench capability categories in more realistic contexts — answering from PDFs, images, and bioinformatics files — producing model-specific accuracy drops of 26–46% across subtasks relative to LAB-Bench.
works.summary: The abilities LAB-Bench measures have improved substantially since 2024, so LABBench2 rebuilds the suite at higher realism: subtasks (per the official repository) include cloning, dbqa2, figqa2 and tableqa2 in image and PDF variants, litqa3, patentqa, protocolqa2, seqqa2, sourcequality, suppqa2, and trialqa, with tasks grounded in the artifacts researchers actually handle. The added realism produces a meaningful jump in difficulty — model-specific accuracy differences range from −26% to −46% across subtasks — restoring headroom for the next model generation.
works.domains_text: Biology research practice: molecular biology and cloning, genomics sequences, protocols, literature and patents, clinical-trial records.

zh.overview: LABBench2 是面向生物学研究 AI 系统的改进版 benchmark：近 1,900 个任务在更真实的情境中重演 LAB-Bench 的能力类别——从 PDF、图片与生物信息学文件中作答——相对 LAB-Bench 造成各子任务上 26–46% 的模型准确率下滑。
zh.summary: LAB-Bench 所测的能力自 2024 年以来已大幅提升，LABBench2 因此以更高的真实度重建套件：子任务（据官方仓库）包括 cloning、dbqa2、图像与 PDF 变体的 figqa2 / tableqa2、litqa3、patentqa、protocolqa2、seqqa2、sourcequality、suppqa2 与 trialqa，任务植根于研究者实际经手的材料。真实度的提升带来实打实的难度跃升——各子任务上模型准确率差异为 −26% 至 −46%——为下一代模型重新留出提升空间。

works.title: ChemCensor / CREED
works.overview: ChemCensor is an evaluation methodology for single-step retrosynthesis that replaces exact-match Top-K against a single ground truth with a chemical-plausibility metric; the same validator generates CREED, a dataset of millions of validated reaction records for LLM training.
works.summary: Published as "When Single Answer Is Not Enough: Rethinking Single-Step Retrosynthesis Benchmarks for LLMs", the work observes that retrosynthesis admits many valid precursor sets, so Top-K accuracy against one recorded answer mismeasures the task. It contributes a benchmarking framework that evaluates general-purpose and chemistry-specialized LLMs with ChemCensor, a novel metric for chemical plausibility, and CREED, millions of ChemCensor-validated reaction records used to train a model that improves over LLM baselines under the framework.
works.domains_text: Chemistry — synthesis planning and drug discovery: single-step retrosynthesis evaluation.

zh.overview: ChemCensor 是单步逆合成的评估方法学：用化学合理性指标取代「对照单一真值的 Top-K 精确匹配」；同一套验证器还生成了 CREED——数百万条经验证的反应记录，用于 LLM 训练。
zh.summary: 论文题为「When Single Answer Is Not Enough: Rethinking Single-Step Retrosynthesis Benchmarks for LLMs」，其观察是：逆合成允许多组合法的前体，因此对照单一记录答案的 Top-K 准确率量错了对象。论文贡献一套 benchmark 框架，用新的化学合理性指标 ChemCensor 评估通用与化学专用 LLM，并发布 CREED——数百万条经 ChemCensor 验证的反应记录；用 CREED 训练的模型在该 benchmark 下超过 LLM 基线。

works.title: FIRE-Bench
works.overview: FIRE-Bench (Full-cycle Insight Rediscovery Evaluation) is a benchmark that asks agents to rediscover established, verifiable findings from recent, high-impact machine learning research, given only a high-level research question from the published study. It comprises 40 fully executed tasks together with 60 additional papers released for community evaluation.
works.summary: FIRE-Bench argues that because novel findings demand costly real-world validation, existing benchmarks fall back on LLM-as-judge scoring of generated papers or single leaderboard metrics, both coarse proxies for scientific reasoning. It instead asks agents to rediscover established findings: given only a high-level research question from a published study, an agent must independently design experiments, run them, and draw evidence-backed conclusions, scored against the study's documented findings. Across state-of-the-art coding agents with frontier backbones, even the strongest reaches limited rediscovery success (below 50 F1), with high run-to-run variance and recurring failures in experimental design, execution, and evidence-based reasoning.
works.domains_text: Machine learning research: LLM behavior analysis in the executed core; computer vision, vision-language modeling, and neural network analysis in the extension; code generation, RAG, agents and tool use, safety and alignment, and multilingual modeling in the community pool.

zh.overview: FIRE-Bench（Full-cycle Insight Rediscovery Evaluation）是一个 benchmark，要求 agent 在仅获得已发表研究的高层研究问题的情况下，重新发现近期高影响力机器学习研究中确立的、可验证的结论。它包含 40 个完整执行的任务，以及另行发布供社区评估的 60 篇论文。
zh.summary: FIRE-Bench 认为，由于新颖发现需要代价高昂的真实世界验证，现有 benchmark 只能退而依赖对生成论文的 LLM-as-judge 评分或单一排行榜指标，两者都只是科学推理的粗糙代理。它转而要求 agent 重新发现既有结论：仅给定来自已发表研究的高层研究问题，agent 必须独立设计实验、运行实验并得出有证据支撑的结论，再对照该研究记录在案的结论计分。在以前沿模型为 backbone 的最先进 coding agent 中，即便最强者也只能取得有限的重发现成功率（低于 50 F1），且运行间方差高，并在实验设计、执行与循证推理中反复失败。

works.title: Civil-Eval
works.overview: Civil-Eval is a Chinese-language evaluation dataset for civil and transportation engineering knowledge, built from Chinese national professional-registration examinations, together with a weighted scoring method used to benchmark general-purpose LLMs, reasoning models, and a domain-specific civil-engineering model.
works.summary: The authors argue that general-domain LLM evaluation datasets contain no civil-engineering knowledge, so the capability boundary of large models in this vertical is unmeasured. They build Civil-Eval from the questions of Chinese national registration examinations — Class-1 Registered Architect, Class-2 Registered Architect, and Supervising Engineer — after manual screening, organization, and re-checking, covering 8 examination subjects with 426 single-choice and 91 multiple-choice questions. Ten representative Chinese and international general LLMs are evaluated alongside the reasoning models OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek-R1 and the civil-engineering domain model CivilGPT. The reported conclusion is that general base models without civil-engineering corpus training still fall short of human experts, that models handle regulation- and law-oriented text comprehension better than tasks requiring mathematical reasoning, and that multiple-choice items remain the weakest format.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering, covering building structures and building physics/services, building materials and construction, pre-design and site design, construction economics and practice management, construction contract management, and construction-supervision theory and regulations. One subject targets project objective control for transportation infrastructure, so the dataset also spans transportation-infrastructure engineering within the same domain.

zh.overview: Civil-Eval 是一套面向土木与交通工程知识的中文评测数据集，题目取自中国的国家级注册执业资格考试，并配有一套加权计分方法，用来评测通用大模型、推理模型以及一个土木工程领域专用模型。
zh.summary: 作者认为，通用领域的大模型评测数据集不含土木工程知识，大模型在这一垂直行业的能力边界因此无从衡量。他们从一级注册建筑师、二级注册建筑师与监理工程师三类国家注册考试的试题出发，经人工筛选、整理与复核，构建出 Civil-Eval，覆盖 8 个考试科目，含 426 道单选题与 91 道多选题。评测对象为十个有代表性的国内外通用大模型，外加推理模型 OpenAI o1 与 DeepSeek-R1，以及土木工程领域模型 CivilGPT。论文的结论是：未经土木工程语料训练的通用基座模型仍不及人类专家；模型更擅长法律法规类的文本理解，而在需要数学推理的题目上表现较差；多选题则始终是最弱的题型。

works.title: BioAgent Bench
works.overview: BioAgent Bench is an AI-agent evaluation suite for bioinformatics: manually curated end-to-end tasks — RNA-seq, variant calling, metagenomics — that agents must complete as multi-step pipelines producing concrete output artifacts, with robustness probed via controlled perturbations.
works.summary: Each task hands the agent a task-specific prompt and expects a completed bioinformatics pipeline whose output artifacts are then scored by an LLM-based grader for pipeline progress and outcome validity. Frontier closed- and open-weight models are evaluated across multiple agent harnesses, and robustness is tested with controlled perturbations — corrupted inputs, decoy files, and prompt bloat. The headline finding: frontier agents can complete multi-step bioinformatics pipelines without elaborate custom scaffolding, but correct high-level pipeline construction does not guarantee reliable step-level reasoning.
works.domains_text: Bioinformatics workflows: RNA sequencing, variant calling, and metagenomics.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: BioAgent Bench 是生物信息学的 AI agent 评估套件：人工整理的端到端任务——RNA-seq、变异检测、宏基因组——agent 须以多步流水线完成并产出具体的输出产物，鲁棒性用受控扰动检验。
zh.summary: 每个任务给 agent 一段任务提示，期待其交付完整的生物信息学流水线，输出产物由 LLM 判分器按流水线进度与结果有效性打分。前沿闭源与开放权重模型在多个 agent harness 下受评，鲁棒性用受控扰动检验——损坏的输入、诱饵文件与提示膨胀。核心发现：前沿 agent 无需精心定制的脚手架也能完成多步生物信息学流水线，但流水线整体搭对并不保证步骤级推理可靠。

works.title: Terminal-Bench Science
works.overview: Terminal-Bench Science extends the Terminal-Bench framework to natural-science domains, evaluating AI agents on containerized scientific-computing workflows with deterministic programmatic verification.
works.summary: Terminal-Bench Science is a scientist-driven benchmark for evaluating AI agents on real computational workflows drawn from natural-sciences research. Tasks run in containerized environments and are validated with pytest-based deterministic checks. The project is hosted by Stanford University and the Laude Institute, and follows a structured Propose → Build → Review contribution model.
works.domains_text:
Five scientific domains:

- **Life Sciences** — Biology, Ecology, Medicine, Neuroscience.
- **Physical Sciences** — Astronomy, Chemistry, Materials Science, Physics.
- **Earth Sciences** — Atmospheric, Environmental, Geosciences, Ocean Sciences.
- **Mathematical Sciences** — Applied Mathematics, Formal Mathematics, Operations Research, Statistics.
- **Engineering Sciences** — Chemical, Civil, Electrical, Mechanical Engineering.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: Terminal-Bench Science 将 Terminal-Bench 框架扩展到自然科学领域，通过确定性的编程化验证在容器化环境中评估 AI agent 在真实科学计算工作流上的表现。
zh.summary: Terminal-Bench Science 是一个由科学家驱动的 benchmark，用来评估 AI agent 在自然科学研究中真实计算工作流上的表现。任务在容器化环境中执行，通过 pytest 进行确定性验证。项目由 Stanford University 与 Laude Institute 共同维护，采用结构化的 Propose → Build → Review 贡献模型。

works.title: MolecularIQ
works.overview: MolecularIQ is a molecular structure reasoning benchmark restricted exclusively to symbolically verifiable tasks: every answer can be checked against the molecular graph itself, eliminating the literature labels, surrogate labels, and multiple-choice formats that let leakage and bias into most chemistry benchmarks.
works.summary: MolecularIQ's premise is that a molecule's properties are determined by the composition and structure encoded in its molecular graph, so reasoning about molecules requires actually parsing that graph. Its tasks are chosen so correctness is symbolically verifiable — no literature or surrogate labels that risk leakage, no multiple choice. Fine-grained evaluation localizes model failures to specific tasks and molecular structures, yielding capability patterns ("fingerprints") for current chemistry LLMs.
works.domains_text: Chemistry — molecular structure and graph-level reasoning, the substrate beneath property and reaction prediction.

zh.overview: MolecularIQ 是只收录「符号可验证」任务的分子结构推理 benchmark：每个答案都能对照分子图本身检验，从而摆脱大多数化学 benchmark 里引入泄漏与偏差的文献标签、代理标签和选择题形式。
zh.summary: MolecularIQ 的出发点是：分子的性质由其分子图编码的组成与结构决定，因此对分子的推理必须以真正解析分子图为前提。它的任务经过筛选，正确性可以符号化验证——不依赖有泄漏风险的文献或代理标签，也不用选择题。细粒度评估把模型失败定位到具体任务与具体分子结构上，为当前化学 LLM 画出能力「指纹」。

works.title: ToolPRMBench
works.overview: ToolPRMBench is a benchmark that evaluates process reward models (PRMs) for tool-using agents, recasting agent trajectories as step-level cases in which a correct action must be chosen over a plausible incorrect alternative. It draws 987 such cases from four tool-use benchmarks and ranks 17 large language models, general PRMs, and tool-specialized PRMs on step-level judgement accuracy.
works.summary: ToolPRMBench addresses the absence of a systematic evaluation benchmark for PRMs in tool-using settings, where existing PRM benchmarks target general reasoning or web agents rather than structured tool calls. It converts trajectories from ToolTalk, GTA, BFCL, and ToolSandbox into single-decision-step samples, each carrying the interaction history, a correct action, a plausible incorrect alternative, and the available tool metadata, then filters them through a three-judge LLM verification pipeline. On the resulting leaderboard, ToolPRM-GRPO records the highest average accuracy at 78.6%, ahead of Claude-4.5-haiku at 75.1% and GPT-5 at 74.4%, while the four general PRMs fall in the 49.2–52.8% band.
works.domains_text: Tool-using agent interaction across information-seeking, multi-step reasoning, and interactive tool execution, over the API surfaces of ToolTalk, GTA, BFCL, and ToolSandbox.

zh.overview: ToolPRMBench 是一个评估面向工具使用 agent 的 process reward model（PRM）的 benchmark，它把 agent trajectory 改写为 step 级样例，要求在正确动作与貌似合理的错误动作之间做出选择。它从四个 tool-use benchmark 中抽取 987 个这样的样例，并在 step 级判别准确率上对 17 个 LLM、通用 PRM 与工具专用 PRM 进行排名。
zh.summary: ToolPRMBench 针对工具使用场景下缺乏系统性 PRM 评估 benchmark 的问题，已有的 PRM benchmark 面向通用推理或 web agent，而非结构化的工具调用。它把 ToolTalk、GTA、BFCL 与 ToolSandbox 的 trajectory 转换为单决策 step 样例，每个样例包含交互历史、一个正确动作、一个貌似合理的错误动作以及可用工具 metadata，再通过三判官 LLM 验证流程进行过滤。在由此得到的排行榜上，ToolPRM-GRPO 以 78.6% 的平均准确率位居首位，其后是 Claude-4.5-haiku 的 75.1% 与 GPT-5 的 74.4%，而四个通用 PRM 落在 49.2–52.8% 区间。

works.title: Simona
works.overview: Simona is a dataset of 1,000 expert-written chemical process descriptions, introduced as the evaluation set for a multi-agent LLM workflow that converts natural-language process descriptions into executable, converging process-simulation flowsheets. Systems are scored by Simulation Convergence Rate and design time against LLM, multi-agent, and human-expert baselines.
works.summary: The paper targets the step between a process flow diagram and a working simulation: converting a described process into a configured flowsheet that actually converges inside a simulator, which the authors characterize as a labor-intensive, parameter-heavy manual task. The proposed system uses four specialized agents — semantic interpretation, topology development, configuration tuning, and outcome assessment — augmented with an Enhanced Monte Carlo Tree Search to stabilize semantic parsing and configuration generation, and interacts repeatedly with a process simulator over HTTP APIs. Evaluation is conducted on Simona, a self-constructed corpus of process descriptions, with convergence rate and design time as the headline metrics.
works.domains_text: Chemical Engineering. The evaluated objective is process simulation and flowsheet design — selecting and connecting unit operations such as mixers and distillation columns and tuning their operating configuration until the flowsheet converges — which is squarely process systems engineering rather than chemistry. No co-domain is assigned: the tasks concern process topology and simulator configuration, not molecular or reaction-level chemistry.

zh.overview: Simona 是一份由专家撰写的 1,000 条化工过程描述数据集，作为一套多智能体 LLM 工作流的评测集提出——该工作流把自然语言的过程描述转换为可执行、可收敛的过程仿真流程图。系统以仿真收敛率（Simulation Convergence Rate）与设计耗时为指标，与 LLM、多智能体及人类专家基线对比。
zh.summary: 论文针对的是工艺流程图与可用仿真之间的那一步：把描述出来的过程配置成在仿真器中真正能收敛的流程图。作者把这一步刻画为耗时费力、参数繁多的手工工作。所提系统由四个专职 agent 构成——语义解读、拓扑构建、配置整定与结果评估——并引入增强蒙特卡洛树搜索来稳定语义解析与配置生成；运行中通过 HTTP API 与过程仿真器反复交互。评测在自建的过程描述语料 Simona 上进行，以收敛率与设计耗时为核心指标。

works.title: Spec-o3
works.overview: Spec-o3 is a tool-augmented vision-language agent for vetting rare celestial object candidates by automated spectral inspection. Alongside the agent, the paper contributes SpecVI-Bench, a standardized five-task benchmark of rare-object identification from LAMOST spectra with deliberately imbalanced test sets, external baselines, a cross-survey generalization split, and a published rubric for expert scoring of the agent's reasoning traces.
works.summary: Final vetting of rare-object candidates in spectroscopic surveys still depends on expert visual inspection, which does not scale with survey volume. Spec-o3 replicates that workflow as an interleaved multimodal chain of thought: the agent reasons over a spectrum and calls a visualization tool to re-render arbitrary wavelength intervals before committing to a verdict. It is produced by a two-stage post-training recipe — cold-start supervised fine-tuning on expert inspection trajectories, then outcome-based reinforcement learning on rare-type verification. The evaluation artifact, SpecVI-Bench, defines five rare-object tasks with rarity-preserving test sets, compares against specialist deep models and proprietary and open VLMs, adds a held-out survey-shift split from LAMOST to SDSS/DESI, and has six astronomers score reasoning traces against a five-level rubric.
works.domains_text: Astronomy: the evaluated objective is spectroscopic classification of rare celestial objects from survey spectra — cataclysmic variables, carbon stars, S-type stars, M-type giants and white dwarfs — using LAMOST catalogs and archive data, with generalization tested against SDSS and DESI. Secondary co-domain is AI & Machine Learning Research, since the agent contribution is a vision-language post-training recipe.

zh.overview: Spec-o3 是一个带工具的视觉语言 agent，通过自动化的光谱检视来核验稀有天体候选体。除 agent 之外，论文还给出 SpecVI-Bench：一个基于 LAMOST 光谱、包含五项稀有天体识别任务的标准化 benchmark，测试集刻意保持类别不均衡，并配有外部 baseline、跨巡天泛化划分，以及一份公开的专家评分量表，用于给 agent 的推理轨迹打分。
zh.summary: 在光谱巡天中，稀有天体候选体的最终核验至今仍依赖专家目视检查，而这一环节无法随巡天数据量同步扩展。Spec-o3 把这套流程复刻成交错式的多模态思维链：agent 一边围绕光谱推理，一边调用可视化工具重绘任意波段区间，然后才给出结论。它由两阶段的后训练配方产出——先在专家检视轨迹上做冷启动监督微调，再在稀有类型核验上做基于结果的强化学习。作为评估产物的 SpecVI-Bench 定义了五项稀有天体任务，测试集保持真实的稀有比例，对照对象包括专用深度模型以及闭源和开源 VLM，另设一个从 LAMOST 到 SDSS/DESI 的留出巡天迁移划分，并请六位天文学家按五级量表为推理轨迹打分。

works.title: MetaAct-RL: Training Language Models for Reasoning Through Meta-Action-Based Reinforcement Learning
works.overview: MetaAct-RL formulates language-model reasoning as sequential choice and execution of semantic meta-actions such as forward reasoning, critique, and refinement.
works.summary: The framework annotates and trains reasoning traces around high-level thinking actions, then applies reinforcement learning with length rewards, regularization, and key-state restarts to promote diverse action use. Across AQuA, GSM8K, MATH, MathQA, SVAMP, and TheoremQA, it reports average gains of 7.99 points for Llama-3.2-1B and 7.17 for Llama-3.1-8B over vanilla RL; Qwen2.5-1.5B gains 7.5 points on AIME 2024.
works.domains_text: General language-model reasoning and post-training; not tied to a canonical science or engineering domain.

works.title: RealPDEBench
works.overview: RealPDEBench is a benchmark for scientific machine learning that integrates real-world measurements with paired numerical simulations — presented as the first of its kind — comprising five datasets, three tasks, eight metrics, and ten baselines. Its subject is scientific ML models rather than LLM agents (see the repository note under Limitations).
works.summary: RealPDEBench targets a bottleneck in scientific ML for complex physical systems: models are overwhelmingly trained and validated on simulated data because real-world measurements are expensive, which limits evaluation and blocks research on sim-to-real transfer. The benchmark provides five real-world measured datasets with paired simulated datasets across different complex physical systems, defines three tasks that allow comparisons between real-world and simulated data, and scores models with eight metrics spanning data-oriented and physics-oriented measures. Experiments over ten baselines reveal significant discrepancies between simulated and real-world data, while pretraining with simulated data consistently improves both accuracy and convergence.
works.domains_text: Complex physical systems: fluid–structure interaction, cylinder and foil flows, and combustion, with paired real-world measurements and numerical simulations.

zh.overview: RealPDEBench 是把真实世界测量数据与配对数值模拟整合在一起的科学机器学习 benchmark——论文称其为此类中的首个——包含五个数据集、三类任务、八项指标与十个基线。其评估对象是科学 ML 模型而非 LLM agent（见 Limitations 中的 repository note）。
zh.summary: RealPDEBench 直指复杂物理系统科学 ML 的一个瓶颈：真实测量数据昂贵稀缺，模型几乎都在模拟数据上训练与验证，这既限制了评估，也阻碍了 sim-to-real 迁移研究。该 benchmark 提供五个带配对模拟数据的真实测量数据集，覆盖不同的复杂物理系统；定义三类任务，支持真实数据与模拟数据的对比以及弥合两者的方法研究；并用横跨数据导向与物理导向的八项指标评分。在十个基线上的实验揭示了模拟数据与真实数据之间的显著差异，同时表明用模拟数据预训练能稳定提升精度与收敛速度。

works.title: LongDA
works.overview: LongDA is a data analysis benchmark that evaluates LLM-based agents under documentation-intensive analytical workflows: 505 analytical queries grounded in expert-written publications over 17 publicly available U.S. national surveys, whose accompanying documentation averages 263k tokens. It ships with LongTA, a tool-augmented agent framework serving as evaluation scaffold and baseline.
works.summary: In contrast to data-analysis benchmarks that assume well-specified schemas and inputs, LongDA targets settings in which navigating long, heterogeneous documentation is the primary bottleneck. Agents must first retrieve and integrate key information (variable definitions, survey weights, data schemas) from multiple unstructured documents — codebooks, methodological descriptions, survey design reports — before performing multi-step computations and writing executable code. The accompanying LongTA framework provides a ReAct-style coding agent with tools for document reading, keyword search, BM25 retrieval, note-taking, and sandboxed Python execution.
works.domains_text: Real-world data analysis over U.S. federal survey data: public health, labor and employment, education, and the scientific workforce.

zh.overview: LongDA 是一个在 documentation-intensive（文档密集型）分析工作流下评估 LLM agent 的数据分析 benchmark：505 条分析查询，grounding 在覆盖 17 个公开美国全国性调查的专家撰写出版物上，配套文档平均长达 263k token。它同时发布了 LongTA——一个作为评估脚手架与 baseline 的工具增强 agent 框架。
zh.summary: 与假定 schema 与输入均已良好指定的数据分析 benchmark 不同，LongDA 面向的是"导航冗长、异构文档才是首要瓶颈"的真实场景。Agent 必须先从多份非结构化文档——codebook、方法学描述、调查设计报告——中检索并整合关键信息（变量定义、调查权重、数据 schema），然后才能执行多步计算并编写可执行代码。配套的 LongTA 框架提供一个 ReAct 风格的 coding agent，带有文档阅读、关键词搜索、BM25 检索、笔记记录与沙箱化 Python 执行等工具。

works.title: HeurekaBench
works.overview: HeurekaBench is a framework for creating benchmarks of exploratory, open-ended research questions over experimental datasets, rather than a fixed benchmark itself. Each question is grounded in a published scientific study and its code repository, and is produced by a semi-automated pipeline whose candidate answers are verified against the findings that study reported.
works.summary: The authors argue that evaluating co-scientist agents requires realistic end-to-end research scenarios that integrate data analysis, interpretation, and the generation of new insights from experimental data, which existing benchmarks do not supply. HeurekaBench addresses this by contributing the construction pipeline rather than a task list: multiple LLMs extract candidate insights from a study and generate candidate workflows, which are then verified against reported findings before becoming questions. The framework is instantiated in single-cell biology as sc-HeurekaBench and used to compare existing single-cell agents, the strongest of which reaches 2.34 out of 5 on open-ended correctness.
works.domains_text: Single-cell biology, as the instantiation of a construction pipeline the authors present as domain-general.

zh.overview: HeurekaBench 是一个用于「造 benchmark」的框架——它生成面向实验数据集的探索性开放研究问题，而本身不是一个固定的 benchmark。每个问题都 grounding 在一篇已发表的科学研究及其代码仓库上，由一条半自动流水线产出，其候选答案须经与该研究已报告的发现比对验证。
zh.summary: 作者指出，评估 co-scientist 类 agent 需要真实的端到端研究场景，须把数据分析、结果解读与从实验数据中产出新洞见三者贯通，而现有 benchmark 并未提供这样的场景。HeurekaBench 的应对方式是贡献构造流水线而非一份题目清单：由多个 LLM 从研究中抽取候选洞见并生成候选工作流，再与已报告的发现比对验证，通过后才成为题目。该框架在单细胞生物学领域实例化为 sc-HeurekaBench，并用于比较现有的单细胞 agent——其中最强者在开放题正确性上为 5 分制的 2.34 分。

works.title: MATP
works.overview: MATP (Multi-step Automatic Theorem Proving) is an evaluation framework that verifies LLM-generated reasoning by translating each natural-language step into First-Order Logic and adjudicating it with an automated theorem prover. It is applied to a benchmark of 10,830 reasoning instances produced by 10 LLMs on tasks drawn from PrOntoQA-OOD, ProofWriter, and FOLIO.
works.summary: MATP addresses the limitation that fluent language can mask subtle logical errors in multi-step LLM reasoning, which fact-checking, self-consistency, and rule-based validation detect only partially. The framework translates premises, the candidate conclusion, and every generated reasoning step into one unified First-Order Logic representation, converts the formulas to TPTP, and applies an automated theorem prover both to label each step and to search for a valid proof path supporting the conclusion. Across 10,830 reasoning instances generated by 10 LLMs, the authors report that MATP surpasses prompting-based baselines by more than 42 percentage points in reasoning step verification, and that reasoning models produce more logically coherent chains than general models despite similar answer accuracy.
works.domains_text: Deductive logical reasoning over natural-language premise sets, spanning synthetic rule-based ontologies (PrOntoQA-OOD, ProofWriter) and human-authored real-world statements about people, locations, quantities, and events (FOLIO).

zh.overview: MATP（Multi-step Automatic Theorem Proving）是一个评估框架，通过将自然语言推理的每一步翻译为一阶逻辑（First-Order Logic），再交由自动定理证明器裁决，来验证 LLM 生成的推理。它被应用于一个包含 10,830 条推理实例的 benchmark，这些实例由 10 个 LLM 在取自 PrOntoQA-OOD、ProofWriter 和 FOLIO 的任务上产生。
zh.summary: MATP 针对这样一个局限：流畅的语言会掩盖多步 LLM 推理中细微的逻辑错误，而事实核查、self-consistency 和基于规则的验证只能部分地检测出它们。该框架将前提、候选结论以及生成的每一个推理步骤翻译为一个统一的一阶逻辑表示，把公式转换为 TPTP，并应用自动定理证明器既标注每一步，又搜索支撑结论的有效证明路径。在由 10 个 LLM 生成的 10,830 条推理实例上，作者报告 MATP 在推理步骤验证上超过基于 prompting 的 baseline 42 个百分点以上，并且尽管答案准确率相近，reasoning 模型产生的推理链比通用模型更具逻辑一致性。

works.title: CASCADE
works.overview: CASCADE is a self-evolving agentic framework in which an agent acquires and accumulates executable skills for scientific work through two meta-skills — continuous learning and self-reflection — and ships SciSkillBench, a 116-task materials-science and chemistry benchmark used to measure what the accumulated skills are worth.
works.summary: The paper frames current scientific agents as limited by dependence on predefined tools or early-stage tool generation, and proposes a transition from "LLM + tool use" to "LLM + skill acquisition". CASCADE gives an agent two meta-skills: continuous learning, via web search, code extraction from documentation, and memory utilization; and self-reflection, via introspection and knowledge-graph exploration. Skills learned this way are persisted and reused across sessions and can be shared between agents and human scientists. To measure the effect, the authors introduce SciSkillBench, a curated benchmark of 116 materials-science and chemistry research tasks, and compare the full system against configurations with the evolution mechanisms removed. Beyond the benchmark, the paper demonstrates computational analysis, autonomous laboratory experiments, and selective reproduction of published papers as applications.
works.domains_text: Materials Science and Chemistry. The tasks require operating specialized materials and chemistry toolkits, retrieving and processing materials data, and running simulations; the paper's arXiv categories are cs.AI and cond-mat.mtrl-sci. The autonomous-laboratory demonstration additionally touches experimental chemistry, but it is a demonstration rather than part of the scored benchmark.

zh.overview: CASCADE 是一个自我演化的 agentic 框架：agent 借助持续学习与自我反思两项 meta-skill，为科学工作获取并积累可执行的 skill；随框架发布的 SciSkillBench 含 116 个材料科学与化学任务，用来衡量积累下来的 skill 究竟值多少。
zh.summary: 论文认为当前的科学 agent 受限于对预定义工具的依赖，或停留在工具生成的早期阶段，并主张从「LLM + 工具使用」转向「LLM + skill 获取」。CASCADE 给 agent 配了两项 meta-skill：持续学习，途径是网页搜索、从文档中抽取代码以及利用记忆；自我反思，途径是内省与知识图谱探索。这样学到的 skill 会被持久化，跨会话复用，还能在 agent 之间以及 agent 与人类科学家之间共享。为衡量效果，作者提出 SciSkillBench——一套精心整理的 116 个材料科学与化学研究任务，并把完整系统与去掉演化机制的若干配置作对比。benchmark 之外，论文还展示了计算分析、自主实验室实验以及对已发表论文的选择性复现等应用。

works.title: HiSciBench
works.overview: HiSciBench is a hierarchical multi-disciplinary benchmark of 8,735 instances that arranges scientific capability into five ascending levels — factual literacy, literature parsing, literature question answering, literature review generation, and data-driven scientific discovery — across mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, geography and astronomy, with multimodal and cross-lingual inputs.
works.summary: The benchmark is built on the premise that "scientific intelligence" is not a single capability but a ladder that runs from reading to discovery, and that a model can look competent at the bottom while failing at the top. Seven tasks are grouped into five levels: L1 general scientific question answering, L2 literature OCR and literature translation, L3 monolingual and cross-lingual literature question answering, L4 topic-guided literature review generation, and L5 data-driven scientific discovery in which the model must write and execute Python analysis code. Each level carries its own scoring protocol, from plain accuracy at the bottom through LLM-as-judge rubrics and citation-verification metrics at L4 to execution-based success rate at L5. Eighteen models are evaluated, including closed and open-weight text models, vision-language models and research-oriented specialised systems, and the reported pattern is a steep decline in performance as the level rises.
works.domains_text: Astronomy is one of the six named disciplines, contributing 597 instances in total: 200 general scientific QA items, 19 literature OCR documents, 19 literature translation documents, 330 monolingual literature QA pairs, 19 cross-lingual literature QA pairs and 10 literature-review topics. The astronomy tasks are literature-facing — parsing, translating, answering questions about and synthesising reviews from astronomy papers sourced from arXiv — rather than observational data analysis; astronomy contributes no L5.1 discovery instances, which are drawn only from chemistry, geography and biology. Co-domains follow the remaining disciplines: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Earth Science (the paper's "geography" discipline).

zh.overview: HiSciBench 是一个层级式的多学科 benchmark，含 8,735 个实例，把科学能力排成五级递进的阶梯——事实素养、文献解析、文献问答、文献综述生成、数据驱动的科学发现——覆盖数学、物理、化学、生物、地理与天文六个学科，输入兼具多模态与跨语言。
zh.summary: 这套 benchmark 的立论是：「科学智能」不是单一能力，而是一道从阅读通向发现的阶梯；模型完全可能在低层显得称职，到了高层却撑不住。七个任务归入五个层级：L1 通用科学问答，L2 文献 OCR 与文献翻译，L3 单语与跨语文献问答，L4 主题引导的文献综述生成，L5 数据驱动的科学发现——最后一层要求模型写出并执行 Python 分析代码。每一层各有自己的评分协议：底层只看准确率，L4 用 LLM-as-judge 的评分细则加引文核验指标，L5 用基于执行的成功率。受评模型共 18 个，涵盖闭源与开源权重的文本模型、视觉语言模型以及面向科研的专用系统；论文报告的规律是：层级越高，性能下滑越陡。

works.title: VLA-Arena
works.overview: VLA-Arena is an open-source benchmark and toolchain for evaluating Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models as generalist robot-manipulation policies, using a structured task-design framework that varies difficulty along three orthogonal axes.
works.summary: VLA-Arena introduces a structured task-design framework that quantifies task difficulty across three orthogonal axes — Task Structure, Language Command, and Visual Observation — so that manipulation tasks can be constructed with fine-grained, controllable difficulty. The benchmark reports that its extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art VLAs surfaces recurring limitations: memorization over generalization, superficial visual perception, and neglect of safety constraints. The authors also report that model rankings reverse across difficulty levels L0–L2, which they take as evidence that each level yields non-redundant diagnostic information. The complete framework, datasets, and an end-to-end toolchain are released for reproducibility.
works.domains_text: Robotics — simulated robot manipulation and control, evaluating VLA models as robot policies. `Repository note:` the primary sources describe simulation-based evaluation and do not report real-robot experiments.

zh.overview: VLA-Arena 是一个开源 benchmark 与工具链，用于评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型作为通用机器人操作策略的表现，采用一套结构化的任务设计框架，沿三个正交轴调节难度。
zh.summary: VLA-Arena 提出一套结构化的任务设计框架，沿三个正交轴——Task Structure、Language Command、Visual Observation——量化任务难度，使操作任务能以细粒度、可控的难度构建。该 benchmark 报告，其对最新 VLA 的大规模评估揭示了反复出现的局限：以记忆代替泛化、浮于表面的视觉感知、以及对安全约束的忽视。作者还报告，模型排名在难度等级 L0–L2 之间发生反转，并据此认为每个等级都给出非冗余的诊断信息。完整框架、数据集与端到端工具链一并公开以支撑可复现性。

works.title: SpatialBench
works.overview: SpatialBench asks whether agents can analyze real-world spatial biology data: 146 verifiable problems across five spatial technologies and seven task categories, graded deterministically on recovery of a key biological result from a pre-step data snapshot.
works.summary: SpatialBench applies the snapshot-and-deterministic-grader design to spatial transcriptomics: agents receive experimental data immediately prior to an analysis step and must recover a known biological result. Base-model accuracy remains low — 20–38% across model families — with strong model-task and model-platform interactions, and the paper argues that harness design (tools, prompts, control flow, execution environment) has a large empirical effect and should be evaluated and improved as a first-class object.
works.domains_text: Spatial transcriptomics and spatial biology across five technologies; sibling of scBench on the single-cell side.

zh.overview: SpatialBench 追问 agent 能否分析真实世界的空间生物学数据：146 个可验证问题，横跨五种空间技术与七类任务，从步骤前数据快照出发、以确定性判分检验关键生物学结果的复原。
zh.summary: SpatialBench 把「快照 + 确定性判分」设计应用到空间转录组：agent 拿到分析步骤开始前一刻的实验数据，须复原已知的生物学结果。基础模型准确率偏低——各模型家族在 20–38% 之间——模型-任务与模型-平台交互效应显著；论文进一步主张 harness 设计（工具、提示、控制流、执行环境）有很大的实证影响，应作为一等对象加以评估与改进。

works.title: AInsteinBench
works.overview: AInsteinBench benchmarks coding agents on scientific repositories: tasks derived from maintainer-authored pull requests in six widely used, production-grade scientific codebases — spanning quantum chemistry, quantum computing, molecular dynamics, numerical relativity, fluid dynamics, and cheminformatics — resolved in executable environments with test-driven verification.
works.summary: SWE-bench-style evaluation meets scientific software: AInsteinBench curates tasks from what maintainers of real scientific codebases actually merged, via multi-stage filtering and expert review, and evaluates agents in executable environments with test-driven verification and attention to scientifically meaningful failure modes. Where general-purpose coding benchmarks test web-app plumbing, these tasks require respecting numerical conventions, physical units, and algorithmic contracts of scientific computing.
works.domains_text: Scientific software engineering across quantum chemistry, quantum computing, molecular dynamics, numerical relativity, fluid dynamics, and cheminformatics codebases.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: AInsteinBench 在科学代码仓库上评测 coding agent：任务派生自六个广泛使用的生产级科学代码库的维护者 pull request——覆盖量子化学、量子计算、分子动力学、数值相对论、流体力学与化学信息学——在可执行环境中以测试驱动的方式验证。
zh.summary: SWE-bench 式评估遇上科学软件：AInsteinBench 从真实科学代码库维护者实际合并的改动出发，经多阶段筛选与专家评审整理任务，在可执行环境中做测试驱动验证，并关注有科学意义的失败模式。通用编码 benchmark 测的是 Web 应用里的胶水代码和杂活，这里的任务则要求遵守科学计算的数值约定、物理单位与算法契约。

works.title: FEM-Bench
works.overview: FEM-Bench is a structured scientific-reasoning benchmark for code-generating LLMs in computational mechanics: FEM-Bench 2025 comprises introductory but nontrivial tasks aligned with a first graduate course — 33 tasks in the function-writing track — with objective verification and paired unit-test-writing evaluation.
works.summary: FEM-Bench treats the finite element method as a probe of whether models can connect physical reasoning — forces, deformation, constraints — to correct numerical code. Models are evaluated on two tracks over five attempts each: writing FEM and related functions, and writing unit tests, both objectively verified. The best function-writing model, Gemini 3 Pro, completes 30/33 tasks at least once and 26/33 all five times; the best test-writing model, GPT-5, reaches a 73.8% Average Joint Success Rate — capable but short of the reliability engineering practice requires.
works.domains_text: Computational mechanics and the finite element method: forces, deformation, and constraints rendered as code.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: FEM-Bench 是面向代码生成 LLM 的计算力学结构化科学推理 benchmark：FEM-Bench 2025 收录与研究生第一门计算力学课程对齐、入门但不平凡的任务——函数编写赛道 33 个任务——配客观验证与成对的单元测试编写评估。
zh.summary: FEM-Bench 把有限元方法当作探针，考察模型能否把物理推理——力、变形、约束——落成正确的数值代码。模型在两条赛道上各尝试五次：编写 FEM 及相关函数，以及编写单元测试，两者都客观验证。函数编写最强的 Gemini 3 Pro 有 30/33 个任务至少成功一次、26/33 个任务五次全部成功；测试编写最强的 GPT-5 的 Average Joint Success Rate 为 73.8%——有能力，但离工程实践要求的可靠性还有距离。

works.title: MiraMind
works.overview: MiraMind is a benchmark for evaluating large language models on mental-health reasoning, scoring not only task outcomes but also the reliability of the explicit reasoning trajectories that connect limited, subjective evidence to clinical judgments.
works.summary: MiraMind frames mental-health reasoning as an evidence-constrained judgment problem: models must transform limited and ambiguous evidence into interpretations, decisions, or claims whose specificity, certainty, severity, and actionability remain warranted by that evidence. The benchmark unifies six task families across 13 datasets spanning appraisal, diagnosis, intervention, multi-step psychiatry question answering, abstraction, and verification. Beyond final-answer accuracy, it evaluates the reasoning trajectory connecting evidence to judgment along usability, logical structure, and informational contribution. Evaluating 20 LLMs surfaces a "restraint gap," in which the specificity or certainty of model judgments exceeds what the available evidence supports; the authors additionally train an 8B model, Mindora, targeting evidence-to-judgment transitions.
works.domains_text: Mental health / psychiatry and clinical psychology — folding into Medicine & Health and Neuroscience & Cognitive Science. Evidence sources span informal user narratives (e.g., Reddit/Twitter posts), counseling dialogues, psychiatric board-style question answering, and Cochrane systematic-review abstracts.

zh.overview: MiraMind 是一个评估大语言模型心理健康推理的 benchmark，它不仅为任务结果评分，还评估把有限、主观的证据连向临床判断的显式推理轨迹的可靠性。
zh.summary: MiraMind 把心理健康推理刻画为一个证据受限的判断问题：模型必须把有限、含糊的证据转化为解释、决定或论断，而这些结论在具体性、确定性、严重性与可操作性上都须由该证据支撑。该 benchmark 统一了跨 13 个数据集的六个任务族，覆盖评估性判断、诊断、干预、多步骤精神科问答、抽象概括与核实。除最终答案准确率外，它还沿可用性、逻辑结构与信息贡献三方面评估连接证据到判断的推理轨迹。对 20 个 LLM 的评估暴露出一种「克制落差」：模型判断的具体性或确定性超出了可用证据所能支撑的程度；作者还额外训练了一个专门针对证据到判断这一转化环节的 8B 模型 Mindora。

works.title: Hydro-SE Bench
works.overview: Hydro-SE Bench is a Chinese-language multiple-choice benchmark of 4,000 questions covering nine subfields of hydro-science and hydraulic engineering, built to measure how much practical water-engineering knowledge — including hydraulic structures, geotechnical engineering, and industry design standards — general-purpose LLMs actually hold.
works.summary: The authors argue that hydro-science and engineering (Hydro-SE) is a knowledge-intensive field whose LLM capabilities have not been measured systematically, and build what they describe as the first benchmark that evaluates LLM knowledge across Hydro-SE subfield dimensions. Questions are drawn from textbooks, industry standards, laws and regulations, and statistical yearbooks, then generated semi-automatically with LLMs guided by expert-designed exemplars and independently reviewed by at least three experts each. Sixteen models — ten commercial and six open-source — are evaluated zero-shot with chain-of-thought reasoning at temperature 0, and the results are broken down by subfield and by cognitive level so that knowledge gaps can be localized rather than reported as a single score.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering, as hydraulic-infrastructure engineering. Four of the nine subfields sit inside the civil engineering of built water infrastructure: Hydraulic Structures and Equipment (dams, spillways, gates, and the machinery serving them), Geotechnical Engineering, Industry Standards (the design codes and specifications governing water-conservancy and hydropower works), and Engineering Safety and Management. The paper's headline finding is specifically that models are weakest on "domain-specific knowledge such as industry standards and hydraulic structures," which is the civil-engineering core of the benchmark. Co-domains: Earth Science (Hydrology and Water Resources, Hydraulics and River Dynamics, Meteorology), Environmental Science (water-resource management), and Energy Systems (Power Systems, reflecting the hydropower side of the field).

zh.overview: Hydro-SE Bench 是一个中文选择题 benchmark，含 4,000 道题，覆盖水科学与水利工程的九个子领域，用以衡量通用 LLM 究竟掌握了多少实用的水利工程知识——包括水工建筑物、岩土工程与行业设计标准。
zh.summary: 作者认为水科学与水利工程（Hydro-SE）是一个知识密集的领域，而 LLM 在其中的能力至今没有得到系统的测量；他们由此构建了自称首个跨 Hydro-SE 子领域维度评估 LLM 知识的 benchmark。题目取自教材、行业标准、法律法规与统计年鉴，再由 LLM 在专家设计的范例引导下半自动生成，并各自经至少三位专家独立评审。十六个模型——十个商业、六个开源——在 temperature 0 下以思维链零样本评测，结果按子领域与认知层级拆分呈现，使知识短板可以定位，而不是汇成一个总分。

works.title: BATS / Budget Tracker
works.overview: A study of what happens when tool-augmented agents are scaled under explicit tool-call budgets, motivated by the finding that simply raising the budget does not help because agents have no awareness of it. It contributes a unified cost metric that prices token and tool consumption on one scale, a lightweight Budget Tracker plug-in that makes the remaining budget visible to the agent, and BATS, a framework that adapts planning and verification to the budget that remains.
works.summary: Test-time scaling for tool-augmented agents differs from scaling reasoning tokens: a tool call is an action against an environment, not just more thinking. The paper's starting observation is negative — raising the tool-call budget alone does not raise performance, because the agent never learns how much it has left and plateaus. Two interventions follow. The Budget Tracker is a plug-in that injects the used and remaining budget per tool into the agent's context at each iteration, together with a policy guideline describing what to do in different budget regimes; it is deliberately minimal, and most of the paper's gain comes from it. BATS builds on that awareness with a planning module that maintains a tree-structured checklist whose breadth and depth adjust to the remaining budget, and a verification module that checks a proposed answer constraint by constraint and decides CONTINUE, PIVOT or SUCCESS conditioned on budget status, compressing the trajectory into a summary when it pivots. To compare any of this fairly, the authors formalise a single cost currency covering both tokens and tool calls, and use it to plot cost-performance scaling curves rather than accuracy at a fixed budget.
works.domains_text: No canonical domain is assigned. The evaluated settings are web browsing, retail dialogue and software issue resolution; HLE-Search draws on Humanity's Last Exam, but the paper reports no science-field breakdown of its 200-question subset, so no slice is identifiable and sized. The contribution is a cost-measurement and budget-awareness methodology rather than a science or engineering task suite.

zh.overview: 一项研究：当工具增强型 agent 在明确的工具调用预算下做 scaling 时会发生什么。出发点是一个反常现象——单纯把预算调高并不管用，因为 agent 根本不知道自己还剩多少。工作贡献了一套把 token 与工具消耗折算到同一尺度的统一计价指标、一个把剩余预算显式告诉 agent 的轻量插件 Budget Tracker，以及一个据此调整规划与验证策略的框架 BATS。
zh.summary: 工具增强型 agent 的测试期 scaling 与单纯扩推理 token 不同：一次工具调用是对环境施加的动作，而不只是多想一会儿。论文的起点是一个反面观察——只把工具调用预算调高，性能并不会跟着涨，因为 agent 始终不知道自己还剩多少，很快就见顶。由此引出两项干预。Budget Tracker 是一个插件，在每一轮迭代开始时把各工具已用与剩余的预算注入 agent 的上下文，并附上一份说明不同预算档位下该怎么做的策略指引；它刻意做得极简，而论文的大部分增益恰恰来自它。BATS 在这份「预算意识」之上再加两件事：规划模块维护一棵树状清单，其广度与深度随剩余预算调整；验证模块在 agent 提出候选答案后逐条约束地反向核查，并根据预算状态决定 CONTINUE、PIVOT 还是 SUCCESS，转向时把已有轨迹压缩成摘要。为了让这些比较站得住脚，作者把 token 与工具调用统一到同一种计价上，据此画出成本—性能的 scaling 曲线，而不是在固定预算下比准确率。

works.title: Enhancing Agentic Autonomous Scientific Discovery with Vision-Language Model Capabilities
works.overview: A 10-task benchmark for data-driven scientific discovery — mostly cosmological power-spectrum and molecular spectral-line problems — paired with a vision-language "plot judge" that grades an agent's generated figures against dynamically generated, domain-specific rubrics and feeds the verdict back as a self-correction signal.
works.summary: The work targets a specific blind spot in agentic scientific discovery: a coding agent that only sees text and stack traces cannot tell that a fitted curve misses a spectral feature or that a power spectrum has the wrong peak structure, because the failure is visible only in the plot. The authors add a vision-language model to the cmbagent multi-agent system as a verification checkpoint — a GPT-4o model first decomposes the natural-language task prompt into a rubric of checkable visual criteria, then a vision-capable judge inspects the produced figure against that rubric alone, without seeing the code, and returns a "continue" or "retry" verdict that drives the agent to revise. To measure whether this helps, the authors construct a 10-task benchmark of data-driven discovery problems whose datasets they generated themselves, and report pass@1 for code-only baselines, text-feedback variants, and VLM-feedback variants across three coding agents.
works.domains_text: Astronomy is the dominant domain: six of the ten tasks are astronomical — three cosmological power-spectrum problems (CMB spectral index, EE polarisation spectrum, Hubble constant) and three molecular spectral-line modelling problems from astrochemistry, where the object being modelled is an astronomical spectrum with self-absorption and hyperfine structure. Physics is a co-domain through the two harmonic-oscillator dynamics tasks. The two SEIR epidemiological tasks sit outside both and are present as a deliberate out-of-field control rather than as a claimed domain contribution.

zh.overview: 一个面向数据驱动科学发现的 10 任务 benchmark——题目以宇宙学功率谱和分子谱线问题为主——外加一个视觉语言「plot judge」：它按动态生成的领域专属评分细则给 agent 画出的图打分，再把判定结果作为自我纠正信号回灌给 agent。
zh.summary: 这项工作针对 agentic 科学发现中的一个特定盲区：只看得到文本和堆栈回溯的编码 agent，无从察觉拟合曲线漏掉了某条谱特征，也看不出功率谱的峰结构不对——这类失败只在图上才显形。作者在 cmbagent 多智能体系统中加入一个视觉语言模型作为验证检查点：先由一个 GPT-4o 模型把自然语言任务提示拆解成一份可逐条核查的视觉判据清单，再由具备视觉能力的 judge 仅对照该清单检查产出的图、全程看不到代码，最后给出「continue」或「retry」判定，驱动 agent 修改。为衡量这样做是否有帮助，作者构建了一个含 10 个数据驱动发现问题的 benchmark，数据集由他们自行生成，并在三个编码 agent 上报告纯代码基线、文本反馈变体与 VLM 反馈变体的 pass@1。

works.title: BridgeEQA
works.overview:
BridgeEQA is an embodied question-answering benchmark for bridge inspection: 2,200 open-vocabulary
question-answer pairs grounded in professional inspection reports over 200 real bridge scenes, where an agent
must gather visual evidence across many viewpoints of a structure, answer to a standardised condition rubric,
and cite the images that support its verdict.
works.summary:
The authors propose *Inspection EQA* as a problem class for episodic-memory embodied question answering,
arguing that infrastructure inspection supplies what generic EQA benchmarks lack: egocentric imagery,
professional reports as grounding, and a standardised evaluation scale. BridgeEQA instantiates it on real
bridge inspection data, and the paper adds Image Citation Relevance, a metric for whether a model cites the
images that actually support its answer. Evaluation of state-of-the-art vision-language models exposes
substantial performance gaps, and the paper proposes Embodied Memory Visual Reasoning (EMVR), which casts
inspection EQA as a Markov decision process over a scene graph and outperforms the baselines.
works.domains_text:
Civil & Structural Engineering: bridge inspection and condition assessment of in-service highway bridges,
with answers aligned to the National Bridge Inventory 0–9 condition rating scale used by state
transportation agencies. The imagery and the reasoning are drawn from professional structural inspection
practice rather than from generic indoor or outdoor scene understanding.

zh.overview: BridgeEQA 是面向桥梁检测的具身问答 benchmark：2,200 组开放词汇问答对，以专业检测报告为依据，覆盖 200 个真实桥梁场景。agent 必须在一座结构的众多视角之间收集视觉证据，按标准化的状态评定量表作答，并引用支持其判断的图像。
zh.summary: 作者提出 *Inspection EQA*（检测式具身问答）作为情节记忆型具身问答的一类问题，认为基础设施检测恰好提供了通用 EQA benchmark 所缺的东西：第一人称视角影像、可作依据的专业报告，以及标准化的评价量表。BridgeEQA 用真实的桥梁检测数据把它实例化，论文还提出 Image Citation Relevance，用于衡量模型引用的图像是否真的支持它给出的答案。对当前最先进视觉语言模型的评测暴露出明显的性能差距；论文进而提出 Embodied Memory Visual Reasoning (EMVR)，把检测式 EQA 表述为场景图上的马尔可夫决策过程，表现优于各基线。

works.title: EnvTrace
works.overview: EnvTrace is a simulation-based evaluation methodology for LLM-generated instrument-control code: instead of static unit tests, it executes candidate code against a digital twin of a synchrotron beamline and scores semantic equivalence by aligning execution traces.
works.summary: EnvTrace starts from the observation that the behavior of physical systems cannot be fully captured by unit tests alone: correctness of control code is a property of what it does to the instrument over time. Candidate code runs against a beamline control-logic digital twin, and trace alignment produces a multi-faceted score for functional correctness across key behavioral dimensions. Over 30 LLMs were evaluated this way, with many top-tier models approaching human-level performance in rapid control-code generation; the digital twin also enables pre-execution validation of live experiments.
works.domains_text: Synchrotron beamline instrumentation — experimental-physics infrastructure control.

zh.overview: EnvTrace 提出一套基于模拟来评估 LLM 生成的仪器控制代码的方法学：不用静态单元测试，而是让候选代码在同步辐射光束线的数字孪生上执行，通过对齐执行轨迹来评判语义等价性。
zh.summary: EnvTrace 的出发点是：物理系统的行为无法只靠单元测试刻画——控制代码的正确性在于它随时间对仪器做了什么。候选代码在光束线控制逻辑的数字孪生上运行，轨迹对齐产出一个覆盖关键行为维度的多维度功能正确性分数。30 余个 LLM 以这种方式受评，许多顶级模型在快速控制代码生成上接近人类水平；数字孪生还能在真实实验执行前做预先验证。

works.title: CostBench
works.overview: CostBench evaluates whether LLM tool-use agents can plan for **cost-optimality** and adapt when the environment blocks the cheapest path. Cost is not reported as a post-hoc statistic; it is the objective the agent is being asked to optimize.
works.summary: CostBench frames tool-use planning as a multi-turn cost-minimization problem. In a travel-planning domain, the same goal is reachable via multiple sequences of atomic and composite tools with configurable costs. The environment then injects blocking events — tool failures and cost changes — that force the agent to replan mid-trajectory under the same cost objective.
works.domains_text: Travel planning, as an instantiation of dynamic tool-use.

zh.overview: CostBench 评估 LLM tool-use agent 是否能够以**成本最优（cost-optimal）**为目标进行规划，并在环境阻断最便宜路径时做出适应。成本在这里不是事后统计，而是 agent 被要求优化的对象。
zh.summary: CostBench 把 tool-use 规划构造为一个多轮的成本最小化问题。在一个旅行规划（travel-planning）场景下，同一个目标可通过多种原子工具与组合工具的序列达成，每种工具都带有可配置的成本。环境会注入阻断事件——工具失效、成本变化——迫使 agent 在同一成本目标下做 trajectory 中途的重规划。

works.title: Can Large Language Models Automate the HAZOP Process Without Human Intervention?
works.overview: A comparative evaluation of four multimodal large language models on the Hazard and Operability (HAZOP) study, in which each model generates a complete HAZOP worksheet from the same piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID) under a standardized prompt and is scored against an expert-prepared reference worksheet. The paper's stated contribution is a structured framework for evaluating LLMs on HAZOP rather than a HAZOP automation system.
works.summary: HAZOP is the standard structured hazard-identification method in the process industries, and the paper asks whether current multimodal LLMs can execute the whole procedure end to end with no human in the loop, and whether the resulting worksheets are usable for risk-based decision-making. Four models — GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, LLaMA, and Gemini — are each given the same P&ID and the same standardized prompt and asked to produce a full HAZOP worksheet. The generated worksheets are compared against an expert-prepared reference worksheet along two separate axes: model performance (output similarity and cost) and HAZOP performance (validity of the generated scenarios and diversity of the proposed safeguards). The paper concludes that LLMs are useful as assistive tools but that unsupervised LLM HAZOP output is not reliable.
works.domains_text: Chemical Engineering — process safety in the process industries. The evaluated object is a HAZOP study over a piping and instrumentation diagram, covering process deviations, causes, consequences, and safeguards; the task is process-engineering hazard analysis, not chemistry knowledge or molecular reasoning. No co-domain is assigned.

zh.overview: 一项对四个多模态大语言模型在危险与可操作性分析（HAZOP）上的对比评估：每个模型都在统一的提示词下，从同一张管道仪表流程图（P&ID）生成一份完整的 HAZOP 工作表，再对照专家编制的参考工作表打分。论文自陈的贡献是一套评估 LLM 做 HAZOP 的结构化框架，而不是一个 HAZOP 自动化系统。
zh.summary: HAZOP 是流程工业中标准的结构化危险辨识方法，论文要问的是：当前的多模态 LLM 能否在无人介入的情况下端到端跑完整个流程，以及所得到的工作表是否足以支撑基于风险的决策。四个模型——GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、LLaMA 与 Gemini——各自拿到同一张 P&ID 和同一条标准化提示词，要求产出一份完整的 HAZOP 工作表。生成的工作表再从两个彼此独立的维度与专家参考工作表对照：模型层面的表现（输出相似度与成本），以及 HAZOP 层面的表现（所生成情景的有效性与所提防护措施的多样性）。论文的结论是：LLM 作为辅助工具有用，但无人监督的 LLM HAZOP 输出并不可靠。

works.title: TempoBench
works.overview: A formally verifiable temporal benchmark that isolates *counterfactual causal attribution* over execution trajectories, testing whether LLMs can identify which inputs were necessary for an observed output rather than merely simulating a system forward.
works.summary: TempoBench is built from synthesized deterministic Mealy machines, which give an infinitely scalable corpus of trajectory-based causal-reasoning problems with controllable complexity and provably correct causal labels. It separates two abilities: forward *simulation* of an execution trace, and identification of the *minimal necessary cause* of an observed output. The authors report that frontier models simulate systems forward accurately but fall sharply when asked which inputs were necessary for an observed output — a disparity they name the SIM/MIN gap — often confusing "possible inputs" with "necessary causes." The paper also reports that fine-tuning open-source models on TempoBench data yields targeted gains on external causal benchmarks while preserving general-purpose, math, and code performance.
works.domains_text: N/A — the benchmark is built from abstract deterministic Mealy machines used as synthetic causal-reasoning problems; it does not evaluate a scientific or engineering field. The authors motivate it by downstream causal-inference tasks such as debugging, root-cause analysis, and task planning.

zh.overview: 一个可形式化验证的时序 benchmark，隔离出对执行轨迹的*反事实因果归因*，检验 LLM 能否识别哪些输入是某个观测输出的必要条件，而不只是把系统向前模拟一遍。
zh.summary: TempoBench 由合成的确定性 Mealy 机构建，给出一个无限可扩展的、基于轨迹的因果推理问题语料，其复杂度可控、因果标签可证明正确。它分离两种能力：对执行迹的前向*模拟*，以及识别某个观测输出的*最小必要原因*。作者报告：前沿模型能准确地把系统向前模拟，但被问及哪些输入是某个观测输出的必要条件时表现骤降——他们把这一差距命名为 SIM/MIN gap——常把「可能的输入」混同为「必要的原因」。论文还报告，在 TempoBench 数据上微调开源模型可在外部因果 benchmark 上带来有针对性的增益，同时保持通用、数学与代码性能。

works.title: Lean4Physics / LeanPhysBench
works.overview: Lean4Physics (Lean4PHYS) is a reasoning framework for college-level physics in Lean4, contributing LeanPhysBench — 200 hand-crafted, peer-reviewed formal physics statements derived from university textbooks and competition problems — together with PhysLib, a community-driven repository of unit systems and theorems for formal physics reasoning. The paper presents it as the first physics benchmark in Lean4.
works.summary: LeanPhysBench moves physics evaluation into a formal proof assistant: solving a problem means producing a Lean4 proof the kernel accepts, so correctness is machine-checked rather than judged. Because formal physics needs infrastructure mathematics libraries lack — unit systems, physical theorems — the paper also builds PhysLib as a foundation. Evaluating expert math Lean4 provers and state-of-the-art closed-source models, the best results are 16% (DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B) and 35% (Claude-Sonnet-4), and PhysLib adds an average 11.75% improvement.
works.domains_text: College-level physics rendered as formal Lean4 statements; subfield composition is not stated in the abstract.

zh.overview: Lean4Physics（Lean4PHYS）是大学物理在 Lean4 中的推理框架，贡献了 LeanPhysBench——200 条手工编写、经同行评审的形式化物理命题，取材于大学教材与物理竞赛题——以及 PhysLib，一个社区驱动的、收录形式化物理推理所需单位制与定理的基础仓库。论文称这是首个 Lean4 物理 benchmark。
zh.summary: LeanPhysBench 把物理评估搬进形式化证明助手：解题意味着给出被 Lean4 内核接受的证明，正确性由机器检查而非评判。由于形式化物理需要数学库所缺少的基础设施——单位制、物理定理——论文同时构建了 PhysLib 作为地基。在专业数学 Lean4 证明器与最先进闭源模型上，最佳成绩分别为 16%（DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B）与 35%（Claude-Sonnet-4）；PhysLib 平均带来 11.75% 的提升。

works.title: The Tool Decathlon / Toolathlon
works.overview: The Tool Decathlon (Toolathlon) is a benchmark for language agents on diverse, realistic, long-horizon task execution: 108 tasks spanning 32 real software applications and 604 tools, with realistic initial environment states and strictly verifiable, state-based evaluation scripts.
works.summary: Toolathlon targets the gap between narrow or simplified tool-use benchmarks and real-world workflows that switch across many applications. Tools are sourced from a curated set of 32 Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers — revised or implemented by the authors — plus 7 local toolkits, covering everyday platforms (Google Calendar, Notion, Gmail) and professional ones (Snowflake, Kubernetes, WooCommerce, BigQuery). Unlike prior work that ensures functional realism but limited environment-state diversity, environments are initialized with realistic states from real software (e.g., a Canvas course with dozens of students, real financial spreadsheets), combining remote applications with locally containerized open-source replacements (Poste.io for email, Canvas, Kubernetes, WooCommerce). Task instructions are deliberately fuzzy to mirror authentic user requests, but the intent is deterministically inferable from environment states.
works.domains_text: General-purpose software workflows: education/course management, finance, e-commerce, cluster and database operations, email and calendar coordination, research and daily productivity.

zh.overview: The Tool Decathlon（Toolathlon）是一个面向多样、真实、长 horizon 任务执行的 language agent benchmark：108 个任务覆盖 32 个真实软件应用与 604 个工具，配以真实的初始环境状态，并用严格可验证的、基于状态的评估脚本打分。
zh.summary: Toolathlon 针对的是狭窄或简化的 tool-use benchmark 与需要在众多应用间切换的真实工作流之间的差距。工具来自作者精选并修复或自行实现的 32 个 Model Context Protocol（MCP）server，外加 7 个本地工具包，覆盖日常平台（Google Calendar、Notion、Gmail）与专业平台（Snowflake、Kubernetes、WooCommerce、BigQuery）。与只保证功能真实性但环境状态多样性有限的既有工作不同，环境用来自真实软件的状态初始化（例如有几十名学生的 Canvas 课程、真实的财务表格），并将远程应用与本地容器化的开源替代（用 Poste.io 替代邮件服务、Canvas、Kubernetes、WooCommerce）结合。任务指令刻意写得模糊，以模拟真实用户请求，但真实意图可以从环境状态中确定性地推断出来。

works.title: Enconda-bench
works.overview: Enconda-bench (Environment Configuration Diagnosis Benchmark) evaluates software-engineering agents at the process level on environment configuration — a bottleneck where end-to-end build/test benchmarks obscure where and why agents fail.
works.summary: Enconda-bench provides process-level trajectory assessment of software-engineering agents during environment setup. Rather than only scoring end-to-end build or test success, it evaluates fine-grained capabilities — planning, error diagnosis, repair, and execution — across the configuration process. Task instances are automatically constructed by injecting realistic README errors and validated in Docker.
works.domains_text: Environment configuration for software-engineering agents.

zh.overview: Enconda-bench（Environment Configuration Diagnosis Benchmark）在环境配置这一软件工程 agent 常见瓶颈上做过程级评估——避免端到端 build/test benchmark 只报最终结果，隐藏 agent 在哪里、为何失败。
zh.summary: Enconda-bench 在环境配置过程中对软件工程 agent 做 trajectory 过程级评估。不再仅给出端到端 build/test 是否成功，而是评估配置过程中细粒度的能力——planning、error diagnosis、repair、execution。任务实例通过向真实 README 注入实际错误自动构造，并在 Docker 中验证。

works.title: ReplicationBench
works.overview: ReplicationBench is an evaluation framework asking whether AI agents can replicate astrophysics research papers: each paper is split into tasks requiring agents to replicate its core contributions — experimental setup, derivations, data analysis, and codebase — with every task co-developed with the original paper authors.
works.summary: ReplicationBench treats paper replication as the unit of evaluation in astrophysics, a data-driven science. Agents work in computational sandboxes on tasks that target a key scientific result each; because tasks are co-developed with the original authors, both faithfulness (adherence to original methods) and correctness (technical accuracy of results) can be objectively scored. The dataset comprises 111 replication tasks spanning 20 research papers (per the official repository). Even the best-performing language models score under 20%.
works.domains_text: Astrophysics research workflows, as a testbed for data-driven science.

zh.overview: ReplicationBench 是追问「AI agent 能否复现天体物理研究论文」的评估框架：每篇论文被拆成若干任务，要求 agent 复现其核心贡献——实验设置、推导、数据分析与代码库——且每个任务都与论文原作者共同开发。
zh.summary: ReplicationBench 把论文复现作为天体物理（一门数据驱动的科学）中 agent 评估的基本单元。agent 在计算沙箱中完成任务，每个任务瞄准一项关键科学结果；由于任务与原作者共同开发，忠实性（是否遵循原方法）与正确性（结果的技术准确性）都能客观打分。数据集含 111 个复现任务，覆盖 20 篇研究论文（据官方仓库）。即便表现最好的语言模型，得分也不足 20%。

works.title: Toward Responsible AI in High-Stakes Domains: A Dataset for Building Static Analysis with LLMs in Structural Engineering
works.overview: A published dataset and validation protocol in which GPT-4o answers structural-analysis prompts for reinforced-concrete frames twice — once as a bare language model and once as a tool-using agent that drives OpenSeesPy through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server — with both sets of answers scored as relative error against manually built ETABS reference models.
works.summary: The work publishes the full record of a controlled comparison in structural analysis: four reinforced-concrete building frames are each analysed by GPT-4o in two configurations — unaided, and as a tool-using agent driving OpenSeesPy through a Model Context Protocol server — alongside a manually written OpenSees model and a commercial ETABS model that supplies ground truth. Every prompt, exchange, output and error metric is released under an open licence. The stated purpose is to separate probabilistic language generation from deterministic numerical computation and to document how far each configuration can be trusted in a safety-critical workflow.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering. The evaluated objective is the static and seismic response of reinforced-concrete building frames — inter-storey drift, maximum displacement, base shear and fundamental period — computed against design-code requirements, which is a structural-engineering analysis task rather than generic tool operation. No co-domain is claimed: the language-model and MCP machinery is the means, not the evaluated objective.

zh.overview: 一份已正式发表的数据集与验证方案：GPT-4o 对钢筋混凝土框架的结构分析问题作答两遍——一遍是纯语言模型裸答，一遍是作为工具型 agent 通过 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器驱动 OpenSeesPy——两组答案都以相对误差对照人工搭建的 ETABS 参考模型计分。
zh.summary: 论文公开了一次结构分析对照实验的完整记录：四榀钢筋混凝土建筑框架各自由 GPT-4o 在两种配置下分析——无辅助裸答，以及作为工具型 agent 通过 Model Context Protocol 服务器驱动 OpenSeesPy——同时还有一份人工编写的 OpenSees 模型，以及一份提供 ground truth 的商业 ETABS 模型。全部提示词、交互过程、输出与误差指标均以开放许可发布。作者陈述的目的，是把概率性的语言生成与确定性的数值计算分开，并记录在涉及安全的工作流里每种配置究竟能被信任到什么程度。

works.title: AstaBench
works.overview: AstaBench is a benchmark suite that provides a holistic measure of agentic ability to perform scientific research, pairing its tasks with a reproducible tool environment and cost-controlled scoring. It comprises 2,400+ problems across 11 benchmarks in four task categories — literature understanding, code & execution, data analysis, and end-to-end discovery — with many problems inspired by actual user requests to deployed Asta agents.
works.summary: AstaBench argues that existing agent benchmark suites lack reproducible tools for controlled comparison, fail to account for confounders such as model cost and tool access, rarely standardize task interfaces for general agents, lack tasks informed by authentic product usage, and offer few comprehensive baselines. The authors formalize benchmarking principles and instantiate them as a suite of 2,400+ problems in 11 benchmarks, backed by the Asta Environment — the first scientific research environment with production-grade, date-restricted search tools — together with the `agent-eval` cost-accounting toolkit and the `agent-baselines` suite of standardized agents. Evaluating 57 agents across 22 agent classes, the paper finds that despite meaningful progress on individual aspects, AI remains far from solving the challenge of science research assistance.
works.domains_text: Multiple scientific domains weighted towards computer science: benchmark-level domains are CS, biology, or mixed, with DiscoveryBench alone spanning sociology, biology, humanities, economics, engineering, and meta-science, and CORE-Bench-Hard⁻ spanning computer science, social science, and medicine.

zh.overview: AstaBench 是一个为 agent 的科学研究能力提供整体度量的 benchmark 套件，将任务与可复现的工具环境和成本受控的评分相配套。它由 11 个 benchmark 的 2,400+ 个问题组成，覆盖四个任务类别——文献理解、代码与执行、数据分析与端到端发现——其中许多问题源自已部署 Asta agent 收到的真实用户请求。
zh.summary: AstaBench 认为现有 agent benchmark 套件缺乏用于受控比较的可复现工具，未考虑模型成本与工具访问等混杂因素（confounder），很少为通用 agent 标准化任务接口，缺少由真实产品使用数据支撑的任务，也缺乏全面的 baseline。作者将基准测试原则形式化，并将其实例化为一个由 11 个 benchmark、2,400+ 个问题组成的套件，其背后是 Asta Environment——首个配备生产级、按日期截断检索工具的科学研究环境——并配套 `agent-eval` 成本核算工具包与标准化 agent 套件 `agent-baselines`。论文对 22 个 agent 类别中的 57 个 agent 进行评估，发现尽管在个别方面取得了实质进展，AI 距离解决科学研究辅助这一挑战仍很遥远。

works.title: CUARewardBench
works.overview: CUARewardBench is a benchmark that treats outcome reward models (ORM) and process reward models (PRM) as the judged subjects, testing whether vision-language models can reproduce expert verdicts on computer-using agent trajectories. It pairs 272 trajectory-success annotations with 346 step-correctness annotations over OSWorld rollouts from seven policy models spanning 25.9–50.8% success rates.
works.summary: CUARewardBench argues that script-based verifiers for computer-using agents scale poorly and cannot assess individual steps, while the VLM-based reward models proposed as their replacement remain largely unverified.
