It curates expert-annotated trajectories from OSWorld-verified rollouts and evaluates seven vision-language models under three published CUA reward prompt templates, as both outcome and process reward models. The best single configuration reaches 82.9% precision and 80.1% overall accuracy on trajectory-level judgment, and the authors' Unanimous Prompt Ensemble raises precision to 89.8% and NPV to 93.3% by classifying only when all ensemble members agree.
works.domains_text: Ubuntu desktop computer use across ten OSWorld software categories: Chrome, Thunderbird, LibreOffice Writer/Calc/Impress, VS Code, GIMP, VLC, OS operations, and multi-app workflows.

zh.overview: CUARewardBench 是一个把 outcome reward model（ORM）与 process reward model（PRM）本身作为被评判对象的 benchmark，用于检验 vision-language model 能否复现专家对 computer-using agent trajectory 的判定。它在来自七个 policy model、成功率跨越 25.9–50.8% 的 OSWorld rollout 上，配套了 272 条 trajectory 成功标注与 346 条 step 正确性标注。
zh.summary: CUARewardBench 提出，面向 computer-using agent 的脚本式验证器扩展性差且无法评估单个 step，而被提议取而代之的 VLM 式 reward model 在很大程度上仍未经检验。它从 OSWorld-verified rollout 中筛选出经专家标注的 trajectory，并在三套已公开的 CUA reward prompt 模板下，把七个 vision-language model 同时作为 outcome 与 process reward model 进行评测。最佳单一配置在 trajectory 级判定上达到 82.9% precision 与 80.1% 总体准确率，作者提出的 Unanimous Prompt Ensemble 通过仅在全体成员一致时才给出判定，把 precision 提升到 89.8%、NPV 提升到 93.3%。

works.title: Hard2Verify
works.overview: Hard2Verify is a benchmark that scores step-level verifiers on their ability to grade the individual steps of frontier-model proofs to recent, open-ended Olympiad mathematics problems. It comprises 1,860 expert-labeled steps across 200 model-generated solutions to 80 competition problems, produced with over 500 hours of human labor.
works.summary: Hard2Verify argues that existing step-level verification benchmarks sit below the frontier, drawing on easy or short-answer questions and on human-written or synthetically corrupted solutions rather than on naturally occurring frontier-model errors. The authors curate 80 problems from ten recent Olympiads, sample one solution per problem from GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Claude Sonnet 4, and have mathematical experts label every step of the 200 surviving responses under strict grading that treats any step derived from an earlier mistake as incorrect. Across 29 evaluated generative critics and process reward models, GPT-5 leads with 86.53 Balanced Accuracy on step-level correctness but only 70.61 on first-error identification, and open-source verifiers lag closed-source models beyond a few standouts.
works.domains_text: Open-ended competition mathematics: Olympiad-style proof problems in English, text-only, with image-dependent questions excluded.

zh.overview: Hard2Verify 是一个 benchmark，用于评估 step-level verifier 为最新开放式 Olympiad 数学题的 frontier 模型证明逐步打分的能力。它包含针对 80 道竞赛题的 200 份模型生成解答中的 1,860 个专家标注步骤，由超过 500 小时的人力投入产生。
zh.summary: Hard2Verify 认为现有的 step-level 验证 benchmark 尚未触及 frontier，它们依赖简单题或短答案题，以及人工撰写或合成注入错误的解答，而非自然产生的 frontier 模型错误。作者从十场近期 Olympiad 中筛选出 80 道题，用 GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro 和 Claude Sonnet 4 为每道题各采样一份解答，并请数学专家在严格评分标准下标注最终保留的 200 份回答的每一个步骤，任何由先前错误推导而来的步骤一律判为错误。在被评测的 29 个 generative critic 与 process reward model 中，GPT-5 在步骤级正确性上以 86.53 Balanced Accuracy 领先，但在首个错误定位上仅为 70.61；除少数突出者外，开源 verifier 落后于闭源模型。

works.title: MatSciBench
works.overview: MatSciBench benchmarks the reasoning ability of large language models in materials science: 1,340 college-level problems spanning the essential subdisciplines, with detailed reference solutions for 946 and images for 315 — DeepSeek-R1 tops text-only questions at 75.22% while GPT-5 leads image questions at 53.02%.
works.summary: MatSciBench moves materials evaluation from knowledge recall to multi-step reasoning: 1,340 college-level problems across the essential materials subdisciplines, 946 with detailed reference solutions and 315 posed with images. Leading thinking and non-thinking LLMs are evaluated, and the split by modality is telling — DeepSeek-R1 reaches 75.22% on text-only questions but the best image performer (GPT-5) manages only 53.02%, marking multimodal materials reasoning as the harder frontier.
works.domains_text: Materials science — college-level reasoning across the essential subdisciplines of the field.

zh.overview: MatSciBench 评测大语言模型在材料科学中的推理能力：1,340 个大学水平问题横跨该领域的核心子学科，其中 946 个配详细参考解、315 个带图像——DeepSeek-R1 在纯文本题上以 75.22% 领先，GPT-5 在图像题上以 53.02% 领先。
zh.summary: MatSciBench 把材料评估从知识回忆推进到多步推理：1,340 个大学水平问题横跨材料的核心子学科，其中 946 个配详细参考解、315 个以图像形式给出。评测覆盖领先的思考型与非思考型 LLM，按模态划分的结果颇具启示——DeepSeek-R1 在纯文本题上达 75.22%，而图像题最好的 GPT-5 只有 53.02%，把多模态材料推理标记为更难的前沿。

works.title: AFMBench
works.overview: AFMBench is an evaluation suite of 100 expertly curated tasks that requires LLM agents to operate a real atomic force microscope rather than a simulator, spanning the workflow from experimental design through results analysis. It is documented here for AFMBench, the paper's *evaluation* contribution; the accompanying AILA framework is agent-implementation work adjacent to this repository's evaluation focus (see the repository note under Limitations).
works.summary: The authors argue that domain question-answering benchmarks do not establish whether a model can run a laboratory instrument, and that simulation-based evaluation omits the temporal constraints and experimental variability of real hardware. AFMBench therefore holds the agent to physical execution on a Nanosurf DriveAFM reached through a Python API, with four interchangeable LLMs swapped into a fixed harness and every task run three times. The headline result supports the authors' concern: Claude-3.5-Sonnet, strong on materials-science question answering, carries a 51.6% error rate here, and the best model reaches 65% overall task completion while dropping to 23.3% on tasks that merge documentation with analysis.
works.domains_text: Scanning-probe microscopy of materials — operating an atomic force microscope for imaging, mechanical characterization, and image analysis.

zh.overview: AFMBench 是一个含 100 个由专家整理任务的评测套件，要求 LLM agent 操作一台真实的原子力显微镜而非仿真器，覆盖从实验设计到结果分析的完整流程。此处收录的是 AFMBench，即该论文的**评测**贡献；与之配套的 AILA 框架属于 agent 实现工作，与本仓库的评测重心相邻（见 Limitations 下的 repository note）。
zh.summary: 作者指出，领域问答 benchmark 无法确立一个模型是否能操作实验仪器，而基于仿真的评估又抹去了真实硬件的时间约束与实验变异性。因此 AFMBench 要求 agent 在一台经由 Python API 访问的 Nanosurf DriveAFM 上物理执行，把四个可互换的 LLM 装进同一个固定框架，每个任务运行三次。头号结果印证了作者的担忧：在材料科学问答上表现强劲的 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 在此处的错误率为 51.6%，而最佳模型的总体任务完成率为 65%，在把文档记录与分析合并的任务上则跌至 23.3%。

works.title: MASSE
works.overview:
MASSE is a training-free multi-agent LLM system for structural engineering that ships alongside a released
100-problem structural engineering dataset with expert-verified ground truth and four rubric-scored
benchmarks (SAAB, SDAB, LAB, MASEB) covering structural analysis, structural design, load transformation,
and end-to-end workflow execution.
works.summary:
MASSE decomposes a real consulting-firm structural engineering workflow into an Analyst Team, an Engineer
Team, and a Management Team of LLM agents that pass structured JSON between roles, retrieve seismic
parameters from building-code documents via RAG, build and solve OpenSeesPy finite-element models, and
issue capacity-verification verdicts. To measure the system, the authors construct a dataset of one hundred
structural engineering problems of varying difficulty, each paired with an expert-validated ground-truth
solution, and define four benchmarks with explicit point rubrics that an LLM judge applies to the complete
analysis log. The paper reports a model comparison across four LLM backends, a cost/runtime trade-off
analysis, an ablation on agent memory and structured I/O, and a human study against practising engineers.
works.domains_text:
Civil & Structural Engineering. The evaluated objective is a structural engineering decision throughout:
retrieving site-specific seismic parameters (Sa(0.2), Sa(0.5), Sa(1.0), Sa(2.0), PGA, PGV) from building-code
documents, converting them to seismic floor loads, assembling an OpenSeesPy beam-column and brace model of a
racking structure, running the finite-element analysis, computing member capacities, and returning a
pass/fail structural-adequacy verdict. This is earthquake *engineering* — the design and verification of a
load-bearing structure — rather than seismic hazard science. No co-domain is claimed: the finite-element and
RAG tooling is a means to the structural verdict, not an evaluated objective in its own right.

zh.overview: MASSE 是一套面向结构工程、无需训练的多 agent LLM 系统，随之发布的还有一个含 100 道结构工程题的数据集，题目均配专家核验的 ground truth，另有四项按评分细则打分的 benchmark（SAAB、SDAB、LAB、MASEB），分别覆盖结构分析、结构设计、荷载转换与端到端工作流执行。
zh.summary: MASSE 把一家咨询公司真实的结构工程工作流拆成三个 LLM agent 团队——分析团队、工程师团队与管理团队，角色之间以结构化 JSON 传递信息，通过 RAG 从建筑规范文档中检索抗震参数，构建并求解 OpenSeesPy 有限元模型，最后给出承载力校核结论。为衡量该系统，作者构建了一个含一百道结构工程题、难度不一的数据集，每题都配一份经专家验证的 ground-truth 解，并定义四项 benchmark，各自带有明确的分项评分细则，由一个 LLM judge 对照完整的分析日志逐项打分。论文报告了四种 LLM 后端的模型对比、一项成本与运行时长的权衡分析、一项关于 agent 记忆与结构化 I/O 的消融，以及一项与执业工程师的人类对照研究。

works.title: Mephisto
works.overview: Mephisto is a multi-agent LLM framework that drives the CIGALE spectral-energy-distribution (SED) code to infer the physical properties of galaxies from multi-band photometry, iteratively refining physical models via tree search and a self-play-accumulated knowledge base. Alongside the system, the authors construct a 256-galaxy task set with an external quantitative pass criterion and run all seven LLM backbones over it, releasing code, catalogs and the knowledge base on Zenodo.
works.summary: Mephisto decomposes SED interpretation into cooperating agent roles — hypothesis reasoning, CIGALE execution, fit evaluation, knowledge extraction and knowledge validation — and searches over candidate physical models rather than over a fixed precomputed parameter grid. Each galaxy is analysed by expanding a search tree of model-refinement hypotheses (depth-first for exploitation, breadth-first for exploration), with the fit quality of executed CIGALE runs feeding back into the next round of reasoning; insights distilled from past interactions are validated by ablation and retained in a persistent knowledge base. The authors evaluate the framework on a deliberately constructed 256-galaxy sample from COSMOS2020, scored against an exhaustive 360-million-point CIGALE grid, and apply it to 31 JWST "Little Red Dot" objects from JADES. A cross-backbone study repeats the full 256-galaxy run with seven different LLMs and reports success rate against relative API cost.
works.domains_text: **Astronomy** — specifically extragalactic astronomy and galaxy astrophysics. The evaluated objective is an astronomical inference: recovering physical properties (stellar mass, star-formation rate, dust attenuation, redshift, AGN contribution) of real observed galaxies from multi-band photometry, using an astronomy-specific modelling code (CIGALE) and real survey data (COSMOS2020, JWST/JADES). No co-domain is assigned: the work contributes no general methodology benchmark and its software component is a thin wrapper around an existing astronomy code rather than a software-engineering evaluation.

zh.overview: Mephisto 是一个多智能体 LLM 框架，它驱动 CIGALE 光谱能量分布（SED）代码，从多波段测光推断星系的物理性质，并借助树搜索与自我博弈积累的知识库不断改进物理模型。除框架本身外，作者还构建了一个 256 个星系的任务集，配以外部的定量通过判据，用全部七种 LLM 骨干各跑一遍，并把代码、星表与知识库发布在 Zenodo 上。
zh.summary: Mephisto 把 SED 解释拆解成若干协作的 agent 角色——假设推理、CIGALE 执行、拟合评估、知识提取与知识校验——并在候选物理模型上搜索，而不是在固定的预计算参数网格上搜索。每个星系的分析都靠展开一棵模型改进假设的搜索树来完成（深度优先用于利用，广度优先用于探索），每次 CIGALE 运行的拟合质量都会反馈到下一轮推理；从过往交互中提炼的经验经消融验证后，留存进一个持久的知识库。作者在一个特意构建的 256 星系样本上评估该框架，样本取自 COSMOS2020，打分对照一个 3.6 亿点的穷举 CIGALE 网格；他们还把框架用于 JADES 中 31 个 JWST 发现的「小红点」（Little Red Dot）天体。跨骨干研究则用七种不同的 LLM 把 256 星系的完整流程各重跑一遍，报告成功率与相对 API 成本的关系。

works.title: NewtonBench
works.overview: NewtonBench is a benchmark that evaluates scientific law discovery in LLM agents through interactive experimentation on simulated physical systems. It comprises 324 tasks generated by applying counterfactual law shifts to 12 canonical physics laws.
works.summary: NewtonBench argues that existing law-discovery benchmarks face a methodological trilemma among scientific relevance, scalability, and memorization resistance, and that they oversimplify discovery as static function fitting. It instead has agents uncover laws embedded in simulated model systems by iteratively running experiments, across 324 tasks derived from counterfactual shifts of canonical physics laws. Experiments on frontier LLMs reveal a clear but fragile discovery capability: GPT-5 reaches 72.9% overall symbolic accuracy, but performance degrades sharply with system complexity and observational noise, and a code interpreter can hurt more capable models by inducing a premature shift from exploration to exploitation.
works.domains_text: Twelve physics domains, one canonical law each: Newton's law of universal gravitation, Coulomb's law, Ampere's force law, Fourier's law, Snell's law, radioactive decay, damped harmonic motion, Malus's law, the speed of sound in an ideal gas, Hooke's law, the Bose-Einstein distribution, and heat transfer.

zh.overview: NewtonBench 是一个通过在模拟物理系统上进行交互式实验来评估 LLM agent 科学定律发现能力的 benchmark。它包含 324 个任务，由对 12 条经典物理定律施加反事实定律偏移（counterfactual law shifts）生成。
zh.summary: NewtonBench 认为现有定律发现 benchmark 面临科学相关性、可扩展性与抗记忆性之间的方法学三难困境，并且把发现过度简化为静态函数拟合。它转而让 agent 通过迭代运行实验来揭示嵌入在模拟模型系统中的定律，共 324 个任务，均由经典物理定律的反事实偏移派生。在 frontier LLM 上的实验揭示出清晰但脆弱的发现能力：GPT-5 的总体 symbolic accuracy 达到 72.9%，但性能随系统复杂度与观测噪声急剧下降，而 code interpreter 可能促使较强模型过早从探索转向利用，反而降低其表现。

works.title: An LLM-driven framework for cosmological model-building and exploration
works.overview: A multi-stage evaluation framework that measures whether an LLM-driven coding agent can autonomously propose, implement and explore alternative cosmological models by modifying the CLASS Boltzmann-solver codebase inside a containerized environment. Agent submissions are scored automatically against binary execution milestones, numerical agreement with ground-truth reference implementations, and cosmological likelihood/tension rewards computed from real survey data.
works.summary: The authors state that they "introduce a multi-stage framework to evaluate the ability of an LLM-driven agent to autonomously propose, implement and explore cosmological models." The agent works inside a Podman/Docker container that pre-installs CLASS version 3.3.0 together with stage-specific prompt files, LLM-generated file maps of the `background.c`, `perturbations.c` and `input.c` modules, model descriptions and auxiliary testing code. Its deliverable is a patch to the CLASS repository, which is exported from the container and evaluated automatically. The framing is explicitly evaluative: the paper's concluding claim is that the results provide "a concrete framework for evaluating AI agents on complex scientific workflows that combine domain knowledge, mathematical reasoning, coding, and empirical validation."
works.domains_text: Astronomy — specifically cosmology: implementing alternative dark-energy and modified-cosmology models in a Boltzmann solver, computing CMB and matter power spectra, and confronting them with DESI baryon acoustic oscillation measurements, a Planck early-Universe CMB three-parameter prior, Pantheon+ supernovae, and SH0ES Hubble-constant measurements. Physics is a legitimate co-domain (the models are dark-energy field theories), and Scientific Software & Systems work is instrumental (patching a ~43,000-line C codebase plus 10,000 lines of numerical files).

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: 一套多阶段评估框架，衡量 LLM 驱动的 coding agent 能否在容器化环境中修改 CLASS 玻尔兹曼求解器代码库，自主提出、实现并探索另类宇宙学模型。agent 的提交由三方面自动打分：二元的执行里程碑、与真值参考实现的数值一致性，以及基于真实巡天数据算出的宇宙学似然/张力奖励。
zh.summary: 作者称，他们「提出了一个多阶段框架，用于评估 LLM 驱动的 agent 自主提出、实现并探索宇宙学模型的能力」。agent 在一个 Podman/Docker 容器中工作，容器预装了 CLASS 3.3.0，并附带各阶段的 prompt 文件、由 LLM 生成的 `background.c`、`perturbations.c` 与 `input.c` 三个模块的文件索引、模型描述以及辅助测试代码。它要交付的成果是一份针对 CLASS 仓库的补丁，补丁从容器中导出后自动评估。论文的定位明确是评估性的：其结论称这些结果给出了「一个具体的框架，用以评估 AI agent 在融合领域知识、数学推理、编程与实证验证的复杂科学工作流上的表现」。

works.title: LLM-IOAA
works.overview: LLM-IOAA is a systematic evaluation of frontier large language models on the complete theory and data-analysis exams of the International Olympiad on Astronomy & Astrophysics (IOAA), graded by former IOAA contestants and team leaders against the official marking schemes and scored against real contestant distributions.
works.summary: The work takes four consecutive years of IOAA exams (2022–2025) — an international pre-university olympiad whose problems demand deep conceptual understanding, multi-step astrophysical derivation, and multimodal analysis of real observational data — and runs five frontier LLMs on every problem. Answers are graded by two authors who are themselves former IOAA participants and national team leaders, using the official IOAA rubrics, with every model–problem assessment independently graded twice and discrepancies resolved by consensus. Gemini 2.5 Pro and GPT-5 reach gold-medal-level scores on the theory exams, ranking in roughly the top two among the 200–300 human contestants per year, while performance on the data-analysis exams diverges sharply across models. The authors accompany the scores with an eight-category error taxonomy that locates the remaining failures in conceptual and geometric/spatial reasoning rather than arithmetic.
works.domains_text: Astronomy and astrophysics — the evaluated objective is astronomical throughout: positional and spherical astronomy, stellar structure and evolution, celestial mechanics, galactic and extragalactic astronomy, cosmology, and the analysis of real observational data such as light curves, spectra and sky images. The physics and mathematics invoked are applied to astronomical objects and observations rather than studied for their own sake.

zh.overview: LLM-IOAA 系统评测了前沿大语言模型在国际天文学与天体物理学奥林匹克竞赛（IOAA）完整理论与数据分析试卷上的表现：由历届 IOAA 选手和国家队领队按官方评分标准判分，并与真实选手的分数分布对照。
zh.summary: 工作取用 2022–2025 连续四年的 IOAA 试卷——这项面向大学前学生的国际奥赛，题目要求深入的概念理解、多步天体物理推导，以及对真实观测数据的多模态分析——让五个前沿 LLM 逐题作答。判分由两位作者完成，他们本人就是历届 IOAA 参赛选手和国家队领队，依据官方 IOAA 评分细则，每一组模型–题目的评定都独立判两遍，出现分歧则协商达成一致。Gemini 2.5 Pro 与 GPT-5 在理论考试上达到金牌水平，在每年 200–300 名人类选手中大致排进前两名；数据分析考试上各模型的表现则明显分化。作者在分数之外还给出一套八类错误分类，把残余的失败定位在概念推理与几何/空间推理上，而不是算术。

works.title: CMT-Benchmark
works.overview: CMT-Benchmark is a benchmark of 50 expert-researcher-level problems in condensed matter theory, built by expert researchers and machine-graded against expert-supplied ground truth, including symbolic handling of non-commuting operators via normal ordering.
works.summary: CMT-Benchmark spans analytical and computational condensed-matter-theory approaches — Hartree-Fock, exact diagonalization, quantum and variational Monte Carlo, DMRG, and statistical mechanics — over quantum many-body systems and classical statistical mechanics. Solutions are checked programmatically against expert ground truth with grading that generalizes across tasks, including normal-ordered symbolic comparison of non-commuting operators.
works.domains_text: Condensed matter theory: quantum many-body systems, classical statistical mechanics, computational physics methods.

zh.overview: CMT-Benchmark 是由专家研究者构建的凝聚态理论 benchmark，含 50 道达到专家自身研究水平的问题，对照专家提供的真值做机器判分，包括通过正规排序对非对易算符做符号化处理。
zh.summary: CMT-Benchmark 横跨凝聚态理论的解析与计算方法——Hartree-Fock、精确对角化、量子/变分蒙特卡洛、DMRG 与统计力学——覆盖量子多体系统与经典统计力学。解答对照专家真值程序化检验，判分方法可跨任务泛化，包括对非对易算符做正规排序后的符号比较。

works.title: AtomWorld
works.overview: AtomWorld is a benchmark for evaluating the spatial reasoning of large language models on crystalline materials: models perform ten fundamental atomic-structure actions across four widely used modelling categories, with verifiable checks — and struggle badly on operations involving complex spatial relations (below 12% success for rotations).
works.summary: Crystalline materials are defined by the geometry of their atomic structure, so an LLM that reasons about them must manipulate that structure, not just recall facts about it. AtomWorld poses ten fundamental actions — constructing and modifying atomic structures — across four common modelling categories, scored by verifiable checks on the resulting structure rather than by a judge. The finding is a sharp spatial-reasoning gap: even the strongest models handle simple edits but fail on operations needing complex spatial relations, with rotation success below 12%.
works.domains_text: Materials science — crystalline-structure spatial reasoning: constructing and modifying atomic structures under standard modelling operations.

zh.overview: AtomWorld 评测大语言模型对晶态材料的空间推理：模型在四类常用建模范式下执行十种基本的原子结构操作，用可验证的检查判分——在涉及复杂空间关系的操作上表现很差（旋转成功率低于 12%）。
zh.summary: 晶态材料由其原子结构的几何决定，因此对它推理的 LLM 必须操作结构，而不只是回忆关于它的事实。AtomWorld 设计了十种基本操作——构建与修改原子结构——横跨四类常用建模范式，按对所得结构的可验证检查判分，而非依赖 judge。结论是一个鲜明的空间推理缺口：即便最强的模型也能应付简单编辑，却在需要复杂空间关系的操作上失手，旋转成功率低于 12%。

works.title: A Lightweight Large Language Model-Based Multi-Agent System for 2D Frame Structural Analysis
works.overview: A benchmark of twenty 2D building-frame structural-analysis problems, each evaluated over ten independent trials, together with a five-agent Llama-3.3 70B pipeline that converts a textual frame description into executable OpenSeesPy finite-element code.
works.summary: Extending the same group's earlier beam work from 1D members to 2D frames, this paper builds a twenty-problem benchmark of multi-bay, multi-story plane frames and uses it to show that general-purpose LLMs cannot construct valid finite-element models of them. The proposed system decomposes the modeling task across five specialized agents — problem analysis, geometry, code translation, model validation, and load — all powered by the lightweight Llama-3.3 70B Instruct model. Its central design choice is a two-stage split in which geometric reasoning is resolved in natural language and emitted as a structured JSON topology before any code is written, so that the LLM performs a constrained translation rather than open-ended code generation. A deterministic, tool-based validation agent then deduplicates nodes and elements and renumbers identifiers before loads are applied.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering. The evaluated objects are multi-bay, multi-story building frames — the paper frames them as the load-bearing skeleton of structures ranging from industrial plants to high-rise buildings — and the graded outcome is a valid finite-element model of that frame with its axial, shear, and bending responses. Two of the benchmark topologies are abstracted from real buildings. No co-domain is assigned; OpenSeesPy is the instrument, not the evaluated objective.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: 一个含二十道二维建筑框架结构分析题的 benchmark，每题独立运行十次；随之提出的是一套由五个 agent 组成、以 Llama-3.3 70B 驱动的管线，把框架的文字描述转成可执行的 OpenSeesPy 有限元代码。
zh.summary: 同一团队此前做的是一维梁，这篇把设定推进到二维框架：作者搭了一个二十题的多跨多层平面框架 benchmark，用它说明通用 LLM 无法为这类框架构造出有效的有限元模型。所提系统把建模任务拆给五个专职 agent——问题分析、几何、代码翻译、模型校验与荷载——全部由轻量的 Llama-3.3 70B Instruct 驱动。其核心的设计选择是一次两阶段切分：几何推理先用自然语言理清，再输出为结构化的 JSON 拓扑，之后才动手写代码，于是 LLM 做的是受约束的翻译，而不是开放式的代码生成。随后由一个基于工具、确定性执行的模型校验 agent 去重节点与单元、重编号标识，最后才施加荷载。

works.title: PsychCounsel-Bench
works.overview: PsychCounsel-Bench evaluates the psychology intelligence of LLMs on professional-certification questions: approximately 2,252 single-choice questions from the U.S. National Counselor Certification Exam, where advanced models clear the ~70% passing threshold while smaller open-source models fall well short.
works.summary: PsychCounsel-Bench grounds psychology evaluation in a professional standard: about 2,252 curated single-choice questions from the U.S. National Counselor Certification Exam (NCE), scored against the exam's ~70% passing threshold. Advanced models — GPT-4o, Llama3.3-70B, Gemma3-27B — clear the threshold comfortably, while smaller open-source models (Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B) remain far below, making the benchmark a clean pass/fail-anchored measure of professional psychology knowledge.
works.domains_text: Neuroscience & Cognitive Science — professional counseling psychology knowledge, sourced from a certification examination.

zh.overview: PsychCounsel-Bench 用专业认证题评测 LLM 的心理学水平：约 2,252 道来自美国国家咨询师认证考试（NCE）的单选题，先进模型能越过约 70% 的及格线，而较小的开源模型则远远不及。
zh.summary: PsychCounsel-Bench 把心理学评估锚定在专业标准上：约 2,252 道精选自美国国家咨询师认证考试（NCE）的单选题，对照该考试约 70% 的及格线评分。先进模型——GPT-4o、Llama3.3-70B、Gemma3-27B——轻松过线，而较小的开源模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B）远远不及，使该 benchmark 成为一个以及格/不及格为锚的专业心理学知识度量。

works.title: PTA-GRPO: Plan Then Action, High-Level Planning Guidance Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
works.overview: PTA-GRPO distills compact high-level guidance from chain-of-thought traces, then jointly optimizes plan quality and fine-grained reasoning with reinforcement learning.
works.summary: The first stage summarizes detailed solution traces into an analytic plan and uses plan–reasoning pairs for supervised fine-tuning. The second stage adds a guidance-aware GRPO objective that rewards both the final answer and the quality of the high-level plan. The hierarchy is therefore plan followed by token-level reasoning, rather than independent modules acting at different environment time scales.
works.domains_text: General mathematical reasoning and language-model post-training; not mapped to the Mathematics domain because the work studies a generic reasoning method rather than mathematical research activity.

works.title: ChemX
works.overview: ChemX benchmarks agentic systems on automated scientific information extraction in chemistry: 10 manually curated, domain-expert-validated datasets on nanomaterials and small molecules, against which document-extraction agents such as ChatGPT Agent and chemistry-specific pipelines are compared.
works.summary: ChemX targets the extraction bottleneck of chemical data curation: turning papers — with their domain terminology, complex tables, schematics, and context-dependent ambiguity — into structured records. Ten expert-validated datasets (including cytotoxicity, nanozymes, co-crystals, and oxazolidinones collections) provide the ground truth. The paper benchmarks agentic extractors including ChatGPT Agent and chemical-specific data-extraction agents, alongside a single-agent approach with precise control over document preprocessing and static GPT-5-class baselines, finding persistent challenges across all of them.
works.domains_text: Chemistry and materials science — nanomaterials (nanozymes, nanomagnetics) and small-molecule datasets, published at a NeurIPS materials-discovery workshop.

zh.overview: ChemX 评测 agent 系统在化学科学信息自动抽取上的表现：10 个人工整理、领域专家校验的数据集，覆盖纳米材料与小分子，用来对比 ChatGPT Agent 等文档抽取 agent 与化学专用抽取管线。
zh.summary: ChemX 瞄准化学数据整编的抽取瓶颈：把论文——连同其领域术语、复杂表格、示意图与依赖上下文的歧义——转成结构化记录。十个专家校验的数据集（含细胞毒性、纳米酶、共晶、恶唑烷酮等专题集）提供真值。论文评测了包括 ChatGPT Agent 与化学专用数据抽取 agent 在内的多种 agent 式抽取器，另设一个可精细控制文档预处理的单 agent 方案与 GPT-5 级静态基线对照，结论是所有系统都面临持续存在的挑战。

works.title: gammapyGPT
works.overview: An agent that writes, executes and validates Gammapy analysis code for ground-based gamma-ray astronomy inside a controlled execution environment, together with an accompanying benchmarking suite of gamma-ray analysis tasks whose numerical outputs are checked against expected values.
works.summary: Specialized scientific libraries such as Gammapy lack the documentation volume, example corpus and API stability that foundation models rely on for popular frameworks, so code generated against them is often outdated or wrong. The work addresses this for Gammapy with an agent that expands a user prompt into a governed chat history, emits a single Python script, executes it under a pared-down environment with a data pointer and a hard time limit, and feeds a concise error summary back into the next iteration until the script validates or the attempt budget is exhausted. Retrieval-augmented generation is optional, injecting top-k tutorial snippets when available. The contribution is packaged as a small Python package (`gammapygpt`) with a minimal web demo and a benchmarking harness.
works.domains_text: Astronomy — specifically ground-based gamma-ray astronomy and high-energy astrophysics, in the Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory analysis context. The scored quantities are astronomical results (observation counts, region significance, energy flux, spectral index, spatial–spectral source fits) obtained through the Gammapy analysis library, so the evaluated objective is an astronomical data-analysis one even though the agent's output medium is code.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: 一个能在受控执行环境中为地基伽马射线天文学编写、执行并验证 Gammapy 分析代码的 agent，并配有一套伽马射线分析任务的 benchmark，其数值输出会与预期值核对。
zh.summary: 像 Gammapy 这样的专用科学库，既没有基础模型在流行框架上所依赖的文档量与示例语料，API 也不够稳定，因此针对它们生成的代码常常过时或出错。这项工作为 Gammapy 解决该问题：agent 把用户提示扩展成一段受管控的对话历史，产出单个 Python 脚本，在只带一个数据指针的精简环境中执行该脚本、并对执行设有硬性时间上限，再把简明的错误摘要回灌到下一轮迭代，直到脚本通过验证或尝试次数用尽。检索增强生成是可选项，在有资料时注入 top-k 教程片段。整个贡献打包成一个小型 Python 包（`gammapygpt`），附带一个极简网页 demo 与一套 benchmark 测评框架。

works.title: CritPt
works.overview: CritPt (Complex Research using Integrated Thinking – Physics Test, pronounced "critical point") is a benchmark of 71 composite, unpublished research-level physics challenges, decomposed into 190 simpler checkpoint tasks, newly created by more than 50 active physics researchers across 11+ subfields.
works.summary: CritPt simulates full-scale research projects at the entry level: every challenge is unpublished and hand-curated to admit a guess-resistant, machine-verifiable answer, graded by an automated pipeline heavily customized for advanced physics-specific output formats. Challenges decompose into 190 checkpoint tasks that localize where reasoning breaks down. The best average accuracy among base models is only 5.7% (GPT-5, high), rising moderately to around 10% when models are equipped with coding tools.
works.domains_text: Eleven-plus physics subfields: condensed matter, quantum physics, atomic, molecular & optical physics, astrophysics, high energy physics, mathematical physics, statistical physics, nuclear physics, nonlinear dynamics, fluid dynamics, and biophysics.

zh.overview: CritPt（Complex Research using Integrated Thinking – Physics Test，读作「critical point」）是含 71 个复合、未发表的研究级物理挑战的 benchmark，可分解为 190 个更简单的检查点任务，由 50 余位活跃物理研究者在 11 个以上子领域中全新创作。
zh.summary: CritPt 模拟入门级别的完整研究项目：每个挑战都未曾发表，并被精心整理成防猜测、可机器验证的答案形式，由一条为高等物理专用输出格式深度定制的自动判分流水线打分。挑战分解出的 190 个检查点任务能定位推理在哪一步失守。基础模型的最高平均准确率仅 5.7%（GPT-5, high），配备编码工具后仅温和升至约 10%。

works.title: AstroMMBench
works.overview: AstroMMBench is a multimodal astronomy benchmark of 621 expert-reviewed multiple-choice questions over figures drawn from astronomy papers, spanning six astrophysical subfields, used to evaluate 25 multimodal large language models on astronomical image understanding.
works.summary: AstroMMBench targets a gap the authors identify between general multimodal benchmarks and the specific demands of astronomical figures: plots, spectra, sky images and instrument diagrams whose interpretation requires domain knowledge rather than generic visual description. Questions are generated from image–text pairs mined from arXiv astronomy TeX sources, filtered so that answering genuinely requires the image, and then reviewed by a panel of 15 astronomy experts. The resulting 621-question set is scored as plain multiple-choice accuracy across 25 open- and closed-source MLLMs, with per-subfield breakdowns showing cosmology and high-energy astrophysics to be the hardest categories.
works.domains_text: Astronomy — the entire benchmark is astronomical image interpretation, organized by the arXiv astro-ph subfield taxonomy (galaxies, cosmology, planetary, high-energy, instrumentation, solar and stellar). No non-astronomy content is included; the co-domain touching AI & Machine Learning Research is methodological only, since the object of measurement is multimodal model capability rather than an astronomical result.

zh.overview: AstroMMBench 是一个多模态天文 benchmark：621 道经专家审核的选择题，题面配的是取自天文论文的插图，覆盖六个天体物理子领域，用于评测 25 个多模态大语言模型对天体图像的理解。
zh.summary: AstroMMBench 瞄准作者指出的一处落差：通用多模态 benchmark 与天文插图的实际要求并不相称——曲线图、光谱、天区图像与仪器示意图，读懂它们靠的是领域知识，而不是笼统的看图说话。题目由 arXiv 天文论文 TeX 源码中挖掘出的图文对生成，经筛选以确保作答确实离不开图像，再交由 15 位天文专家组成的评审组把关。最终的 621 道题以纯粹的选择题准确率在 25 个开源与闭源 MLLM 上打分，分子领域的结果显示宇宙学与高能天体物理是最难的两类。

works.title: SysMoBench
works.overview: SysMoBench is a benchmark that evaluates AI's ability to write formal models of large, complex computer systems in TLA+. It covers eleven concurrent and distributed system artifacts and scores generated models with four automatically checked metrics rather than human or LLM judgement.
works.summary: SysMoBench addresses the limitation that existing AI specification benchmarks target small code fragments — function-level pre- and post-conditions, or logic puzzles — rather than complete systems, whose complex behavioral properties must be abstracted into a formal model. The authors build a benchmark over real-world concurrent and distributed system artifacts, use TLA+ as the specification language, and automate the quality metrics so that no human or LLM judge sits in the scoring loop. Across eleven system artifacts the reported results show that agents model the simplest artifacts well, while a Raft implementation such as Etcd Raft exceeds their ability.
works.domains_text: Formal specification of concurrent and distributed systems: operating-system synchronization primitives, consensus implementations, replication, leader election, and distributed data structures.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: SysMoBench 是一个 benchmark，评估 AI 用 TLA+ 为大型复杂计算机系统编写形式化模型的能力。它覆盖 11 个并发与分布式系统构件，并用四个可自动检查的指标为生成的模型打分，而不依赖人工或 LLM 判断。
zh.summary: SysMoBench 针对这样一个局限：已有的 AI 规约 benchmark 面向的是小规模代码片段——函数级前置与后置条件，或逻辑谜题——而非完整系统，而完整系统需要把复杂的行为性质抽象为形式化模型。作者在真实世界的并发与分布式系统构件上构建 benchmark，以 TLA+ 作为规约语言，并将质量指标自动化，使评分环路中不存在人工或 LLM judge。在 11 个系统构件上，报告结果显示 agent 能较好地建模最简单的构件，而 Etcd Raft 这类 Raft 实现已超出其能力。

works.title: SoM-1K
works.overview: SoM-1K is a multimodal benchmark of 1,065 annotated strength-of-materials (mechanics of materials) problems — each pairing a textual problem statement with a schematic diagram, an expert-written description of that diagram, and a full worked ground-truth solution — used to evaluate eight foundation models under three prompting strategies with expert manual grading.
works.summary: Strength of materials sits at the base of civil, mechanical, aerospace and materials engineering curricula, and solving its problems requires reading a schematic — supports, member geometry, load positions and directions — at the same time as the text. The authors argue that this makes it a natural probe for multimodal engineering reasoning, and build a dataset in which the diagram is a first-class annotated component rather than an image dropped into a prompt. Alongside the raw schematic they introduce **Descriptions of Images (DoI)**: a rigorous expert-verified textual rendering of exactly what the diagram shows, containing no solution steps, so that the contribution of visual information can be isolated from the contribution of reasoning hints. Evaluating five LLMs and three VLMs, they find that the best configuration reaches only 56.6% accuracy, and that text-only models given DoI generally beat vision-language models given the actual diagram.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering: the benchmark's subject is strength of materials, which the repository's domain scope lists explicitly under structural analysis and structural modelling, and the dominant problem categories are the load-bearing members of structural analysis — beams (59.15%) and frames (5.07%) account for the majority of the dataset, with tasks covering internal forces, bending moments, deflections, and statically indeterminate systems. The paper is written out of civil engineering departments (Hunan University College of Civil Engineering; University of Miami Department of Civil & Architectural Engineering) and the annotators are described as structural engineering and mechanics-of-materials educators. Mechanical & Aerospace is a genuine co-domain through shared solid mechanics: the paper states that SoM is a core subject in civil, mechanical, aerospace and materials engineering curricula, and the torsion category (12.86%) is posed on shafts rather than civil structures. The problems are generic textbook members rather than named buildings or bridges, so the civil/structural claim rests on the subject matter and the member types, not on identified infrastructure.

zh.overview: SoM-1K 是一个多模态 benchmark，收录 1,065 道经过标注的材料力学题目——每道题都由文字题干、示意图、一份专家撰写的图形描述，以及一份完整的标准解答配套组成——用来评测八个基础模型在三种 prompt 策略下的表现，判分全部由专家人工完成。
zh.summary: 材料力学是土木、机械、航空航天与材料工程课程体系的基石，解题时既要读题面，又要同时读懂示意图——支座形式、构件几何、荷载的作用位置与方向。作者据此认为它天然适合用来探测多模态工程推理能力，于是构建了一份把示意图当作一等标注成分、而非随手塞进 prompt 的图片的数据集。除原始示意图外，他们还引入 **Descriptions of Images (DoI)**：一份经专家核验、严格照实描述图中内容的文字，不含任何解题步骤，从而把视觉信息的贡献与推理提示的贡献分离开。在五个 LLM 与三个 VLM 上评测的结果是：最好的配置也只有 56.6% 的准确率，而且给了 DoI 的纯文本模型普遍胜过拿到真实示意图的视觉-语言模型。

works.title: AECBench
works.overview: AECBench is a hierarchical Chinese-language knowledge benchmark for the architecture, engineering and construction field: 4,800 engineer-authored questions across 23 tasks organized by a five-level cognition framework, with open-ended answers scored by an LLM judge against expert rubrics and a calibration step that corrects measured judge bias.
works.summary: The authors argue that AEC work is safety-critical and code-governed, so a pooled accuracy number says little about whether an LLM can be trusted in practice; competence has to be resolved by cognitive level. AECBench therefore arranges 23 practice-derived tasks along five levels — Knowledge Memorization, Knowledge Understanding, Knowledge Reasoning, Knowledge Calculation, and Knowledge Application — with the application level further split into analysis, evaluation, and creation. Objective items are scored by accuracy; open-ended items, up to roughly 2,000-word engineering documents, are scored by an LLM-as-a-Judge against rubrics predefined by domain experts. The paper treats that judge as an object of study rather than an oracle, measuring its bias against expert scores and fitting regression calibrations to correct it.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering: the question set is anchored in building codes and code tables, structural and seismic design, concrete structures, construction practice and engineering economics. Architectural and MEP design content is included as part of the AEC built-environment scope and folds into the same canonical domain; no second canonical domain is claimed.

zh.overview: AECBench 是一个面向建筑、工程与施工（AEC）领域的分层中文知识 benchmark：4,800 道由工程师命制的题目，按五级认知框架组织为 23 项任务，开放式作答由 LLM judge 依专家评分细则打分，并配有一道校准步骤来修正实测到的 judge 偏差。
zh.summary: 作者认为，AEC 工作事关安全、且由规范约束，一个笼统的总准确率说明不了 LLM 在实务中是否可信，能力必须按认知层级拆开来看。AECBench 因此把 23 项源自实务的任务沿五个层级排开——知识记忆、知识理解、知识推理、知识计算与知识应用，其中应用层再细分为分析、评价与创作。客观题按准确率计分；开放式题目——最长可达约 2,000 字的工程文档——则由 LLM-as-a-Judge 依领域专家预先设定的评分细则打分。论文没有把这个 judge 当成不容置疑的判准，而是当成研究对象：先量出它相对专家评分的偏差，再拟合回归模型加以校正。

works.title: CFDLLMBench
works.overview: CFDLLMBench is a three-tier benchmark suite for evaluating large language models on computational fluid dynamics, progressing from graduate-level CFD knowledge (CFDQuery) through numerical and physical reasoning in generated Python solvers (CFDCodeBench) to end-to-end OpenFOAM case configuration and execution (FoamBench).
works.summary: CFDLLMBench argues that CFD is a uniquely demanding testbed for scientific LLM capability because it requires domain knowledge, numerical method selection, and long-context software operation at once — and that prior CFD-LLM evaluation stopped at whether generated OpenFOAM cases execute, without asking whether the resulting simulation is physically correct. The suite is structured as three progressively harder tiers probing distinct competencies, so a model's profile across tiers is the reported result rather than one aggregate number. Its evaluation framework grades on outcomes rather than implementation: solutions are scored on executability, relative numerical error against reference solutions, and numerical convergence under mesh and time-step refinement. The paper evaluates both zero-shot LLMs and agentic frameworks (MetaOpenFOAM, Foam-Agent) on the hardest tier.
works.domains_text: Computational fluid dynamics and adjacent scientific computing: fluid mechanics, thermal transport, turbulence modeling, numerical methods and discretization, mesh generation, and OpenFOAM workflow operation.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: CFDLLMBench 是评估大语言模型计算流体力学（CFD）能力的三层 benchmark 套件，难度逐级递进：从研究生水平的 CFD 知识（CFDQuery），到生成 Python 求解器所需的数值与物理推理（CFDCodeBench），再到端到端的 OpenFOAM 算例配置与执行（FoamBench）。
zh.summary: 论文认为 CFD 是检验 LLM 科学能力的一块格外苛刻的试金石：它同时要求领域知识、数值方法选择以及长上下文下的软件操作；而此前的 CFD-LLM 评估往往止步于"生成的 OpenFOAM 算例能否跑起来"，并不追问由此得到的仿真在物理上是否正确。该套件被组织成三个难度递进、考察不同能力的层级，因此最终报告的是模型在各层上的能力剖面，而非单一聚合分数。其评估框架看结果而非实现方式：解答按可执行性、相对参考解的数值误差、以及在网格与时间步细化下的数值收敛性打分。论文在最难的一层上同时评估零样本 LLM 与 agentic 框架（MetaOpenFOAM、Foam-Agent）。

works.title: MatQnA
works.overview: MatQnA is a benchmark dataset for multimodal LLMs in materials characterization and analysis, spanning ten mainstream characterization methods — XPS, XRD, SEM, TEM and others — where the most advanced models (GPT-4.1, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, Doubao Vision Pro) already reach nearly 90% on objective questions.
works.summary: MatQnA organizes materials-characterization evaluation by method: ten mainstream techniques including X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, X-ray diffraction, scanning electron microscopy, and transmission electron microscopy. Its QA pairs — both multiple-choice and subjective — are built by a hybrid approach combining LLMs with human-in-the-loop validation. Preliminary results show frontier multimodal models (GPT-4.1, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, Doubao Vision Pro 32K) already achieve nearly 90% accuracy on objective data-interpretation questions, marking characterization QA as closer to solved than the harder reasoning benchmarks.
works.domains_text: Materials science — instrument-level materials characterization and analysis across ten techniques.

zh.overview: MatQnA 是面向多模态 LLM 的材料表征与分析 benchmark 数据集，覆盖十种主流表征方法——XPS、XRD、SEM、TEM 等——最先进的模型（GPT-4.1、Claude 4、Gemini 2.5、Doubao Vision Pro）在客观题上已接近 90%。
zh.summary: MatQnA 按方法组织材料表征评估：十种主流技术，含 X 射线光电子能谱、X 射线衍射、扫描电镜与透射电镜。其问答对——含选择题与主观题——由「LLM 加人类在环校验」的混合方式构建。初步结果显示，前沿多模态模型（GPT-4.1、Claude 4、Gemini 2.5、Doubao Vision Pro 32K）在客观的数据解读题上已达接近 90% 的准确率，这表明，相比更难的推理类 benchmark，表征问答已更接近被攻克。

works.title: MatCha
works.overview: MatCha is a multimodal benchmark on materials characterization: 1,500 questions across four key stages of materials research comprising 21 distinct tasks over real characterization imaging data, revealing a significant performance gap between multimodal LLMs and human experts.
works.summary: Published as "Can Multimodal LLMs See Materials Clearly?", MatCha asks whether MLLMs can do the perception-and-interpretation work of materials characterization. Its 1,500 questions span four key stages of materials research across 21 distinct tasks, grounded in real-world characterization imaging data. Models show a significant gap from human experts, degrade on questions requiring higher-level expertise, and are not rescued by simple few-shot or chain-of-thought prompting.
works.domains_text: Materials science — materials characterization across the research workflow, on real characterization imaging data.

zh.overview: MatCha 是材料表征的多模态 benchmark：1,500 个问题横跨材料研究的四个关键阶段、共 21 个不同任务，覆盖真实表征成像数据，揭示多模态 LLM 与人类专家之间的显著差距。
zh.summary: 论文题为「Can Multimodal LLMs See Materials Clearly?」。MatCha 追问 MLLM 能否承担材料表征中「感知与解读」的工作。其 1,500 个问题横跨材料研究的四个关键阶段、共 21 个不同任务，以真实表征成像数据为依据。模型与人类专家存在显著差距，在需要更高专业深度的问题上退化，且简单的少样本或链式思维提示都救不回来。

works.title: HiPhO
works.overview: HiPhO is a high-school physics olympiad benchmark compiling the 13 latest (2024–2025) international and regional olympiad exams, graded with official marking schemes at both answer and step level, and mapping model scores onto official gold/silver/bronze medal thresholds for direct comparison with human contestants.
works.summary: HiPhO's distinctive commitment is human-aligned evaluation: instead of inventing a grading scheme, it adopts the exams' official marking schemes for fine-grained answer- and step-level grading fully aligned with human examiners, then assigns medals by the official thresholds. The exams are the latest available (2024–2025), keeping contamination pressure low, and cover mixed text-only and diagram-based modalities. Across 30 state-of-the-art (M)LLMs: open-source MLLMs mostly remain at or below bronze; open-source LLMs show promising progress with multiple golds; closed-source reasoning MLLMs achieve 6 to 12 gold medals — yet most models remain far from full marks.
works.domains_text: High-school olympiad physics; subfield composition follows the source exams and is not separately enumerated.

zh.overview: HiPhO 是高中物理奥赛 benchmark，汇编 2024–2025 年最新的 13 套国际与地区奥赛真题，用官方评分方案在答案与步骤两级判分，并按官方奖牌线把模型分数映射为金、银、铜牌，与人类选手直接比较。
zh.summary: HiPhO 的独特承诺是与人对齐的评估：它不自创评分方案，而是采用赛事的官方评分方案，在答案级与步骤级做细粒度判分，与人类阅卷完全对齐，再按官方阈值授予奖牌。真题取最新的 2024–2025 赛季，污染压力低，且混合纯文本与图示两种模态。在 30 个最先进 (M)LLM 上：开源 MLLM 大多停留在铜牌线及以下；开源 LLM 进步明显、多次摘金；闭源推理 MLLM 拿到 6 到 12 枚金牌——但大多数模型距满分仍有显著差距。

works.title: CMPhysBench
works.overview: CMPhysBench is a benchmark of more than 520 meticulously curated graduate-level calculation problems in condensed matter physics, scored with Scalable Expression Edit Distance (SEED), a fine-grained non-binary partial-credit measure over solution expressions.
works.summary: CMPhysBench targets condensed matter physics — magnetism, superconductivity, strongly correlated systems, and foundational theoretical frameworks — with calculation-based problems that require the model to generate a comprehensive solution independently rather than select an answer. Its SEED score assigns partial credit by expression similarity, complementing binary accuracy.
works.domains_text: Condensed matter physics: magnetism, superconductivity, strongly correlated systems, and foundational theoretical frameworks.

zh.overview: CMPhysBench 是凝聚态物理领域的 benchmark，含 520 余道精心整理的研究生水平计算题，用 Scalable Expression Edit Distance（SEED）——一种对解答表达式的细粒度、非二元部分得分——进行评分。
zh.summary: CMPhysBench 面向凝聚态物理——磁学、超导、强关联体系与基础理论框架——的计算型问题，要求模型独立生成完整解答而非选出答案。其 SEED 分数按表达式相似度给出部分得分，与二元准确率互补。

works.title: CEQuest
works.overview: CEQuest is a 164-question benchmark on construction drawing interpretation and construction estimation, written by domain experts from construction estimating textbooks and drawing-interpretation guides, and used to compare five LLMs on accuracy, evaluation time, and model size.
works.summary: The paper argues that general-purpose LLM benchmarks such as MMLU and HellaSwag do not capture the reasoning required in construction, and that existing construction datasets such as FloorPlanCAD target visual symbol recognition rather than the textual reasoning and estimation that construction professionals actually perform. CEQuest is presented as a pilot benchmark filling that gap: a curated question set covering the progression from foundational drawing literacy through spatial cross-referencing to quantity takeoff and cost estimation. Five LLMs — four open-weight models served locally through Ollama plus GPT-4.1 through the OpenAI API — are evaluated on it, with each run repeated five times and reported as mean ± standard deviation. The authors report that no model exceeds 80% accuracy and diagnose two recurring failure modes: inability to hold the required answer format, and estimation answers that are numerically plausible but violate professional practice.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering. The evaluated objective is construction engineering work on building projects: reading and cross-referencing construction drawings, identifying drawing elements and view types, and performing quantity takeoff and cost estimation from dimensional data. This falls under the domain's construction engineering, planning, scheduling and quantity/cost estimation scope. The worked failure case in the paper is a concrete-slab volume computation (5.33 cubic yards) where the models pick the nearest integer rather than rounding up as professional estimating practice requires — an estimating-practice judgement, not document comprehension for its own sake. The authors are from Florida International University and the University of Florida. No structural analysis, member design, or code-compliance checking is evaluated, so no additional co-domain is assigned.

zh.overview: CEQuest 是一个含 164 道题目的 benchmark，考察施工图纸解读与工程造价估算。题目由领域专家依据造价估算教材与图纸解读指南编写，并用于在准确率、评测耗时与模型规模三个维度上比较五个 LLM。
zh.summary: 论文认为，MMLU、HellaSwag 这类通用 LLM benchmark 反映不出建筑施工所需的推理能力；而 FloorPlanCAD 等已有的建筑类数据集针对的是视觉符号识别，并非施工从业者真正在做的文字推理与造价估算。论文把 CEQuest 定位为填补这一空白的试点 benchmark：题目经过精选，覆盖从最基础的读图能力，到跨图纸的空间对照，再到工程量计算与造价估算这一进阶过程。作者在其上评测了五个 LLM——四个通过 Ollama 本地部署的开放权重模型，加上通过 OpenAI API 调用的 GPT-4.1——每次运行重复五遍，以均值 ± 标准差报告。作者称没有模型的准确率超过 80%，并指出两种反复出现的失败模式：无法稳定遵守要求的作答格式；以及估算结果在数值上看似合理，却违背行业实务规范。

works.title: CODE2BENCH
works.overview: CODE2BENCH is a dynamic benchmark-construction framework that mines recent real-world code repositories and generates Python and Java tasks under a 100% branch-coverage quality gate.
works.summary: CODE2BENCH combines two forms of scaling: continuously refreshing task sources from recent repositories and increasing test rigor through property-based testing. Scope-graph analysis classifies dependencies, and generated suites must achieve 100% branch coverage before admission. CODE2BENCH-2509 contains native Python and Java tracks drawn from 220 Python and 189 Java repositories and is evaluated on ten models.
works.domains_text: Software engineering and code generation. The contribution is benchmark construction rather than a scientific application task, so it is not added to the domain axis.

zh.overview: CODE2BENCH 是动态 benchmark 构造框架。它从近期真实 code repository 中取材，为 Python 和 Java 生成任务，并要求测试达到 100% branch coverage 才能入库。
zh.summary: CODE2BENCH 同时扩展两件事：从近期 repository 持续刷新任务来源，并用 property-based testing 提高测试严谨度。Scope graph 用于分类依赖，生成的测试必须覆盖全部 branch。CODE2BENCH-2509 含原生 Python 与 Java track，来源涉及 220 个 Python 和 189 个 Java repository，并测试了十个模型。

works.title: QCBench
works.overview: QCBench evaluates LLMs on domain-specific quantitative chemistry: 350 computational problems across 7 chemistry subfields in three difficulty tiers, structured to prevent heuristic shortcuts and demand explicit step-by-step numerical reasoning.
works.summary: QCBench targets the gap between language fluency and scientific computation: 350 quantitative problems spanning analytical, bio/organic, general, inorganic, physical, polymer, and quantum chemistry, tiered as easy, medium, and difficult. Problems are constructed so heuristic pattern-matching fails and explicit numerical work is required. Evaluations of 24 LLMs show consistent performance degradation as task complexity increases.
works.domains_text: Chemistry — quantitative and computational chemistry across seven named subfields.

zh.overview: QCBench 评估 LLM 的领域定量化学能力：350 个计算题覆盖 7 个化学子领域、分三档难度，题目结构上防住启发式捷径，必须做显式的分步数值推理。
zh.summary: QCBench 瞄准语言流畅与科学计算之间的落差：350 个定量问题横跨分析化学、生物/有机化学、普通化学、无机化学、物理化学、高分子化学与量子化学，按易、中、难分档。题目的构造让模式匹配无从下手，必须真正完成数值计算。对 24 个 LLM 的评测显示，随任务复杂度上升，性能一致地下降。

works.title: FGBench
works.overview: FGBench evaluates molecular property reasoning at functional-group granularity: 625K generated problems annotated with which of 245 functional groups drive a property difference, with a 7K curated subset used to benchmark state-of-the-art LLMs.
works.summary: FGBench asks not just whether a model predicts a molecular property but whether it can reason about *why* — localized to functional groups. The dataset comprises 625K property-reasoning problems covering 245 functional groups in three settings: single functional-group impacts, multiple functional-group interactions, and direct molecular comparisons, spanning both regression and classification. Benchmarking on 7K curated problems shows current LLMs struggle with functional-group-level property reasoning.
works.domains_text: Chemistry — structure–property relationships at functional-group level, motivated by molecular design and drug discovery.

zh.overview: FGBench 在官能团粒度上评估分子性质推理：62.5 万个生成的推理问题，标注了是 245 个官能团中的哪一个驱动了性质差异；另设 7,000 个精选子集用于评测最先进的 LLM。
zh.summary: FGBench 问的不只是模型能否预测分子性质，而是它能否说清「为什么」——并把原因定位到官能团。数据集含 62.5 万个性质推理问题，覆盖 245 个官能团，分三种设定：单官能团影响、多官能团相互作用、分子间直接对比，同时包含回归与分类任务。在 7,000 个精选问题上的评测显示，当前 LLM 在官能团层面的性质推理上明显吃力。

works.title: Evaluation and Benchmarking of LLM Agents: A Survey
works.overview: *Evaluation and Benchmarking of LLM Agents: A Survey* is a survey of the LLM-agent evaluation field that introduces a two-dimensional taxonomy organizing existing work by evaluation objectives (what to evaluate) and evaluation process (how to evaluate), and highlights enterprise-specific evaluation challenges. It is included here as a reference paper, not a benchmark contribution.
works.summary: The survey provides an in-depth overview of LLM-agent evaluation, which it characterizes as a complex and underdeveloped area. It organizes the field along a two-dimensional taxonomy: (1) evaluation objectives — what to evaluate, such as agent behavior, capabilities, reliability, and safety; and (2) evaluation process — how to evaluate, including interaction modes, datasets and benchmarks, metric computation methods, and tooling. Beyond the taxonomy, it highlights enterprise-specific challenges often overlooked in current research — role-based access to data, reliability guarantees, dynamic and long-horizon interactions, and compliance — and identifies future directions toward holistic, more realistic, and scalable evaluation.
works.domains_text: Cross-domain coverage: LLM-agent evaluation and benchmarking, with explicit attention to enterprise deployment settings.

zh.overview: *Evaluation and Benchmarking of LLM Agents: A Survey* 是一篇关于 LLM-agent 评估领域的综述：提出一个二维分类法，沿 evaluation objectives（评估什么）与 evaluation process（如何评估）组织现有工作，并强调面向企业部署的评估挑战。此处以**参考论文**（非 benchmark 贡献）纳入。
zh.summary: 综述对 LLM-agent 评估——它称之为一个复杂且尚不成熟的领域——作了深入综述。它沿二维分类法组织领域：(1) evaluation objectives——评估什么，如 agent behavior、capabilities、reliability 与 safety；(2) evaluation process——如何评估，包括 interaction modes、datasets and benchmarks、metric computation methods 与 tooling。除分类法外，它还强调了当前研究常忽视的面向企业的挑战——role-based data access、reliability guarantees、dynamic and long-horizon interactions 与 compliance——并指出面向 holistic、更现实、可扩展评估的未来方向。

works.title: PhysGym
works.overview: PhysGym is a benchmark suite and simulation platform for LLM-based agents in interactive physics discovery: agents actively probe simulated environments, gather data sequentially under constraints, and formulate hypotheses about underlying physical laws — with sophisticated control over how much prior knowledge the agent is given.
works.summary: PhysGym's distinctive axis is prior-knowledge control: the same discovery problem can be posed at four levels of provided priors (L1–L4 per the official repository), so the benchmark can separate what an agent discovers from what it was told. The suite comprises 97 curated physics problems (sourced from PHYBench, per the official repository) run as interactive simulations with limited experimental budgets, and provides standardized evaluation protocols and metrics for assessing hypothesis accuracy and model fidelity.
works.domains_text: Physics discovery over interactive simulations of physical laws; problems are sourced from the PHYBench problem set.

zh.overview: PhysGym 是面向 LLM agent 交互式物理发现的 benchmark 套件与模拟平台：agent 主动探查模拟环境、在约束下逐步采集数据、并就底层物理定律提出假设——其特色是对提供给 agent 的先验知识做精细控制。
zh.summary: PhysGym 的独特维度是先验知识控制：同一个发现问题可以在四个先验层级（据官方仓库为 L1–L4）下布置，从而把「agent 发现了什么」与「agent 被告知了什么」分开。套件含 97 个精选物理问题（据官方仓库，取自 PHYBench），以带有限实验预算的交互模拟形式运行，并提供评估假设准确性与模型保真度的标准化协议与指标。

works.title: From Queries to Criteria: Understanding How Astronomers Evaluate LLMs
works.overview: An empirical study of how domain experts actually judge an LLM system in situ: 368 real queries and 11 interviews from a four-week deployment of an astronomy literature RAG bot are inductively coded into a query taxonomy and five evaluation criteria, which are then used to build and release a 40-item expert-authored astronomy benchmark with an automatic scoring protocol validated against user ratings.
works.summary: The authors deployed `@Ask-astro-ph`, a Slack retrieval-augmented-generation bot over roughly 300,000 astrophysics arXiv papers (through July 2023) using bge-small-en-v1.5 retrieval of the top five papers and GPT-4o for generation, to astronomers at the Space Telescope Science Institute. Over four weeks (29 May – 24 June 2024) 35 of 43 recruited participants issued 368 queries; eleven were interviewed afterwards. Inductive coding of the queries yields a nine-type query taxonomy, and the interviews yield five criteria astronomers apply when judging responses — criteria that existing multiple-choice astronomy benchmarks largely do not capture. The findings are turned into concrete benchmark-construction recommendations and instantiated as a 40-question benchmark with expert-written gold answers, whose automatic relevance scores correlate at Pearson 0.82 with real user thumbs-up/down ratings.
works.domains_text: Astronomy — the deployed system, the participant population (PhD astronomers at the Space Telescope Science Institute), the retrieval corpus (astrophysics arXiv), and every benchmark question and gold answer are astronomical. The authors expect the evaluation framing to generalize to other observational and semi-verifiable sciences, but the evaluated material is astronomy throughout.

zh.overview: 一项实证研究，考察领域专家在真实工作现场究竟如何评判一个 LLM 系统：作者把一个天文文献 RAG 机器人四周部署期内的 368 条真实提问与 11 次访谈作归纳编码，提炼出一套提问类型学与五条评价准则，再据此构建并公开了一个 40 道题、由专家撰写答案的天文 benchmark，其自动打分协议已对照用户评分完成校验。
zh.summary: 作者把 `@Ask-astro-ph` 部署给 Space Telescope Science Institute 的天文学家使用。这是一个 Slack 上的检索增强生成机器人，语料为约 30 万篇天体物理 arXiv 论文（截至 2023 年 7 月），先用 bge-small-en-v1.5 检索出最相关的五篇，再交由 GPT-4o 生成回答。四周之内（2024 年 5 月 29 日至 6 月 24 日），43 位招募到的参与者中有 35 位共提出 368 条提问，事后有 11 位接受了访谈。对提问作归纳编码，得到九类提问的类型学；访谈则归纳出天文学家评判回答时所用的五条准则——现有的天文选择题 benchmark 基本捕捉不到这些准则。这些发现被转化为具体的 benchmark 构建建议，并落实为一个 40 题、附专家撰写标准答案的 benchmark；它的自动相关性得分与真实用户的点赞/点踩评分的 Pearson 相关系数达到 0.82。

works.title: MMCircuitEval
works.overview: MMCircuitEval is the first multimodal circuit-focused benchmark for evaluating LLMs: 3,614 curated question–answer pairs spanning digital and analog circuits across critical EDA stages — from general knowledge and specifications to front-end and back-end design — drawn from textbooks, question banks, datasheets, and real-world documentation.
works.summary: MMCircuitEval organizes circuit evaluation along the design flow: its 3,614 QA pairs span digital and analog circuits across EDA stages from general knowledge and specifications to front-end and back-end design, sourced from textbooks, technical question banks, datasheets, and real-world documentation. Questions carry image inputs and come in multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blank, and open-ended formats, categorized by design stage, circuit type, tested ability (knowledge, comprehension, reasoning, computation), and difficulty. The evaluation surfaces significant performance gaps among current models, particularly in back-end design and complex computations.
works.domains_text: Electrical Engineering — digital and analog circuit knowledge and design across EDA stages, with multimodal (image + text) inputs.

zh.overview: MMCircuitEval 是评测 LLM 的首个以电路为中心的多模态 benchmark：3,614 个精选问答对，横跨数字与模拟电路、覆盖关键 EDA 阶段——从通用知识与规格到前端与后端设计——取自教科书、题库、数据手册与真实文档。
zh.summary: MMCircuitEval 沿设计流程组织电路评估：其 3,614 个问答对横跨数字与模拟电路、覆盖从通用知识与规格到前端与后端设计的 EDA 阶段，取自教科书、技术题库、数据手册与真实文档。问题带图像输入，形式包括选择题、填空题与开放题，按设计阶段、电路类型、所测能力（知识、理解、推理、计算）与难度分类。评测揭示当前模型间存在显著性能差距，尤其在后端设计与复杂计算上。

works.title: DrafterBench
works.overview: DrafterBench is an open-source benchmark for LLM agents on technical-drawing revision in civil engineering: 1,920 tasks built from twelve revision task types and 46 custom drawing-manipulation tools, scored by reading the recorded operation chain rather than the rendered drawing.
works.summary: The authors identify drawing revision as, in their words, "one of the most labor-intensive and low-tech tasks that needs automation in Civil Engineering", based on interviews with more than ten North American construction companies, and turn it into an agent benchmark. Tasks are summarized from 100+ real revision files supplied by design firms and construction companies, and are issued to the model as natural-language revision instructions over PDF drawings containing text, tables and vector entities such as lines, rebars and columns. Beyond plain function calling, the benchmark deliberately probes whether an agent can work from instructions that are unstructured, vague, or incomplete, and whether it applies unstated drafting conventions — what the paper calls implicit policy awareness, for example saving the revised file under a company-policy filename. Scoring is fully automatic: dual functions log the operation path without modifying files, so an agent's operation chain is compared against a reference chain instead of the rendered PDF being inspected visually.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering: the task universe is civil-engineering construction drawings and the revision workflow that design firms and construction companies run between the design and construction stages, with drawing objects including structural entities such as rebars and columns. No co-domain is claimed — the benchmark evaluates document-level engineering production work rather than analysis of a physical structure.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: DrafterBench 是一个开源 benchmark，考察 LLM agent 做土木工程施工图修改：以十二类修改任务和 46 个自制图纸操作工具构建出 1,920 道题，判分读的是记录下来的操作链，而不是渲染出来的图纸。
zh.summary: 作者走访了十余家北美建筑施工企业，据此认定图纸修改——用他们的话说——是「土木工程中最耗人力、技术含量最低而又需要自动化的任务之一」，于是把它做成了一个 agent benchmark。任务取自设计院与施工企业提供的 100 多份真实修改文件，以自然语言修改指令的形式下达给模型，操作对象是 PDF 图纸中的文字、表格，以及线条、钢筋、柱子这类矢量图元。除普通的函数调用外，benchmark 还刻意考察两件事：agent 能否在指令不规整、含糊或信息不全时照样把活干完，以及它会不会遵守指令中未言明的制图惯例——论文称之为隐性惯例意识（implicit policy awareness），例如按公司命名规则保存修改后的文件。判分完全自动：一套镜像函数（dual functions）在不改动文件的前提下记录操作路径，因此比对的是 agent 的操作链与参考操作链，不必人眼去看渲染出的 PDF。

works.title: OpenXRD
works.overview: OpenXRD is a benchmark framework for LLM and multimodal-LLM X-ray diffraction question answering: 217 expert-curated crystallography questions evaluated across 74 state-of-the-art models under closed-book and open-book conditions, finding that expert-reviewed context helps mid-sized models most.
works.summary: XRD is the workhorse of crystallography, and OpenXRD tests whether foundation models understand it: 217 expert-curated XRD questions answered by 74 LLMs and MLLMs (7B–70B and beyond), in both closed-book form and open-book form with supporting passages. The passages are generated by GPT-4.5 and refined by crystallography experts, which sets up the headline finding — expert-reviewed materials give significantly larger gains than AI-generated ones even at matched token counts, and mid-sized models benefit most while very large models saturate or suffer interference.
works.domains_text: Materials science — crystallography: X-ray diffraction knowledge and reasoning.

zh.overview: OpenXRD 是面向 LLM 与多模态 LLM 的 X 射线衍射问答 benchmark 框架：217 个专家策划的晶体学问题，在 74 个最先进模型上以闭卷与开卷两种条件评测，发现专家审校的上下文对中等规模模型帮助最大。
zh.summary: XRD 是晶体学的主力工具，OpenXRD 检验基础模型是否懂它：217 个专家策划的 XRD 问题，由 74 个 LLM 与 MLLM（7B–70B 乃至更大）作答，分闭卷与带辅助段落的开卷两种形式。段落由 GPT-4.5 生成、经晶体学专家审校，由此引出头条发现——即使 token 数相同，专家审校的材料带来的提升也显著大于 AI 生成的材料，且中等规模模型受益最多，而超大模型则出现饱和，甚至反而受到干扰。

works.title: SimAgents
works.overview: SimAgents is a multi-agent LLM system that reads cosmological simulation papers and reconstructs the simulation's configuration parameters in a form the simulation software will accept, released together with a manually annotated evaluation dataset of more than 40 published simulations and a parameter-level scoring protocol against single-agent baselines.
works.summary: The paper starts from a concrete bottleneck in computational cosmology: the parameters needed to reproduce a published simulation are scattered through dense prose in different models and formats, and translating them into an executable configuration is slow and error-prone. SimAgents assigns the task to specialised agents that collaborate through structured discussion — a Physics Agent that interprets the paper with domain knowledge, a Software Agent that enforces the constraints written in the simulation code's user manual, and an Analysis Code Writer that produces visualisation and preliminary-analysis code once the configuration is fixed. To measure whether the extracted configurations are correct, the authors build an evaluation dataset by collecting more than 40 simulations from arXiv and from journals including ApJ and MNRAS and hand-annotating every relevant parameter/value pair, then score SimAgents against chain-of-thought and exchange-of-thought baselines under both human and automatic grading.
works.domains_text: Astronomy. The evaluated objective is the configuration of cosmological simulations: the annotated ground truth consists of cosmological parameters (matter, baryon and dark-energy density, Hubble parameter, σ8, spectral index) and initial-condition settings for MP-Gadget, and the reference simulations are established cosmological structure-formation suites. Physics is a secondary co-domain through the cosmological model the parameters describe.

zh.overview: SimAgents 是一个多 agent LLM 系统：它读取宇宙学模拟论文，把论文中的模拟配置参数还原成模拟软件可以直接接受的形式。系统随附一套人工标注的评估数据集，收录 40 余项已发表模拟，并配有一套参数级的评分协议，用于与单 agent 基线对照。
zh.summary: 论文的出发点是计算宇宙学中的一个具体瓶颈：复现一项已发表模拟所需的参数散落在密集的正文里，模型不同、格式各异，把它们翻译成可执行的配置既慢又容易出错。SimAgents 把这件事交给一组分工明确、通过结构化讨论协作的 agent——Physics Agent 用领域知识解读论文，Software Agent 依模拟代码用户手册中写明的约束把关，Analysis Code Writer 则在配置确定之后生成可视化与初步分析代码。为检验抽取出的配置是否正确，作者从 arXiv 以及 ApJ、MNRAS 等期刊收集 40 余项模拟，逐一人工标注全部相关的参数/取值对，构成评估数据集，再在人工评分与自动评分两种方式下，把 SimAgents 与 chain-of-thought、exchange-of-thought 两个基线作对比。

works.title: CosmoPaperQA
works.overview: CosmoPaperQA is a 105-pair cosmology question-answering dataset built from five highly cited cosmology papers, used to evaluate nine retrieval-augmented-generation (RAG) agent configurations against expert human grading and to calibrate an LLM-as-a-Judge grader as a proxy for that human evaluation.
works.summary: The work starts from the observation that existing astronomy QA resources are largely synthetic — AstroMLab 1's 4,425 AI-generated multiple-choice questions and Astro-QA's 3,082 questions are cited as the comparison points — and instead extracts questions directly from real research papers. A team of expert cosmologists wrote 105 question-answer pairs spanning three complexity tiers: factual retrieval of specific parameters, synthetic reasoning that integrates multiple pieces of evidence, and analytical interpretation requiring deep domain expertise. Nine RAG configurations were run over the same five-paper corpus, producing 945 answers, all of which a single PhD-level domain expert graded by hand. Those 945 human grades were then used to calibrate two LLM judges, which reproduced the human ranking of systems closely enough (Pearson r > 0.99 across evaluation methods) for the authors to propose LLM-as-a-Judge as a scalable substitute for expert grading.
works.domains_text: Astronomy. Every question is drawn from cosmology literature — CMB power-spectrum and parameter results, Hubble-constant measurements, cosmological simulations, and galaxy-level cosmological inference — so the evaluated objective is astrophysical domain understanding rather than generic reading comprehension. Physics is a secondary co-domain through the cosmological-parameter physics the questions probe.

zh.overview: CosmoPaperQA 是一份含 105 组问答对的宇宙学问答数据集，题目取自五篇高引宇宙学论文。它用来评测九种检索增强生成（RAG）agent 配置，以专家人工评分为对照，并据此校准一个 LLM-as-a-Judge 评分器，让它充当人工评估的替代。
zh.summary: 这项工作的出发点是一个观察：现有的天文问答资源大多是合成的——文中以 AstroMLab 1 的 4,425 道 AI 生成选择题和 Astro-QA 的 3,082 道题作为对照——因此它改从真实研究论文中直接提取问题。一支宇宙学专家团队撰写了 105 组问答对，分三个复杂度层级：具体参数的事实检索、需要整合多处证据的综合推理，以及需要深厚领域造诣的分析性阐释。九种 RAG 配置在同一份五篇论文的语料上运行，共产生 945 份回答，全部由一位博士级领域专家逐条人工评分。这 945 个人工评分随后用于校准两个 LLM judge；两者复现系统排名的吻合程度足够高（各评估方法之间 Pearson r > 0.99），作者据此提出把 LLM-as-a-Judge 作为专家评分的可规模化替代。

works.title: SciGym
works.overview: SciGym measures the scientific capabilities of language models with a systems-biology dry lab: agents iteratively design experiments and analyze the resulting simulated data on biological systems encoded in the Systems Biology Markup Language (SBML), submitting hypothesized mechanisms against hidden ground-truth systems.
works.summary: SciGym addresses the cost problem of evaluating open-ended experimentation: wet labs are too expensive to run at benchmark scale, so it substitutes a dry lab that simulates data from hidden SBML-encoded biological systems. Agents choose experiments sequentially, observe simulated results, and submit SBML-format hypotheses, with error-checking and configurable resubmission rounds (per the official repository). Six frontier LLMs are evaluated on 137 small systems, with 350 systems released in total; all models' performance declines significantly as system complexity increases.
works.domains_text: Systems biology: mechanistic models of biological systems encoded in SBML.

zh.overview: SciGym 用一个系统生物学干实验（dry lab）来测量语言模型的科学能力：agent 在以 SBML（Systems Biology Markup Language）编码的生物系统上迭代地设计实验、分析模拟数据，并对照隐藏的真值系统提交机制假设。
zh.summary: SciGym 直面开放式实验评估的成本问题：湿实验太贵，无法以 benchmark 规模运行，于是用干实验代替——由隐藏的 SBML 编码生物系统生成模拟数据。agent 按序选择实验、观察模拟结果、以 SBML 格式提交假设，配错误检查与可配置的重提交轮次（据官方仓库）。六个前沿 LLM 在 137 个小型系统上受评，共发布 350 个系统；所有模型的表现都随系统复杂度上升而显著下降。

works.title: EngDesign
works.overview: EngDesign is a benchmark of 101 real-world engineering **design** tasks across nine engineering areas in which an LLM must produce a functional design artifact that is then verified by domain simulators rather than checked against a reference answer.
works.summary: EngDesign is built on the argument that existing engineering evaluations measure textbook recall, whereas real engineering asks for a design that satisfies stated goals, constraints, and performance requirements. Each task therefore gives the model a design specification and expects a structured design output, which an automated pipeline feeds to a domain-specific simulator (MATLAB, SPICE/Cadence, finite element analysis, or a hand-written evaluation script) for functional verification. Every task returns a binary pass/fail verdict, a 0–100 numerical score, and an evaluation log, and the harness additionally supports an iterative protocol in which the model receives simulator feedback and revises its design. The authors evaluate 12 chat and reasoning LLMs and report that even the strongest model passes only a minority of tasks on a first attempt.
works.domains_text: The benchmark is explicitly multi-domain. **Civil & Structural Engineering** is represented by the Structure Design area, whose tasks size structural members (truss member area, steel beam thickness) and lay out load-carrying structure under support and volume constraints using finite-element and topology-optimisation verification. Co-domains: Mechanical & Aerospace (Mechanical Systems, and the solid-mechanics content shared with Structure Design), Electrical (Control Design, Digital Hardware Design, Analog IC Design, Signal Processing), Robotics (robot design and planning tasks), and Computer Science / Software & Systems (Operating System Design, Computer Architecture Design). The paper does not tie the Structure Design tasks to any building or bridge design code.

zh.overview: EngDesign 收录 101 项来自真实工程的**设计**任务，横跨九个工程方向。LLM 必须交出一份可用的设计成果，再由领域仿真器验证其功能是否达标，而不是拿去和参考答案比对。
zh.summary: EngDesign 的立论是：现有工程评估考的是教科书式的记忆，而真实工程要的是一份能同时满足既定目标、约束与性能要求的设计。因此每项任务给模型一份设计规格，要求它输出结构化的设计方案；自动化管线再把方案送进对应领域的仿真器（MATLAB、SPICE/Cadence、有限元分析，或一段手写的评估脚本）做功能验证。每项任务都会给出通过/不通过的二元判定、一个 0–100 的数值分数和一份评估日志；评测框架还支持一种迭代协议——把仿真器的反馈回传给模型，让它修改设计。作者评测了 12 个对话型与推理型 LLM，结果是：即便最强的模型，首次尝试也只能通过其中少数任务。

works.title: PAC Bench
works.overview: PAC Bench asks whether foundation models understand the prerequisites for executing manipulation policies — object Properties, Affordances, and Constraints: over 30,000 annotations spanning 673 real-world images (115 object classes), 100 real humanoid-view scenarios, and 120 simulated constraint scenarios across four tasks.
works.summary: Before a robot plans a manipulation, something must know that a glass is fragile, a handle affords pulling, and an overhang blocks a grasp. PAC Bench evaluates exactly this prerequisite layer from a task-executability perspective: VLMs answer property, affordance, and constraint questions over real images (including Unitree G1 humanoid-view captures) and simulated constraint scenarios. The evaluations reveal significant gaps in current VLMs' grasp of fundamental physical concepts — on identifying all correct affordances, performance drops to near zero for most models (project page).
works.domains_text: Robotics — manipulation-prerequisite understanding evaluated on real robot-viewpoint (Unitree G1) and tabletop imagery, framed by executability for manipulation policies.

zh.overview: PAC Bench 追问基础模型是否理解执行操作策略的前提——物体的属性（Properties）、affordance 与约束（Constraints）：30,000+ 条标注，覆盖 673 张真实图像（115 个物体类别）、100 个真实人形机器人第一视角场景与四类任务下的 120 个模拟约束场景。
zh.summary: 机器人规划一次操作之前，总得有东西知道玻璃杯易碎、把手可拉、悬垂物挡住抓取。PAC Bench 从「任务可执行性」角度评估的正是这个前提层：VLM 在真实图像（含 Unitree G1 人形机器人视角拍摄）与模拟约束场景上回答属性、affordance 与约束问题。评估暴露出当前 VLM 对基本物理概念理解的显著缺口——在「识别全部正确 affordance」上，多数模型的表现掉到接近零（项目页）。

works.title: SDBench
works.overview: SDBench (the Sequential Diagnosis Benchmark) recasts 304 diagnostically challenging NEJM clinicopathological conference cases as interactive encounters: the agent starts from a short case abstract and must iteratively request findings from a gatekeeper model that reveals information only when explicitly queried, scored on diagnostic accuracy and the cost of visits and tests ordered. The accompanying MAI-DxO orchestrator is agent-construction work (see the repository note under Limitations).
works.summary: SDBench makes diagnosis a budgeted information-acquisition problem: every test ordered has a cost, and the gatekeeper reveals findings only on explicit request, so the evaluated quantity is the accuracy-cost frontier rather than accuracy alone. Models from the OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek, and Llama families are evaluated alongside 21 practicing US/UK physicians (mean 20% accuracy on completed cases, per the official page). The paper's paired MAI-DxO orchestrator with o3 reaches 80% accuracy — four times the physician average — while cutting diagnostic costs 20% versus physicians and 70% versus off-the-shelf o3; its maximum-accuracy configuration reaches 85.5%.
works.domains_text: Clinical diagnosis (general and internal medicine via NEJM-CPC cases), diagnostic testing, and cost of care.

zh.overview: SDBench（Sequential Diagnosis Benchmark）把 304 个高难度 NEJM 临床病理讨论会（CPC）病例改造成交互式接诊：agent 从简短的病例摘要出发，须向一个「守门人」模型逐条索取检查发现——信息只有被明确问到才会给出——评分同时看诊断准确率与就诊和检查的花费。配套的 MAI-DxO 编排器属于 agent 构建工作（见 Limitations 中的 repository note）。
zh.summary: SDBench 把诊断变成预算化的信息获取问题：每项检查都有费用，守门人只应答被明确提出的询问，被评估的因此是「准确率-成本前沿」而非单独的准确率。OpenAI、Gemini、Claude、Grok、DeepSeek 与 Llama 系模型与 21 位美英执业医生（据官方页完成病例的平均准确率为 20%）同场受评。论文配套的 MAI-DxO 编排器搭配 o3 达到 80% 准确率——医生平均值的四倍——同时比医生降低 20% 诊断费用、比裸用 o3 降低 70%；最高准确率配置达 85.5%。

works.title: A Large Language Model-Empowered Agent for Reliable and Robust Structural Analysis
works.overview: An eight-problem beam structural-analysis benchmark paired with two explicitly defined measures — reliability (fraction of correct outputs over repeated identical runs) and robustness (stability of that reliability as load position and boundary conditions vary) — used first to characterize a bare LLM and then an OpenSeesPy code-generating agent on the same problems.
works.summary: The work asks how reliable and robust a state-of-the-art LLM is on structural analysis that demands exact numerical computation, and builds a small benchmark specifically to answer it. Eight statically determinate beam problems are constructed, and Llama-3.3 70B Instruct is sampled 500 times per problem configuration to measure reliability, then re-sampled across the full sweep of load positions to measure robustness. Finding that the model reasons qualitatively about statics but cannot be trusted quantitatively, the authors reframe the task from text generation to code generation and build an agent that emits OpenSeesPy code, executes it, and visualizes the result with OpsVis. The same benchmark and the same two measures are then applied to the agent, so the before/after comparison is made on identical ground.
works.domains_text: Civil & Structural Engineering. The evaluated objective is a structural-mechanics decision on a load-bearing member: static equilibrium analysis of beams to obtain support reactions, with bending-moment and shear diagrams produced for the extended tasks. The paper positions the work explicitly within civil engineering and treats beam analysis as the foundational step before larger structural systems. No co-domain is assigned — OpenSeesPy is the means, not the evaluated objective.

activities.name: Scientific Software & Workflow Engineering
activities.zh_name: 科学软件与工作流工程

zh.overview: 一个含八道梁结构分析题的 benchmark，配两项定义明确的指标——可靠性（同一题重复运行中输出正确的比例）与鲁棒性（荷载位置与边界条件变化时，可靠性保持稳定的程度）。作者先用它刻画一个裸 LLM，再在同一组题目上刻画一个生成 OpenSeesPy 代码的 agent。
zh.summary: 结构分析要求精确的数值计算，当今最强的 LLM 在这类任务上究竟有多可靠、多稳健？论文正是为回答这个问题专门搭了一个小 benchmark。作者构造八道静定梁题目，每种题目配置采样 Llama-3.3 70B Instruct 500 次以测可靠性，再把荷载位置扫一遍、重新采样以测鲁棒性。结果显示模型对静力学有定性的把握，定量上却不可信；于是作者把任务从文本生成改写为代码生成，构建一个 agent 输出 OpenSeesPy 代码、执行它，并用 OpsVis 把结果画出来。同一套 benchmark、同样两项指标再用到 agent 上，改造前后的对比因此站在同一基准上。

works.title: ChemEBench
works.overview: ChemEBench is a chemical-engineering evaluation benchmark introduced alongside ChemELLM, a 70-billion-parameter domain-specific language model built on Spark-70B by the Dalian Institute of Chemical Physics and iFLYTEK. It organizes evaluation into three progressive levels covering 15 dimensions and 101 distinct chemical-engineering tasks, from foundational domain knowledge through professional engineering skills such as equipment selection, separation, heat transfer, process safety, and process economics.
works.summary: The paper "From lab to fab: A large language model for chemical engineering" presents three coupled artifacts: ChemEData, a curated chemical-engineering corpus of 19 billion pre-training tokens and 1 billion fine-tuning tokens; ChemELLM, a 70B model obtained by domain-adaptive pre-training and supervised fine-tuning of Spark-70B on that corpus; and ChemEBench, described by the authors as the first multidimensional benchmark for chemical engineering. ChemEBench is used to compare ChemELLM against fourteen mainstream commercial and open-weight models on a level-structured task suite that rises from factual chemical-engineering knowledge to applied professional skills. The framing of the benchmark is capability measurement in a discipline where general-purpose models are argued to be shallow, rather than agentic or tool-using evaluation.
